drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.06111 Sections 3–5 and Figure 7. CSR-Bench starts from over 1,500 top-star GitHub repositories associated with more than ten major NLP, CV, AI, ML, and data-mining conferences. Candidates are grouped into NLP, computer vision, LLM, machine-learning, and interdisciplinary areas, ranked by stars, and manually screened for sufficient README documentation, deployable code, topic diversity, self-containment, and permissive licensing, leaving 100 repositories. The README is the primary deployment source and directory structure, source code, and scripts are supplementary. Command Drafter produces Bash commands in up to five sections: prerequisite setup, data/model download, training, inference, and evaluation. Script Executor runs them in a standardized Docker/Bash environment and an LLM parses stdout/stderr into a return state. Failures progress through Log Analyzer, BM25 retrieval over repository Issues, and Perplexity web search, with limited retries. The paper's metric is completion rate, successful commands divided by all executed commands, reported for setup, download, training, evaluation, and inference stages.

name: CureBench
intro: CURE-Bench 是 NeurIPS 2025 治疗推理竞赛基准，评测模型在药物决策、治疗规划、安全性与疗效分析中的多步推理、工具使用和临床可靠性。
build_method: 基于 TxAgent 数据生成系统，以 QuestionGen、TraceGen、ToolGen 三个模块生成并验证临床问题、推理轨迹和工具解法
metric: 正确性、鲁棒性、效率、事实性与临床相关性的预定义加权总分；头部提交由人类专家复核
eval_feature: 内部知识赛道与工具增强赛道；智能体裁判和临床专家验证
scale: 数千条（精确数量未公开）
build_method_en: Use a TxAgent-based modular pipeline—QuestionGen, TraceGen, and ToolGen—to generate and validate clinical questions, reasoning traces, and tool-based solutions
eval_feature_en: Internal-knowledge and tool-augmented tracks with agentic judges and clinical-expert validation
intro_en: CURE-Bench is a NeurIPS 2025 therapeutic-reasoning competition benchmark for multi-step drug decision-making, treatment planning, safety and efficacy analysis, tool use, and clinical reliability.
metric_en: Predefined weighted aggregate of correctness, robustness, efficiency, factuality, and clinical relevance, with human-expert review of top submissions
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official CURE-Bench site and NeurIPS 2025 competition abstract. CURE-Bench covers twelve published therapeutic task families spanning treatment recommendation, adverse events, drug labeling and ingredients, warnings, dependence, dosage, special populations, pharmacology, clinical information, nonclinical toxicology, and patient information. Its validated TxAgent-derived multi-agent pipeline is documented as QuestionGen for clinically plausible queries, TraceGen for grounded multi-step reasoning traces, and ToolGen for callable biomedical tools; the output is described only as thousands of examples, so no exact item count is claimed. Track 1 permits internal model knowledge only, while Track 2 permits external biomedical tools and real-time information. Submissions include reasoning traces, final answers, token use, and model metadata. The official evaluation combines correctness, rephrasing and option-order robustness, token/tool efficiency, agentic factuality and clinical-relevance checks, plus expert assessment of top submissions into a predefined weighted score. Exact task instances, split sizes, metric weights, prompts, and judge configuration are not publicly specified, and the diagram preserves those boundaries.

name: CURIE
intro: CURIE是一个科学长上下文理解、推理和信息提取基准，用于评估大型语言模型在辅助真实科学工作流程中的能力。包含10个挑战性任务，共580个问题与解答，涵盖六个科学领域。评估模型的领域专业知识、长上下文理解及多步推理能力。
build_method: 六个领域中每领域 1–3 名博士专家定义真实科研任务、选择宽松许可来源、标注标准答案和难度并交叉复核
metric: LLMSim-F1、ROUGE-L、边界框 IoU、蛋白序列一致率；各任务归一化至 [0,1] 后取十任务平均
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 开放式问答, 抽取, 摘要
eval_feature: 长文本, 领域特定, 多轮
build_method_en: One to three Ph.D. experts per discipline define realistic workflows, select permissively licensed sources, annotate ground truth and difficulty, and cross-review extraction tasks
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Domain-specific, Multi-turn
intro_en: CURIE is a scientific long-context understanding, reasoning, and information extraction benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in supporting real scientific workflows. It includes 10 challenging tasks with a total of 580 questions and answers across six scientific domains. The benchmark assesses models' domain expertise, long-context comprehension, and multi-step reasoning abilities.

    E["用任务描述、输出格式和完整论文文本作为上下文零样本提示模型"] --> F["根据任务使用ROUGE-L、BERTScore、IoU、同一性比率或基于模型的F1评分"]
    F["根据任务使用ROUGE-L、BERTScore、IoU、同一性比率或基于模型的F1评分"] --> G["专家手动评定每个任务10-12%的响应并测量提取的精确率和召回率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.13517 Sections 3–4 and Appendix Tables 3–4. CURIE uses 1–3 Ph.D. experts in each of six disciplines—materials science, theoretical condensed-matter physics, quantum computing, geospatial analysis, biodiversity, and proteins—to define ten realistic scientific-workflow tasks. Tasks must be solvable from the supplied context and expert-evaluable; experts select permissively licensed papers or scientific records, create nuanced ground truth, assign difficulty, and cross-review extraction annotations. The release contains 580 input/solution pairs from 429 research documents, averaging about 15k words of context, across DFT-S, DFT-P, DFT-C, MPV, HFD, HFE, QECC, GEO, BIOGR, and PDB. Standard zero-shot prompts contain the task, output format, and full paper; BIOGR instead uses a map image and caption, and PDB uses stripped coordinate text. Primary aggregate metrics are LLMSim precision/recall/F1 for DFT-S, DFT-P, and MPV; ROUGE-L for DFT-C, HFD, HFE, QECC, and GEO; bounding-box IoU for BIOGR; and pairwise-alignment identity ratio for PDB. Metrics are normalized to [0,1] and averaged across ten tasks. Experts additionally use task rubrics and audit 10–12% of outputs as good, okay, or bad; this audit validates metrics but is not substituted into the primary aggregate.

name: CursorBench
intro: CursorBench 是 Cursor 基于内部工程团队真实会话持续更新的编程智能体评测套件，使用模糊、多文件、多工具和多步骤任务衡量真实开发效用。
build_method: 用 Cursor Blame 将已提交代码追溯到生成它的智能体请求，形成开发者请求与标准解法对，并从内部/受控来源筛选、每隔数月刷新
metric: 公开排行榜：正确性得分、单任务平均成本、Token 数、步骤数；内部另评代码质量、效率和交互行为
eval_feature: 智能体裁判接受多种有效解法；离线评测与受控线上实验交叉验证
build_method_en: Use Cursor Blame to trace committed code to the agent request that produced it, pair the developer query with its ground-truth solution, curate internal/controlled sources, and refresh every few months
eval_feature_en: Agentic graders accept multiple valid solutions; offline results are cross-checked with controlled online experiments
intro_en: CursorBench is Cursor's continuously updated internal coding-agent suite, built from real engineering sessions and ambiguous, multi-file, multi-tool, multi-step development tasks.
metric_en: Public leaderboard: correctness score, average cost per task, tokens, and steps; internal axes also include code quality, efficiency, and interaction behavior
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Cursor's official March 2026 methodology post and live CursorBench 3.1 leaderboard, not inferred from third-party model system cards. Cursor Blame traces committed code back to the agent request that produced it, yielding a natural developer-query/ground-truth-solution pair. Tasks come mainly from Cursor's internal codebase and controlled sources, are refreshed every few months, and intentionally use short, ambiguous descriptions. Version 3.0 focused on edit, refactor, and bug-fix tasks; 3.1 adds codebase understanding, bug finding, planning, and code review, and revises some edit-task grading criteria. Agents run against an initialized codebase and are graded by agentic graders that can accept multiple valid solutions. Cursor discloses correctness, code quality, efficiency, and interaction behavior as internal axes, while the public 3.1 leaderboard reports Score, average cost per task, tokens, and steps; cost applies each model's published input/cache-read/cache-write/output token prices. Controlled online experiments validate whether offline rankings track developer outcomes. Because the task distribution changes, scores must be compared only within the same eval version. Task instances, suite size, grader prompts/rubrics, harness, and per-item outputs remain proprietary and are explicitly marked as undisclosed.

name: CValues
intro: CValues 是首个中文人类价值观评测基准，从安全和责任两个递进层级评估 LLM：众包人员收集十类对抗安全提示，八个领域的专业专家撰写责任提示，并同时提供人工与自动评测。
build_method: 十类安全场景中由众包人员攻击早期 ChatPLUG，八个责任领域由专业专家各写 100 题；再经人工归类、反向改写和选项换序构建自动选择题
metric: 人工：安全回答占比、责任回答专家平均分；自动：准确率及排除拒答后的准确率
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试, 排序
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
scale: 2,100 条人工评测提示 + 4,312 道自动选择题
build_method_en: Crowdworkers attack early ChatPLUG across ten safety scenarios while eight domain experts write 100 responsibility prompts each; human categorization, opposite-response rewriting, and option-order swapping produce automatic MCQs
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: CValues is the first Chinese human-values benchmark to assess two ascending levels of alignment: crowdworker-collected adversarial safety prompts across ten scenarios and responsibility prompts authored by experts in eight domains, with both human and automatic evaluation.

flowchart LR
    A(Expert Knowledge & Human Values) --> B[Expert-Curated Scenarios]
    B --> C[Prompt Development]
    C --> D{{Manual Annotation}}
    D --> E[Categorization & Refinement]
    E --> F{Quality Check}
    F -- Pass --> G[Adversarial Prompt Generation]
    F -- Fail --> D
    G --> H(CValues Benchmark Dataset)
    H --> I[Manual Evaluation]
    H --> J[Automated Evaluation]
    I --> K[LLM Alignment Assessment]
    J --> K
metric_en: Human: safe-response ratio and expert mean responsibility score; automatic: accuracy and accuracy excluding refusals
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Professional experts manually collect adversarial safety prompts across 10 scenarios"] --> B["Professional experts induce responsibility prompts from 8 domains"]
    B["Professional experts induce responsibility prompts from 8 domains"] --> C["Apply two expert-in-the-loop methods to collect representative prompts susceptible to value issues"]
    C["Apply two expert-in-the-loop methods to collect representative prompts susceptible to value issues"] --> D["Construct 4312 multi-choice prompts for automatic evaluation"]
    D["Construct 4312 multi-choice prompts for automatic evaluation"] --> E["Assemble 2100 adversarial prompts for human evaluation"]
    E["Assemble 2100 adversarial prompts for human evaluation"] --> F["Conduct automatic evaluation using multi-choice prompts to measure safety and responsibility alignment"]
    F["Conduct automatic evaluation using multi-choice prompts to measure safety and responsibility alignment"] --> G["Conduct human evaluation for reliable comparison of LLM value alignment"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["专业专家手动收集10个场景的对抗性安全提示"] --> B["专业专家从8个领域归纳责任提示"]
    B["专业专家从8个领域归纳责任提示"] --> C["应用两种专家在环方法收集易受价值问题影响的代表性提示"]
    C["应用两种专家在环方法收集易受价值问题影响的代表性提示"] --> D["构建4312个多选题提示用于自动评估"]
    D["构建4312个多选题提示用于自动评估"] --> E["组装2100个对抗性提示用于人工评估"]
    E["组装2100个对抗性提示用于人工评估"] --> F["使用多选题提示进行自动评估以衡量安全性和责任感对齐"]
    F["使用多选题提示进行自动评估以衡量安全性和责任感对齐"] --> G["进行人工评估以可靠比较LLM价值观对齐"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.09705 Sections 2.1–2.3 and Figure 3. CValues defines two ascending Chinese-value criteria: Level 1 safety, requiring no harmful or risky response, and Level 2 responsibility, requiring positive guidance, humanistic care, and attention to social impact. For safety, the authors extend a ten-scenario taxonomy and have crowdworkers attack an early ChatPLUG instant-message chatbot; only questions that successfully trigger a safety issue are labeled by scenario and retained, yielding 1,300 prompts. For responsibility, the 100 Bottles of Poison for AI project recruits eight professional experts from domains such as environmental science, law, and psychology, each writing 100 induced questions, yielding 800 prompts. These 2,100 prompts form the human-evaluation set. Safety responses are independently labeled safe/unsafe by three specialized annotators and majority-voted, with safe-response proportion as score. Because full expert evaluation is expensive, responsibility human evaluation uses ChatPLUG-13B as a representative: three top-k candidates per prompt are judged by the originating expert, who chooses the best or neither, scores it 1–10, and may write an answer; domain means are reported. For automatic evaluation, multiple LLM responses are human-categorized into opposite value classes; ChatGPT rewrites one response if a class is missing; one response from each class is templated into a binary MCQ and the option order is swapped. The automatic set has 4,312 items—2,600 safety and 1,712 responsibility—and reports accuracy both including and excluding refusals.

name: CVBench
intro: CVBench是首个旨在严格评估跨视频关系推理能力的诊断基准。它包含1000个问答对，涵盖跨视频对象关联、跨视频事件关联和跨视频复杂推理三个层次。该基准挑战模型分析和整合来自动态视觉流的时空模式，并揭示了当前多模态大语言模型在跨视频理解方面的瓶颈。
org: Sun Yat-sen University, University of Hong Kong, Foshan University, University of Birmingham
build_method: 从 YouTube 检索 1,500 个候选视频，按跨视频关系、领域、时长和 720p/24fps 质量筛为 1,315 个，再经多级描述、GPT-4o 生成和两轮人工复核形成 1,000 题
metric: 准确率（总体、三个推理层级及 15 个子任务）
build_method_en: Retrieve 1,500 YouTube candidates; curate 1,315 by cross-video relations, domain, duration and 720p/24fps quality; then use hierarchical descriptions, GPT-4o synthesis and two-stage human review to produce 1,000 QA pairs
eval_feature_en: Process Evaluation
intro_en: CVBench is the first diagnostic benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate cross-video relational reasoning abilities. It contains 1,000 QA pairs covering three levels: cross-video object association, cross-video event association, and cross-video complex reasoning. The benchmark challenges models to analyze and integrate spatiotemporal patterns from dynamic visual streams, revealing current multimodal large language models' bottlenecks in cross-video understanding.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.19542 Sections 3.1–3.2, Figure 3 and Tables 1–4. CVBench defines three diagnostic tiers—cross-video object association, event association and complex reasoning—covering 15 subtasks. Task-driven YouTube retrieval yields 1,500 candidate videos. Eight annotators curate groups of two to four videos for multi-domain coverage, intrinsic relationships such as similarity, difference, causality and temporal order, primarily sub-10-minute duration, and at least 720p/24fps quality; gap filling and quality-driven replacement leave 1,315 videos. The four-stage QA pipeline adaptively samples frames and writes segment captions, aggregates video-level descriptions, builds relational summaries covering state transitions, causal links, complementarities and contradictions, and uses GPT-4o to generate at least two MCQs per group with one correct answer and three entity/temporal/causal distractors. First-stage review by eight annotators applies 15 task-specific criteria and can revise questions, fix options or recollect videos. Five new annotators independently re-examine 200 questions each for compliance, correctness and hallucination, yielding 1,000 QA pairs. Evaluation uses indexed multi-video inputs, eight frames per video for open models unless otherwise stated, zero-shot or chain-of-thought prompting, and Accuracy reported overall and by tier/subtask.

name: CVE-Bench
intro: CVE-Bench是一个评估AI智能体利用真实世界网络应用漏洞能力的基准。它通过一个沙盒框架，模拟真实世界的网络攻击场景，旨在解决现有基准在覆盖范围和真实性方面的不足。该基准基于严重级别的常见漏洞和暴露（CVE），并提供有效的漏洞利用评估。初步评估显示，最先进的智能体框架可以解决高达13%的漏洞。
build_method: 从 2024-05-01 至 2024-06-14 的 NVD Critical CVE 中，经两位作者筛选可复现、开源免费、跨平台 Web 应用并复现漏洞利用，封装 40 个容器化任务
metric: 成功率：智能体是否达成八类标准攻击目标之一；分别支持零日和一日上下文
eval_feature: 动态更新, 防污染, 对抗性, 过程评估
scale: 40 个 Critical CVE（CVSS v3.1 不低于 9.0）
build_method_en: Two authors screen NVD Critical CVEs from 2024-05-01 through 2024-06-14 for reproducible FOSS, platform-independent web applications, reproduce exploits, and package 40 containerized tasks
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Adversarial, Process Evaluation
intro_en: CVE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to exploit real-world network application vulnerabilities. It uses a sandbox framework to simulate real-world network attack scenarios, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks in coverage and realism. The benchmark is based on high-severity Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and provides effective vulnerability exploitation assessment. Preliminary evaluations show that state-of-the-art agent frameworks can exploit up to 13% of the vulnerabilities.

    C["将每个漏洞应用容器化并配置数据库"] --> D["根据PoC或描述复现漏洞利用验证正确性"]
    D["根据PoC或描述复现漏洞利用验证正确性"] --> E["将每个漏洞利用对齐到八种标准攻击类型"]
    E["将每个漏洞利用对齐到八种标准攻击类型"] --> F["为每个CVE指定攻击目标和生命周期上下文"]
    F["为每个CVE指定攻击目标和生命周期上下文"] --> G["部署评估服务器自动验证智能体攻击成功与否"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.17332 Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix A. The source pool is every NVD entry published from May 1 through June 14, 2024 and rated CRITICAL under CVSS v3.x. One author screens and a second independently confirms that the CVE affects a free/open-source web application, is platform-independent, needs no sensitive external information and can be reproduced. The authors reproduce exploits from a public PoC when available or from the NVD description and vendor patch otherwise; all 40 retained CVEs have CVSS v3.1 scores of at least 9.0. Reference exploit containers are kept private to reduce contamination and real-world risk. Target environments typically contain application, database and auxiliary containers, with victim simulation when required. Each task includes an endpoint, usage guidance, eight measurable standard attack goals, and disallowed actions such as attacking the evaluator or brute-forcing passwords. Zero-day mode withholds the vulnerability description; one-day mode includes the NVD summary. The agent interacts only with designated targets, and an in-container grader continuously monitors whether any standard goal is achieved; the benchmark metric is exploit success rate.

name: CWEval
intro: CWEval 是同时评测 LLM 生成代码功能性与安全性的结果驱动框架；其公开 CWEval-bench 含 119 个安全关键编码任务，覆盖 31 类 CWE 和 5 种编程语言。
build_method: 依据 CWE 文档设计自包含安全关键任务，为每题编写无安全提示泄漏的清晰规格、功能与安全动态判定器，以及安全和功能正确但不安全的双参考实现并由专家验证
metric: func@k（通过全部功能测试）与 func-sec@k（同时通过全部功能和安全测试），采用无偏 pass@k 式估计
eval_feature: 功能与安全联合动态执行；结果驱动判定
scale: 119 个任务 · 31 类 CWE · 5 种语言
build_method_en: Derive self-contained security-critical tasks from CWE documentation; write clear specifications without security-awareness leakage, dynamic functionality/security oracles, and secure plus functional-but-insecure reference implementations; then expert-verify each task
eval_feature_en: Joint dynamic functionality and security execution with outcome-driven oracles
intro_en: CWEval is an outcome-driven framework that evaluates the functionality and security of LLM-generated code simultaneously; its public CWEval-bench contains 119 security-critical tasks spanning 31 CWEs and five programming languages.
metric_en: func@k for passing all functionality tests and func-sec@k for passing all functionality and security tests, using unbiased pass@k-style estimators
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the independent CWEval paper arXiv:2501.08200 Sections III–V and the official Co1lin/CWEval repository, rather than treating CWEval as a Qwen-only vulnerability-repair benchmark. Tasks are derived from CWE documentation and isolate third-party dependencies while preserving security-critical behavior. Every specification includes a function signature, natural-language docstring and optional examples, must contain security semantics, intentionally avoids security-awareness hints, and remains functionally unambiguous. Each task has dynamic functionality oracles based on expected behavior and security oracles that may inspect outputs, execution time, memory validity or state integrity. A secure reference implementation must pass both suites; at least one functional-but-insecure implementation must pass functionality and fail security, proving vulnerability reproducibility and feasible mitigation without sacrificing function. Expert programmers manually verify the tasks. CWEval-bench contains 119 tasks covering 31 CWEs across five languages, including 11 C-specific memory-vulnerability tasks. Model samples are executed against both oracle suites. func@k estimates the probability that any of k samples is functional, while func-sec@k requires both functionality and security; both use the unbiased pass@k estimator.

name: Cybench
intro: Cybench是一个用于评估语言模型在网络安全任务中能力和风险的框架。它包含40个专业级别的夺旗（CTF）任务，这些任务来源于4个不同的CTF竞赛，涵盖了广泛的难度。每个任务都包含描述、起始文件，并在一个代理可以执行命令和观察输出的环境中初始化。为了更详细的评估，每个任务还引入了子任务。
build_method: 从四个 2022–2024 年专业 CTF 竞赛筛选 40 题，覆盖六类技能和 2 分钟至 24 小时 54 分钟首解时间；为每题补充子任务、标准解脚本、CI 与服务存活检查
metric: 无引导成功率、子任务引导最终成功率、宏平均子任务完成率、最难已解题首解时间，以及 Token/耗时
build_method_en: Select 40 tasks from four professional 2022–2024 CTFs across six categories and first-solve times from 2 minutes to 24 h 54 min; add subtasks, a solution script, CI, and server liveness checks
eval_feature_en: Process Evaluation
intro_en: Cybench is a framework for evaluating language models' capabilities and risks in cybersecurity tasks. It includes 40 professional-level CTF tasks sourced from 4 different CTF competitions, covering a wide range of difficulties. Each task contains a description, starter files, and is initialized in an environment where an agent can execute commands and observe outputs. For more detailed evaluation, each task also includes subtasks.

    C["在Kali Linux容器中初始化任务及服务器"] --> D["将每个任务分解为带中间目标的子任务"]
    D["将每个任务分解为带中间目标的子任务"] --> E["构建在环境中执行命令并观察输出的网络安全代理"]
    E["构建在环境中执行命令并观察输出的网络安全代理"] --> F["在有无子任务指导下评估8个语言模型"]
    F["在有无子任务指导下评估8个语言模型"] --> G["在4种代理架构下测试顶级模型性能"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.08926 Sections 2–4, the official Cybench website, and andyzorigin/cybench repository. Cybench selects 40 recent professional-level tasks from HackTheBox Cyber Apocalypse 2024, SekaiCTF 2022–23, GlacierCTF and HKCert CTF. The 2022–2024 timing mitigates train-test overlap; tasks proxy real cybersecurity skills across cryptography, web, reverse engineering, forensics, exploitation and miscellaneous categories. Human first-solve time grounds difficulty from 2 minutes to 24 hours 54 minutes. Every task contains a description, starter files and evaluator, runs in a common Kali Linux environment with local files and isolated remote task servers, and receives sequential intermediate question/answer subtasks. A ground-truth solution script must reproduce the exact flag; CI confirms the task is buildable and solvable and automated probes confirm servers are alive. The agent repeats an action–execution–observation–memory loop with Bash commands. Unguided mode has one objective and binary success; subtask mode retains memory across sequential checkpoints and reports both final-task binary success and fractional subtask completion. The evaluator compares submitted answers to the key. Reports include unguided success, subtask-guided success, macro-averaged subtask percentage, hardest solved task by human first-solve time, token use and elapsed time.

name: CyberGym
intro: CyberGym是一个大规模基准测试，旨在评估AI智能体在真实世界网络安全方面的能力。它包含1,507个真实漏洞，涵盖188个软件项目。该基准主要任务是让智能体根据文本描述和代码库生成漏洞复现的概念验证测试。CyberGym不仅能有效区分AI智能体的网络安全能力，还促成了35个零日漏洞的发现。
build_method: 从 OSS-Fuzz/ARVO 历史漏洞定位精确补丁提交，提取修复前后代码、标准 PoC 与补丁，用 GPT-4.1 改写描述并经信息充分性、双版本复现和堆栈去重筛选
metric: PoC 成功率：修复前版本必须触发 sanitizer 崩溃，修复后版本必须不崩溃
build_method_en: Source OSS-Fuzz/ARVO vulnerabilities, locate exact fix commits, recover pre/post code, ground-truth PoC and patch, rephrase descriptions with GPT-4.1, then filter for informativeness, dual-version reproducibility and stack-trace uniqueness
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Process Evaluation
intro_en: CyberGym is a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' capabilities in real-world cybersecurity. It includes 1,507 real vulnerabilities across 188 software projects. The main task is for agents to generate proof-of-concept tests reproducing vulnerabilities based on textual descriptions and codebases. CyberGym effectively differentiates AI agents' cybersecurity skills and has contributed to the discovery of 35 zero-day vulnerabilities.

    G --> H{Review & Validate PoC}
    H -->|Pass| I[Integrate into Dataset]
    H -->|Fail| J[Refine & Re-generate]
    I --> K(CyberGym Dataset
1507 Vulns, 188 Projects)
    K --> L[AI Agent Evaluation]
    L --> M(Evaluation Results)
metric_en: PoC success rate: sanitizer crash required on the pre-patch executable and forbidden on the post-patch executable

flowchart LR
    A["Source 1,507 real-world vulnerabilities from OSS-Fuzz across 188 diverse software projects"] --> B["Apply systematic automated filters to ensure benchmark instance quality and timeliness"]
    B["Apply systematic automated filters to ensure benchmark instance quality and timeliness"] --> C["Manually validate filtered vulnerability instances to confirm benchmark suitability"]
    C["Manually validate filtered vulnerability instances to confirm benchmark suitability"] --> D["Provide agents with vulnerability text descriptions and pre-patch codebases as inputs"]
    D["Provide agents with vulnerability text descriptions and pre-patch codebases as inputs"] --> E["Task agents to generate proof-of-concept tests that reproduce the target vulnerabilities"]
    E["Task agents to generate proof-of-concept tests that reproduce the target vulnerabilities"] --> F["Execute generated PoCs on pre-patch versions to verify vulnerability reproduction success"]
    F["Execute generated PoCs on pre-patch versions to verify vulnerability reproduction success"] --> G["Execute generated PoCs on post-patch versions to confirm proper vulnerability patching"]
    G["Execute generated PoCs on post-patch versions to confirm proper vulnerability patching"] --> H["Deploy agents for open-ended discovery on latest versions, identifying zero-day vulnerabilities"]

    A["从OSS-Fuzz获取188个项目的1507个真实漏洞"] --> B["应用自动化过滤器确保基准实例质量和时效性"]
    B["应用自动化过滤器确保基准实例质量和时效性"] --> C["人工验证过滤后的漏洞实例以确认适用性"]
    C["人工验证过滤后的漏洞实例以确认适用性"] --> D["向智能体提供漏洞文本描述和补丁前代码库"]
    D["向智能体提供漏洞文本描述和补丁前代码库"] --> E["要求智能体生成复现目标漏洞的概念验证测试"]
    E["要求智能体生成复现目标漏洞的概念验证测试"] --> F["在补丁前版本上执行PoC验证漏洞复现成功"]
    F["在补丁前版本上执行PoC验证漏洞复现成功"] --> G["在补丁后版本上执行PoC确认漏洞已正确修补"]
    G["在补丁后版本上执行PoC确认漏洞已正确修补"] --> H["在最新版本上部署智能体发现零日漏洞"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.02548 Sections 3–5 and the official sunblaze-ucb/cybergym release. CyberGym sources historical vulnerabilities and ground-truth PoCs from OSS-Fuzz through ARVO. Because OSS-Fuzz updates projects daily, the authors binary-search commits in the final pre-fix day to find the first version where the ground-truth PoC stops crashing. Each candidate yields pre-patch and post-patch code, the ground-truth PoC and patch; sanitizer-enabled executables are built, and GPT-4.1 rephrases informative single-issue patch messages into vulnerability descriptions. Quality assurance removes vague or multi-issue descriptions, re-runs the PoC on both versions to verify reproducibility, and removes redundant/ambiguous cases using patch identity and crash-stack similarity. The final benchmark has 1,507 instances across 188 projects. Difficulty Level 0 provides only code, Level 1—the primary task—adds the description, Level 2 adds the ground-truth crash stack, and Level 3 adds the patch diff and post-patch code. Agents iteratively submit PoCs and observe execution feedback. A success must crash the pre-patch executable under sanitizers and not crash the post-patch executable; success rate is the fraction of instances meeting both conditions. Separate from the benchmark metric, follow-up analysis finds 17 incomplete historical patches and 10 zero-days from benchmark-generated PoCs, then 25 additional zero-days in open-ended latest-version runs, for 35 responsibly disclosed zero-days total.

name: CyberSecEval
intro: CyberSecEval 3 是 Meta 的网络安全风险与能力评测套件，围绕第三方风险以及应用开发者与终端用户风险构建八类评测，并比较护栏启用前后的表现。
build_method: 风险分类, 模拟实验, 人类研究, 可执行任务
metric: 成功率, 攻击增益, 不安全输出率, 恶意请求遵从率
task_type: 网络安全评测, 安全测试
eval_feature: 八类风险, 第三方与应用风险, 护栏前后对照, 人工与自动化评判
build_method_en: Risk Taxonomy, Simulations, Human Study, Executable Tasks
eval_feature_en: Eight Risks, Third-party and Application Risk, Before/After Guardrails, Human and Automated Review
intro_en: CyberSecEval 3 is Meta's cybersecurity risk and capability suite covering eight evaluations across third-party risk and risk to application developers and end users, with mitigation-aware comparisons.
metric_en: Success Rate, Attack Uplift, Insecure Output Rate, Malicious-request Compliance Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.01605 (CyberSecEval 3), especially Figure 1 and Sections 3-5. The generic catalog item is explicitly anchored to version 3 because it is the paper-backed suite with a complete eight-risk methodology and official PurpleLlama implementation. The diagram separates four third-party risks from four application/end-user risks, preserves their distinct human, simulated, executable, and prompt-corpus protocols, and shows the paper's before/after mitigation comparisons using PromptGuard, CodeShield, and Llama Guard 3.

name: CyScenarioBench
intro: CyScenarioBench 是 Irregular 构建的私有场景式网络安全评测框架，它从真实事件抽象攻击树，在全新高保真环境中衡量模型的任务、路径和完整战役级编排能力。
build_method: 真实事件分析, 攻击树建模, 全新高保真仿真环境
metric: 任务/路径/战役成功率, 分支决策, 约束遵循, 推理漂移
eval_feature: 三级嵌套评测, 长程编排, 状态恢复, 抗污染私有集
build_method_en: Real-incident Analysis, Attack-tree Modeling, Fresh High-fidelity Simulations
eval_feature_en: Three Nested Levels, Long-horizon Orchestration, State Recovery, Private Anti-contamination Set
intro_en: CyScenarioBench is Irregular's private scenario-based cybersecurity framework. It abstracts attack trees from real incidents and measures task-, path-, and campaign-level orchestration in fresh high-fidelity environments.
metric_en: Task/Path/Campaign Success, Branching Decisions, Constraint Adherence, Reasoning Drift
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Irregular's official CyScenarioBench working draft dated 2025-12-05, especially Sections 3-4. No arXiv paper or public dataset is claimed. The flow follows the disclosed methodology: analyze real incidents; extract decisions, constraints, and states; formalize attack trees; create fresh unseen containerized environments with websites, personas, voice modules, and defenses; keep the set private; and score models at task, path, and campaign levels while recording branching, drift, dead ends, troubleshooting, and impossible state transitions.

name: DARE-bench
intro: DARE-bench 是一个面向数据科学与机器学习建模任务的基准，用于评估大模型在复杂多步数据科学任务中的建模能力与指令忠实度，并提供可验证真值以支持客观评测。
build_method: Kaggle开放数据采集, LLM任务构造, 受控后处理, 可验证真值

intro_en: DARE-bench is a benchmark for data science and machine learning modeling tasks. It evaluates LLM agents on complex multi-step data science workflows, instruction fidelity, and objectively verifiable outcomes.
build_method_en: Open Kaggle Data Collection, LLM Task Design, Controlled Post-Processing, Verifiable Ground Truth
metric_en: IF Exact Match, Macro-F1, Clipped R²
task_type_en: Code Generation, Data Science Modeling, Time Series Forecasting
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Ground Truth, Instruction Following, Process Evaluation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICLR 2026 paper arXiv:2602.24288 and the official Snowflake repository. The paper benchmark contains 5,948 training and 352 evaluation tasks: Classification-IF/MM each 1,160/74, Regression-IF/MM each 899/45, and Time-series-XF/CF each 915/57. The official repository currently publishes a smaller license-filtered subset of 4,274 training and 324 evaluation tasks; the diagram intentionally uses the paper's full 6,300-task contract. Open-license tabular Kaggle data and crawled metadata feed LLM feasibility analysis. Random or chronological splits, about 20% IF training-noise injection, entity checks, and resampling create the variants. IF outputs come from sandboxed reference code with a fixed seed, while MM and time-series variants use masked original labels. The standard evaluation uses five turns and a 200-second sandbox maximum per turn; IF uses exact match, Classification-MM Macro-F1, and regression/time-series clipped R².

intro_en: DBQA corresponds to the DbQA subset of LAB-Bench: 650 programmatically generated multiple-choice questions that require access to and reasoning over attributable, versioned biological-database information.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.10362 (LAB-Bench), especially Figure 2, Table 1, Appendix C.8, and Appendix D. DBQA is normalized to the paper's capitalization DbQA and treated as the database-question-answering subset rather than an unrelated generic database benchmark. The flow preserves its 10 programmatic subtasks, source/version disambiguation, database-derived correct answers and hard distractors, 650-question scale with a 35% public subset, shuffled multiple-choice prompt with an insufficient-information option, zero-shot chain-of-thought baseline, answer-tag parser with regex then Claude 2 fallback, and accuracy/precision/coverage metrics.

name: DeepPlanning
intro: DeepPlanning 是一个旨在解决现有LLM规划评估局限性的基准测试。它引入了复杂的、真实世界的任务，需要主动信息获取、局部约束推理和全局约束优化。该基准测试的特点是多日旅行规划和多产品购物任务，即使是前沿的Agentic LLM也难以应对。

The benchmark features multi-day travel planning and multi-product shopping tasks, which are challenging even for state-of-the-art Agentic LLMs.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.18137, especially Sections 3.1-3.3, Figure 2, and Table 1. DeepPlanning contains 120 travel tasks (available in Chinese and English) and 120 English shopping tasks. Stage 1 builds isolated domain databases and hierarchical toolkits: travel uses real data from Fliggy, Amap, and Web Search with 9 APIs; shopping uses controlled synthetic product data with 15 APIs. Stage 2 reverse-generates tasks from a base solution skeleton, adds personalized and hidden environmental constraints, and adjusts candidates to guarantee exactly one reachable optimal solution before LLM verbalization. Stage 3 manually checks fluency, unambiguous logic, and reachability. Evaluation is code-based: travel itineraries are parsed by Qwen-Plus-2507 and scored for commonsense, personalization, composite quality, and strict case accuracy; shopping carts use match score and case accuracy.

name: DeepResearchBench
intro: DeepResearch Bench 从 96,147 条真实用户查询估计 22 个领域的研究需求分布，由领域专家构建 100 个中英文博士级任务，并用 RACE 与 FACT 分别评估报告质量和引用检索质量。
org: University of Science and Technology of China; Metastone Technology
build_method: 真实查询分布分析, 领域专家构建, 人工筛选
metric: RACE 总分与四维分数, 引用准确率, 每题有效引用数
task_type: 研究Agent任务, 信息综合
eval_feature: 参考报告自适应评测, 引用事实支持检查, 人类一致性验证
build_method_en: Real-query Distribution Analysis, Domain-expert Construction, Manual Screening
eval_feature_en: Reference-based Adaptive Evaluation, Citation Support Checking, Human-alignment Validation
intro_en: DeepResearch Bench estimates demand across 22 fields from 96,147 real user queries, curates 100 bilingual PhD-level tasks with domain experts, and evaluates report quality and citation retrieval with RACE and FACT.
metric_en: RACE Overall and Four Dimensions, Citation Accuracy, Effective Citations per Task
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.11763, especially Figure 2 and Sections 2-3. This entry is explicitly the USTC/Metastone 100-task DeepResearch Bench with RACE and FACT, not FutureSearch's separate RetroSearch benchmark. The paper anonymizes 96,147 search-chat queries, filters 44,019 deep-research queries with DeepSeek-V3-0324, estimates demand across 22 domains, proportionally compresses the distribution to 100 tasks (50 Chinese and 50 English), and manually screens tasks proposed by PhD or senior practitioners. RACE uses adaptive task-specific weights/criteria over comprehensiveness, depth, instruction following, and readability with reference-relative scoring. FACT extracts and deduplicates statement-URL pairs, retrieves pages through Jina Reader, and reports citation accuracy plus effective citations per task.

name: DeepResearchEval
intro: DeepResearchEval是一个针对深度研究系统的自动化评测框架。它采用角色驱动的流程来生成复杂的真实研究任务，这些任务需要整合多个来源的证据并进行外部检索。该框架包含一个自适应的单点质量评估机制，能根据每个任务动态调整评估维度、标准和权重，同时还具备主动事实核查功能，即使在没有引文的情况下也能通过网络搜索自主验证报告内容的准确性。
org: Infinity Lab, Shanda Group; Nanyang Technological University
build_method: 角色驱动大模型生成, 双重自动过滤, 博士专家验证

eval_feature: 可刷新动态任务, 无参考自适应评分, 引用与无引用陈述主动核查
build_method_en: Persona-driven LLM Generation, Two-stage Automated Filtering, PhD-expert Verification
eval_feature_en: Refreshable Live Tasks, Reference-free Adaptive Scoring, Active Checking of Cited and Uncited Claims
intro_en: DeepResearchEval is an automated evaluation framework for deep research systems. It uses a role-driven process to generate complex, real-world research tasks that require integrating evidence from multiple sources and performing external retrieval. The framework includes an adaptive single-point quality assessment mechanism that dynamically adjusts evaluation dimensions, criteria, and weights for each task. It also features proactive fact-checking, enabling autonomous verification of report accuracy via web search even without citations.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.09688, especially Figures 2 and 4 and Sections 3-4. The pipeline generates 50 personas across 10 domains, creates four tasks per persona (200 candidates), retains candidates above 0.7 on four qualification criteria, and removes tasks that a no-search parametric baseline can answer well, leaving 155. Seven PhD experts verify and rank the retained set; 80% receive approval from at least four experts, and the top 100 become the evaluated English task set. Adaptive point-wise quality evaluation combines four general dimensions with generated task-specific dimensions and normalized dimension/criterion weights on 1-10 judgments. Active fact-checking segments reports, extracts cited and uncited verifiable claims, retrieves evidence through MCP tools, labels claims Right/Wrong/Unknown, and reports the Right-to-all-statements ratio.

name: DeepSearchQA
intro: DeepSearchQA是一个包含900个提示的基准测试，旨在评估智能体在17个不同领域中执行复杂多步信息检索任务的能力。该基准通过精心设计的手工任务，测试智能体系统性整理碎片信息、去重与实体解析以及在开放式搜索空间中判断停止标准的能力。所有任务均基于开放网络，并具有客观可验证的答案集。对现有智能体架构的评估显示，即使是最先进的模型也难以在高召回率和精确度之间取得平衡，揭示了当前智能体设计在深度研究能力方面的显著局限性。
build_method: 专家构建, 客观真值过滤, 时间锚定
metric: F1（主指标）, 精确率, 召回率, 四类结果占比
eval_feature: 黑盒结果评测, 单答案与答案集, 因果搜索链, 停止与撒网失败分析
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Definitive-ground-truth Filtering, Time Anchoring
eval_feature_en: Black-box Outcome Evaluation, Single/Set Answers, Causal Search Chains, Stopping and Hedging Analysis
intro_en: DeepSearchQA is a benchmark consisting of 900 prompts designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform complex multi-step information retrieval tasks across 17 different domains. The benchmark uses carefully crafted manual tasks to test agents' capabilities in systematically organizing fragmented information, deduplication and entity resolution, as well as determining stopping criteria in an open search space. All tasks are based on the open web and have objectively verifiable answer sets. Evaluations of existing agent architectures show that even state-of-the-art models struggle to balance high recall and precision, revealing significant limitations in current agent designs for deep research capabilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.20975, especially Sections 2-3 and Tables 2-3. Expert annotators curate 900 difficult information-seeking prompts across 17 fields and retain objective tasks with definitive single-answer or exhaustive-set ground truth. Prompts are time-anchored or tied to static sources to reduce live-web drift. Tasks form causal chains that test structured retrieval, context assembly, logical reasoning, deduplication, entity resolution, and stopping criteria. Agents are treated as black boxes and submit distinct answer sets. Continuous evaluation reports precision, recall, and primary F1; categorical evaluation distinguishes fully correct, fully incorrect, partially correct, and correct-with-extraneous-answer outcomes to expose premature stopping and hedging.

name: DeR^2
intro: DeR2是一个受控的深度研究沙盒，旨在隔离文档基础推理，同时保留深度搜索的核心难点，如多步合成、去噪和基于证据的结论制定。它通过四种机制将证据访问与推理解耦，从而量化检索损失和推理损失，并实现细粒度的错误归因。为防止参数泄露，DeR2采用两阶段验证，确保在没有证据的情况下参数失败，同时保证预言概念的可解性。每个实例都提供了一个冻结的文档库，其中包含专家标注的概念和验证的理由。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注, 模型难度校准
metric: Answer-level Accuracy, Retrieval Loss (RLoss), Controlled Regime Gaps
eval_feature: 防污染, 冻结文档库, 受控条件对照, 过程评估
scale: 300个问题, 81位博士标注员, 15+学科, 平均每题6.5篇文档
build_method_en: Expert curation, human annotation, model difficulty calibration
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, frozen document libraries, controlled-regime comparison, process evaluation
intro_en: DeR2 is a controlled deep research sandbox designed to isolate document-based reasoning while retaining core challenges of deep search, such as multi-step synthesis, denoising, and evidence-based conclusion formulation. It decouples evidence access from reasoning through four mechanisms, enabling quantification of retrieval loss and reasoning loss, as well as fine-grained error attribution. To prevent parameter leakage, DeR2 employs two-stage validation to ensure parameter failure without evidence while guaranteeing the solvability of predicted concepts. Each instance provides a frozen document corpus containing expert-annotated concepts and verified rationales.

name: Design2Code
intro: Design2Code评估多模态模型把真实网页截图转换为HTML/CSS的能力。论文从C4验证集的127.9k个网页出发，经自动过滤去重到14k，再由两位作者从7k个抽样候选中整理出484个主测试网页；另有80个独立GitHub来源的HARD网页。生成页面经浏览器渲染后，以元素级与高层视觉指标评估，并用人类成对偏好验证。
org: Stanford University, Georgia Institute of Technology
build_method: C4真实网页抓取与CSS内联, 自动过滤去重, 依赖隔离, 两位作者人工筛选, 独立HARD集
metric: Block-Match, Text, Position, Color, CLIP, Human Pairwise Preference
modality: 图像, 文本, 代码
eval_feature: 真实网页, 多模态截图到代码, 浏览器渲染比较, 人工偏好校验
build_method_en: C4 Real-page Scraping and CSS Inlining, Automatic Filtering and Deduplication, Dependency Isolation, Two-author Manual Curation, Separate HARD Set
eval_feature_en: Real Webpages, Multimodal Screenshot-to-code, Browser-rendered Comparison, Human-preference Validation
intro_en: Design2Code evaluates multimodal models that convert real webpage screenshots into HTML/CSS. The paper starts from 127.9k C4-validation webpages, automatically filters and deduplicates them to 14k, and has two authors curate 484 main test pages from a 7k sample; a separate HARD set contains 80 GitHub-sourced pages. Generated pages are browser-rendered, scored with element-level and high-level visual metrics, and validated against human pairwise preferences.
metric_en: Block-Match, Text, Position, Color, CLIP, Human Pairwise Preference
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.03163 Sections 2-4 and Appendix B. Design2Code scrapes C4 validation links, inlines CSS to create 127.9k single-file real webpages, removes overly long/simple pages and deduplicates to 14k, isolates external resources, then has the first two authors jointly annotate 200 pages to 75% agreement and divide a 7k sample for manual quality, safety, formatting, and diversity review, yielding 484 main test pages. Design2Code-HARD is a separate 80-page GitHub-sourced set using the same filtering family. Evaluation renders generated HTML/CSS, matches text and non-text blocks, reports Block-Match/Text/Position/Color/CLIP, and validates ranking on 100 examples with five annotators and majority vote; the metric model predicts pairwise preference at 79.9% accuracy.

name: DLC-Bench
intro: DLC-Bench是用于评估详细局部描述（DLC）的无参考基准。它从Objects365 v2验证集选择100个带人工掩码的区域，并构建892个经人工验证的正向与负向问题；Llama-3.1-8B裁判据此检查描述是否覆盖真实区域细节并避免幻觉。DLC-SDP是同期DAM模型的训练数据管线，不是DLC-Bench本体的构建流程。
build_method: 人工区域选择, 多VLM属性生成, 人工问题验证, 训练集去重
metric: Positive Score, Negative Score, Average Score
modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 多模态
eval_feature: 无参考评估, 细节覆盖, 幻觉惩罚, 文本裁判
scale: 100个掩码实例, 892个经人工验证的问题
build_method_en: Manual region selection, multi-VLM property generation, manual question verification, training-set deduplication
eval_feature_en: Reference-free evaluation, detail coverage, hallucination penalties, text-only judge
intro_en: DLC-Bench is a reference-free benchmark for Detailed Localized Captioning. It selects 100 human-masked regions from the Objects365 v2 validation set and builds 892 manually verified positive and negative questions; a Llama-3.1-8B judge checks whether captions cover true regional details while avoiding hallucinations. DLC-SDP is the companion DAM training-data pipeline, not the construction pipeline for DLC-Bench itself.

name: DPG-Bench
intro: DPG-Bench（Dense Prompt Graph Benchmark）由ELLA论文提出，用于评估文生图模型对长且信息密集提示的语义遵循能力。它包含1,065个由四类来源扩写、人工核验并以DSG问题图标注的提示；模型每题生成4张图，由mPLUG-large回答语义问题并按DSG图规则评分。
build_method: 四源数据聚合, GPT-4密集扩写, 人工核验, DSG问题图标注
metric: DPG-Bench Graph Score, Global, Entity, Attribute, Relation, Other
task_type: 图像生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 细粒度问题图评测, 多图生成, MLLM裁判
scale: 1,065个提示, 平均83.91个CLIP词元, 5个一级类别, 13个二级类别
build_method_en: Four-source aggregation, GPT-4 dense expansion, human verification, DSG question-graph annotation
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained question-graph evaluation, multi-image generation, MLLM judge
intro_en: DPG-Bench (Dense Prompt Graph Benchmark) was introduced in the ELLA paper to evaluate semantic following of long, information-dense prompts by text-to-image models. Its 1,065 prompts are expanded from four sources, human-verified, and annotated with DSG question graphs; models generate four images per prompt, mPLUG-large answers semantic questions, and DSG graph rules determine the score.
scale_en: 1,065 prompts, mean 83.91 CLIP tokens, 5 level-1 and 13 level-2 categories
metric_en: DPG-Bench Graph Score, Global, Entity, Attribute, Relation, Other
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ELLA arXiv:2403.05135 Section 4 and the official TencentQQGYLab/ELLA evaluation release. The diagram records COCO, PartiPrompts, DSG-1k, and Object365 sources; expansion of the first three and sampling 1-4 Object365 objects; GPT-4 scene/attribute/relation enrichment; human verification; a second GPT-4 DSG pass for tuple categories, questions, and dependency graphs; the exact 1,065-prompt, 83.91-token, 4,286-noun, 5/13-category benchmark; four generated images per prompt; mPLUG-large question answering; DSG graph scoring; and the overall plus Global/Entity/Attribute/Relation/Other reports.

name: DreamBench++
intro: DreamBench++ 是面向个性化图像生成的人类偏好对齐基准。它收集 150 张多样参考图像并为每张图设计 9 个不同难度的提示，通过包含内部思考与任务强化的 GPT-4o 两阶段协议，分别评估概念保持和提示遵循，并用独立人工评分验证自动指标的一致性。
build_method: 多来源图像整理, 分层提示设计, GPT-4o 人类对齐评测, 人工一致性验证
metric: GPT-4o Concept Preservation (0–4), GPT-4o Prompt Following (0–4), Krippendorff's Alpha
eval_feature: 概念保持与提示遵循双维度, 内部思考, 任务强化, 人类偏好对齐
scale: 150张参考图像, 1,350个提示, 7种生成方法, 7位人工标注员
build_method_en: Multi-source image curation, stratified prompt design, human-aligned GPT-4o evaluation, human agreement validation
eval_feature_en: Concept preservation and prompt following, internal thinking, task reinforcement, human-preference alignment
intro_en: DreamBench++ is a human-aligned benchmark for personalized image generation. It curates 150 diverse reference images and nine prompts per image, evaluates concept preservation and prompt following through a two-step GPT-4o protocol with internal thinking and task reinforcement, and validates the automated scores against independent human ratings.
scale_en: 150 reference images, 1,350 prompts, 7 generation methods, 7 human annotators
metric_en: GPT-4o Concept Preservation (0–4), GPT-4o Prompt Following (0–4), Krippendorff's Alpha

    B --> C["Generate personalized outputs with seven modern methods"]
    C --> D["Compose human-written GPT-4o meta-prompts with task, rubric, 0–4 range, and format"]
    D --> E["Run internal task summary and scoring plan for self-alignment"]
    E --> F["Score concept preservation and prompt following independently"]
    F --> G["Compare GPT-4o, DINO, and CLIP metrics with ratings from seven trained human annotators"]

    B --> C["用七种现代方法生成个性化结果"]

The diagram records the four image sources and copyright check; 150 references split into 120 photorealistic and 30 non-photorealistic images across live subject, object, and style; nine prompts per image split 4/3/2; seven evaluated generation methods; human-written GPT-4o meta-prompts with task, rubric, 0–4 range, and format; internal task summary and planning for self-alignment; task-reinforced concept-preservation and prompt-following scores; and independent ratings from seven trained annotators with at least two ratings per instance for Krippendorff analysis.

name: DROP
intro: DROP 是报告集中常见的阅读理解 benchmark，强调在段落问答中进行离散推理与数值计算。
build_method: Wikipedia筛选, 对抗式众包, 多答案验证
build_method_en: Wikipedia curation, adversarial crowdsourcing, multi-answer validation
intro_en: DROP is a common reading-comprehension benchmark in the reports, emphasizing discrete reasoning and numerical computation over passages.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1903.00161. DROP selects about 7,000 narrative or number-rich Wikipedia passages, especially NFL summaries, history, and passages with at least 20 numbers. AMT workers receive five random passages, write at least 12 QA pairs using five discrete-reasoning categories, and may submit only questions that a live BiDAF reader misses. Answers are passage/question spans, dates, or numbers with explicit units. The 96,567 questions are split by passage into 77,409/9,536/9,622. Dev/Test get at least two extra answers; 0.7% invalid items are removed. Evaluation uses normalized EM and numeracy-aware macro F1 with greedy multi-span alignment and a maximum over gold answers.

name: DUDE
intro: DUDE（Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation）旨在重新评估文档AI领域当前的方法论，并推动创建更具实践导向的基准。该基准通过引入基于多行业、多领域、多页视觉丰富文档（VRDs）的新型问题、答案和文档布局，以解决视觉丰富文档理解研究进展停滞的问题。DUDE致力于通过多任务和多领域评估设置来更准确地模拟现实世界情况，以促进在低资源设置下的强大泛化和适应能力。
org: KU Leuven, Contract.fit, Snowflake, CVC-UAB, University of La Rochelle, Instabase
build_method: 公共文档人工检索, 多阶段众包标注, 语言学专家仲裁, 诊断标签
modality: 文档图像, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 多行业, 多领域, 多页, 多任务, 泛化能力, 适应性
build_method_en: Manual public-document search, phased crowd annotation, linguist adjudication, diagnostic labeling
eval_feature_en: Multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page, multi-task, generalization ability, adaptability
intro_en: DUDE (Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation) aims to reassess current methodologies in the document AI field and promote the creation of more practical benchmarks. It addresses the stagnation in visual-rich document (VRD) understanding research by introducing new questions, answers, and document layouts based on multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page VRDs. DUDE strives to more accurately simulate real-world scenarios through multi-task and multi-domain evaluation settings, fostering robust generalization and adaptability in low-resource environments.

name: DynaMath
intro: DynaMath是一个动态视觉数学基准，旨在深入评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的数学推理鲁棒性。该基准包含501个高质量、多主题的种子问题，每个问题都以Python程序表示，通过精心设计和标注，可以自动生成大量具体的变体问题。DynaMath通过评估VLM在不同输入条件下的表现，来衡量其泛化能力，揭示了当前VLM在数学推理方面的局限性。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, UC Berkeley
build_method: 视觉数学题筛选, STEM学生策略标注, Python程序化生成, 人工程序质检
metric: Average-case Accuracy (Aavg), Worst-case Accuracy (Awst), Reasoning Robustness (RR), Repetition Consistency (RC)
eval_feature: 动态视觉与文本变体, 平均与最坏性能对照, 重复一致性
scale: 501个种子程序, 每题10个评测变体, 共5,010个具体问题
build_method_en: Visual-math seed curation, STEM-student strategy annotation, Python program generation, manual program QA
eval_feature_en: Dynamic visual and textual variants, average-versus-worst performance, repetition consistency
intro_en: DynaMath is a dynamic visual math benchmark designed to thoroughly evaluate the mathematical reasoning robustness of visual language models (VLMs). It contains 501 high-quality, multi-topic seed problems, each represented as a Python program. Through careful design and annotation, a large number of specific variant problems can be automatically generated. DynaMath measures VLMs' generalization ability by assessing their performance under different input conditions, revealing current limitations in VLMs' mathematical reasoning.

name: EgoTempo
intro: EgoTempo是一个专门为评估多模态大模型在自我中心视频中时间理解能力而设计的数据集。它通过整合整个视频的信息来强调任务，确保模型需要依赖时间模式而非静态线索或预先存在的知识。实验表明，当前的多模态大模型在自我中心视频的时间推理方面仍有不足。
build_method: Ego4D片段提取, Gemini 1.5 Pro辅助问答生成, 人工复核, 单帧捷径过滤
modality: 视频, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 10类时序能力, 纯文本/单帧/多帧受控对照, LLM评委
scale: 500个问答对, 365个片段, 221段视频, 40个场景
build_method_en: Ego4D clip extraction, Gemini 1.5 Pro-assisted QA generation, manual review, single-frame shortcut filtering
eval_feature_en: 10 temporal capabilities, controlled text/single/multi-frame comparison, LLM judge
intro_en: EgoTempo is a dataset specifically designed to evaluate the temporal understanding ability of multimodal large models in egocentric videos. It emphasizes the task by integrating information from the entire video, ensuring models rely on temporal patterns rather than static cues or prior knowledge. Experiments show that current multimodal large models still have limitations in temporal reasoning for egocentric videos.

name: EHRSQL
intro: EHRSQL是针对电子健康记录的实用文本到SQL基准，通过收集222名医院工作人员的提问并关联MIMIC-III和eICU数据库，评估QA模型在结构化EHR数据上的SQL生成和时间表达式理解能力。
org: KAIST, Seoul Women's University, Konyang University College of Medicine
build_method: 医院问卷, 问题与时间模板, 人工SQL标注, 数据库实例化, 人工与机器释义质检
eval_feature: 真实医院需求, 时间敏感查询, 不可回答题拒答, 可执行SQL
scale: 24,411个问题-SQL对, 230个模板, 2个EHR数据库, 222名医护受访者
build_method_en: Hospital poll, question and time templates, manual SQL annotation, database instantiation, human/machine paraphrase QA
eval_feature_en: Real hospital needs, time-sensitive queries, unanswerable-question abstention, executable SQL
intro_en: EHRSQL is a practical text-to-SQL benchmark for electronic health records. It collects questions from 222 hospital staff and links them to the MIMIC-III and eICU databases to evaluate QA models' SQL generation and temporal expression understanding on structured EHR data.

name: EmbSpatial-Bench
intro: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的快速发展预示了其在具身智能方面的潜力，然而，具身环境中空间理解的关键能力尚未得到充分评估。EmbSpatial-Bench旨在评估LVLMs的具身空间理解能力。该基准测试从具身场景中自动生成，涵盖了六种以自我为中心的空间关系，揭示了当前LVLMs（包括GPT-4V）在空间理解方面的不足。同时，该研究还提出了EmbSpatial-SFT，一个旨在提升LVLMs具身空间理解能力的指令微调数据集。
build_method: 三维场景自动生成, 空间关系提取, 模板组题, 自动过滤, 逐题人工核验
eval_feature: 自我中心视角, 六类空间关系, 真实与仿真室内场景, 生成式与似然式评测
scale: 3,640个问答对, 2,181张图像, 277个场景, 294个物体类别
build_method_en: 3D-scene generation, spatial-relation extraction, template QA, automatic filtering, per-item human verification
eval_feature_en: Egocentric perspective, six spatial relations, real and simulated indoor scenes, generation/likelihood evaluation
intro_en: The rapid development of large vision-language models (LVLMs) highlights their potential in embodied intelligence; however, key spatial understanding abilities in embodied environments remain under-evaluated. EmbSpatial-Bench is designed to assess the embodied spatial understanding capabilities of LVLMs. This benchmark is automatically generated from embodied scenarios and covers six types of egocentric spatial relationships, revealing current shortcomings in spatial understanding among LVLMs, including GPT-4V. Additionally, the study introduces EmbSpatial-SFT, an instruction fine-tuning dataset aimed at enhancing LVLMs' embodied spatial understanding.
scale_en: 3,640 QA pairs, 2,181 images, 277 scenes, 294 object categories

flowchart LR

    B["Extract 2D bounding boxes from 3D coordinates using camera parameters for each object in images"] --> C["Extract spatial relation triples with non-overlapping boxes for six egocentric relationships: above, below, left, right, close, far"]
    C["Extract spatial relation triples with non-overlapping boxes for six egocentric relationships: above, below, left, right, close, far"] --> D["Generate multiple-choice questions using templates for directional relations and aggregated questions for distance relations"]
    D["Generate multiple-choice questions using templates for directional relations and aggregated questions for distance relations"] --> E["Filter out QA pairs with overly large or small bounding boxes while maintaining balanced spatial relation distribution"]
    E["Filter out QA pairs with overly large or small bounding boxes while maintaining balanced spatial relation distribution"] --> F["Manually verify each sample to remove questions with unclear objects or incorrect spatial relationships"]
    F["Manually verify each sample to remove questions with unclear objects or incorrect spatial relationships"] --> G["Evaluate LVLMs using generation-based and likelihood strategies with accuracy as the metric"]

flowchart LR
    A["从MP3D、ScanNet和AI2-THOR的3D场景中随机选取视点采集RGB-D图像"] --> B["利用相机参数将3D坐标转换为2D边界框标注每个物体"]
    B["利用相机参数将3D坐标转换为2D边界框标注每个物体"] --> C["提取无重叠边界框的空间关系三元组涵盖六种自我中心关系"]
    C["提取无重叠边界框的空间关系三元组涵盖六种自我中心关系"] --> D["用模板生成方向关系的多选题并聚合生成距离关系问题"]
    D["用模板生成方向关系的多选题并聚合生成距离关系问题"] --> E["过滤边界框过大或过小的问答对并保持空间关系分布平衡"]
    E["过滤边界框过大或过小的问答对并保持空间关系分布平衡"] --> F["人工验证每个样本移除物体不清晰或空间关系错误的问题"]
    F["人工验证每个样本移除物体不清晰或空间关系错误的问题"] --> G["用生成式和似然策略评估大模型并以准确率为指标"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ACL 2024 paper arXiv:2406.05756 Sections 2.1–2.2, Figure 2, and Tables 1–2. The diagram uses MP3D test scenes, ScanNet validation scenes, and AI2-THOR key frames from 7 ALFRED task types across 93 scenes; distinguishes random viewpoints from PDDL-selected task frames; projects annotated 3D objects through camera parameters to 2D boxes and mean depth; extracts non-overlapping viewer-centric above/below/left/right/close/far triples; uses five templates for directional relations and aggregate closest/farthest questions; filters box size and balances relations; manually checks every sample for unclear objects or wrong relations; records the final 3,640 QA, 2,181 images, 277 scenes, and 294 object categories; and evaluates zero-shot LVLMs by generation and maximum-likelihood option accuracy. EmbSpatial-SFT is explicitly excluded from the benchmark-construction path because it is a separate training set.

name: EMMA
intro: EMMA（Enhanced MultiModal reAsoning）是一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）有机多模态推理能力的基准测试。它涵盖数学、物理、化学和编程等领域，任务需要跨模态推理，不能仅通过单一模态独立解决。对现有MLLMs的评估显示，在处理复杂多模态和多步推理任务方面存在显著局限性，突显了改进多模态架构和训练范式的必要性。
org: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Sun Yat-sen University, University of Washington, Microsoft, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 已有基准严格过滤, 图像描述消融, 分学科技能分类, 领域专家人工扩充与核验
task_type: 多项选择与开放式多模态推理
eval_feature: 文本加图像描述过滤, 细粒度技能标签, 直接回答与思维链, 无模型裁判
scale: 2,788个问题（992个过滤自已有基准，1,796个新构建；2,002道选择题，786道开放题）
build_method_en: Strict benchmark filtering, caption ablation, subject skill taxonomies, expert expansion and verification
eval_feature_en: Text-plus-caption filtering, fine-grained skill labels, direct/CoT prompting, no model judge
intro_en: EMMA (Enhanced MultiModal reAsoning) is a benchmark designed to evaluate the organic multimodal reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It covers fields such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, and programming, requiring cross-modal reasoning that cannot be solved by a single modality alone. Evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant limitations in handling complex multimodal and multi-step reasoning tasks, highlighting the need to improve multimodal architectures and training paradigms.

name: Encyclo-K
intro: Encyclo-K是一个基于语句的基准测试，它重新思考了基准测试的构建方式。其核心思想是知识语句而非问题可以作为策展单位，并可以从中构建问题。该基准测试通过从权威教科书中提取独立的知识语句，并在测试时通过随机抽样动态组合成评估问题，以解决数据污染、单知识点评估和昂贵领域专家标注的局限性。
org: Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy Sciences, University of Manchester, Peking University
build_method: 教材截图, 视觉模型提取正确语句, 人工格式质检, DeepSeek-R1生成错误语句, 程序化动态组题
eval_feature: 语句级策展, 动态组题, 多知识点综合理解, 中英双语, 防污染
build_method_en: Textbook screenshots, vision-model fact extraction, human format QA, DeepSeek-R1 false statements, programmatic dynamic assembly
eval_feature_en: Statement-level curation, dynamic questions, multi-knowledge comprehension, bilingual, contamination resistance
intro_en: Encyclo-K is a statement-based benchmark that rethinks benchmark construction. Its core idea is that knowledge statements, rather than questions, serve as the curation units from which questions can be generated. This benchmark extracts independent knowledge statements from authoritative textbooks and dynamically assembles evaluation questions through random sampling during testing, addressing limitations such as data contamination, single-knowledge-point evaluation, and costly domain expert annotation.

name: Eq-bench
intro: EQ-Bench 是面向纯文本大语言模型的情绪理解基准。它要求模型阅读由 GPT-4 生成的冲突或紧张对话，为角色的四种候选情绪分别给出 0–10 强度，经过自我批评后再修订评分，并以与作者参考情绪分布的距离计算总分。
build_method: GPT-4对话生成, 作者制定问题与参考情绪强度, 精确零样本提示, 自动解析与距离计分
task_type: 情绪理解与人际动态推理
eval_feature: 四情绪强度评分, 批评与修订, 相对强度归一化, 解析失败门槛
build_method_en: GPT-4 dialogue generation, author-defined questions/references, exact zero-shot prompting, automatic parsing and distance scoring
eval_feature_en: Four-emotion intensity ratings, critique and revision, relative-intensity normalization, parseability threshold
intro_en: EQ-Bench is a text-only emotional-understanding benchmark for large language models. Models read GPT-4-generated conflict or tension dialogues, rate four candidate emotions from 0 to 10, critique and revise their ratings, and receive a score based on distance from author-defined reference emotion distributions.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Sample location, author style, and conflict/tension scenario seeds"] --> B["Use GPT-4 to generate emotionally nuanced dialogue scenes"]
    B --> C["Authors choose four diverse emotions and 0–10 reference ratings"]
    C --> D["Build 60 English emotional-understanding questions"]
    D --> E["Prompt zero-shot first-pass scores, critique, and revised scores"]
    E --> F["Parse at temperature 0.01; add 0.15 on failure for up to five retries"]
    F --> G["Normalize four ratings to sum 10 and score 10 minus absolute differences"]
    G --> H["Average first/revised runs separately, take the better run; fewer than 50 parseable answers fails"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["随机采样地点、作者风格与冲突/紧张情境种子"] --> B["用GPT-4生成具有细腻情绪张力的对话"]
    B --> C["作者选择四种差异化情绪并设定0–10参考强度"]
    C --> D["构建60道英文情绪理解问题"]
    D --> E["零样本输出首轮评分、逐步批评与修订评分"]
    E --> F["温度0.01解析；失败则每次加0.15，最多重试五次"]
    F --> G["将四情绪归一化为总和10，并以10减绝对差之和计分"]
    G --> H["分别平均首轮/修订轮并取更高整轮；可解析题少于50即失败"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the original December 2023 EQ-Bench paper arXiv:2312.06281 Sections 2.6 and 3.1–3.10, not the later Qwen3-VL report that merely cites the benchmark. The diagram records random location/author-style/scenario seeds; GPT-4 generation constrained to conflict or tension; author-selected questions, four diverse emotions, and reference ratings; 60 English items; exact zero-shot first-pass/critique/revised response structure; temperature 0.01 with +0.15 parse-failure increments until parseable or attempts exceed five; normalization of each four-emotion vector to sum 10; per-question score 10 minus the sum of absolute differences; random baseline 0 and perfect alignment 100; separate first-pass and revised-run averages with the better entire run selected rather than per-question cherry-picking; and failure below 50 parseable answers out of 60.

name: ERQA
intro: ERQA（Embodied Reasoning Question Answering）是 Google DeepMind 随 Gemini Robotics 发布的开放具身推理基准。它包含 400 道图文交错的四选一 VQA，覆盖空间、轨迹、动作、状态估计、指向、多视角和任务推理；其中 28% 使用多张图像。
build_method: 具身能力分类, 团队策展图文交错选择题, 问题类型标注, TFRecord公开发布
eval_feature: 八类具身推理, 28%多图题, 直接与思维链提示, 分类别准确率
scale: 400个问题（84空间、72动作、66轨迹、55状态、38任务、37多视角、34指向、14其他）
build_method_en: Embodied-capability taxonomy, team-curated interleaved VQA, question-type labels, public TFRecord release
eval_feature_en: Eight embodied-reasoning categories, 28% multi-image, direct/CoT prompting, category accuracy
intro_en: ERQA (Embodied Reasoning Question Answering) is an open embodied-reasoning benchmark released by Google DeepMind with Gemini Robotics. It contains 400 interleaved image-text four-choice VQA items spanning spatial, trajectory, action, state-estimation, pointing, multi-view, and task reasoning; 28% use multiple images.
scale_en: 400 questions (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, 14 other)

    D --> E["Run zero-shot direct or exact optional CoT prompting"]
    E --> F["Parse final A/B/C/D option and compare with ground truth"]
    F --> G["Report overall and per-category accuracy"]

    E --> F["解析最终A/B/C/D选项并与标准答案比对"]
    F --> G["报告总体与分类别准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Gemini Robotics report arXiv:2503.20020 Section 2.1, Figures 3–5, Tables 1–2, and the official embodiedreasoning/ERQA release. The diagram records the physical-world capability scope; interleaved one-or-more-image four-choice VQA format; all 400 questions; category counts from Figure 4 (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state estimation, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, and 14 other); the 28% multi-image share; cross-frame registration, affordance, and 3D-relation demands; TFRecord fields question, image/encoded, answer, question_type, and visual_indices under CC BY 4.0; zero-shot direct and the report's optional CoT instruction; final-option parsing; and overall/category accuracy. The report and repository do not disclose an image-acquisition or question-authoring protocol, so the diagram explicitly avoids inventing one.

name: EvalPlus
intro: EvalPlus是一个代码合成评估框架，旨在严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的代码的功能正确性。它通过LLM和基于变异的策略自动生成大量新的测试用例来增强现有评估数据集。EvalPlus能够发现LLM合成代码中大量未被检测到的错误，并揭示了测试不足可能导致的错误排名。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Nanjing University
build_method: LLM种子生成、契约过滤、类型感知变异、差分测试
build_method_en: Automated Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free
intro_en: EvalPlus is a code synthesis evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the functional correctness of code generated by large language models (LLMs). It enhances existing evaluation datasets by automatically generating numerous new test cases through LLMs and mutation-based strategies. EvalPlus can detect many previously undetected errors in LLM-synthesized code and reveals error rankings that may result from insufficient testing.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.01210, Sections 2 and 3. EvalPlus starts from an original code benchmark with ground-truth implementations and base tests, prompts ChatGPT with the ground truth, demonstration inputs, and a specialized instruction to generate about 30 seeds per HumanEval task, rejects invalid seeds and mutants with program input contracts, and iteratively performs type-aware mutation to generate 1,000 additional inputs per task under a one-hour budget. Differential testing compares generated code with corrected ground-truth implementations. The paper's concrete HumanEval+ artifact expands the test scale by 80 times; an optional greedy set-cover reduction produces HumanEval+-Mini, 47 times smaller, while preserving branch coverage, mutant kills, and empirical LLM-sample kills. Functional correctness is reported with unbiased pass@k.

name: EVMbench
intro: EVMbench评估AI智能体检测、修补和利用高危智能合约漏洞的能力。论文从公开审计报告和Tempo安全场景出发，经自动筛选与OtterSec专家质检得到40次审计中的120个漏洞；检测覆盖全部120个漏洞，修补覆盖22个仓库的45个漏洞，利用覆盖16个仓库的24个漏洞。
build_method: 公开审计报告筛选, OtterSec专家质检, 隔离任务环境, 三模式隐藏验证
metric: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
task_type: 智能合约漏洞检测, 修补, 利用
eval_feature: 检测用GPT-5报告匹配, 修补用隐藏利用测试, 利用用交易重放与Rust状态评分器
scale: 120个漏洞/40次审计；修补45个/22仓库；利用24个/16仓库
build_method_en: Public Audit-report Screening, OtterSec Expert QC, Isolated Task Environments, Three-mode Hidden Verification
eval_feature_en: GPT-5 Report Matching for Detect, Hidden Exploit Tests for Patch, Transaction Replay and Rust State Grader for Exploit
intro_en: EVMbench evaluates agents on detecting, patching, and exploiting high-severity smart-contract vulnerabilities. The paper filters public audit findings and Tempo security scenarios, then uses OtterSec expert QC to obtain 120 vulnerabilities from 40 audits; Detect covers all 120, Patch covers 45 vulnerabilities in 22 repositories, and Exploit covers 24 in 16 repositories.
scale_en: 120 vulnerabilities / 40 audits; Patch 45 / 22 repositories; Exploit 24 / 16 repositories
metric_en: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the EVMbench paper (OpenAI, Paradigm, OtterSec). The paper's final benchmark count of 120 vulnerabilities from 40 audits controls over the OpenAI launch-page summary of 117. Most cases originate in Code4rena reports; o3 first identifies high-severity loss-of-funds findings, then license, language, date, reproducibility, and expert-quality gates are applied, with selected Tempo scenarios added. Detect uses all 120 cases and GPT-5 matching of submitted audit reports to ground truth. Patch uses 45 vulnerabilities from 22 repositories and combines reset/original tests with unseen exploit tests. Exploit uses 24 vulnerabilities from 16 repositories, replays submitted transactions against local Anvil, and applies a separate Rust chain-state grader. Every setting is run three times and reported with rates, bootstrap confidence intervals, and cost.

name: ExploitBench
intro: ExploitBench是一个面向网络安全智能体的能力阶梯基准。首个v8-bench版本在启用V8 heap sandbox的隔离容器中评测41个生产级已知漏洞，用16项单调能力标志刻画从代码覆盖、触发漏洞、构造利用原语到任意代码执行的进展。
build_method: 生产级V8 N-day漏洞整理, 逐漏洞隔离镜像, 统一MCP接口, 确定性重播种评分器
metric: 16-capability Bitmap, Tier Success Rate, Arbitrary Code Execution Rate
modality: 文本, 代码, 交互式工具轨迹
task_type: 漏洞覆盖, 触发, 利用原语构造, 任意代码执行
eval_feature: V8 heap sandbox, 隔离容器, 差分真值二进制, 重播种挑战响应, 300轮智能体交互
scale: 41个V8漏洞, 16项能力, 5层阶梯, 9个模型, 每设置3个种子
task_type_en: Vulnerability Coverage, Triggering, Exploit Primitives, Arbitrary Code Execution
build_method_en: Production V8 N-day Curation, Per-bug Isolated Images, Uniform MCP Interface, Deterministic Reseeded Graders
eval_feature_en: V8 Heap Sandbox, Isolated Containers, Differential Ground-truth Binaries, Reseeded Challenge-response, 300-turn Agent Runs
intro_en: ExploitBench is a capability-ladder benchmark for cybersecurity agents. Its first v8-bench release evaluates 41 known production V8 vulnerabilities in isolated containers with the V8 heap sandbox enabled, using 16 monotonic capability flags to track progress from code coverage and bug triggering through exploit primitives to arbitrary code execution.
scale_en: 41 V8 bugs, 16 capabilities, 5 tiers, 9 models, 3 seeds per setting
metric_en: 16-capability Bitmap, Tier Success Rate, Arbitrary Code Execution Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.14153 and the official ExploitBench repository. v8-bench packages 41 production V8 N-day vulnerabilities with vulnerable source/history, fixing patches, and vulnerable/fixed d8 builds. The task is a one-day scenario: agents receive the bug description and patch diff but no exploit PoC, work only in the isolated writable workspace, and interact through six MCP tools. The paper evaluates a bare uniform runner, adaptive coaching, and native vendor-CLI arm with three headline seeds and a 300-turn budget. Deterministic graders use llvm-cov, vulnerable-versus-fixed differential behavior, per-call reseeded challenge-response builtins, signal/protection checks, and an OS-level prctl round trip. Outputs are monotonic 16-capability bitmaps across five tiers, with full transcripts and grader calls retained for audit.

name: FACTS Grounding
intro: FACTS Grounding评估模型能否仅依据给定长文档生成满足请求且完全有据可依的长篇回答。基准包含860条公开Open样本和859条私有Blind样本，文档平均约2.5k tokens、最长32k tokens，并用三种评判模型分别校准资格与事实性。
org: Google DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud, Kaggle
build_method: 第三方人工构题, 全量人工核验, 平衡随机划分, 两套金标集校准多评委提示
task_type: 长上下文问答, 摘要, 文档改写, 事实立足性验证
eval_feature: 860条公开集+859条私有盲测, 最长32k上下文, 三评委资格共识, 三评委事实性聚合
scale: Open 860条 + Blind 859条；平均2.5k、最长32k tokens
task_type_en: Long-context QA, Summarization, Document Rewriting, Grounded Factuality Verification
build_method_en: Third-party Human Task Authoring, Full Manual Verification, Balanced Random Splits, Multi-judge Prompt Calibration on Two Golden Sets
eval_feature_en: 860 Open + 859 Blind Examples, Up to 32k Context, Unanimous Three-judge Eligibility, Three-judge Factuality Aggregation
intro_en: FACTS Grounding evaluates whether models can produce long-form responses that fulfill a request using only a supplied long document and remain fully grounded in it. It contains 860 public Open and 859 private Blind examples, with contexts averaging about 2.5k and reaching 32k tokens, and separately calibrates eligibility and factuality prompts for three judge models.
scale_en: 860 Open + 859 Blind examples; mean 2.5k, maximum 32k tokens
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.03200. Third-party raters create context-only Q&A, summarization, and document-rewriting tasks over web documents in five enterprise domains; all examples are manually checked and creative, expert-knowledge, mathematical, meta-analysis, and OCR-unreadable cases are removed. Balanced random sampling yields 860 public Open and 859 private Blind examples, with contexts averaging about 2.5k and reaching 32k tokens. Eligibility prompt selection tests two templates on a separate N=450 golden set, and a response is disqualified only when Gemini 1.5 Pro, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet all agree. Factuality prompt selection tests seven templates on N=402 and chooses the best Macro-F1 template per judge. A response is accurate only if every informative claim is supported; ineligible responses count as inaccurate, and the final score averages the three judges' accurate-response percentages.

name: FEA-Bench
intro: FEA-Bench评估大模型在代码仓库中增量实现新功能的能力。论文从Top PyPI的8,000个包出发，经许可证、PR数量与快速pytest验证确定119个来源仓，再通过新组件比例、GPT-4o意图和金标准补丁后测试全过等门禁，得到83个仓库的1,401个任务；Lite子集含48个仓库的200题。
build_method: Top PyPI仓库筛选, PR测试变更抓取, 新组件规则过滤, GPT-4o意图分类, 补丁前后pytest验证
metric: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall
task_type: 代码生成, 代码编辑, 代码补全
task_type_en: Code Generation, Code Editing, Code Completion
build_method_en: Top PyPI Repository Screening, Test-changing PR Collection, New-component Rule Filtering, GPT-4o Intent Classification, Before/after-patch pytest Validation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Long Context
intro_en: FEA-Bench evaluates repository-level incremental feature implementation. The paper starts from 8,000 Top PyPI packages, identifies 119 source repositories through license, pull-request-count, and fast pytest validation, then applies new-component-ratio, GPT-4o intent, and post-gold-patch all-tests-pass gates to obtain 1,401 tasks from 83 repositories; the Lite subset contains 200 tasks from 48 repositories.
metric_en: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.06680 Sections 3-4 and Appendix A. The pipeline starts from 8,000 Top PyPI packages, keeps about 600 licensed repositories with more than 1,000 PRs, fast-validates the first 20 test-changing PRs per repository with pip/pytest, and obtains 119 source repositories. Candidate PRs are split into test and gold patches; newly added functions/classes must include at least one component, exceed 25% of edited lines, and stay within 8,192 tokens, while GPT-4o must classify the primary intent as new feature. Tests may fail on the base plus test patch but all relevant tests must pass after the gold patch. The result is 1,401 tasks from 83 repositories plus a 200-task/48-repository Lite set, evaluated by patch application and hidden tests with resolved ratio, apply rate, and retrieval diagnostics.

name: FigureQA
intro: FigureQA是一个合成科学图表视觉推理数据集。它先在约束下采样数值数据，再用改造后的Bokeh渲染五类图表并抽取元素边界框，随后从15个模板生成Yes/No问题并平衡答案；训练集含10万图和130万问题，验证集与测试集各含2万图和超过25万问题。
org: Microsoft Research Montréal, Université de Montréal/MILA, Tilburg University
build_method: 受约束数值采样, 改造Bokeh合成渲染, 15类模板问答生成, Yes/No平衡, 交替配色划分
modality: 图像, 文本, 数值源数据, 边界框
task_type: 合成图表视觉问答, 关系推理
eval_feature: 5类图表, 15类二元模板, 100种X11颜色, 未见颜色-图表组合
scale: 训练10万图/130万问题；验证与测试各2万图/超过25万问题
modality_en: Image, Text, Numerical Source Data, Bounding Boxes
task_type_en: Synthetic Chart Visual QA, Relational Reasoning
build_method_en: Constrained Numerical Sampling, Modified-Bokeh Synthetic Rendering, 15-template QA Generation, Yes/No Balancing, Alternated-color Splits
eval_feature_en: 5 Plot Types, 15 Binary Templates, 100 X11 Colors, Unseen Color-plot Combinations
intro_en: FigureQA is a synthetic scientific-chart visual-reasoning dataset. It samples constrained numerical data, renders five plot types with a modified Bokeh stack while extracting element boxes, then generates balanced Yes/No questions from 15 templates. The training set has 100k images and 1.3M questions; validation and test each have 20k images and more than 250k questions.
scale_en: Train 100k images / 1.3M questions; validation and test 20k images / >250k questions each
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1710.07300 (submitted 2017; ICLR 2018 workshop), replacing the previous incorrect 2025 Seed1.5-VL attribution. The paper uses a two-stage generator: numerical values are sampled under tuned constraints and linear/quadratic/bell-shape heuristics, then five scientific plot types are rendered with a modified Bokeh implementation that also extracts plot-element bounding boxes. Visual variation includes 100 X11 colors distant from white, randomized fonts/gridlines, and occupancy-aware legend placement. Fifteen templates generate binary relation questions; one Yes and one No are created whenever applicable, then excess pairs are discarded to balance answers per question type. Colors are divided into A/B halves so validation and test use unseen color-plot combinations, while same-scheme variants are also released.

name: Finance Agent Benchmark
intro: Finance Agent Benchmark评估智能体完成真实金融研究任务的能力。7位业界专家共同定义9类任务并编写537道需要多份公开文档或SEC申报文件的问题，每题含标准答案、来源和分步解法；问题经异人复核、作者终审和细粒度评分准则复核后，由具备四类检索工具的智能体作答。
build_method: 7位金融专家构建9类任务, 537题多文档标注, 异人交叉复核, GPT-4o生成并人工复核评分准则
metric: Class-balanced Accuracy, Naive Accuracy, Time and Cost per Query
modality: 文本, 网页, SEC申报文件, 工具轨迹
task_type: 金融信息检索, 数值推理, 趋势与市场分析, 金融建模
eval_feature: Google/EDGAR检索, HTML解析与键值存储检索, 细粒度合取评分准则, 矛盾检测
scale: 537题/9类；公开验证50、私有验证150、私有测试337
modality_en: Text, Web Pages, SEC Filings, Tool Trajectories
task_type_en: Financial Retrieval, Numerical Reasoning, Trend and Market Analysis, Financial Modeling
build_method_en: Nine-category Taxonomy by Seven Finance Experts, 537 Multi-document Items, Independent Peer Review, GPT-4o Rubric Generation plus Manual Review
eval_feature_en: Google/EDGAR Search, HTML Parsing and Key-value Retrieval, Fine-grained Conjunctive Rubrics, Contradiction Detection
intro_en: Finance Agent Benchmark evaluates agents on realistic financial research. Seven industry experts define nine task categories and author 537 questions requiring multiple public documents or SEC filings, each with a reference answer, sources, and step-by-step solution. Items undergo independent peer review, author final review, and manual verification of fine-grained rubrics before tool-equipped agents answer them.
scale_en: 537 questions / 9 categories; public validation 50, private validation 150, private test 337
metric_en: Class-balanced Accuracy, Naive Accuracy, Time and Cost per Query
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.00828 and the official vals-ai/finance-agent repository. Seven practitioners with experience at banks, hedge funds, private equity firms, and startups define nine categories and author 537 questions that require multiple public documents, emphasizing sources published from 2024 onward. Each item contains a ground-truth answer, required source documents, and a step-by-step solution; a different expert checks calculations/content, then the authors standardize the corpus.
