GPT-4o extracts atomic rubrics from expert answers, all rubrics are manually reviewed, and a whole-answer contradiction check is added. Splits are 50 public-validation, 150 private-validation, and 337 fully private test examples. The paper harness exposes Google Search, EDGAR Search, ParseHTML, and RetrieveInformation. Correctness applies conjunction over required rubric checks with contradiction rejection; the primary metric equally averages the nine category accuracies, with naive accuracy, time, tool use, and cost also reported.

name: FinSearchComp
intro: FinSearchComp是一个完全开源的Agent基准测试，旨在对金融搜索和推理能力进行真实、专家级别的评估。该基准包含三个任务：时间敏感数据获取、简单历史查询和复杂历史调查，以复现真实的金融分析师工作流程。通过70位专业金融专家的标注和严格的质量保证流程，确保了其难度和可靠性。它包含635个问题，涵盖全球和大中华区市场，并评估了21个模型。
build_method: 三类金融任务分源构建, 70位专家标注, 盲审交叉验证, 动态与范围真值
eval_feature: 开放域工具使用, Global/大中华区双语划分, 78.6%范围评分, 专家抽查
build_method_en: Three Task-specific Financial Pipelines, 70-expert Annotation, Blind Cross-validation, Dynamic and Range-based Gold Answers
eval_feature_en: Open-domain Tool Use, Bilingual Global/Greater-China Splits, 78.6% In-range Grading, Expert Spot Checks
intro_en: FinSearchComp is a fully open-source Agent benchmark designed for realistic, expert-level evaluation of financial search and reasoning capabilities. It includes three tasks: time-sensitive data retrieval, simple historical queries, and complex historical investigations, replicating real financial analyst workflows. With annotations from 70 professional financial experts and a rigorous quality assurance process, it ensures both difficulty and reliability. The benchmark contains 635 questions covering global and Greater China markets and evaluates 21 models.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.13160 Sections 2.2-2.6, Figures 2-4, and the official FinSearchComp release. T1 uses public APIs and executable calls for dynamic answers; T2 uses official filings, authority sites, and professional databases for direct facts; T3 uses the same source families for multi-source calculations. Fifty proficient and twenty senior financial experts author and oversee the data. Reliable-source selection, explicit definitions/dates, ranges or tolerances, and avoidance of revision-prone metrics reduce ambiguity; one or two blind experts independently solve every item and a senior expert edits, arbitrates, or discards disagreements. The final 635 questions split into Global 337 (T1/T2/T3: 134/119/84) and Greater China 298 (110/100/88). End-to-end agents may orchestrate web, plugins, APIs, SQL, and other tools. Rubric-guided LLM judgments use exact match for 21.4% and in-range checks for 78.6%; expert validation reports at least 95% agreement.

name: FIREBENCH
intro: FIREBENCH面向企业与API场景评估六类精确指令遵循能力：输出格式、顺序回复、条目排序、过度自信、正向内容要求和负向内容要求。论文Table 1给出2,470条样本，并按类别使用程序验证、简单模糊匹配或GPT-4.1准则评判。
build_method: 六类企业能力池组装, 程序化真值构造, GPT-5内容准则生成
task_type: 指令遵循, 信息抽取, 客服, 代码代理
eval_feature: 企业场景, 格式约束, API驱动
intro_en: FIREBENCH evaluates six precise instruction-following capabilities for enterprise and API settings: output format, ordered responses, item ranking, overconfidence, positive content requirements, and negative content requirements. Paper Table 1 contains 2,470 samples graded by programmatic checks, simple fuzzy matching, or GPT-4.1 rubrics depending on category.
build_method_en: Six Enterprise Capability Pools, Programmatic Ground-truth Construction, GPT-5 Content-rubric Generation
task_type_en: Instruction Following, Information Extraction, Customer Support, Coding Agents
eval_feature_en: Enterprise Scenarios, Format Constraints, API-driven Evaluation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.04857 Sections 3.1-3.6 and Table 1. The exact composition is 2,470: output format 1,300; ordered responses 200; item ranking 200; overconfidence 370; positive content 200; negative content 200. Output-format QA draws 25 questions from each of LongBench V2, QUALITY, GPQA Diamond, and LogiQA and states 21 constraints, but Section 3.1 also reports 1,000 QA instances, an internal arithmetic inconsistency; the diagram preserves the paper's reported 1,000 and Table 1 total rather than inventing a correction. MHPP contributes 300 coding-format cases. Ordered support trials collect 10-15 fields one per turn; ranking uses 20 tables; overconfidence combines 300 paired prompt trials and about 70 unanswerable documents. GPT-5 generates positive/negative rubrics over 200 Arena Hard Auto 2.0 prompts each. Programmatic or fuzzy checks score the first four categories; GPT-4.1 judges content rubrics and any violation fails.

name: FLAMES
intro: FLAMES是一个针对大语言模型价值观对齐的中文评测基准，由上海人工智能实验室和复旦大学共同开发。它包含一套精心设计的对抗性提示，旨在揭示模型在安全性、公平性等方面的深层价值观对齐缺陷。该基准不仅涵盖了通用的无害原则，还融入了和谐等具有中国文化特色的价值观维度。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University
build_method: 五维价值框架, 众包对抗提示, 两轮攻击过滤, 双人标注与专家仲裁, 专用评分器训练
task_type: 安全测试, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
scale: 2,251条提示；公开评测1,000条；约22.9K条已标回答
build_method_en: Five-dimensional Value Framework, Crowdsourced Adversarial Prompts, Two-stage Attack Filtering, Dual Annotation plus Expert Adjudication, Specified-scorer Training
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: FLAMES is a Chinese evaluation benchmark for value alignment in large language models, jointly developed by Shanghai AI Laboratory and Fudan University. It includes a set of carefully designed adversarial prompts aimed at revealing deep value alignment flaws in areas such as safety and fairness. The benchmark covers general harmlessness principles and incorporates culturally specific values like harmony.
scale_en: 2,251 prompts; 1,000 public evaluation prompts; ~22.9K annotated responses
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.06899 Sections 3-5 and Tables 2-3. The five-dimension prompt counts are fairness 590, safety 779, morality 522, legality 118, and data protection 242, totaling 2,251. Crowdworkers use concrete scenarios and three attack methods: disguise, reverse induction, and unsafe inquiry. Two review rounds first check dimension/scenario/attack structure and then require a successful attack on at least one tested LLM. Seventeen LLMs yield about 22.9K annotated responses. Two graduate annotators label each response; a corresponding-field expert adjudicates disagreement. Fairness/safety/morality use 3/2/1 labels, while legality/data protection use 3/1. The public 1,000-prompt evaluation set is stratified 249/429/201/46/75, with remaining prompts retained. Paper results use human harmless rate and harmless score, macro-averaged over five dimensions; the multitask FLAMES-scorer reaches 79.5% accuracy and enables automation.

name: FOFO
intro: 本文提出了FOFO，一个开创性的基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）遵循复杂、特定领域格式的能力，这是它们作为AI代理应用的一个关键但未被充分研究的能力。FOFO通过AI与人类协作的方法，开发了多样的真实世界格式和指令，填补了现有基准在评估格式遵循能力方面的空白。
org: Salesforce Research, University of Illinois at Chicago, Pennsylvania State University
build_method: 专家领域种子与GPT-4扩展, 专用格式生成与人工复核, FORMAT-INSTRU生成与逐条核验
task_type: 格式化文本生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 缺少任一格式要求即失败, GPT-4二元判断与解释, 100题人工一致性复核
build_method_en: Expert Domain Seeds plus GPT-4 Expansion, Domain-format Generation and Human Review, FORMAT-INSTRU Generation and Per-item Verification
eval_feature_en: Any Missing Format Requirement Fails, GPT-4 Binary Verdict plus Explanation, 100-item Human Agreement Check
intro_en: This paper introduces FOFO, a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) ability to follow complex, domain-specific formats—a critical yet underexplored capability for their use as AI agents. FOFO employs AI-human collaboration to develop diverse real-world formats and instructions, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks for assessing format adherence.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.18667 Section 3, Tables 1-3, and Appendix A. Experts seed useful agent subdomains, GPT-4 expands and groups them, and iterative human review yields 10 domains with five subdomains each. GPT-4 proposes five human-readable text formats per subdomain while initially excluding generic formats; experts regenerate or remove poor proposals, then universal JSON/XML/CSV/Markdown/YAML formats are added back, giving 248 formats. GPT-4 writes detailed FORMAT-INSTRU for each selected domain/subdomain/format triplet with exact configurations and dummy context; humans edit, remove, or regenerate each item. The final 494 instructions average 2,908 characters. Models generate with their official prompt formats, temperature 0.7, and 5,120 max new tokens. GPT-4 returns a binary verdict and explanation; missing any single requirement fails. Human review agrees on 84/100 judgments and reveals all 16 disagreements are GPT-4 false positives.

name: FRAMES
intro: FRAMES（Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set）是一个高质量数据集，旨在测试大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成最终答案时的事实性、检索能力和推理能力。该基准测试提供了一个统一的框架，用于评估LLMs在端到端检索增强生成（RAG）场景中的性能。FRAMES包含具有挑战性的多跳问题，需要整合来自多个来源的信息。
build_method: 放弃高幻觉合成试验, 人工多Wikipedia构题, 三个月后重标, 时间消歧与二元答案过滤
eval_feature: 每题2–15篇Wikipedia, 五类推理标签, BM25单步/多步与oracle, Gemini 1.5 Pro自动评分
build_method_en: Rejected High-hallucination Synthetic Pilot, Human Multi-Wikipedia Authoring, Three-month Reannotation, Temporal Disambiguation and Binary-answer Filtering
eval_feature_en: 2–15 Wikipedia Articles per Item, Five Reasoning Labels, BM25 Single/Multi-step and Oracle, Gemini 1.5 Pro Autorating
intro_en: FRAMES (Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set) is a high-quality dataset designed to test large language models (LLMs) on factuality, retrieval ability, and reasoning when generating final answers. This benchmark provides a unified framework to evaluate LLMs' performance in end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) scenarios. FRAMES includes challenging multi-hop questions that require integrating information from multiple sources.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2409.12941 Sections 2-3, Algorithm 1, and Tables 2-3. The synthetic pilot produced over 30% hallucinated questions/answers and struggled beyond four articles, so it is explicitly not the final data source. Vetted humans instead write each question, free-form gold answer, and required Wikipedia article list, then assign any of five reasoning labels. Three-month-later reannotation removes 5.5% whose answers no longer hold; temporal context is added for freshness, binary answers are removed, and Wikipedia-only sourcing improves interpretability. The final 824 questions require 2-15 articles. Single-step baselines compare no retrieval, BM25 top-2/top-4, and oracle articles. Multi-step BM25 iteratively generates queries; the best setup uses five steps, five queries per step, and top ten documents with planning/no-repeat guidance. Gemini 1.5 Pro autorating against gold reaches 0.96 human agreement accuracy and Cohen's kappa 0.889.

name: FronTalk
intro: FronTalk是一个多轮、多模态前端代码生成基准。论文从C4抽样10,000个网页，经GPT-4o摘要、BERTopic聚类与人工选择得到100个网站，再生成并人工精炼10轮功能/设计意图及测试。最终100个对话含1,000轮和3,676个测试用例，文本与视觉模拟器表达等价意图，并通过网页智能体评估指令遵循、遗忘和可用性。
build_method: C4网页抽样与BERTopic聚类, 人工选择100站, GPT-4o生成十轮意图与测试, 人工删除/编辑问题用例, 双用户模拟器
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码
task_type: 前端代码生成, 多轮软件工程
eval_feature: 多模态反馈, 智能体评估, 遗忘分析
intro_en: FronTalk is a multi-turn, multimodal front-end code-generation benchmark. The paper samples 10,000 C4 webpages, uses GPT-4o summaries, BERTopic clustering, and manual selection to obtain 100 sites, then generates and manually refines ten turns of functional/design intents and tests. The final 100 dialogues contain 1,000 turns and 3,676 test cases; textual and visual simulators express equivalent intents, and web agents assess instruction following, forgetting, and usability.
build_method_en: C4 Web Sampling and BERTopic Clustering, Manual 100-site Selection, GPT-4o Ten-turn Intent/Test Generation, Manual Removal/Editing, Dual User Simulators
task_type_en: Front-end Code Generation, Multi-turn Software Engineering
eval_feature_en: Multimodal Feedback, Agent-based Evaluation, Forgetting Analysis
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.04203 Sections 2.2-2.4. FronTalk samples 10,000 C4 webpages, summarizes them with GPT-4o, clusters them with BERTopic, and manually selects one informative representative from each of 100 prominent clusters. GPT-4o generates ten turns of functional/design intents and verifiable tests per site. Manual refinement removes 66 hallucinated cases (1.7%) and edits 2,783 (73.4%), raising validity from 90.1% to 94.7%, for 100 dialogues, 1,000 turns, and 3,676 tests. Text and visual simulators contextualize equivalent intents against conversation state; intermediate/final pages are evaluated for pass rate and forgetting, while first-time-user web-agent trajectories support pairwise usability comparison.

name: FrontierCode
intro: FrontierCode 是 Cognition 于 2026 年发布的生产级软件工程基准，检验代码智能体提交的 PR 是否真正可合并。150 个真实开源仓库任务由 20+ 位维护者构建，评分同时覆盖正确性、回归安全、构建与风格、测试、改动范围和代码质量；1.1 版以 Main 100 题和 Extended 150 题报告结果。
build_method: 开源维护者构建, 对抗式评分加固, 多阶段人工评审
metric: 通过率, 加权评分标准分
task_type: 智能体软件工程, 仓库级代码修改
eval_feature: 可合并性, 代码质量, blocker 标准, 公平联网检查
scale: 150 题, 36 个开源仓库, 1,000+ 评分标准
task_type_en: Agentic Software Engineering, Repository-level Code Modification
build_method_en: Open-source maintainer authoring, adversarial rubric hardening, multi-stage human review
eval_feature_en: Mergeability, Code Quality, Blocker Criteria, Fair Internet-use Verification
intro_en: FrontierCode is Cognition's 2026 production-quality software-engineering benchmark for whether a coding agent's pull request is truly mergeable. Its 150 real open-source tasks are built by 20+ maintainers and grade correctness, regression safety, build and style, tests, scope, and code quality; version 1.1 reports the 100-task Main and 150-task Extended sets.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Cognition's official June 2026 FrontierCode construction specification and the July 2026 FrontierCode 1.1 update. More than 20 open-source maintainers selected realistic tasks across 36 repositories and defined mergeability rubrics. Criteria combine classical, command, reverse-classical, scope, adaptive-classical, and LLM grading. Rubrics are adversarially hacked, calibrated with four solutions, reviewed by pod leads and Cognition researchers, and iterated. Version 1.1 audits 1,000+ criteria, demotes 75 overly strict blockers, and adds a fair-internet-use prompt plus a verifier that zeros violating runs. Current reporting uses Main 100 and Extended 150; Diamond is deprecated.

name: FrontierMath
intro: FrontierMath 是由 60+ 位数学家创作并盲审的数百道原创、未发表高级数学题。命题必须满足原创、可自动核验、不可猜中和计算可处理四项要求；模型可在交互式 Python 环境中实验，最终答案由精确匹配、SymPy 等价或自定义脚本自动评分。
build_method: 专家原创命题, 领域专家盲审, 原创性与污染检查, 自动验证
task_type: 高级数学推理, 实验式代码求解
eval_feature: 未发表题目, 自动验证, 低污染风险, 三维专家难度
scale: 数百道原创题；覆盖约 70% 的 MSC2020 顶级学科
intro_en: FrontierMath contains hundreds of original, unpublished advanced-mathematics problems authored and blind-reviewed by 60+ mathematicians. Problems must be original, automatically verifiable, guessproof, and computationally tractable; models may experiment in Python before exact, SymPy, or custom-script verification of the final answer.
build_method_en: Expert original problem writing, blind domain review, originality and contamination checks, automatic verification
task_type_en: Advanced Mathematical Reasoning, Experiment-enabled Code Solving
eval_feature_en: Unpublished Problems, Automated Verification, Low Contamination Risk, Three-dimensional Expert Difficulty
scale_en: Hundreds of original problems; about 70% of top-level MSC2020 subjects
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.04872 Sections 2 and 4. More than 60 mathematicians write new unpublished problems under four requirements: originality, automated verifiability, guessproofness, and computational tractability. Each package includes a statement, detailed solution, verification script, subject and technique tags, and difficulty metadata. At least one blind domain expert checks correctness, ambiguity, guessability, code, classifications, and difficulty. Secure handling, expert source checks, Quetext, and Copyscape reduce contamination. Difficulty is background 1–5 plus creativity and execution hours—not Tier 1–4. Models experiment in Python, submit a self-contained pickled object, and are graded by exact, SymPy, or custom verification.

name: FrontierScience
intro: FrontierScience 通过奥赛与研究两条互补轨道评估专家级科学推理。42 位国际奥赛奖牌得主或国家队教练创作封闭答案题，45 位博士科学家创作开放研究子问题；专家从 500+ 与 200+ 候选中筛出 100 道奥赛题和 60 道研究题开源黄金集。
build_method: 奥赛与博士专家原创命题, 多轮领域专家评审, 元评审筛选
metric: 分轨准确率；研究题以 ≥7/10 为成功
task_type: 开放式科学问答, 短答案科学推理
eval_feature: 双轨评测, 过程评分标准, 内部模型筛难, 保留集防污染
scale: 数百题；开源黄金集 100 道奥赛题 + 60 道研究题
task_type_en: Open-ended Science QA, Short-answer Scientific Reasoning
build_method_en: Original Olympiad and PhD-expert authoring, multi-round domain review, expert meta-review
eval_feature_en: Dual-track Evaluation, Process Rubrics, Internal-model Difficulty Filtering, Held-out Contamination Tracking
intro_en: FrontierScience evaluates expert scientific reasoning through complementary Olympiad and Research tracks. Forty-two international medalists or national-team coaches author closed-answer tasks and 45 PhD scientists author open research subproblems; expert meta-review filters 500+ and 200+ candidates into an open gold set of 100 Olympiad and 60 Research items.
scale_en: Hundreds of questions; open gold set of 100 Olympiad + 60 Research items
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.21165 Sections 2.1–2.4 and 3.1. The Olympiad track uses 42 medalists or national-team coaches with 108 total medals; the Research track uses 45 PhD scientists and targets authentic three-to-five-hour subproblems. Tasks are selected against internal models, independently reviewed at least once for Olympiad and twice for Research, then receive holistic or meta-review. More than 500 Olympiad and 200 Research candidates yield a 100 + 60 open gold set, with the rest held out. Olympiad answers use GPT-5 equivalence judgment over 20 trials; Research uses independent 10-point rubric items, GPT-5 high-effort judging, a 7-point success threshold, and 30 trials.

name: FullStackBench
intro: FullStack Bench 是字节跳动 Seed Foundation Code Team 提出的双语、多语言全栈代码基准。3,374 道题覆盖 16 种编程语言和 11 个主流应用领域，配有 15,168 个单元测试；SandboxFusion 抽取、合成并执行模型代码，以 Pass@1 评分。
build_method: 多源代码收集, LLM 辅助人工标注, 交叉精炼, 六模型难度投票
language: 中文, 英文；16 种编程语言
task_type: 全栈开发, 代码生成
eval_feature: 双语题面, 多语言代码, 11 个应用领域, SandboxFusion 执行
scale: 3,374 道题, 15,168 个单测, 16 种编程语言
build_method_en: Multi-source code collection, LLM-assisted human annotation, cross-refinement, six-model difficulty voting
eval_feature_en: Bilingual Prompts, Multilingual Code, 11 Application Domains, SandboxFusion Execution
intro_en: FullStack Bench is ByteDance Seed Foundation Code Team's bilingual, multilingual full-stack coding benchmark. Its 3,374 problems span 16 programming languages and 11 mainstream application domains with 15,168 unit tests; SandboxFusion extracts, synthesizes, and executes model code for Pass@1 scoring.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.00535 Sections 2–3. GitHub snippets, code documents/books, XLCoST, and expert-authored domain questions are converted into instructions, reference solutions, language-specific tests, and labels with LLM assistance and human verification. Annotators check difficulty, ambiguity, and solvability, cross-refine each other's work, and resolve disagreement by consensus or senior adjudication. Six-model voting filters items solved by all models and labels difficulty. A 500K-question Stack Overflow analysis yields 11 mainstream domains plus Others. The bilingual release contains 3,374 problems across 16 programming languages and 15,168 unit tests. SandboxFusion extracts model code, combines tests, executes it, and reports Pass@1.

name: FunctionQA
intro: FunctionQA 是 MathVista 新建的 400 题视觉代数子集，要求模型精细感知函数图并对变量、表达式、方程和函数进行代数推理。题目由 STEM 研究生人工标注，经三位评审独立核验和共识修订，再按 MathVista 的答案抽取、归一化与精确准确率协议评测。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: STEM 研究生人工标注, 三人独立复核, 共识消歧
task_type: 函数图问答, 视觉代数推理
eval_feature: 函数图精细感知, 代数推理, 确定性答案归一化
build_method_en: STEM graduate-student annotation, three independent reviews, consensus resolution
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained Function-plot Perception, Algebraic Reasoning, Deterministic Answer Normalization
intro_en: FunctionQA is MathVista's newly created 400-example visual-algebra subset. It requires fine-grained perception of function plots and algebraic reasoning over variables, expressions, equations, and functions. STEM graduate students manually annotate items, three reviewers independently verify them, and MathVista extracts, normalizes, and exactly scores model answers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the FunctionQA portions of arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 2.2–2.4 and 3.1. FunctionQA is a MathVista-created visual algebra subset, not an Intern-S1 benchmark about software functions or tools. Its 400 items emphasize subtle perception of function plots and algebra over variables, expressions, equations, and functions. STEM graduate students manually annotate the new datasets; three reviewers independently check them, yielding 99.2% agreement across 736 new MathVista items, and the six disagreements are resolved by consensus. FunctionQA is standardized as math-targeted textbook QA with function-plot context and algebraic skill. Evaluation generates a response from image and query, uses a GPT-4 short-answer extractor, normalizes the answer, and computes deterministic exact accuracy.

name: GAIA
intro: GAIA是一个为通用AI助手设计的基准测试，旨在评估AI在现实世界问题中的表现。这些问题需要推理、多模态处理、网页浏览和工具使用等基本能力。GAIA的问题对人类来说概念简单，但对最先进的AI来说极具挑战性，旨在推动通用人工智能（AGI）的发展。
build_method: 人工标注
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本, 多模态, 工具使用, 网页浏览
scale: 466个问题（166个开发题，300个隐藏答案测试题）
build_method_en: Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, Multimodal, Tool Use, Web Browsing
intro_en: GAIA is a benchmark designed for general AI assistants to evaluate their performance on real-world problems. These problems require core abilities such as reasoning, multimodal processing, web browsing, and tool use. GAIA’s tasks are conceptually simple for humans but highly challenging for state-of-the-art AI, aiming to advance the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).
scale_en: 466 questions (166 development, 300 test with hidden answers)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.12983. GAIA contains 466 human-designed real-world assistant questions whose answers are concise, factual, and unambiguous. Paper authors and paid annotators combine stable web evidence, attached multimodal files, or self-contained puzzles and record the answer, useful tools, steps, and estimated time. Two additional annotators independently solve every item; agreement among all three validates the question, while disagreements trigger repair or removal. The paper reports that 68% pass unchanged and that validation and repair require about two human-hours per retained item. Questions are assigned to Levels 1–3 from required steps and tool diversity. The release contains 166 annotated development questions and 300 test questions with hidden answers. Evaluation is zero-shot, allows reasoning, browsing, code, and tools as needed, normalizes outputs by answer type, and reports quasi-exact-match accuracy; the paper does not prescribe one fixed tool trajectory.

name: Gaia2
intro: Gaia2是一个用于在真实、异步环境中评估大型语言模型代理的基准。它引入了独立于代理行为而演变的环境场景，要求代理在时间限制下操作、适应动态和嘈杂的事件、解决模糊性并与其他代理协作。每个场景都配有写操作验证器，支持细粒度的动作级评估。该基准建立在开源的ARE平台之上，旨在推动下一代实用代理系统的发展。
build_method: 人工构建与合成数据
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: Agent评估, 复杂推理, 动态适应, 多步推理
eval_feature: 异步, 动态环境, 多Agent协作, 时间限制, 噪声鲁棒性, 模糊性解决
scale: 1,120个场景（800个核心场景 + 320个增强场景）
task_type_en: Agent Evaluation, Complex Reasoning, Dynamic Adaptation, Multi-step Reasoning
build_method_en: Manually constructed and synthetic data
eval_feature_en: Asynchronous, dynamic environment, multi-agent collaboration, time constraints, noise robustness, ambiguity resolution
intro_en: Gaia2 is a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in real, asynchronous environments. It introduces environment scenarios that evolve independently of agent behavior, requiring agents to operate within time constraints, adapt to dynamic and noisy events, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario includes a write operation validator, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation. Built on the open-source ARE platform, this benchmark aims to advance the development of next-generation practical agent systems.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.11964. Gaia2 is built on ARE's asynchronous apps, event DAGs, time, notifications, scenarios, and write verification. Mobile provides 12 apps and 101 tools across 10 PersonaHub-seeded, dependency-consistent user universes containing 400K–800K tokens; simulated time advances during model generation. Humans author oracle DAGs of initial state, write actions, and environment events to isolate Execution, Search, Ambiguity, Adaptability, or Time. Multiple independent validation rounds, consistency checks, graph guardrails, and baseline-agent calibration yield 800 unique core scenarios and a 160-item mini subset. Applying Noise and Agent2Agent environment modifiers to mini adds 320 scenarios, for 1,120 total. All models use a ReAct-style one-JSON-call scaffold at temperature 0.5, 16K tokens per turn, three runs, and at most 200 steps. The ARE Verifier checks exact/flexible arguments, causality, timing, and completeness for every write action; on 450 trajectories it reaches 0.98 agreement and 0.99 precision. The primary metric is Pass@1 by split and overall.

name: GaokaoBench
intro: GaokaoBench是一个直观的评测基准，它使用2010至2022年的中国高考题目来评估大型语言模型。该基准包含1781道客观题和1030道主观题，覆盖了理科和文科的9个科目。它采用零样本设置和人工评分相结合的方式，全面考察模型的语言理解、逻辑推理和生成能力。
build_method: 基于2010-2022年中国高考试题，通过自动化脚本和人工标注结合的方式构建
metric: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 填空题, 改错题
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Fill-in-the-blank, Error correction
build_method_en: Constructed based on 2010-2022 China Gaokao exam questions, combining automated scripts and manual annotation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: GaokaoBench is an intuitive evaluation benchmark that uses Chinese Gaokao exam questions from 2010 to 2022 to assess large language models. The benchmark includes 1,781 objective questions and 1,030 subjective questions, covering nine science and humanities subjects. It employs a zero-shot setting combined with human scoring to comprehensively evaluate models' language understanding, logical reasoning, and generation abilities.
metric_en: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.12474, Sections 2.2 and 3.1-3.4. GaokaoBench converts national Chinese College Entrance Examination PDFs from 2010-2022 into JSON with automated scripts plus manual annotation and converts mathematical expressions to LaTeX. It covers nine science and humanities subjects with 2,811 questions: 1,781 objective and 1,030 subjective, spanning single choice, multiple choice, cloze, correction, open-ended, and multi-question formats. Type-specific zero-shot prompts require both reasoning and a constrained final output. Objective answers are scored by regular matching; each subjective answer is graded by two teachers and averaged. The paper also supplies teacher-authored marking points to GPT-4-turbo at temperature 0 as an alternative judge, comparing it with human scores using Spearman and Kendall-Tau. Subject objective/subjective scoring rates are converted into separate science and humanities totals out of 750.

name: GaRAGe
intro: GaRAGe是一个大型RAG基准，包含人工整理的长篇答案及每个依据段落的注释，支持细粒度评估LLM在生成RAG答案时识别相关依据的能力。该基准涵盖2366个多样化问题，包含3.5万多条来自私有文档和网络的注释段落，反映真实RAG应用场景。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
metric: Relevance-Aware Factuality Score, F1 in attribution, true positive rate in deflections
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 混合网页/私有依据, 段落相关性标注, 拒答与引用归因
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Domain-specific
intro_en: GaRAGe is a large-scale RAG benchmark featuring manually curated long-form answers and annotated supporting paragraphs for each, enabling fine-grained evaluation of LLMs' ability to identify relevant evidence when generating RAG answers. The benchmark includes 2,366 diverse questions and over 35,000 annotated paragraphs from private documents and the web, reflecting real-world RAG application scenarios.
metric_en: Relevance-Aware Factuality Score, F1 in attribution, true positive rate in deflections
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.07671. GaRAGe uses a four-pass LLM pipeline to plan Web exploration, search, blend multiple snippets into complex questions, and filter for well-formedness, named entities, and semantic deduplication. Grounding is collected from the Web alone or mixed with private knowledge bases, then retrieved and cross-encoder reranked while retaining realistic irrelevant or outdated noise. Professional annotators reject invalid, false-premise, harmful, or non-information-seeking questions; tag time-sensitivity, complexity, popularity, and category; and label every passage. Exact passage counts are 4,752 private and 30,599 Web. Annotators write cited long-form answers using only relevant passages, averaging 192 words, or deflect when evidence is insufficient. The final 2,366 questions support eligibility, factuality, uRAF/RAF, deflection TPR/FPR, and attribution precision/recall/F1 under a common greedy-decoding prompt.

name: GDPVal
intro: GDPval是一个评估AI模型在真实世界中具有经济价值任务表现的基准测试。它涵盖了美国劳工统计局针对44个职业的大部分工作活动，这些职业来自对美国GDP贡献最大的9个行业。任务是根据平均拥有14年经验的行业专业人士的代表性工作构建的。该基准测试还提供了一个包含220个任务的黄金子集和公共自动化评分服务。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: Agent任务, 专业工作交付
eval_feature: 盲测专家对比, 多次采样, 交付物评测
scale: 1,320个任务、44个职业、9个行业（公开黄金子集220题）
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, process evaluation
intro_en: GDPVal is a benchmark for evaluating AI models' performance on economically valuable tasks in the real world. It covers most work activities for 44 occupations from the 9 industries contributing most to the US GDP, based on data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. Tasks are constructed to represent work performed by industry professionals with an average of 14 years of experience. The benchmark also provides a gold subset of 220 tasks and a public automated scoring service.
scale_en: 1,320 tasks across 44 occupations and 9 sectors (220-task public gold subset)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.04374. GDPVal selects nine U.S. sectors contributing more than 5% of GDP and 44 predominantly digital occupations using O*NET task classifications and wage/employment data. Qualified occupation experts have at least four years of experience and average 14 years; they author a request, optional reference files, and a professional deliverable mapped to O*NET, then record difficulty, representativeness, time, and estimated economic value. Automated checks and iterative human review produce 1,320 tasks, with at least three and an average of five human reviews per item. The public gold subset contains 220 tasks, five per occupation, with expert identifiers scrubbed. For each task and model, three model samples are each compared with the human deliverable by three blinded occupation graders, yielding nine comparisons. The primary metric is head-to-head deliverable win rate against human expert work. The automated grader is experimental: its 66% agreement is compared with 71% human inter-rater agreement and does not replace the primary expert comparison.

name: GEdit-Bench
intro: GEdit-Bench是一个基于真实世界用户指令的图像编辑评测基准。它旨在提供一个更真实、更全面的评估框架，以衡量图像编辑模型的性能。该基准的发布旨在缩小开源模型与领先的闭源模型（如GPT-4o和Gemini）在图像编辑能力上的差距。
build_method: 真实用户数据收集, 人工筛选, 双语标注
metric: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 真实用户指令, 双语评测, VLM-as-Judge
scale: 606个双语图像编辑实例、11个类别
build_method_en: Real-user Collection, Human Filtering, Bilingual Annotation
eval_feature_en: Real-user Instructions, Bilingual Evaluation, VLM-as-Judge
intro_en: GEdit-Bench is an image editing evaluation benchmark based on real-world user instructions. It aims to provide a more realistic and comprehensive framework for assessing the performance of image editing models. The benchmark is released to narrow the gap in image editing capabilities between open-source models and leading closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Gemini.
metric_en: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.17761. The Step1X-Edit paper builds GEdit-Bench from more than 1,000 real Internet editing instances, including Reddit-style user requests. Human reviewers assign 11 editing categories and remove similar-purpose instructions to preserve diversity. User-uploaded images are de-identified by reverse-searching multiple public search engines and substituting visually and semantically consistent public images; if no substitute exists, the instruction is minimally modified while preserving intent and image–instruction fidelity. Every retained image receives English and Chinese instructions, yielding 606 public examples. Open and proprietary editors are evaluated on the full set; common valid-output intersections contain 434 English and 422 Chinese examples. VIEScore uses GPT-4.1 and Qwen2.5-VL-72B judges to report Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, and Overall Score.

name: GenAI-Bench
intro: GenAI-Bench 是从 GenAI-Arena 社区投票中清洗得到的多模态偏好基准，用于衡量 MLLM 裁判能否在图像生成、图像编辑和视频生成任务上复现人类四分类偏好。它与另一个含1,600条组合式提示词的同名文生视觉基准不同。
build_method: 匿名社区投票, NSFW清洗, 专家抽样复核
modality: 图像, 视频, 文本
task_type: 多模态裁判, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 四分类偏好, 精确匹配, 社区投票
build_method_en: Anonymous Community Voting, NSFW Filtering, Expert Sample Review
eval_feature_en: Four-way Preference Labels, Exact Match, Community Votes
intro_en: GenAI-Bench is a multimodal preference benchmark cleaned from GenAI-Arena community votes. It measures whether MLLM judges reproduce human four-way preferences across image generation, image editing, and video generation. It is distinct from the separate 1,600-prompt compositional text-to-visual benchmark with the same name.
scale_en: 3,723 preference pairs (1,735 image generation; 919 editing; 1,069 video)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.04485 and the official TIGER-Lab/GenAI-Bench card. This entry is the GenAI-Arena preference benchmark, not the separate 1,600-prompt compositional GenAI-Bench. The Arena standardizes 35 open models across text-to-image, image editing, and text-to-video; mixes live user prompts with ImagenHub/VBench prompts and precomputed GenAI-Museum outputs; anonymously presents same-task pairs; and collects left-better, right-better, tie-good, or both-bad votes. An author audit of 350 votes leaves 303 valid and finds 93.07% clearly or vaguely reasonable. Llama Guard and technical filters yield 1,735 image-generation, 919 editing, and 1,069 video preference pairs, 3,723 total. An MLLM judge receives the prompt and output pair, must emit one of four exact labels, and is scored by exact agreement with the human vote for each task and on average. Arena Bradley–Terry Elo ranks generators, whereas GenAI-Bench accuracy evaluates judges.

name: GenEval
intro: GenEval 是面向文本到图像模型的对象组合评测。它用六类模板任务、MS-COCO 对象词表和自动感知模型，逐图验证对象存在、计数、颜色、位置与属性绑定是否满足提示。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, LAION
build_method: 任务模板, MS-COCO对象词表, 自动感知验证, 人工一致性检验
task_type: 文本到图像生成, 组合对齐
eval_feature: 6类组合任务, 目标检测与CLIP验证, 二元逐图判定
scale: 553个提示；每个模型每提示生成4张图
build_method_en: Task Templates, MS-COCO Object Vocabulary, Automated Perceptual Verification, Human Agreement Check
eval_feature_en: Six Compositional Tasks, Detection and CLIP Verification, Binary Per-image Correctness
intro_en: GenEval evaluates object compositionality in text-to-image models. Six templated tasks, an MS-COCO object vocabulary, and automated perceptual models verify whether each image satisfies requested objects, counts, colors, positions, and attribute bindings.
scale_en: 553 prompts; four generated images per prompt for each model
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.11513 and the official GenEval repository. The paper defines six tasks—single object, two objects, counting, colors, position, and color attribute binding—built from task templates and 80 MS-COCO object classes. After per-task random sampling and deduplication, the benchmark contains 553 prompts and generates four images per prompt. COCO Mask2Former checks object presence, count, and centroid-based position; CLIP ViT-L/14 classifies masked object crops for color and binding. An image is correct only when every requested element is correct; scores are averaged over the four images, by task, and then across the six tasks. The paper validates the automatic evaluator with 6,000 human annotations on 1,200 images.

name: GenExam
intro: GenExam 是覆盖十个学科的多学科文生图考试基准。它以参考真值图、考试式提示和原子评分点衡量模型生成包含复杂学科知识图像的能力，并提供严格分与宽松分。
build_method: 多源图像收集, GPT-5筛选与提示起草, 博士标注员交叉复核
task_type: 文生图, 多学科考试评测
eval_feature: 原子评分点, 参考图GPT-5裁判, 严格与宽松计分
build_method_en: Multi-source Image Collection, GPT-5 Filtering and Prompt Drafting, Cross-validation by PhD Annotators
eval_feature_en: Atomic Scoring Points, Reference-image GPT-5 Judge, Strict and Relaxed Scoring
intro_en: GenExam is a multidisciplinary text-to-image examination benchmark spanning ten subjects. Reference images, exam-style prompts, and atomic scoring points measure whether models can generate complex images containing subject knowledge, with both strict and relaxed scores.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.14232 and the official OpenGVLab/GenExam repository. The benchmark defines an ISCED-F-aligned four-level taxonomy, gathers about 40K candidate images from exam/textbook Web search and seven subject-knowledge datasets, removes technical defects, then uses GPT-5 to retain 6.5K high-value images. GPT-5 drafts exam prompts and weighted yes/no scoring points; three PhD annotators cross-validate the image, prompt, and scoring points before the 1,000-item release. GenExam-Mini uses level-three stratified sampling and has 487 items in the official results. For evaluation, one generated image is judged against the reference image by GPT-5: weighted semantic correctness is 0–1, while spelling, logical consistency, and readability are each 0–2. Strict correctness requires semantic 1 and all three auxiliary scores 2; the relaxed score uses weights 0.7/0.1/0.1/0.1.

name: GENIUS
intro: GENIUS（Generative Fluid Intelligence Evaluation Suite）是一个用于评估统一多模态模型生成式流体智能的基准，重点考察模型在即时上下文中归纳模式、执行临时约束和适应情境知识的能力。
org: Peking University, CUHK, StepFun, PolyU, MSRA
build_method: 人工构建, 专家构建
metric: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature: 归纳推理, 约束遵循, 情境适应
scale: 510个样本、3个维度、5个任务、20个子任务
intro_en: GENIUS is a benchmark for evaluating generative fluid intelligence in unified multimodal models. It measures how models induce implicit patterns, execute ad-hoc constraints, and adapt to contextual knowledge in image generation tasks.
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Interleaved Multimodal Context Design
metric_en: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature_en: Inductive Inference, Constraint Following, Contextual Adaptation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.11144. GENIUS operationalizes generative fluid intelligence from CHC theory as Implicit Pattern Induction, Ad-hoc Constraint Execution, and Contextual Knowledge Adaptation. Its 510 expert-curated samples are distributed 86/213/211 across those dimensions and organized into five generation tasks and 20 subtasks. Each item uses interleaved multimodal context whose modalities are jointly necessary, deliberately suppressing semantic shortcuts and memorized priors; experts also annotate task-specific evaluation hints. Unified multimodal models generate images from the context. The hybrid Gemini-3-Pro judge compares output, references, and hints, including a pixel-identity plagiarism check where relevant. Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, and Aesthetic Quality are each scored 0/1/2 and combined with weights 6:3.5:0.5; an exact reference copy receives zero for Visual Consistency.

name: GenQA
intro: GenQA 不是独立数据集或论文，而是 OLMo 3 报告与官方 OLMES 配置中 OlmoBaseEval 的九任务宏平均能力组，聚合排序选择/续写与生成式短答案问答。
build_method: 模型排名聚类, 任务格式对齐, 官方九任务套件聚合
task_type: 基础模型问答聚合, 排序选择与短答案生成
eval_feature: 九任务宏平均, 任务级few-shot协议, 准确率与答案库F1
task_type_en: Aggregated Base-model QA, Rank-choice and Short-answer Generation
build_method_en: Model-ranking Clustering, Task-format Alignment, Official Nine-task Suite Aggregation
eval_feature_en: Nine-task Macro Average, Task-specific Few-shot Protocols, Accuracy and Answer-bank F1
intro_en: GenQA is not a standalone dataset or paper. It is the nine-task macro-averaged OlmoBaseEval capability group defined in the OLMo 3 report and official OLMES configuration, aggregating rank-choice/continuation and generative short-answer QA.
scale_en: Nine tasks; BasicSkills contains six subtasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.13961 and the official OLMES TASK_SUITE_CONFIGS entry olmo3:base:gen. OLMo 3 pools about 23K benchmark results from 70 open-weight models, applies Ward hierarchical clustering to group tasks with similar model rankings, then aligns clusters with task format. GenQA is the resulting nine-task macro-average: HellaSwag, WinoGrande, LAMBADA, BasicSkills (six subtasks), DROP, Jeopardy, NaturalQs, SQuAD, and CoQA. Rank-choice/continuation tasks use their task-defined accuracy variants; short-answer tasks use F1 against answer banks. Most tasks are 5-shot, LAMBADA is 0-shot, and CoQA uses built-in examples; generative tasks use temperature 0 and top-p 1 with 50 or 100 output tokens. The report documents incomplete answer banks as a false-negative limitation and treats Gen2MC as a separate remedy, not part of GenQA.

name: Global-MMLU-Lite
intro: Global-MMLU-Lite 是 Global MMLU 的文化平衡轻量子集。流程图按论文首发版展示15种人工翻译或人工后编辑语言、每种语言各200道文化敏感题与200道文化无关题；官方数据集后来已扩展。
build_method: MMLU文化标注, 多语言翻译与人工后编辑, CS/CA平衡抽样
language: 论文v1为15种语言；当前v3为23种语言
task_type: 知识问答, 多语言评测
eval_feature: 文化敏感/无关分层, 多语言精确选项匹配, 论文版平衡抽样
build_method_en: MMLU Cultural Annotation, Multilingual Translation and Human Post-editing, Balanced CS/CA Sampling
eval_feature_en: Culturally Sensitive/Agnostic Strata, Multilingual Exact Option Match, Paper-release Balanced Sampling
intro_en: Global-MMLU-Lite is the culturally balanced lightweight subset of Global MMLU. The diagram follows the paper release: 15 fully human-translated or post-edited languages, with 200 Culturally Sensitive and 200 Culturally Agnostic questions per language; the maintained official dataset has since expanded.
language_en: 15 languages in paper v1; 23 languages in current v3
scale_en: 6,000 items in paper v1 (15×400); about 14K in current v3
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.03304 and the official CohereLabs/Global-MMLU-Lite dataset card. Global MMLU begins with about 14K English MMLU questions over 57 subjects. The paper uniformly samples 2,850 questions, collects at least three cultural/geographic/dialect labels per item from 200 annotators, and derives Culturally Sensitive (CS) or Culturally Agnostic (CA) membership. It machine-translates MMLU into 41 languages and maximizes human verification through professional MMMLU, a paid Gold Set, and community post-editing. The Lite paper release retains 15 fully human-translated or post-edited languages and balances each at 200 CS plus 200 CA items, 6,000 total. Evaluation exact-matches the selected option and reports overall, per-language, CS, and CA accuracy. The maintained dataset is now v3 with 23 languages and about 14K rows; the diagram intentionally preserves the paper-release v1 construction.

name: GMAI-MMBench
intro: GMAI-MMBench是一个全面的通用医疗AI基准，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在各种医疗应用中的有效性。该基准解决了现有基准在临床相关性、评估不完整性和交互式LVLMs指导不足等方面的局限性。它由284个数据集构建，涵盖38种医学图像模态、18项临床相关任务、18个科室和4种感知粒度，采用视觉问答（VQA）形式。
build_method: 多源医疗数据整合, 标签标准化, 人工验证
eval_feature: 零样本, 可定制词汇树切片, 隐藏测试答案
build_method_en: Multi-source Medical Data Integration, Label Standardization, Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Custom Lexical-tree Slices, Hidden Test Answers
intro_en: GMAI-MMBench is a comprehensive general medical AI benchmark designed to evaluate the effectiveness of large vision-language models (LVLMs) across various medical applications. It addresses limitations of existing benchmarks in clinical relevance, incomplete evaluation, and insufficient guidance for interactive LVLMs. The benchmark is built from 284 datasets, covering 38 medical image modalities, 18 clinically relevant tasks, 18 departments, and 4 levels of perceptual granularity, using a visual question answering (VQA) format.
scale_en: 25,831 VQA pairs (4,550 validation; 21,281 test) from 284 datasets
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.03361. GMAI-MMBench surveys hundreds of medical sources and retains 284 datasets: 268 public datasets plus 16 ethically approved hospital datasets. The pipeline filters for usable high-quality labels, standardizes heterogeneous images and label expressions, and organizes a customizable lexical tree spanning 38 modalities, 18 clinical VQA tasks, 18 departments, and four perceptual granularities. Local-view question and option pools are grouped by modality, task, and granularity; each generated question must expose all three cues and may contain up to four options. Manual validation removes questions missing those cues, answerable without the image, incorrectly answered, unclear, or paired with poor images. Selection caps each answer at 30 cases while preserving source and demographic diversity. The final benchmark has 25,831 VQA pairs: 4,550 validation and 21,281 test. LVLMs run zero-shot through VLMEvalKit; option/answer extraction feeds overall and lexical-tree-slice accuracy, while test answers remain hidden for organizer evaluation.

name: GMMLU
intro: Global-MMLU 是对 MMLU 的 42 语言扩展，通过专业翻译、社区后编辑和机器翻译提高多语言质量，并为代表性子集标注文化、地理和方言知识需求，以区分文化敏感（CS）与文化无关（CA）评测。
build_method: 机器翻译, 专业翻译, 社区后编辑, 文化敏感性标注
task_type: 选择题, 知识问答, 多语言评测
eval_feature: 文化敏感/文化无关切片, 多语言, 翻译质量
task_type_en: Multiple-choice QA, Knowledge QA, Multilingual Evaluation
build_method_en: Machine Translation, Professional Translation, Community Post-editing, Cultural-sensitivity Annotation
eval_feature_en: Culturally Sensitive/Agnostic Slices, Multilingual, Translation Quality
intro_en: Global-MMLU extends MMLU to 42 languages, improving multilingual quality through professional translations, community post-edits, and machine translation. A representative subset is annotated for cultural, geographic, and dialect knowledge requirements to distinguish Culturally Sensitive (CS) from Culturally Agnostic (CA) evaluation.
scale_en: 589,764 samples in 42 languages; 6,000-item Lite set in 15 languages
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.03304. Global-MMLU starts from roughly 14K English MMLU questions across 57 subjects. Two linked processes improve the evaluation: 200 professional and community annotators label 2,850 uniformly sampled English questions, at least three annotators per item, for cultural, geographic, or dialect knowledge and derive CS/CA metadata; in parallel, Google Translate produces 41 target-language versions that are replaced or post-edited wherever professional MMMLU, compensated Gold Set, or native community work is available, improving 25 languages. The full release contains 589,764 samples across 42 languages. Global-MMLU Lite balances 200 CS and 200 CA questions in each of 15 human-translated or post-edited languages for 6,000 samples. Evaluation preserves MMLU multiple choice, exact-matches the selected option, and reports accuracy by language and CS/CA/resource slices.

name: GPQA
intro: GPQA包含448个由领域专家编写的生物、物理和化学多项选择题，设计为“谷歌难题”，难以被熟练非专家和先进AI系统解答。旨在促进可扩展监督研究，帮助专家从超越人类能力的AI系统中获得真实信息。
org: New York University, Google DeepMind, Cohere
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 领域特定, 防污染
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Contamination-free
intro_en: GPQA contains 448 multiple-choice questions in biology, physics, and chemistry, written by domain experts and designed as "Google-proof" problems that are difficult for skilled non-experts and advanced AI systems to solve. It aims to promote scalable supervision research and help experts obtain reliable information from AI systems that surpass human capabilities.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.12022. Domain experts in biology, physics, and chemistry write graduate-level MCQs with choices, answers, explanations, subdomain labels, and time spent. A first same-domain expert answers and comments, the writer may revise, and the revised item is sent in parallel to a second expert and three skilled other-domain non-experts who have web access and must spend at least 15 minutes. The extended set has 546 questions. The 448-question main set requires at least one of two experts to agree and at most two of three non-experts to answer correctly; the 198-question Diamond set requires both experts to agree and at most one non-expert to answer correctly, counting the paper's documented post-hoc expert agreement cases. Model answers are regex-extracted and scored by main/Diamond accuracy.

name: GPQA Diamond
intro: GPQA Diamond是GPQA (Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A) 基准的一个精选子集，包含198个由领域专家验证的最高质量问题。这些问题涵盖物理、化学和生物学等研究生级别的科学领域，被广泛用于评估大型语言模型的高级科学推理能力。
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 领域特定, 防污染
build_method_en: Manually constructed
eval_feature_en: Multi-step reasoning
intro_en: GPQA Diamond is a curated subset of the GPQA (Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A) benchmark, containing 198 highest-quality questions verified by domain experts. These questions cover graduate-level scientific fields such as physics, chemistry, and biology, and are widely used to evaluate the advanced scientific reasoning abilities of large language models.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.12022. GPQA Diamond is the paper’s highest-quality subset of GPQA. It is selected after the same expert-writing, expert-validation, revision, and non-expert-validation pipeline used for GPQA. The Diamond set contains 198 questions and uses more stringent criteria than the main set: both expert validators must agree or the second expert’s error must be clearly explained as a mistake after seeing the writer’s explanation, and the majority of non-expert validators must answer incorrectly. This preserves questions that are more likely objective, expert-solvable, and Google-proof for highly skilled non-experts. Evaluation remains multiple-choice model answering with accuracy.

name: GraphWalks
intro: GraphWalks 是 OpenAI 发布的长上下文图推理数据集，没有配套的构建论文。模型读取哈希节点有向边表，完成精确深度 BFS 或父节点集合查询，并按官方最后一行答案格式返回节点集合。
build_method: 有向图题面与BFS/Parents标签生成；官方未公开图采样算法
task_type: 图推理, 长上下文集合预测
eval_feature: 精确深度BFS, 父节点查询, 集合F1, 最后一行答案解析
build_method_en: Directed Graph Prompt and BFS/Parents Label Generation; Graph Sampling Algorithm Not Documented
eval_feature_en: Exact-depth BFS, Parent Query, Set F1, Last-line Answer Parser
intro_en: GraphWalks is an OpenAI long-context graph-reasoning dataset without a companion construction paper. Models read a directed edge list with hashed node names, execute exact-depth BFS or parent-set queries, and return a node set in the official last-line answer format.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official openai/graphwalks dataset card, schema, files, extraction code, grading code, and changelog; no construction paper is published, so the graph sampling algorithm is explicitly left undocumented rather than inferred. The current dataset has 1,150 rows in one train split: 550 BFS and 600 parents items, with prompt, answer_nodes, prompt_chars, problem_type, and date_added fields. Prompts serialize directed edge lists with hashed node identifiers and fixed worked examples. BFS labels include nodes reachable at exactly the requested depth while excluding the start and revisited nodes; parents labels are incoming neighbors excluding the target. The 2026 repair corrected 24 of 400 short-set parent labels that had included the root. Models must put Final Answer: [...] on the last line; malformed output becomes an empty prediction. Official grading compares node sets with precision, recall, and F1, including F1=1 for empty/empty.

name: GSM8K
intro: GSM8K是一个包含8500个高质量、语言多样的小学数学应用题的数据集，旨在诊断和评估大型语言模型在多步数学推理方面的能力。尽管这些问题在概念上相对简单，但即便是最大规模的Transformer模型也难以在该基准上取得高分。
eval_feature: 思维链
build_method_en: Manually constructed
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: GSM8K is a dataset of 8,500 high-quality, linguistically diverse elementary math word problems designed to diagnose and evaluate large language models' abilities in multi-step mathematical reasoning. Although these problems are conceptually simple, even the largest Transformer models struggle to achieve high scores on this benchmark.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2110.14168. Human writers create 8.5K original, linguistically diverse grade-school math word problems requiring two to eight elementary arithmetic steps; the process avoids scraped templates and uses worker answer agreement for quality control, yielding an estimated breaking-error rate below 2%. Writers provide diverse natural-language solutions and final answers. The official split is 7.5K train and 1K test. The baseline samples one low-temperature solution and checks its final answer. The paper's verifier experiment trains a generator for two epochs, samples 100 completions per training item, labels them solely by final-answer correctness, trains a verifier for one epoch, and ranks 100 test completions to select the highest-scored solution before reporting test solve rate.

name: GSM8K-Platinum
intro: GSM8K-Platinum 是完整 GSM8K 测试集的低噪声修订版。研究者先用多个前沿模型定位潜在问题，再人工删除歧义或逻辑不一致的题并修正错标答案，使每个保留错误更能代表真实模型失败。
build_method: 多模型筛查, 人工核验, 错标修正
eval_feature: 可靠性评测, 低标签噪声, 零样本
build_method_en: Multi-model Screening, Human Verification, Label Correction
eval_feature_en: Reliability Evaluation, Low Label Noise, Zero-shot
intro_en: GSM8K-Platinum is a low-noise revision of the full GSM8K test set. Multiple frontier models first flag potential problems; humans then remove ambiguous or logically inconsistent questions and correct mislabeled answers so every retained error better represents a genuine model failure.
scale_en: 1,209 questions cleaned from the 1,319-item GSM8K test set
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.03461 and the official madrylab/gsm8k-platinum dataset card. The full 1,319-question GSM8K test set is run through multiple frontier LLMs using zero-shot prompting at temperature 0.5, with step-by-step instructions omitted for reasoning models. Any model error flags an item: 219 are manually inspected and the other 1,100 receive consensus status. Humans remove 110 ambiguous, inconsistent, or poorly constructed questions, verify 99 correct labels, and correct 10 mislabeled answers without rewriting questions. The 1,209-item release preserves GSM8K's question and worked-answer fields and adds consensus/verified/revised cleaning status. Exact integer comparison supports the official study's error-count reliability view and the equivalent accuracy view used by leaderboards.

name: HaluEval
intro: HaluEval 是一个包含 35,000 个样本的幻觉识别基准：30,000 个任务特定样本均分至问答、知识对话和摘要，另有 5,000 个来自 Alpaca 查询的通用样本。任务特定分支由 ChatGPT 生成并经事实增强过滤；通用分支则以响应分歧筛选难例并由人工标注幻觉类型与跨度。
org: Renmin University of China, Université de Montréal
build_method: ChatGPT 双策略生成、事实增强筛选、人工标注
eval_feature: 对抗性难例、任务特定与通用双分支、幻觉跨度标注
build_method_en: Two-strategy ChatGPT generation, ground-truth-enhanced filtering, human annotation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial hard cases, task-specific and general branches, hallucination-span labels
intro_en: HaluEval is a 35,000-sample hallucination-recognition benchmark: 30,000 task-specific samples evenly cover question answering, knowledge-grounded dialogue, and summarization, while 5,000 general samples come from Alpaca queries. ChatGPT generates task-specific hallucinations that are ground-truth-enhanced filtered; the general branch selects response-disagreement hard cases and adds human hallucination-type and span labels.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.11747. HaluEval contains exactly 35,000 samples: 10,000 each for QA from HotpotQA, knowledge-grounded dialogue from OpenDialKG, and summarization from CNN/DailyMail, plus 5,000 general Alpaca queries. For each task-specific seed, ChatGPT produces candidates through one-pass and conversational instruction learning with task-specific hallucination patterns; a ground-truth-enhanced ChatGPT filter keeps the most plausible difficult hallucinated counterpart paired with the normal answer. For general queries, three ChatGPT responses are sampled, average pairwise BERTScore identifies 5,000 low-similarity hard cases, and three qualified annotators per response label hallucination yes/no, affected spans, and unverifiable/nonfactual/irrelevant aspects. Thirty annotators participate; majority voting yields Fleiss' kappa 0.811, with 977 of 5,000 general samples labeled hallucinatory. Evaluation randomly presents a normal or hallucinated output and reports recognition accuracy for QA, dialogue, summarization, and general data.

name: HalluLens
intro: HalluLens 以幻觉来源区分外在幻觉与内在幻觉：前者与训练数据中的世界知识不一致，后者与输入上下文不一致。其动态外在套件包含 PreciseWikiQA、LongWiki、MixedEntities 和 GeneratedEntities，共 15,200 个样本；内在分支整合 HHEM、ANAH 2.0 与 FaithEval 三个既有基准。
org: FAIR at Meta, GenAI at Meta, HKUST
build_method: 动态生成外在任务、整合既有内在幻觉基准
metric: False Refusal, Hallucinated When Not Refused, Correct Answer, Precision, Recall@32, F1@32, False Acceptance
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 事实验证, 分类, 安全测试
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 对抗性
scale: 15,200 个动态外在样本 + 3 个整合的内在幻觉基准
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Generation, Fact Verification, Classification, Safety Testing
build_method_en: Dynamic extrinsic-task generation plus integrated intrinsic benchmarks
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, real-time, Contamination-free, Adversarial
intro_en: HalluLens classifies hallucinations by source: extrinsic hallucinations conflict with world knowledge represented in training data, while intrinsic hallucinations conflict with the input context. Its dynamic extrinsic suite contains PreciseWikiQA, LongWiki, MixedEntities, and GeneratedEntities for 15,200 samples; the intrinsic branch integrates the existing HHEM, ANAH 2.0, and FaithEval benchmarks.
scale_en: 15,200 dynamic extrinsic samples + 3 integrated intrinsic benchmarks
metric_en: False Refusal, Hallucinated When Not Refused, Correct Answer, Precision, Recall@32, F1@32, False Acceptance
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.17550, Sections 2-4. HalluLens separates extrinsic hallucinations inconsistent with training-data world knowledge from intrinsic hallucinations inconsistent with input context. The dynamic extrinsic suite totals 15,200 samples: PreciseWikiQA selects 5,000 questions from 44,754 GoodWiki pages across ten WikiRank difficulty bins; LongWiki builds 250 long-answer prompts with 50 items at each difficulty from 5 through 9; MixedEntities creates 8,000 nonexistent animal, plant, bacteria, and medicine names from ITIS and drug-name sources; GeneratedEntities creates 1,950 absent business, event, and product names through three-LLM round robin and Brave-search verification. Intrinsic evaluation integrates HHEM summarization, reference-backed ANAH 2.0, and FaithEval noisy/contradictory-context tasks rather than rebuilding them. Automated judges report task-specific refusal, correctness, long-form precision/Recall@32/F1@32, and false-acceptance metrics; LongWiki verification is Wikipedia-only.

name: HalluQA
intro: HalluQA 是针对中文大模型幻觉的 450 题问答基准，由 175 道误导题、69 道高难误导题和 206 道知识题组成，共覆盖 30 个领域。数据以 GLM-130B、ChatGPT 与 Puyu 的稳定错误作为对抗性筛选信号，并由作者或 NLP 专家复核问题、答案和外部依据。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, LLM生成
task_type: 开放式问答, 幻觉评判
eval_feature: 对抗性、中文原生、GPT-4 五票判定
scale: 450（175 误导题 + 69 高难误导题 + 206 知识题；30 个领域）
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Chinese-native, five-vote GPT-4 judging
intro_en: HalluQA is a 450-question benchmark for hallucinations in Chinese LLMs, comprising 175 misleading questions, 69 misleading-hard questions, and 206 knowledge questions across 30 domains. Stable failures from GLM-130B, ChatGPT, and Puyu serve as adversarial selection signals, while authors or an NLP expert verify questions, answer sets, and external evidence.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.03368, Sections 2.2-2.4 and 3.2-3.3. HalluQA totals 450 questions across 30 domains: 175 misleading, 69 misleading-hard, and 206 knowledge questions. The misleading branch adapts 20 TruthfulQA-style patterns plus Chinese history, custom, superstition, and legend patterns; six manual seeds are expanded with five GLM-130B samples and retained when at least three of five outputs show imitative falsehoods. The misleading-hard branch mines recent Chinese web confusions and adversarial ChatGPT 3.5 failures. Ten Chinese-native graduate interns write knowledge candidates; ChatGPT and Puyu each answer five times, both must fail at least three of five, and an NLP expert filters roughly 1,000 candidates to 206. Misleading items receive four correct and four wrong answers; knowledge items receive at least one of each plus external evidence. Independent author/expert review removes ambiguity and unsupported items. GPT-4-0613 evaluates directness, correctness, fluency, support, and hallucination with five votes at temperature 0 and top-p 0.5; refusal counts as hallucination except for unanswerable questions. The official metric is non-hallucination rate, and human agreement with the judge is reported separately as 93.5%.

name: HallusionBench
intro: HallusionBench是一个全面的基准测试，旨在评估图像-上下文推理能力。该基准测试通过强调对视觉数据的细致理解和解释，对先进的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）提出了重大挑战。它包含346张图像和1129个问题，全部由人类专家精心制作。通过新颖的视觉问题结构和对照组设计，HallusionBench能够对模型的响应趋势、逻辑一致性和各种故障模式进行定量分析，并深入理解语言幻觉和视觉错觉等问题。
org: University of Maryland, University of California, Beijing Institute of Technology, Tencent AI Lab, C
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
metric: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc
modality: 图像, 文本, 多模态
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Adversarial, process evaluation
intro_en: HallusionBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate image-context reasoning abilities. By emphasizing detailed understanding and interpretation of visual data, it poses significant challenges to advanced large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes 346 images and 1,129 questions, all carefully crafted by human experts. Through novel visual question structures and control group designs, HallusionBench enables quantitative analysis of model response patterns, logical consistency, and various failure modes, providing deep insights into issues such as language hallucination and visual illusions.
metric_en: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.14566, Sections 3 and 4. HallusionBench defines 591 Visual Dependent questions that require visual context and 538 Visual Supplement questions that test whether images correct or override parametric knowledge. Experts collect 346 images and construct 455 visual-question control pairs, including no-visual inputs, original online images, and 181 manually edited images produced by flipping, order reversal, masking, OCR, object, and color edits; the final benchmark has 1,129 binary questions. A text-only GPT-4 judge at temperature 0 labels each LVLM response correct, incorrect, or unclear three times and averages the scores, with human checks showing close agreement. The suite reports all, figure, question-pair, easy, and hard accuracy, yes/no bias and consistency tests, and a decision-tree diagnosis of language hallucination, visual illusion, or mixed/uncertain failure.

name: HarmBench
intro: HarmBench 是一个标准化自动红队评测框架，包含 510 个由作者依据主流模型使用政策人工设计和反复筛选的有害行为，覆盖 4 个功能类别与 7 个语义类别。它通过固定的验证/测试划分、标准化生成设置和两类专用分类器，以攻击成功率衡量红队方法对目标模型及防御的突破效果。
org: Center for AI Safety, University of California Berkeley, Stanford University, University of Illinois
build_method: 政策提炼, 专家人工构建, 反复筛选, 分层划分
task_type: 自动红队, 安全测试
eval_feature: 对抗性, 保留测试集, 专用分类器
build_method_en: Policy Distillation, Expert Authoring, Iterative Curation, Stratified Splitting
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Held-out Test Set, Specialized Classifiers
intro_en: HarmBench is a standardized automated red-teaming framework with 510 harmful behaviors manually designed and repeatedly curated by the authors from major model-use policies. The behaviors cover four functional and seven semantic categories. A fixed validation/test split, standardized generation settings, and two specialized classifier paths measure attack success against target models and defenses.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.04249. HarmBench starts by collecting and distilling acceptable-use policies from major AI labs with GPT-4, then authors manually curate 510 harmful behaviors designed to violate laws or widely held norms. Behaviors span seven semantic categories and four functional categories: standard, copyright, contextual, and multimodal. The benchmark provides an official validation/test split of 100 and 410 behaviors and requires attacks/defenses not tune on test behaviors. The evaluation pipeline gives behaviors to a red-teaming method to generate test cases, sends those test cases to target LLMs with standardized generation settings, and scores completions with an open classifier for non-copyright behaviors plus a hashing-based classifier for copyright behaviors. Results are reported as attack success rate.

name: HEAD-QA
intro: HEAD-QA是基于西班牙医疗系统专业资格考试的多项选择问答基准，涵盖医学、护理学、心理学、化学、药学和生物学六个领域，对人类专家也极具挑战性。
build_method: 官方考试题抽取、无效题清理、按年份切分与机器翻译人工抽检
eval_feature: 西班牙文/英文双语、按年份切分、与官方人类成绩可比
build_method_en: Official-exam extraction, invalid-item removal, chronological splitting, and human-audited machine translation
eval_feature_en: Spanish/English bilingual views, chronological splits, and comparability with official human results
intro_en: HEAD-QA is a multiple-choice question benchmark based on the Spanish healthcare system professional qualification exam, covering six fields: medicine, nursing, psychology, chemistry, pharmacy, and biology. It is highly challenging even for human experts.

    F -- Pass --> G(Validated Q&A Pairs)
    F -- Fail --> H[Refinement/Discard]

    J --> K(Medical Knowledge Assessment)
