drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.04701 and the official HEAD-QA release. HEAD-QA is created from Spanish public-health specialization examinations from 2013 onward. It covers medicine, pharmacology, psychology, nursing, biology, and chemistry; radiophysics is excluded because equations made PDF parsing difficult, and questions invalidated after the official exams are removed. Each sample stores a question ID/text, optional image path, answer IDs/text, and the correct-answer ID. The full dataset has 6,765 questions: 2,657 from 2013-2014 for training, 1,366 from 2015 for development, and 2,742 from later exams for testing. The original Spanish data is translated with Google API; two bilingual reviewers assess adequacy and one native English speaker assesses fluency on 60 random items. Evaluation selects one option and reports accuracy plus official POINTS (correct +3, wrong -1); no additional blank-answer rule is inferred.

name: HealthAdminBench
intro: HealthAdminBench 是一个医疗行政 computer-use agent 基准。135 个专家任务在 4 个确定性 GUI 环境中复现事前授权、拒付申诉和耐用医疗设备流程，并以 1,698 个可验证子任务同时衡量细粒度进展与严格的端到端任务成功。
org: Stanford University, Kinetic Systems, Stanford Health Care
build_method: 专家工作流设计, 确定性GUI仿真, 专家审计, 混合验证器
metric: 任务成功率, 子任务成功率, 95% Bootstrap置信区间
task_type: Computer-use Agent, 医疗行政工作流
eval_feature: 确定性GUI, 状态持久化, 严格端到端判定
scale: 135 个任务, 1,698 个子任务（1,177 确定性 + 521 自由文本）
build_method_en: Expert Workflow Design, Deterministic GUI Simulation, Expert Audit, Hybrid Verification
eval_feature_en: Deterministic GUI, Persistent State, Strict End-to-end Scoring
intro_en: HealthAdminBench evaluates healthcare-administration computer-use agents with 135 expert-designed tasks in four deterministic GUI environments. Prior authorization, appeals and denials, and durable medical equipment workflows are decomposed into 1,698 verifiable subtasks, supporting both granular progress measurement and strict end-to-end task success.
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Subtask Success Rate, 95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.09937, Sections 2-4 and the official som-shahlab/health-admin-bench repository. Practicing healthcare administrators designed 135 prior-authorization, appeals/denials, and durable-medical-equipment tasks after more than 100 hours of workflow shadowing. The benchmark implements an EHR, two payer portals, and fax as deterministic GUI environments with synthetic patient data, typed schemas, policy checks, failure modes, and persistent state while abstracting CAPTCHA, MFA, and session management. A stratified 40-task audit uses two revenue-cycle experts per task, with corrections propagated across the set. The 135 tasks contain 1,698 subtasks across six capability groups: 1,177 deterministic JMESPath checks and 521 GPT-5.4 free-text judges, whose 60-sample expert agreement is 93.3%. Subtasks are binary, and strict task success requires every subtask to pass; reporting includes subtask and task success with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.

name: HealthBench
intro: HealthBench 是一个由 262 名医生共同构建的开放式医疗对话基准，包含 5,000 个多轮对话和 48,562 条独特评分标准，覆盖 7 个主题与 5 个行为轴。对话来自定制模型生成、医生红队和 HealthSearchQA 改写，并经相关性过滤；逐样本 rubric 由模型裁判判定后汇总为标准化分数。
build_method: 医生策划, LLM生成, 医生红队, Rubric标注
metric: 医生编写Rubric的模型评分, 截断均值, Bootstrap标准误
task_type: 开放式医疗对话, 医疗安全
eval_feature: 多轮, 医生Rubric, 模型裁判, 行为轴切片
scale: 5,000 个对话, 48,562 条独特评分标准
build_method_en: Physician Curation, LLM Generation, Physician Red Teaming, Rubric Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Physician Rubrics, Model-based Grader, Behavioral-axis Slices
intro_en: HealthBench is an open-ended medical-dialogue benchmark built with 262 physicians. Its 5,000 multi-turn conversations carry 48,562 unique rubric criteria across seven themes and five behavioral axes. Conversations come from a tailored generation pipeline, physician red teaming, and HealthSearchQA rewrites, followed by relevance filtering; a model-based grader evaluates physician-authored rubrics and aggregates normalized scores.
metric_en: Model-graded Physician Rubric Score, Clipped Mean, Bootstrap Standard Error
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.08775, Sections 2-4 and Appendix B, plus the official openai/simple-evals implementation. HealthBench was developed over 11 months with 262 vetted physicians across 60 countries and 26 specialties. Physician advisors chose domains and situations, wrote prompt seeds and consensus criteria, prepared training materials, and reviewed work. Most examples were generated by a tailored language-model pipeline from physician-enumerated situations; additional examples came from physician red teaming and HealthSearchQA query rewrites. Conversations alternate user and assistant turns, start and end with the user, and are filtered for realism, self-consistency, physical-health relevance, and message completeness. Physicians write positive and negative example-specific rubrics and assign theme and behavioral-axis categories; majority-supported reusable requirements form 34 consensus criteria. The final 5,000 conversations contain 48,562 unique criteria across seven themes and five axes. A model grader marks each criterion true or false; met criteria receive their signed points, the example score divides earned points by maximum positive points, and aggregate means are clipped to [0,1] with bootstrap uncertainty and slice reporting.

name: HealthBench Hard
intro: HealthBench Hard 是从 HealthBench 5,000 个对话中按多模型低分筛出的 1,000 个困难样本。构建时先剔除所有模型均为零分的约 1.5% 样本，再按五家模型提供方的平均 HealthBench 分数选择最低 1,000 个；原始对话、医生 rubric 和正式评分公式均保持不变。
build_method: HealthBench子集筛选, 多提供方模型难度排序
metric: 医生编写Rubric的模型评分, 截断均值, Bootstrap标准误
task_type: 开放式医疗对话, 医疗安全
eval_feature: 多模型难例选择, 医生Rubric, 模型裁判
scale: 1,000 个困难对话（从 HealthBench 5,000 个对话筛选）
build_method_en: HealthBench Subset Selection, Cross-provider Model Difficulty Ranking
eval_feature_en: Multi-model Hard-case Selection, Physician Rubrics, Model-based Grader
intro_en: HealthBench Hard is a 1,000-example difficult subset selected from HealthBench's 5,000 conversations. Construction first removes the roughly 1.5% of examples on which every selection model scores zero, then takes the 1,000 lowest average HealthBench scores across five model providers. The original conversations, physician rubrics, and official scoring formula remain unchanged.
scale_en: 1,000 difficult conversations selected from 5,000 HealthBench conversations
metric_en: Model-graded Physician Rubric Score, Clipped Mean, Bootstrap Standard Error
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.08775, Appendix C, and the official openai/simple-evals HealthBench Hard loader. The authors compute each full-set HealthBench score for o3, Grok 3, Gemini 2.5 Pro (March 2025), Claude 3.7 Sonnet with extended thinking, and Llama 4 Maverick. They first remove examples on which no model earns positive points, approximately 1.5% of the 5,000-example full set, to avoid selecting items dominated by excessive difficulty or rubric variability. They then rank the remaining examples by average score across model providers and select the lowest 1,000; provider averaging avoids making the split adversarial to one model family. No new conversations or rubrics are authored. Evaluation preserves HealthBench's signed physician-authored criteria, binary model-grader decisions, per-example normalization by maximum positive points, clipped aggregate mean, bootstrap uncertainty, and behavioral-axis slices.

name: HealthBench Professional
intro: HealthBench Professional 是 OpenAI 面向真实临床医生聊天任务发布的开放基准，包含从 15,079 个候选中分层筛选的 525 个任务，覆盖会诊、写作与文档、医学研究三类常见工作。190 名医生参与创作与三阶段复核，困难样本相对候选池富集约 3.5 倍，约三分之一来自医生红队测试。
build_method: 真实医生聊天采集, 三阶段医生复核, 难度分层抽样, 医生Rubric标注
metric: 长度校正的医生Rubric分数, 场景与专科切片
task_type: 开放式临床对话, 医疗专业任务
eval_feature: 真实临床工作流, 医生红队, 专科匹配人类基线, 模型Rubric裁判, 长度校正
scale: 525个任务（从15,079个候选筛选）；190名医生
task_type_en: Open-ended clinician chat, professional medical tasks
build_method_en: Real clinician chats, three-stage physician review, difficulty-stratified sampling, physician-authored rubrics
eval_feature_en: Real clinical workflows, physician red teaming, specialist-matched human baseline, model rubric grader, length adjustment
intro_en: HealthBench Professional is OpenAI's open benchmark of real clinician-chat tasks. Its 525 tasks were stratified from 15,079 candidates across care consult, writing and documentation, and medical research. A cohort of 190 physicians contributed authorship and three-stage review; difficult examples are enriched by about 3.5 times and roughly one-third are physician red-teaming cases.
scale_en: 525 tasks selected from 15,079 candidates; 190 physician contributors
metric_en: Length-adjusted physician-rubric score, use-case and specialty slices
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.27470, especially Sections 2-4 and 8, plus the official OpenAI release page and dataset schema. HealthBench Professional is a separate 2026 open benchmark that complements HealthBench; it is not a Claude system-card split. 190 physicians with experience across 50 countries and 26 specialties authored or reviewed real ChatGPT for Clinicians conversations from good-faith use and deliberate red teaming. Stage 1 creates the conversation, example-specific signed rubric, and Likert 1-7 difficulty rating; Stage 2 checks realism, difficulty, and rubric quality, with two independent physicians verifying difficult cases; Stage 3 adjudicates ambiguity and removes subjective criteria. Metadata tags drive stratified selection of 525 tasks from 15,079 candidates, enriching difficult examples about 3.5 times, with roughly one-third red teaming. Specialist-matched physicians provide unbounded-time, web-enabled responses for all tasks. GPT-5.4 at low reasoning grades each criterion independently; met signed points are normalized by maximum positive points, then an empirically estimated response-length adjustment is applied before clipped mean and slice reporting.

name: HealthBench-Hallu
intro: HealthBench-Hallu 是 Baichuan-M3 报告在 HealthBench 模型回答上运行的细粒度医疗幻觉评测。它抽取并原子化医学事实声明，以实时检索的权威证据将声明标为支持、不确定或驳斥，并用加权幻觉率区分严重事实错误与证据不足。论文未披露独立题目数。
build_method: HealthBench回答复用, GPT-5事实声明抽取, 实时权威证据检索
metric: 加权幻觉率, 驳斥率, 不确定率
task_type: 医疗回答, 事实声明级幻觉验证
eval_feature: 声明原子化, 实时检索, 权威证据, 三档标签
scale: 基于 HealthBench 模型回答运行；论文未披露独立题目数
build_method_en: HealthBench Response Reuse, GPT-5 Claim Extraction, Live Authoritative-evidence Retrieval
eval_feature_en: Claim Atomicity, Live Search, Authoritative Evidence, Three-way Labels
intro_en: HealthBench-Hallu is the fine-grained medical-hallucination evaluation run over HealthBench model responses in the Baichuan-M3 report. It extracts and atomizes medical factual claims, retrieves current authoritative evidence, labels each claim Supported, Uncertain, or Refuted, and separates severe factual errors from insufficient evidence with a weighted hallucination rate. The paper does not disclose a separate item count.
scale_en: Runs over HealthBench model responses; no independent item count is reported
metric_en: Weighted Hallucination Rate, Refuted Rate, Uncertain Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.06570, Section 4.3 and the Fact-Aware Verification description in Section 3.3. HealthBench-Hallu is not presented as an independently constructed question dataset: the authors run a high-precision factuality-verification pipeline over model responses generated across HealthBench tasks, and do not report a separate item count. GPT-5 extracts medical factual claims for coverage; the pipeline resolves coreference, rewrites claims for atomicity, discards noise and distractors, deduplicates while preserving order, and searches authoritative sources and clinical guidelines in real time instead of using cached evidence. Each claim is labeled Supported with weight 0, Uncertain with weight 0.5, or Refuted with weight 1. The weighted hallucination rate is the mean claim weight, while Refuted Rate and Uncertain Rate remain separately visible. This distinguishes erroneous or misapplied medical knowledge and fabricated or distorted evidence, data, and causal relationships from merely insufficient support.

name: HealthSearchQA
intro: HealthSearchQA 是 Google 在 MultiMedQA 论文中引入的开放式消费者医疗问答数据集。论文版本包含 3,375 条常见健康搜索问题，由医学状况及相关症状作为种子，检索搜索引擎向输入种子词用户公开展示的常见问题；数据只提供问题，不含参考答案，采用自由文本开放域回答。
build_method: 医学状况与症状种子, 公开常见搜索问题检索与策划
metric: 12个临床医生评估轴, 普通用户意图与有用性评分, Bootstrap区间
eval_feature: 消费者健康查询, 无参考答案, 医学共识与伤害评估, 普通用户效用评估
scale: 3,375条仅含问题的消费者医疗查询
build_method_en: Medical-condition and symptom seeds, retrieval and curation of publicly shown common search questions
eval_feature_en: Consumer health queries, no reference answers, medical consensus and harm review, lay-user utility evaluation
intro_en: HealthSearchQA is Google's open-ended consumer medical QA dataset introduced with MultiMedQA. The paper version contains 3,375 commonly searched health questions retrieved from publicly shown search-engine queries using medical conditions and associated symptoms as seeds. It provides questions only, with free-text open-domain responses and no reference answers.
metric_en: 12 clinician evaluation axes, lay-user intent and helpfulness ratings, bootstrap intervals
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Medical conditions and symptom seeds"] --> B["Public commonly searched questions"]
    B --> C["3,375 question-only queries"]
    C --> D["MultiMedQA consumer-health component"]
    D --> E["100 HealthSearchQA questions in a 140-question study"]
    E --> F["Clinician and lay-user ratings"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["医学状况与症状种子"] --> B["公开常见搜索问题"]
    B --> C["3,375条仅含问题的查询"]
    C --> D["MultiMedQA消费者健康组成"]
    D --> E["140题研究中的100道HealthSearchQA"]
    E --> F["临床医生与普通用户评分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2212.13138, especially Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.5. The arXiv paper consistently reports 3,375 HealthSearchQA questions in its contribution list, MultiMedQA summary table, dataset-construction paragraph, and size line. Medical conditions and associated symptoms seed retrieval of publicly available commonly searched questions generated by a search engine and shown to users entering those terms. The released benchmark is English, open-domain, free-response, and question-only; it does not include reference answers or use automatic accuracy. The human-evaluation framework was refined through clinician focus groups and triplicate ratings of 25 question-answer tuples per dataset. The paper's detailed study randomly selected 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA questions, disjoint from prompt-tuning examples. Clinician and model answer sources were blinded; one of nine clinicians rated each answer over 12 scientific-consensus, harm, comprehension, retrieval, reasoning, content, and bias axes. Five non-medical raters evaluated intent and helpfulness/actionability, while 100 bootstrap replicas produced 95% percentile intervals. The diagram explicitly keeps this 140-question sampled study separate from construction of all 3,375 queries.

name: HellaSwag
intro: HellaSwag是一个常识推理挑战数据集。人类在该数据集上的准确率超过95%，但先进的语言模型得分却很低。该数据集通过对抗性过滤（Adversarial Filtering）方法构建，旨在生成对机器而言极具挑战性、但对人类来说却很简单的句子补全问题。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
build_method: LLM生成, 对抗性过滤
eval_feature: 对抗性, 常识推理
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Adversarial Filtering
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, commonsense reasoning
intro_en: HellaSwag is a commonsense reasoning challenge dataset. Humans achieve over 95% accuracy on it, while advanced language models score much lower. The dataset is constructed using Adversarial Filtering to create sentence completion tasks that are very challenging for machines but easy for humans.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1905.07830 Sections 4.1-4.4 and 5. HellaSwag combines ActivityNet captions/activity labels with 80K scraped WikiHow context/follow-up paragraphs and chooses two-sentence WikiHow generations as the Goldilocks setting. A fine-tuned GPT oversamples wrong endings; on each adversarial-filtering round BERT-Large is reinitialized, trained on a random dummy split, and easy negatives are replaced until convergence. Crowd workers then see one true and five adversarial endings, and realistic machine endings are replaced. The benchmark keeps 25K high-agreement ActivityNet and 45K WikiHow contexts, totaling 70K. Validation and test each contain 5K in-domain and 5K held-out-category examples. Models choose the true ending from four choices and are reported by overall, in-domain, zero-shot, and source accuracy.

name: HELMET
intro: HELMET是一个全面的基准测试，旨在有效且彻底地评估长上下文语言模型（LCLMs）。它涵盖了七个多样化的、以应用为中心的类别，解决了现有基准测试中存在的覆盖范围有限、上下文长度不足和评估指标不可靠等问题。HELMET通过增加可控的上下文长度（高达128K tokens）、基于模型的评估和少样本提示，提供了更可靠和一致的LCLM排名。研究发现，合成任务不能可靠预测下游性能，且HELMET中不同类别之间趋势各异、相关性低。
build_method: 公开长上下文任务策划、可控长度构造与任务适配评测
metric: SubEM, Citation metrics, NDCG@10, Accuracy, ROUGE F1, GPT-4o model-based scores
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题, 摘要, 信息检索, 文本生成
eval_feature: 七类应用导向任务、128K+可控上下文、稳健少样本提示与参考式模型评测
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Multiple Choice, Summarization, information retrieval, text generation
build_method_en: Public-task curation, controllable-length construction, and task-appropriate evaluation
eval_feature_en: Seven application-centric categories, controllable 128K+ contexts, robust few-shot prompts, and reference-based model evaluation
intro_en: HELMET is a comprehensive benchmark designed to effectively and thoroughly evaluate long-context language models (LCLMs). It covers seven diverse, application-focused categories, addressing limitations in existing benchmarks such as limited coverage, insufficient context length, and unreliable evaluation metrics. HELMET offers more reliable and consistent LCLM rankings by incorporating controllable context lengths (up to 128K tokens), model-based evaluation, and few-shot prompting. Studies show that synthetic tasks do not reliably predict downstream performance, and trends vary with low correlation across different categories within HELMET.
metric_en: SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, ROUGE F1, GPT-4o model-based scores
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["diverse long-context desiderata"] --> B["RAG/Cite/Re-rank/ICL/LongQA/Summ/Recall"]
    B --> C["selected public datasets"]
    C --> D["control input length to 128K+"]
    D --> E["two-shot and robust prompts"]
    E --> F["reference-based or model-based metrics"]
    F --> G["59-LCLM holistic evaluation"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["多样长上下文目标"] --> B["RAG/引用/重排/ICL/长QA/摘要/召回"]
    B --> C["精选公开数据集"]
    C --> D["控制到128K以上长度"]
    D --> E["双样例稳健提示"]
    E --> F["参考或模型评估指标"]
    F --> G["59个LCLM整体评测"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.02694 and the official princeton-nlp/HELMET repository. HELMET targets four weaknesses in long-context evaluation: limited application coverage, inadequate length, unreliable metrics, and incompatibility with base models. It curates seven categories and 21 dataset/task configurations: RAG, citation generation, passage re-ranking, many-shot ICL, long-document QA, summarization, and synthetic recall. Evidence tasks vary retrieved or ranked passages and gold positions; ICL varies balanced shots; long documents are truncated from the end; synthetic tasks control generated length and placement, supporting 128K tokens and beyond. Most tasks use two-shot prompts, with variable-shot ICL and original RULER settings. Direct metrics include SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, and ROUGE F1. GPT-4o grades NarrativeQA with fluency times normalized correctness and summaries with atomic-claim precision/recall F1 times fluency. The paper compares 59 LCLMs and explicitly argues for a multi-category profile rather than a synthetic proxy.

name: HiPhO
intro: HiPhO 使用 2024-2025 年 7 项物理奥赛的 13 套官方试卷评估 (M)LLM。论文基准包含 360 道题、519 个小题，覆盖 5 个物理领域、4 种模态和 6 种答案类型；每个题解对均经专家人工核验，7 套考试提供官方步骤评分细则，最终按考试总分映射官方金银铜牌线。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
build_method: 官方试卷OCR, 题解索引匹配, 全量专家核验, 评分细则结构化, 多维标注
metric: 考试总分, 答案级与步骤级得分, 金银铜牌等级
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 官方评分细则, 部分分, 多解取最高分, 多模态, 人机奖牌对比
scale: 13套试卷, 360道题, 519个小题；7套含评分细则
build_method_en: Official-exam OCR, question-answer index matching, complete expert verification, marking-scheme structuring, multidimensional annotation
eval_feature_en: Official marking schemes, partial credit, best-of-multiple solutions, multimodal input, human medal comparison
intro_en: HiPhO evaluates (M)LLMs on 13 official papers from seven 2024-2025 physics Olympiads. The paper benchmark contains 360 problems and 519 subquestions across five physics fields, four modality types, and six answer types. Experts manually verify every QA pair; seven exams include official step-level marking schemes, and total exam scores map to official gold, silver, and bronze thresholds.
scale_en: 13 exam papers, 360 problems, 519 subquestions; 7 papers include marking schemes
metric_en: Exam score, answer- and step-level score, Gold/Silver/Bronze level
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Official 2024-2025 exam PDFs"] --> B["OCR and LaTeX-preserving extraction"]
    B --> C["QA matching and complete expert verification"]
    C --> D["Marking schemes and problem refinement"]
    D --> E["360 problems and 519 subquestions"]
    E --> F["Answer- and step-level grading"]
    F --> G["Exam scores and medal thresholds"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["2024-2025官方试卷PDF"] --> B["OCR与LaTeX保留抽取"]
    B --> C["题解匹配与全量专家核验"]
    C --> D["评分细则与题目精炼"]
    D --> E["360道题与519个小题"]
    E --> F["答案级与步骤级评分"]
    F --> G["考试总分与奖牌线"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.07894, especially Sections 3.1-3.3 and Appendices A.1-A.2, plus the official SciYu/HiPhO release. The paper snapshot selects 13 exam papers from seven influential 2024-2025 physics Olympiads based on influence and availability of human scores. Official PDFs are converted to markdown by OCR while preserving LaTeX, questions and answers are matched by indices, and experts manually verify every QA pair, correcting OCR errors, mismatches, and answer inconsistencies. Seven exams provide official marking schemes; criteria are converted into model-readable step rubrics, and four exams support multiple official solutions. Post-processing completes context, structures interdependent subquestions, and specifies required units. The final paper benchmark has 360 problems, 519 subquestions, 308 English and 52 Chinese problems, five physics fields, four modality types, six answer types, and three difficulty levels. Answer grading uses a rule-based math verifier followed by a strong-model review for failed equivalent matches. For exams with marking schemes, a strong model awards step-level partial credit and takes the highest score across valid official solution paths; exams without schemes use answer-level grading. Problem scores sum to exam scores and map to official medal thresholds.

name: HireBench
intro: HireBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文与 AgentWorldModel-1K 发布数据中的 1,000 个合成环境之一，对应“Coding Graduate Pipeline”招聘场景。AWM 为该场景生成 10 个任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具、样例数据和逐任务验证器。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 四类任务结果, 完成奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强LLM裁判
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；10个招聘任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented LLM judge
intro_en: HireBench is not a standalone benchmark. It is one of 1,000 synthetic environments in the Agent World Model paper and AgentWorldModel-1K release, representing the Coding Graduate Pipeline recruiting scenario. AWM generates ten tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools, sample data, and task-specific verifiers for this scenario.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 recruiting tasks
metric_en: Four-class task outcome, completion reward, Environment Error
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10090v3, especially Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.3, execution-based self-correction, and Appendix Table 15, plus the official Snowflake/AgentWorldModel-1K scenario and task files. HireBench is not defined as a standalone benchmark: the paper lists ‘HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline’ as a generated scenario, and the released gen_scenario.jsonl maps it to ats_applicant_tracking_system_4. Its ten released tasks cover job requisitions, coding assessments, candidate profiles, submissions, interviews, offers, bulk pipeline updates, and recruiting analytics. The common AWM pipeline expands 100 domain-name seeds into stateful CRUD scenarios, classifies and embedding-deduplicates them, generates ten API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario, synthesizes SQLite schema and sample state, emits a minimal typed FastAPI/MCP tool interface, and creates task-specific before/after-state verifiers. Components run in isolation and feed errors back for up to five repair iterations. Agent evaluation combines structured database signals with the trajectory in a code-augmented LLM judge and returns Completed, Partially Completed, Agent Error, or Environment Error.

name: HLE
intro: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) 是一个前沿的多模态基准，旨在评估高级AI系统在人类知识前沿的表现。该基准包含2500个由全球主题专家创建的选择题和简答题，覆盖数学、人文学科和自然科学等多个领域。HLE的设计目标是成为同类中最后一个封闭式学术基准，其问题无法通过简单的网络搜索快速解答，从而对当前最先进的LLM构成重大挑战。
org: Center for AI Safety and collaborating institutions
task_type_en: Multiple choice and short answer questions
build_method_en: Constructed by experts from various global fields
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Zero-shot, few-shot, Domain-specific
intro_en: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is a cutting-edge multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate advanced AI systems' performance at the forefront of human knowledge. It includes 2,500 multiple-choice and short-answer questions created by global subject experts, covering fields such as mathematics, humanities, and natural sciences. HLE aims to be the last closed-book academic benchmark of its kind, with questions that cannot be quickly answered through simple web searches, posing a significant challenge to state-of-the-art LLMs.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.14249, Sections 3-4 and Appendices B.1 and C.1. HLE draws questions from nearly 1,000 expert contributors at more than 500 institutions in 50 countries. Submissions include the question, answer specification, detailed rationale, subject, contributor, and affiliation, and must be precise, original, closed-ended, non-searchable, and easily verifiable. Exact-match items must stump every frontier model; multiple-choice items must stump all but at most one. More than 70,000 model attempts send about 13,000 questions to human review. Round one gives each question one to three graduate-level reviews and iterative author feedback; round two requires organizer or trained-expert approval. The public 2,500-question set spans more than 100 subjects, with about 14% multimodal and 24% multiple choice, while a private held-out set checks overfitting and gaming. Evaluation requests reasoning, a final answer, and 0-100% confidence; an O3-mini structured judge accepts equivalent answer formats, and reports accuracy plus RMS calibration error.

name: HLE-Full
intro: HLE-Full 是网站和模型报告中对完整 Humanity’s Last Exam 评测的标签，并非另行构建的数据集；它使用 HLE 当前公开的 2,500 道多模态专家题。
org: Center for AI Safety, Scale AI
build_method: 全球学科专家投稿、多模型难度筛选与两阶段专家评审
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 多项选择, 精确短答案
eval_feature: 完整多模态、无工具、闭卷与置信度校准
build_method_en: Global subject-expert submissions, multi-model difficulty filtering, and two-stage expert review
eval_feature_en: Full multimodal, no-tool, closed-book evaluation with confidence calibration
intro_en: HLE-Full is a website and model-report label for the complete Humanity’s Last Exam evaluation, not a separately constructed dataset; it uses the current 2,500-item multimodal expert release of HLE.
scale_en: 2,500 public questions (plus a private held-out set)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["global subject experts"] --> B["strict closed-ended submissions"]
    B --> C["frontier-LLM difficulty filtering"]
    C --> D["two rounds of expert review"]
    D --> E["2,500 public questions plus private holdout"]
    E --> F["full multimodal no-tool evaluation"]
    F --> G["O3-mini correctness judge"]
    G --> H["accuracy and RMS calibration error"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["全球学科专家"] --> B["严格封闭式投稿"]
    B --> C["前沿LLM难度筛选"]
    C --> D["两轮专家评审"]
    D --> E["2500道公开题及私有保留集"]
    E --> F["完整多模态无工具评测"]
    F --> G["O3-mini正确性裁判"]
    G --> H["准确率和RMS校准误差"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the current revision of arXiv:2501.14249 and the official cais/hle release. HLE-Full is a reporting label for complete HLE, not a separately constructed benchmark. Nearly 1,000 experts from 500+ institutions in 50 countries submit closed-ended questions across more than 100 subjects. Each submission includes the question, answer specification, detailed rationale, subject, and contributor affiliation and must be precise, unambiguous, solvable, non-searchable, and original or a nontrivial synthesis. Several frontier LLMs precheck difficulty; more than 70,000 attempts yield about 13,000 model-stumping candidates. Graduate-degree reviewers give each item 1-3 first-round reviews before organizer/expert approval. The current paper and dataset release contain 2,500 public questions plus a private held-out set; 24% are multiple choice, the remainder exact match, and around 14% require images. Full multimodal no-tool evaluation requests reasoning, a final answer, and confidence; O3-mini accepts equivalent answer formats. Metrics are accuracy and RMS calibration error.

name: HLE-Verified
intro: HLE-Verified 是 Humanity’s Last Exam 的系统验证与结构化修订版本，通过组件级核验、双轨专家修复和最终裁决，将 2,500 题划分为 668 个金集、1,143 个修订集和 689 个有记录的不确定集。
build_method: 专家审查, 模型交叉检查和独立专家修复
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: Verified
build_method_en: Expert review, model cross-checking, and independent expert correction
eval_feature_en: Verified
intro_en: HLE-Verified is a systematic verification and structured revision of Humanity’s Last Exam. Component-wise validation, dual independent expert repair, and final adjudication partition all 2,500 items into 668 Gold, 1,143 Revision, and 689 documented Uncertain items.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["2,500 original HLE items"] --> B["problem/answer/rationale components"]
    B --> C["expert review plus pass@8 evidence"]
    C --> D["668 unchanged Gold items"]
    C --> E["repairable items"]
    E --> F["dual expert repairs and final adjudication"]
    F --> G["1,143 Revision items"]
    F --> H["689 documented Uncertain items"]
    D --> I["three disjoint release subsets"]
    G --> I
    H --> I
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["2500个原始HLE条目"] --> B["题目/答案/解析组件"]
    B --> C["专家审查与pass@8证据"]
    C --> D["668个未修改金集"]
    C --> E["可修复条目"]
    E --> F["双轨专家修复与最终裁决"]
    F --> G["1143个修订条目"]
    F --> H["689个有记录的不确定条目"]
    D --> I["三个互斥发布子集"]
    G --> I
    H --> I
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the current v3 of arXiv:2602.13964. HLE-Verified starts from all 2,500 original HLE items and decomposes each into problem (including image), final answer, and rationale. Stage I combines independent domain-expert binary judgments, multi-frontier-model pass@8 replication with answer normalization/equivalence, and conservative internal adjudication without content edits. Valid problems and answers with no high-risk ambiguity form 668 unchanged Gold items; these bypass Stage II. Flawed but repairable items enter Stage II under an objective-preservation constraint. Two independent expert teams propose Problem Fix, Solution Fix, and Answer Fix edits with change notes; model proposals are auxiliary only; internal experts select or synthesize minimal canonical repairs. The release has three disjoint subsets: 668 Gold, 1,143 revised-and-certified, and 689 Uncertain items with source and required-expertise tags, plus traces and a 19-category defect taxonomy. Evaluation compares raw and verified full/edited subsets with accuracy and calibration error, using text-only items unless specified. The current v3 counts supersede earlier abstract counts of 641 and 1,170.

name: HLEtext
intro: HLEtext 是 Step 3.5 Flash 报告使用的 Humanity’s Last Exam 纯文本子集，并非独立数据集；它筛除需要图像理解的 HLE 题目后按官方判分协议评测。
org: StepFun; HLE by Center for AI Safety and Scale AI

scale: 未公布精确行数（HLE中约14%题目需图像）
build_method_en: Construct full HLE through the expert pipeline, then remove questions requiring image comprehension
eval_feature_en: HLE text-only subset, pass@1, and gpt-oss-120b judging
intro_en: HLEtext is the text-only subset of Humanity’s Last Exam used in the Step 3.5 Flash report, not an independent dataset; image-dependent HLE questions are removed before applying the official judging protocol.
scale_en: Exact row count not published (around 14% of HLE requires images)

    B --> C["two-stage expert review"]
    C --> D["current 2,500-item HLE"]
    D --> E["remove image-dependent questions"]
    E --> F["one generation per problem"]

    B --> C["两阶段专家评审"]
    C --> D["当前2500题HLE"]
    D --> E["移除依赖图像的题目"]
