drawio_review_note: Aligned jointly with arXiv:2501.14249 (HLE construction), the official cais/hle release, and arXiv:2602.10604 (the Step 3.5 Flash HLEtext evaluation). HLEtext is not a separately sourced dataset. Full HLE is built from nearly 1,000 experts across 500+ institutions and 50 countries, strict closed-ended submissions, more than 70,000 frontier-model difficulty attempts yielding about 13,000 candidates, 1-3 first-round graduate-expert reviews per item, and organizer/expert approval. The current release has 2,500 public questions plus a private held-out set; 24% are multiple choice, the remainder exact match, and around 14% require images. HLEtext removes image-dependent questions while preserving both answer formats. The Step report does not publish an exact text-subset row count, so none is inferred. It runs one generation per HLE problem, uses HLE's official metric and judgment protocol with gpt-oss-120b as judge, and reports HLEtext pass@1 accuracy.

name: HMMT-25
intro: HMMT-25 是 MathArena 收录的 2025 年 2 月 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament 决赛题集，包含 30 道经提取、格式统一和人工核验的竞赛数学题。MathArena 以四次独立作答的 pass@1 准确率评估模型，并结合符号等价解析、语义判题和人工复核降低评分误差。
build_method: 官方赛题提取、格式标准化、人工核验
metric: Pass@1 Accuracy（4 次独立运行均值）, Score/Rank Confidence Intervals
eval_feature: 新近竞赛、发布日期标记、四次独立运行、解析器与语义判题复核
build_method_en: Official problem extraction, format standardization, human verification
eval_feature_en: Fresh competition, release-date flags, four independent runs, parser and semantic-judge review
intro_en: HMMT-25 is the February 2025 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament finals set included in MathArena. It contains 30 competition problems extracted from official materials, standardized, and manually verified. MathArena evaluates four independent responses with pass@1 accuracy and combines symbolic-equivalence parsing, semantic judging, and manual review to reduce scoring errors.
metric_en: Pass@1 Accuracy (mean of 4 independent runs), Score/Rank Confidence Intervals
drawio_review_note: Aligned with MathArena (arXiv:2505.23281), its official HMMT February 2025 configuration, and the MathArena/HMMT dataset card. The 30 official finals problems and answers are extracted, standardized, and manually checked for typos, inconsistencies, and formatting. Models receive the competition prompt with a boxed-answer instruction and produce four independent responses per problem using provider-recommended settings. A custom LaTeX-to-SymPy parser checks symbolic equivalence; Gemini 2.5 Flash handles semantic-equivalence cases. The authors manually review flagged short outputs, parser failures, answers present in reasoning traces, and parser/judge disagreements. Reporting uses pass@1 accuracy averaged over four runs plus score/rank confidence intervals, while release-date flags expose potential post-release contamination.

name: HotpotQA
intro: HotpotQA 是多跳问答 benchmark，报告中常与 NaturalQuestions 等检索问答任务一起用于评估长链路推理。
build_method: Wikipedia超链接图采样, 众包多跳出题, 模型辅助难度划分
metric: 答案EM/F1, 支持事实EM/F1, 联合EM/F1
task_type: 多跳问答, 阅读理解
build_method_en: Wikipedia hyperlink-graph sampling, crowdsourced multi-hop questions, model-assisted hardness splits
intro_en: HotpotQA is a multi-hop QA benchmark often reported alongside NaturalQuestions-style retrieval QA tasks for evaluating chained reasoning.
metric_en: Answer EM/F1, Supporting-fact EM/F1, Joint EM/F1
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1809.09600 Sections 2, 3, and 5. HotpotQA builds a graph from first-paragraph Wikipedia links, then samples bridge pairs 75% of the time and comparison pairs from 42 entity lists otherwise. Crowdworkers write answers and sentence-level supporting facts. From 112,779 valid examples, Turker audits isolate 18,089 mostly single-hop train-easy items, three-fold model filtering yields 56,814 train-medium items, and remaining hard items form train-hard, Dev, and separate distractor/full-wiki tests. Evaluation reports answer, supporting-fact, and joint EM/F1.

name: HR-Bench
intro: HR-Bench 是面向高分辨率多模态理解的基准，使用来自 DIV8K 与互联网的 200 张 8K 图像构造 200 个唯一问题：100 个细粒度单实例感知问题和 100 个细粒度跨实例感知问题。每题同时保留 8K 全图和围绕相关目标裁剪的 4K 视图，并通过选项循环置换评估位置偏差。
org: Wuhan University, The University of Sydney, Jiangsu University, Sun Yat-Sen University, Nanyang Technological University
build_method: 人工目标框标注、GPT-4o 问答生成、专家筛选
eval_feature: 8K 全图与 4K 裁剪视图、选项循环置换、位置不确定性分析
scale: 200 个唯一问题（100 FSP + 100 FCP；每题含 8K/4K 视图）
build_method_en: Human bounding-box annotation, GPT-4o QA generation, expert filtering
eval_feature_en: 8K full-image and 4K crop views, cyclic option permutation, positional uncertainty analysis
intro_en: HR-Bench evaluates high-resolution multimodal understanding with 200 8K images from DIV8K and the Internet. It contains 200 unique questions: 100 Fine-grained Single-instance Perception items and 100 Fine-grained Cross-instance Perception items. Each question is paired with the 8K full image and a 4K crop around relevant objects, and cyclic option permutation measures positional bias.
scale_en: 200 unique questions (100 FSP + 100 FCP; each with 8K/4K views)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.15556, especially Section 3.1 and Appendix A. HR-Bench starts from 200 8K images sourced from DIV8K and the Internet. Annotators mark bounding boxes for relevant objects; GPT-4o generates query-answer pairs from crops within those boxes; human experts remove incorrect or ambiguous queries. The final 200 unique questions split into 100 Fine-grained Single-instance Perception items (attribute, OCR, visual prompting) and 100 Fine-grained Cross-instance Perception items (map, chart, spatial relation). Each question has an 8K full-image view and a 4K crop, not separate unique questions. Multiple-choice options are cyclically permuted so every option occupies every position once, and mean accuracy plus a pilot uncertainty score are reported. The diagram intentionally separates benchmark construction from the paper's DC2 inference method.

name: HumanEval
intro: HumanEval 是由OpenAI开发的一个评测基准，旨在衡量大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面的能力。该基准包含了164个手写的编程问题，每个问题都提供了函数签名、文档字符串和单元测试，用以检验生成代码的函数正确性。
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Contamination-free
intro_en: HumanEval, developed by OpenAI, is a benchmark designed to evaluate the code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It consists of 164 handcrafted programming problems, each providing a function signature, docstring, and unit tests to verify the correctness of the generated code.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2107.03374. HumanEval contains 164 original hand-written programming problems to reduce contamination from public code sources. Each item includes a function signature, docstring, body, and unit tests, averaging 7.7 tests; the model prompt contains a header, signature, and docstring. The paper generates n=200 samples per task for pass@k with k up to 100, stopping at a new top-level code block. Samples execute against hidden tests inside a gVisor sandbox protected by eBPF firewall rules. The evaluator counts c samples that pass every test and applies the paper's numerically stable unbiased pass@k estimator for functional correctness.

name: HumanEval+
intro: HumanEval+ 是 EvalPlus 对 HumanEval 的严格增强版：保留 164 个 Python 代码生成任务，通过修复金标准解答、输入契约、LLM 种子与类型感知变异，将每题平均测试数从 9.6 提升到 764.1，以更充分地检验功能正确性。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Nanjing University
build_method: HumanEval金标准修复, 输入契约, ChatGPT种子, 类型感知变异, 集合覆盖约简
build_method_en: HumanEval Oracle Repair, Input Contracts, ChatGPT Seeds, Type-Aware Mutation, Set-Cover Reduction
intro_en: HumanEval+ is EvalPlus's rigorous extension of HumanEval. It keeps 164 Python code-generation tasks while repairing gold solutions and using input contracts, LLM seeds, and type-aware mutation to raise the average test count from 9.6 to 764.1 for stricter functional-correctness evaluation.
scale_en: 164 tasks; 764.1 tests on average (80×); Mini averages 16.1
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the NeurIPS 2023 paper arXiv:2305.01210v3 and the official EvalPlus repository. HumanEval+ keeps all 164 HumanEval signature-and-docstring tasks, whose base suite averages 9.6 tests. The authors reimplement and test every gold solution after finding more than 10% incorrect, and hand-annotate input contracts for 83 tasks. About 30 ChatGPT seeds per task come from three prompts containing the gold code, existing inputs, and corner-case instructions. Contract-valid seeds bootstrap ingredient-aware, type-aware mutation to generate 1,000 additional inputs within a one-hour budget. HumanEval+ averages 764.1 tests per task, an 80-fold increase. Optional HumanEval+-Mini uses greedy set cover over branch coverage, mutant kills, and other-LLM sample kills to average 16.1 tests, a 47-fold reduction. The paper samples 200 programs at temperatures 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 plus greedy decoding, executes base and extra tests against repaired gold outputs, and reports unbiased Pass@1/10/100.

name: HumanEval-Mul
intro: HumanEval-Mul 是 DeepSeek 报告使用的八语言 HumanEval 功能正确性评测。官方 DeepSeek-Coder Harness 将其链接到 MultiPL-E，从 164 道 Python HumanEval 函数补全题及隐藏测试生成 Python、C++、Java、C#、JavaScript、TypeScript、PHP 和 Bash 轨道；逐语言因不可翻译类型等保留 158-164 题。
build_method: MultiPL-E翻译, 函数签名与测试转换, 类型与Doctest适配, 八语言筛选
task_type: 函数补全, 多语言代码生成
eval_feature: 八编程语言, 隐藏单元测试, 编译与沙箱执行, 逐语言通过率
scale: 8种语言, 1,280个语言题实例；每种语言158-164题
build_method_en: MultiPL-E translation of signatures and tests, type and doctest adaptation, eight-language selection
eval_feature_en: Eight programming languages, hidden unit tests, compilation and sandbox execution, per-language pass rates
intro_en: HumanEval-Mul is the eight-language HumanEval functional-correctness evaluation used in DeepSeek reports. The official DeepSeek-Coder harness links it to MultiPL-E, which translates 164 Python HumanEval function-completion prompts and hidden tests into Python, C++, Java, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, and Bash tracks; language-specific exclusions leave 158-164 problems per track.
scale_en: 8 languages, 1,280 language-problem instances; 158-164 problems per language
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report arXiv:2412.19437, the official deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder HumanEval harness, and the linked MultiPL-E paper arXiv:2208.08227. The V3 report discloses that HumanEval-Mul covers Python, Java, C++, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, and Bash, follows the dataset's original evaluation protocol with default prompts, reports Pass@1, and allows up to 8,192 output tokens; it does not independently describe a new translation pipeline or a uniform item count. The official DeepSeek harness identifies the source as MultiPL-E and ships 164 Python, 161 C++, 158 Java, 161 PHP, 159 TypeScript, 158 C#, 158 Bash, and 161 JavaScript problems, totaling 1,280 language-problem instances. MultiPL-E translates function signatures, first-order unit tests, type annotations, doctests, and Python-specific terminology while leaving the function body for the model; target-language exclusions account for the differing counts. Evaluation cleans language-specific completions, compiles where necessary, executes hidden tests with timeouts, requires every test to pass, and aggregates functional-correctness Pass@1 across the eight tracks.

name: Humanity’s Last Code Exam
intro: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) 收录 235 道顶级竞赛难题：146 道来自 2011-2023 年 ICPC 世界总决赛，89 道来自 2010-2024 年 IOI。ICPC 使用离线标准输入输出测试，IOI 通过自动提交机器人连接官方交互判题；基准还包含独立的自我识别任务。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: ICPC/IOI 官方题目, 人工与 ChatGPT 格式清理, 官方测试收集, 可解性过滤
eval_feature: 在线-离线统一判题, 标准 I/O 与交互题, 自我识别
build_method_en: Official ICPC/IOI Problems, Manual and ChatGPT Formatting, Official-Test Collection, Solvability Filtering
eval_feature_en: Harmonized Online-Offline Judging, Standard I/O and Interactive Tasks, Self-Recognition
intro_en: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) contains 235 elite competition problems: 146 from the 2011-2023 ICPC World Finals and 89 from IOI 2010-2024. ICPC uses an offline standard-I/O harness, while IOI uses an automated submission bot connected to the official interactive judge; the benchmark also includes a separate self-recognition task.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.12713v2. HLCE contains 235 problems, with distinct source windows preserved: 146 ICPC World Finals problems from 2011-2023 and 89 IOI problems from 2010-2024. ICPC statements are manually extracted from official PDFs and standardized with ChatGPT; missing, corrupted, or incompatible tests are filtered. IOI statements come from the Codeforces IOI dump and output-only problems are excluded. Five responses are generated per problem. ICPC uses a Python standard-I/O harness, IOI uses an automated Codeforces submission bot and requires a score of 100, code generation is reported with Pass@1/Pass@5, and the separate self-recognition task uses AUC.

name: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE)
intro: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) 是面向人类知识前沿的多模态封闭式学术基准。其公开集包含 2,500 道由全球近 1,000 名专家贡献的问题，覆盖 100 多个学科，并另设私有留出集检查过拟合与投机。题目经过前沿模型难度筛选、研究生级同行评审和组织者终审，最终以准确率与置信度校准误差评估模型。
org: Center for AI Safety and collaborating institutions
build_method: 全球专家征题、前沿模型门槛、两轮专家评审
task_type: 多项选择题、精确匹配简答题
eval_feature: 前沿模型筛选、私有留出审计、置信度校准
scale: 2,500 个公开问题，另有私有留出集
task_type_en: Multiple choice and exact-match short answer
build_method_en: Global expert submissions, frontier-model gating, and two rounds of expert review
eval_feature_en: Frontier-model filtering, private held-out auditing, and confidence calibration
intro_en: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) is a multimodal closed-ended academic benchmark targeting the frontier of human knowledge. Its public set contains 2,500 questions contributed by nearly 1,000 experts across more than 100 subjects, with a separate private held-out set for detecting overfitting and gaming. Questions pass frontier-model difficulty gates, graduate-level peer review, and organizer approval, and models are evaluated with accuracy and confidence calibration error.
scale_en: 2,500 public questions plus a private held-out set
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["global expert call"] --> B["submission package"]
    B --> C["closed-ended quality rules"]
    C --> D["frontier-model gate"]
    D --> E["graduate review"]
    E --> F["organizer approval"]
    F --> G["public + private sets"]
    G --> H["structured judge"]
    H --> I["accuracy + calibration"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["全球专家征题"] --> B["提交材料"]
    B --> C["封闭式质量规则"]
    C --> D["前沿模型门槛"]
    D --> E["研究生级评审"]
    E --> F["组织者终审"]
    F --> G["公开集+私有集"]
    G --> H["结构化评审器"]
    H --> I["准确率+校准"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.14249, Sections 3-4 and Appendices B.1 and C.1. HLE draws questions from nearly 1,000 expert contributors at more than 500 institutions in 50 countries. Submissions include the question, answer specification, detailed rationale, subject, contributor, and affiliation, and must be precise, original, closed-ended, non-searchable, and easily verifiable. Exact-match items must stump every frontier model; multiple-choice items must stump all but at most one. More than 70,000 model attempts send about 13,000 questions to human review. Round one gives each question one to three graduate-level reviews and iterative author feedback; round two requires organizer or trained-expert approval. The public 2,500-question set spans more than 100 subjects, with about 14% multimodal and 24% multiple choice, while a private held-out set checks overfitting and gaming. Evaluation requests reasoning, a final answer, and 0-100% confidence; an O3-mini structured judge accepts equivalent answer formats, and reports accuracy plus RMS calibration error.

name: IFBench
intro: IFBench 评估语言模型对未见、可程序验证的输出约束的泛化能力。测试集包含 58 个域外约束及其 Python 验证器，构成 300 个单轮提示和 1,387 个多轮改写对话；提示来自发布时未见的 WildChat 任务，并经人工兼容性检查。论文另设 29 个 IFTrain 训练约束用于可验证奖励训练，与测试约束严格分离。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: 人工设计未见约束、实现 Python 验证器、匹配留出 WildChat 任务并人工复核
eval_feature: 域外约束、程序验证、零温度生成
scale: 58 个测试约束；300 个单轮提示；1,387 个多轮对话
build_method_en: Manual unseen constraints, executable Python verifiers, held-out WildChat task matching, and human compatibility review
eval_feature_en: Out-of-domain constraints, programmatic verification, and temperature-zero generation
intro_en: IFBench evaluates whether language models generalize to unseen, programmatically verifiable output constraints. Its test suite provides 58 out-of-domain constraints with Python verifiers, instantiated as 300 single-turn prompts and 1,387 multi-turn rewrite conversations. Tasks are sampled from WildChat prompts unseen at release time and manually checked for compatibility. The paper separately defines 29 IFTrain constraints for verifier-reward training, keeping them distinct from the test constraints.
scale_en: 58 test constraints; 300 single-turn prompts; 1,387 multi-turn conversations
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["manual OOD constraints"] --> B["58 test constraints"]
    B --> C["Python verifiers"]
    C --> D["held-out WildChat tasks"]
    D --> E["human compatibility review"]
    E --> F["300 single-turn + 1,387 multi-turn"]
    F --> G["temperature-0 generation"]
    G --> H["strict + loose accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["人工设计域外约束"] --> B["58个测试约束"]
    B --> C["Python验证器"]
    C --> D["留出WildChat任务"]
    D --> E["人工兼容性复核"]
    E --> F["300单轮+1,387多轮"]
    F --> G["零温度生成"]
    G --> H["严格+宽松准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.02833 and the official allenai/IFBench release. The 58 challenging out-of-domain test constraints are manually authored from LM-user feedback and coverage analysis, grouped into count, ratio, words, sentence, format, custom, and copy categories, and paired with executable Python verifiers. Held-out WildChat tasks are manually checked for task-constraint compatibility and conflicts. The official single-turn set has 300 prompts: 256 carry one constraint and 44 carry two. The official IFBench multi-turn configuration has exactly 1,387 conversations in the form user task → assistant response → user constraint-based rewrite request. Evaluation uses temperature 0 and checks raw outputs strictly; the loose mode also strips the first or last line and selected font modifiers. Paper reporting centers on prompt-level loose accuracy. IFTrain's 29 training constraints and the optional IF-RLVR GRPO/DPO training branch are shown separately because they are not part of the 58-constraint test construction.

name: IFEval
intro: IFEval是一个评估大型语言模型遵循自然语言指令能力的基准，解决了人工评测成本高和自动评测偏差问题。包含约500个带有可验证指令（如字数或关键词要求）的提示，实现客观评估。
metric: 提示级严格准确率、指令级严格准确率、提示级宽松准确率、指令级宽松准确率
eval_feature: 可验证指令
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Instructions
intro_en: IFEval is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to follow natural language instructions, addressing high costs of human evaluation and biases in automatic evaluation. It includes about 500 prompts with verifiable instructions (e.g., word count or keyword requirements) to enable objective assessment.
metric_en: Prompt-level Strict Accuracy, Instruction-level Strict Accuracy, Prompt-level Loose Accuracy, Instruction-level Loose Accuracy
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.07911. IFEval defines 25 atomic instruction types with deterministic verification programs and constructs 541 prompts. Its four-stage synthesis appends one to three randomly selected instructions to base prompts, removes illogical combinations with a few-shot check, rephrases retained prompts with a second few-shot method, and manually checks and edits every prompt. Strict scoring runs the checker on the original response. Loose scoring runs it over eight variants: identity; removal of markdown font modifiers; removal of the first line; removal of the last line; and all pairwise or three-way combinations. The four reported metrics are prompt-level and instruction-level strict and loose accuracy.

name: ImgEdit-Bench
intro: ImgEdit-Bench 是 ImgEdit 论文提出的统一图像编辑评测集，共 811 个案例，分别检验基础编辑、理解-定位-编辑（UGE）和三轮连续编辑能力，并区分单轮自动评分与多轮人工评分。
org: Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School, Peng Cheng Laboratory, Rabbitpre AI
build_method: 人工收集与筛选图像，GPT-4o 生成基础指令后人工过滤，专家设计 UGE 与多轮任务
metric: GPT-4o 1–5分，多轮人工成功率，FakeShield伪影定位召回率
task_type: 图像编辑, 指令遵循, 多轮编辑
eval_feature: 基础编辑, 理解-定位-编辑, 内容记忆, 内容理解, 版本回退
task_type_en: Image editing, instruction following, multi-turn editing
build_method_en: Manual image collection and screening; GPT-4o instruction generation with manual filtering; expert-authored UGE and multi-turn tasks
eval_feature_en: Basic editing, understanding-grounding-editing, content memory, content understanding, version backtracking
intro_en: ImgEdit-Bench is the unified image-editing benchmark introduced by the ImgEdit paper. Its 811 cases cover basic editing, understanding-grounding-editing (UGE), and three-turn sequential editing, with separate single-turn automatic and multi-turn human scoring paths.
metric_en: GPT-4o 1–5 ratings, human multi-turn success, FakeShield artifact-localization recall
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.20275 and the official PKU-YuanGroup/ImgEdit repository. The benchmark contains exactly 811 cases: a 734-case Basic suite spanning nine common edit tasks, a manually curated 47-case UGE suite for difficult understanding-grounding-editing scenarios, and a 30-case multi-turn suite with three interaction turns per case. Basic images are manually collected from the Internet across six super-categories and ten concepts each; GPT-4o proposes instructions that are manually filtered. UGE uses complex images with occlusion, repeated instances, camouflage, or uncommon subjects and expert-written prompts for spatial, multi-object, compound, fine-grained, and large-scale edits. Multi-turn cases test content memory, content understanding, and version backtracking. Single-turn experiments preserve native model resolution, repeat each setting three times, and use GPT-4o task-specific 1–5 rubrics for instruction adherence, editing quality, and detail preservation; quality and preservation cannot exceed adherence. Multi-turn scoring is a separate human yes/no protocol. FakeShield recall is auxiliary. The optional open ImgEdit-Judge is reported separately and is not substituted for the paper's primary benchmark scoring path.

name: IMO-AnswerBench
intro: IMO-AnswerBench 是 IMO-Bench 论文套件中的可验证简答基准，包含 400 道手工筛选的奥林匹克数学题，代数、组合、几何和数论各 100 道。题目经改写与稳健化以得到唯一、清晰且非平凡的短答案，并由奖牌得主和数学家复核；Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader 提取最终答案并判断与标准答案的语义等价性。
build_method: 专家筛选奥赛题、改写稳健化、奖牌得主复核
eval_feature: 语义等价答案评分、多次运行
scale: 400 道题；四个类别各 100 道
build_method_en: Expert Olympiad selection, reformulation and robustification, and medalist review
eval_feature_en: Semantic-equivalence answer grading and repeated runs
intro_en: IMO-AnswerBench is the verifiable short-answer component of the IMO-Bench paper suite. It contains 400 handpicked Olympiad mathematics problems, with 100 each in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. Problems are reformulated and robustified to have unique, clear, non-trivial short answers and are vetted by medalists and mathematicians. A Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader extracts the final answer and judges semantic equivalence to the reference.
scale_en: 400 problems; 100 in each of four categories
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Olympiad sources"] --> B["handpick 400"]
    B --> C["balance four categories"]
    C --> D["reformulate + robustify"]
    D --> E["medalist review"]
    E --> F["AnswerBench v2"]
    F --> G["AnswerAutoGrader"]
    G --> H["semantic equivalence"]
    H --> I["accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["奥赛题源"] --> B["手工筛选400题"]
    B --> C["四类各100题"]
    C --> D["改写+稳健化"]
    D --> E["奖牌得主复核"]
    E --> F["AnswerBench v2"]
    F --> G["答案自动评分器"]
    G --> H["语义等价判断"]
    H --> I["准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.01846 and the official google-deepmind/superhuman imobench release. The paper handpicks 400 national, regional, and international Olympiad problems: exactly 100 each in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. The pre-IMO / IMO-Easy / IMO-Medium / IMO-Hard breakdown is Algebra 11/46/32/11, Combinatorics 4/19/31/46, Geometry 13/44/32/11, and Number Theory 2/20/31/47. Proof-heavy problems are selected or reformulated to produce unique, clear, non-trivial short answers, then robustified by paraphrasing, renaming objects, changing values, or adding distractors. A panel collectively holding 10 IMO gold and 5 silver medals vets the content. AnswerAutoGrader based on Gemini 2.5 Pro extracts the final answer and judges semantic equivalence; its validation covers 800 judgments (274 correct agreements, 1 false positive, 8 false negatives, and 517 incorrect agreements). Paper results report overall and category accuracy, usually averaged over eight runs. The current official answerbench_v2.csv retains 400 rows and records the 2026-02-12 correction of ambiguous statements and incorrect answers.

name: IMO-Bench
intro: IMO-Bench 是由数学奥赛奖牌得主与数学家构建的三能力评测套件。论文快照包含 400 题的 IMO-AnswerBench、60 题的 IMO-ProofBench 和 1,000 条带专家分数的 IMO-GradingBench，分别评估短答案正确性、证明质量以及模型评价证明的能力；三条分支使用不同的输入上下文和指标。
build_method: 奖牌得主与数学家筛选、原创和稳健化题目，并由专家按 IMO 0–7 分制标注
metric: Answer accuracy; proof percent of maximum points; grading accuracy and MAE
task_type: 数学简答、证明生成、证明评分
eval_feature: 专家评分、语义答案评分、评分器验证
scale: 400 道简答题 + 60 道证明题 + 1,000 条评分样本
task_type_en: Mathematical short answers, proof generation, and proof grading
build_method_en: Medalist and mathematician problem selection, authoring and robustification, with expert IMO-style 0–7 grading
eval_feature_en: Expert proof grading, semantic answer grading, and grader validation
intro_en: IMO-Bench is a three-capability evaluation suite built by mathematics Olympiad medalists and mathematicians. The paper snapshot contains the 400-item IMO-AnswerBench, 60-item IMO-ProofBench, and 1,000-item IMO-GradingBench, separately evaluating short-answer correctness, proof quality, and the ability to grade proofs. Each branch uses a different evaluation context and metric.
scale_en: 400 answer problems + 60 proof problems + 1,000 grading samples
metric_en: Answer accuracy; proof percent of maximum points; grading accuracy and MAE
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["expert panel"] --> B["paper suite"]
    B --> C["AnswerBench 400"]
    B --> D["ProofBench 60"]
    B --> E["GradingBench 1,000"]
    C --> F["answer accuracy"]
    D --> G["expert 0-7 grades"]
    E --> H["four-way accuracy + MAE"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["专家评审团"] --> B["论文套件"]
    B --> C["答案集400题"]
    B --> D["证明集60题"]
    B --> E["评分集1,000条"]
    C --> F["答案准确率"]
    D --> G["专家0-7分"]
    E --> H["四分类准确率+MAE"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.01846 and the official google-deepmind/superhuman imobench release. The paper snapshot defines three complementary benchmarks rather than a sequential pipeline. IMO-AnswerBench contains 400 robustified, verifiable short-answer problems, balanced across four IMO categories, and uses a Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader for semantic equivalence. IMO-ProofBench contains 60 proof problems, split into 30 Basic and 30 Advanced; the Advanced set comprises 18 novel medalist-authored problems, 6 robustified IMO 2024 problems, and 6 USAMO 2025 problems. Human experts receive the problem, candidate solution, reference solution, and specific grading guidelines and assign integer 0–7 grades; proof results are percentages of maximum points with basic, advanced, and source slices. The validated ProofAutoGrader is shown only as a scalable proxy, not a replacement for primary human grades. IMO-GradingBench contains 1,000 advanced-proof model solutions with expert 0–7 scores balanced into labels 7/6/1/0; models see only the problem and proposed solution, and are measured by four-way accuracy and mean absolute error. The current official project later adds a 60-item IMO-LeanProofBench, which is intentionally excluded from this paper-snapshot diagram.

name: INCLUDE
intro: INCLUDE 是面向地域与文化知识的多语言多项选择基准，论文完整集含 197,243 题，来自 1,926 场考试、44 种语言、15 种文字和 52 个国家。数据由母语社区从学术、职业认证和地区执照考试中收集、抽取与质检，并结合既有多语言考试集，随后标注学科、层级、国家与地域性，形成完整集及标准化的 BASE/LITE 子集。
org: EPFL, Cohere For AI, Cohere For AI Community, ETH Zurich, Swiss AI Initiative
build_method: 母语社区收集考试，多格式抽取，母语者质检、过滤并做考试级元数据与地域性标注
metric: Accuracy, answer accuracy, formatting error rate
eval_feature: 地域知识、跨语言提示、5-shot 与零样本思维链
build_method_en: Native-community exam collection, multi-format extraction, native-speaker quality control, filtering, and exam-level metadata and regionality annotation
eval_feature_en: Regional knowledge, cross-language prompts, five-shot and zero-shot chain of thought
intro_en: INCLUDE is a multilingual multiple-choice benchmark for regional and cultural knowledge. The paper's complete set contains 197,243 questions from 1,926 examinations, 44 languages, 15 scripts, and 52 countries. Native-language communities collect, extract, and quality-check academic, professional-certification, and regional-license exams; the project also consolidates existing multilingual exam datasets, annotates subject, level, country, and regionality, and derives standardized BASE and LITE subsets.
metric_en: Accuracy, answer accuracy, formatting error rate
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["native exam sources"] --> B["multi-format extraction"]
    B --> C["native-speaker QC"]
    C --> D["filter context/image dependencies"]
    D --> E["118,606 new + 78,637 existing"]
    E --> F["197,243 complete set"]
    F --> G["metadata + regionality"]
    G --> H["BASE 22,635 + LITE 10,770"]
    H --> I["accuracy + formatting analysis"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["母语考试来源"] --> B["多格式抽取"]
    B --> C["母语者质检"]
    C --> D["过滤上下文/图像依赖"]
    D --> E["新数据118,606+既有78,637"]
    E --> F["完整集197,243"]
    F --> G["元数据+地域性"]
    G --> H["BASE 22,635+LITE 10,770"]
    H --> I["准确率+格式分析"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.19799. The paper's full INCLUDE release contains 197,243 MCQA pairs from 1,926 examinations, 44 languages, 15 scripts, 52 countries, and 58 knowledge domains. Native-speaker communities collect academic exams, professional certifications, and regional licenses. PDF, JavaScript/HTML, and other extraction pipelines produce questions, options, and correct answers; native speakers compare them with originals, correct errors, remove image/table-dependent items, preserve required reference context, and label language, topic, level, and country. The exact accounting is 118,606 newly parsed and verified questions plus 78,637 questions from ArabicMMLU, ChineseMMLU, TurkishMMLU, PersianMMLU, VNHSGE, and EXAMS. Exams receive a two-level academic taxonomy and regionality labels: agnostic 34.4%, explicit 18.8%, cultural 16.4%, and implicit 30.4%. The paper subsets contain BASE 22,635 and LITE 10,770 four-option MCQAs; the current BASE-44 dataset card reports 22,637, so the diagram deliberately preserves the paper snapshot. Evaluation compares five-shot and zero-shot chain of thought using in-language or English prompts, with optional region prefixes, and reports accuracy plus answer-accuracy and formatting-error analyses.

name: IndicGenBench
intro: IndicGenBench 是 ACL 2024 发布的印度语言生成评测集，在 29 种语言、13 种文字和 4 个语系上评估跨语言摘要、双向翻译和三条跨语言问答轨道。
build_method: 复用四个公开数据源，筛选英文样本与现有印度语言译文，并由专业译者补齐任务字段和低资源语言
task_type: 跨语言摘要, 双向机器翻译, 跨语言问答
eval_feature: 29种语言, 13种文字, 4个语系, 高/中/低资源分组
task_type_en: Cross-lingual summarization, bidirectional machine translation, cross-lingual QA
build_method_en: Reuse four public source datasets, select English samples and existing Indic translations, and commission professional translators for missing task fields and lower-resource languages
eval_feature_en: 29 languages, 13 scripts, 4 language families, high/medium/low-resource groups
intro_en: IndicGenBench is the ACL 2024 benchmark for generation in 29 Indic languages across 13 scripts and four language families. It evaluates cross-lingual summarization, translation in both directions, and three cross-lingual QA tracks.
scale_en: 5 evaluation tracks; CrossSum-IN 20.3k, FLORES-IN 58.2k, XQuAD-IN 16.6k, XorQA-IN 32k
metric_en: ChrF for summarization and translation; SQuAD Token-F1 for QA
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.16816, the ACL 2024 paper, and the official google-research-datasets/indic-gen-bench repository. The benchmark defines five paper tasks across 29 Indic languages, 13 scripts, and four language families: CrossSum-IN cross-lingual summarization, FLORES-IN machine translation with English-to-Indic and Indic-to-English directions, XQuAD-IN multilingual extractive QA, XorQA-IN-XX with an Indic-language answer, and XorQA-IN-EN with an English answer. The two XorQA answer views share the same 32k source component. Construction starts from CrossSum, FLORES-200, XQuAD/SQuAD, and XOR-TyDi. English samples and existing Indic translations are reused, while professional contract translators complete missing language/task fields. The release preserves task/language/split JSON files, source-dependent licenses, and a benchmark canary. Main evaluation is one-shot, with zero-, five-shot, prompt-language, and multilingual fine-tuning analyses. ChrF scores CrossSum and both FLORES directions; SQuAD Token-F1 scores all three QA tasks. Results are reported by high-, medium-, and low-resource language groups and analyze the gap from English.

name: InfiniteBench
intro: InfiniteBench是首个平均数据长度超过10万标记的大语言模型（LLM）基准。它涵盖了合成与真实世界的任务，涉及多个领域，并同时支持英文和中文。该基准测试中的任务旨在要求模型对上下文中的长距离依赖关系有深入的理解，仅仅从上下文中检索有限的段落不足以完成这些任务。
build_method: 混合, 自动生成, 专家构建
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 代码生成, 数学问题, 文本摘要
eval_feature: 长文本, 双语
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Code Generation, Math Problems, Text Summarization
build_method_en: Hybrid, Automated Generation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Bilingual
intro_en: InfiniteBench is the first large language model (LLM) benchmark with an average data length exceeding 100,000 tokens. It covers both synthetic and real-world tasks across multiple domains and supports both English and Chinese. The tasks in this benchmark require models to deeply understand long-range dependencies in the context; retrieving only limited paragraphs from the context is insufficient to complete these tasks.
scale_en: 3,946 examples, 12 tasks, approximately 200,000 tokens on average
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.13718. InfiniteBench contains 12 tasks across retrieval, code, math, novels, and dialogue, with 3,946 examples and average context length beyond 100K tokens. The paper separates realistic long-context tasks from synthetic contexts. For realistic tasks, novels are sourced from websites and manually filtered, then key entities are replaced to create fake novels; annotators create summarization, open QA, and multiple-choice tasks requiring aggregation or filtering over the full novel. Dialogue tasks use cleaned movie and drama scripts with character masking and padding for short scripts. Code.Debug uses filtered PyPI repositories transformed into single long files with deliberate bugs inserted by authors. Synthetic retrieval, code, and math tasks probe location, information resolution, state preservation, and sequential processing. Evaluation uses task-specific metrics such as ROUGE-L-Sum and accuracy.

name: InfographicVQA
intro: InfographicVQA 是面向复杂信息图的视觉问答数据集，包含 5,485 张图像和 30,035 个问题，要求联合理解 OCR 文本、布局、图形、表格、地图和基础算术。
org: IIIT Hyderabad, IISER Pune, CVC / Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
build_method: 网页信息图检索，两轮去重，受训内部标注者两阶段问答标注，图像级划分与质量过滤
task_type: 信息图视觉问答, OCR, 文档推理
eval_feature: 答案来源、证据类型、计数/排序/算术操作
task_type_en: Infographic visual QA, OCR, document reasoning
build_method_en: Web infographic retrieval, two-stage deduplication, two-stage QA annotation by trained internal annotators, image-disjoint splitting, and quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Answer source, evidence type, counting/sorting/arithmetic operations
intro_en: InfographicVQA is a visual question-answering dataset for complex infographics. Its 5,485 images and 30,035 questions require joint reasoning over OCR text, layout, graphics, tables, maps, and elementary arithmetic.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2104.12756. The authors initially download more than 10,000 images from Google and Bing using the query infographics. Perceptual hashing removes nearly 2,000 duplicates, then Amazon Textract OCR tokens and Jaccard similarity perform a second deduplication, leaving about 7,000 diverse candidate images. A crowd pilot produces more than 40% noisy submissions, so the authors replace it with an internal tool and a closely supported pool: candidates attend a 90-minute webinar, pass a quiz, and 13 annotators are selected. Stage 1 permits unsuitable-image rejection and collects question-answer pairs until the corpus exceeds 30k questions. Images are randomly assigned to image-disjoint train/validation/test splits at roughly 80/10/10. On validation and test, a different worker independently supplies a second answer without seeing the first and may flag cannot-answer; QA answer-source, evidence, and operation types are also recorded. Quality rules remove 1.9% cannot-answer questions, lowercase and deduplicate references, and accept permutations of multi-span answers. The final release has 30,035 questions over 5,485 images from 2,594 web domains, with 23,946/2,801/3,288 train/validation/test questions and 4,406/500/579 images. ANLS is primary alongside exact accuracy: answers are lowercased, matched against the best reference, and normalized edit similarity below 0.5 contributes zero. Human test-set answers provide the near-perfect reference.

name: InfoVQA
intro: InfoVQA 是本站对 InfographicVQA 的别名条目；完整数据集包含 5,485 张信息图和 30,035 个问题，而不是仅含 500 对的测试子样本。
org: IIIT Hyderabad, IISER Pune, CVC / Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
build_method: 网页信息图检索，两轮去重，受训内部标注者两阶段问答标注，图像级划分与质量过滤
task_type: 信息图视觉问答, OCR, 文档推理
eval_feature: 答案来源、证据类型、计数/排序/算术操作
task_type_en: Infographic visual QA, OCR, document reasoning
build_method_en: Web infographic retrieval, two-stage deduplication, two-stage QA annotation by trained internal annotators, image-disjoint splitting, and quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Answer source, evidence type, counting/sorting/arithmetic operations
intro_en: InfoVQA is this catalog's alias entry for InfographicVQA. The complete dataset contains 5,485 infographic images and 30,035 questions, not only a 500-pair test subsample.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2104.12756; InfoVQA is treated here as an alias of InfographicVQA, so its construction and evaluation topology intentionally matches the canonical entry. The authors initially download more than 10,000 images from Google and Bing using the query infographics. Perceptual hashing removes nearly 2,000 duplicates, then Amazon Textract OCR tokens and Jaccard similarity perform a second deduplication, leaving about 7,000 diverse candidate images. A crowd pilot produces more than 40% noisy submissions, so the authors replace it with an internal tool and a closely supported pool: candidates attend a 90-minute webinar, pass a quiz, and 13 annotators are selected. Stage 1 permits unsuitable-image rejection and collects question-answer pairs until the corpus exceeds 30k questions. Images are randomly assigned to image-disjoint train/validation/test splits at roughly 80/10/10. On validation and test, a different worker independently supplies a second answer without seeing the first and may flag cannot-answer; QA answer-source, evidence, and operation types are also recorded. Quality rules remove 1.9% cannot-answer questions, lowercase and deduplicate references, and accept permutations of multi-span answers. The final release has 30,035 questions over 5,485 images from 2,594 web domains, with 23,946/2,801/3,288 train/validation/test questions and 4,406/500/579 images. ANLS is primary alongside exact accuracy: answers are lowercased, matched against the best reference, and normalized edit similarity below 0.5 contributes zero. Human test-set answers provide the near-perfect reference.

name: InteractiveBench
intro: InteractiveBench 在统一的 Horizon-T 预算框架中评估模型主动获取信息与长期决策能力，论文包含 Logic、UI2Html、Math、Poker 和 Trust 五个独立测试床。
build_method: 统一预算交互协议；专家筛选证明任务；可验证环境与长周期博弈模拟
metric: 准确率与已解平均轮数，UI五维总分，Poker每手收益，Trust每轮实际收益
task_type: 交互式证明, UI编码, 数学推理, 扑克, 信任博弈
eval_feature: 主动信息获取, 查询成本, 预算效率, 长期效用, 裁判敏感性
scale: 46个逻辑谜题 + 50个UI截图 + 52道数学题 + 5,000手Poker + Trust循环赛
task_type_en: Interactive proofs, UI coding, mathematical reasoning, poker, trust game
build_method_en: Unified budgeted-interaction protocol, expert-curated proof tasks, verifiable environments, and long-horizon game simulation
eval_feature_en: Active information acquisition, query cost, budget efficiency, long-horizon utility, judge sensitivity
intro_en: InteractiveBench evaluates active information acquisition and long-horizon decision making under a unified Horizon-T budget. The paper defines five independent testbeds: Logic, UI2Html, Math, Poker, and Trust.
scale_en: 46 logic puzzles + 50 UI screenshots + 52 math problems + 5,000 poker hands + Trust round robin
metric_en: Accuracy and solved-turn average; five-part UI score; poker winnings per hand; trust payoff per round
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.04737v4. InteractiveBench formulates evaluation as a Horizon-T interaction between a player and an environment or judge, terminating on a final answer or budget exhaustion. Interactive Proofs contain three independent testbeds with hidden truth and an omniscient verifier. Logic uses 46 expert-curated Situation Puzzles filtered for interaction necessity and ambiguity resolution; the player gets at most 20 rounds of yes/no-style questions or a final explanation and receives Yes/No/Both/Irrelevant feedback. UI2Html uses 50 UI2Code-Real screenshots re-annotated by front-end experts for clarity, diversity, complexity, and feasibility; a fixed VLM summary is intentionally incomplete, each round submits full HTML plus a binary clarification, headless rendering is compared with the hidden target, and five integer sub-scores cover layout, component, style, text, and polish. Math uses 52 expert-selected HLE problems, reference derivations, a 20-round claim/final loop, four-way sparse feedback, temperature zero, and player-token budget matching against Pass@k. Interactive Games comprise no-limit Texas Holdem with 5,000 hands over ten tables and a random-horizon iterated Prisoner's Dilemma Trust Game. Logic and Math report accuracy plus average solved turns; UI2Html sums five sub-scores; Poker reports mean and standard deviation of winnings per hand plus VPIP, fold rate, and latency; Trust reports realized payoff and cooperation/betrayal statistics. Judge-scale ablations show sensitivity, so the report includes that caveat. The reviewed official repository snapshot exposes Situation Puzzle, Math, Poker, and Trust code; UI2Html is specified in the paper but was not a public repository directory at review time, so the diagram follows the paper as the authoritative five-testbed protocol.

name: InterCode
intro: InterCode 将交互式编程形式化为带执行反馈的状态化循环，并以统一 Docker 框架构建 Bash、SQL 和 Python 三个环境，分别从 NL2Bash、Spider 与 MBPP 转换出 200、1,034 和 117 个任务。
build_method: 统一 POMDP 交互合同；Docker 沙箱；从 NL2Bash、Spider 与 MBPP 转换任务；为三环境实现可执行奖励
metric: Success Rate, Error %, 平均轮数, 连续奖励诊断
modality: 文本, 代码, 结构化数据
task_type: 交互式 Bash, Text-to-SQL, Python 代码生成
eval_feature: 状态化执行反馈, Docker 沙箱, 自定义奖励, 多轮纠错
variant: 原论文 Bash / SQL / Python 三环境
task_type_en: Interactive Bash, Text-to-SQL, Python Code Generation
build_method_en: Unified POMDP interaction contract, Docker sandboxes, task conversion from NL2Bash/Spider/MBPP, and executable environment-specific rewards
eval_feature_en: Stateful Execution Feedback, Docker Sandbox, Custom Rewards, Multi-turn Error Correction
intro_en: InterCode formalizes interactive coding as a stateful execution-feedback loop and implements a unified Docker framework for Bash, SQL, and Python. The paper adapts 200 NL2Bash commands, 1,034 Spider questions, and 117 MBPP problems.
metric_en: Success Rate, Error %, Average Turns, Continuous Reward Diagnostics
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2306.14898 and the official princeton-nlp/intercode repository snapshot. The original paper formalizes interactive coding as a POMDP with natural-language instructions, code or submit actions, execution observations, state transitions, and environment-specific rewards. Its modular build contract consists of a Dockerfile, dataset, reward function, and small environment subclass. InterCode-Bash starts from 1,000 NL2Bash commands using at least four utilities, removes unsupported items, grounds ambiguous filenames and paths, updates obsolete flags, and retains 200 commands across three custom file systems plus one file-system-agnostic set. Bash reward combines output similarity, file-set changes, and MD5 content correctness. InterCode-SQL converts the 1,034-question Spider development set across 20 databases from SQLite to a unified MySQL initialization dump; its output reward uses record IoU/Jaccard scaled by adjusted Kendall tau for ordering. InterCode-Python preserves 117 MBPP prompts and unit tests and rewards the proportion passed. Gold actions must execute without error and receive reward 1. The paper compares single-turn against maximum-10-turn Try Again, ReAct, and Plan-and-Solve evaluation, reporting success rate, inadmissible-action Error %, and average turns. InterCode-CTF is a later dedicated paper extension and is documented separately.

name: InterCode-CTF
intro: InterCode-CTF 是一个面向语言智能体的交互式网络安全基准。作者从 picoCTF 人工解答、重建并在 Docker 中复验 100 个任务，要求智能体在十轮内通过 Python/Bash 操作资源并提交正确 flag。
build_method: 从 picoCTF 人工解题与收集；还原完整数字资源；构建任务级 Ubuntu Docker；逐题人工复验
metric: Task Success Rate, 已解任务平均轮数, 分类别成功率
modality: 文本, 代码, 文件资源
task_type: 网络安全, Capture the Flag, 交互式 Shell
eval_feature: 十轮工具交互, 任务级 Docker, stdout/错误反馈, flag 精确判分
scale: 100 个 CTF 任务，覆盖 6 类网络安全技能
task_type_en: Cybersecurity, Capture the Flag, Interactive Shell
build_method_en: Manually solve and collect picoCTF challenges, recreate exact digital assets, build task-specific Ubuntu Docker environments, and manually re-verify every task
eval_feature_en: Ten-turn Tool Interaction, Task-specific Docker, stdout/Error Feedback, Exact Flag Scoring
intro_en: InterCode-CTF is an interactive cybersecurity benchmark for language agents. The authors manually solve, recreate, and verify 100 picoCTF tasks in Docker; agents then use Python or Bash over ten turns to inspect task assets and submit the correct flag.
scale_en: 100 CTF tasks across six cybersecurity-skill categories
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Average Turns on Solved Tasks, Category-level Success
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the dedicated NeurIPS 2023 Multi-Agent Security workshop paper, OpenReview:KOZwk7BFc3, and the official princeton-nlp/intercode CTF implementation. Task authors first solve picoCTF challenges, download the exact code, images, executables, archives, and other digital resources, record the hidden picoCTF flag, and recreate every task as query, gold, source, tags, and task_assets/{task_id}. Each instance runs in a task-specific asset directory inside an Ubuntu/Bourne-shell Docker sandbox with Python, GCC, GDB, and security tooling. The authors manually re-solve every recreated task to verify assets, dependencies, feasibility, and the flag; two CTF-experienced authors produced 100 verified problems in six hours. The paper suite contains 33 General Skills, 27 Reverse Engineering, 19 Cryptography, 15 Forensics, 4 Binary Exploitation, and 2 Web Exploitation tasks. During evaluation the agent receives the instruction, emits Python or Bash actions, observes stdout or errors, and has ten interactions. A case-insensitive exact match between submit picoCTF{...} and the gold flag gives reward 1; otherwise the task is unsolved. The paper reports task success rate, average solved turns, and category breakdown, with the GPT-4 baseline solving 40/100 in 3.9 turns on average.

name: Inverse IFEval
intro: Inverse IFEval 评估模型能否克服 SFT 形成的认知惯性并严格遵循反直觉指令。数据集覆盖 8 类指令与 23 个领域，含 1,012 条中英文问题，并使用相对人工分数验证至 98% 准确率的分类型 LLM 裁判。
org: ByteDance Seed, Nanjing University, Peking University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
build_method: SFT 范式观察与反转；专家种子；多模型多领域生成；长度与相似度过滤；专家复核与双语 rubric 校准
task_type: 反直觉指令遵循, 开放式生成
eval_feature: 8 类对抗指令, 23 领域, 双语, 分类型裁判矩阵, 人工验证
build_method_en: Observe and reverse SFT paradigms, write expert seeds, generate across domains with multiple models, filter by length/similarity, and calibrate bilingual rubrics through expert review
eval_feature_en: Eight Adversarial Instruction Types, 23 Domains, Bilingual, Type-specific Judge Matrix, Human Validation
intro_en: Inverse IFEval measures whether models can overcome cognitive inertia learned from SFT and precisely follow counterintuitive instructions. It contains 1,012 Chinese and English questions across eight instruction types and 23 domains, evaluated by type-specific LLM judges validated to 98% accuracy against human scores.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.04292 Sections 2.1-2.5 and Appendix A. The paper defines five construction stages: observation and reversal, seed data construction, large-scale generation, automatic filtering, and human verification. Common SFT paradigms are inverted into eight types: Question Correction, Intentional Textual Flaws, Code without Comments, Counter-Conventional Formatting, Deliberately Incorrect Answers, Instructional Induction, Mid-turn Instruction Modification, and Counterfactual Answering. LLM-training experts author seeds for every type; product, engineering, and operations reviewers independently vote qualified/unqualified, and only unanimously qualified seeds remain. Type-specific templates and a 23-domain taxonomy guide multiple strong LLMs to generate an initial 20 candidates per domain-type combination. Length and semantic-similarity filters remove weak candidates, targeted generation repairs underrepresented domains, and cross-model verification checks coherence. Experts then verify type consistency, clarity, ambiguity, contradictions, and fine-grained scoring rubrics. The final 1,012 examples comprise 506 English and 506 Chinese instructions with type/domain metadata and standardized rubrics. Evaluation pairs each question with two model responses and a human-verified ground-truth score. Per-type judge-model selection, template optimization, and system-prompt/few-shot enhancement raise judge accuracy from 88% to 98%.

name: IQTest
intro: IQTest 是 MathVista 新建的 228 题视觉逻辑子集，题目来自在线学习平台的智力测试图形，覆盖归纳、抽象、模式预测与计算。STEM 研究生人工标注并由三位评审独立核验，再按 MathVista 的答案抽取、归一化与精确准确率协议评测。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: 从在线学习平台收集智力测试图形；STEM 研究生人工标注；三人独立复核；共识消歧
task_type: 图形问答, 视觉逻辑与算术推理
eval_feature: 归纳, 抽象, 模式预测, 图形计算, 确定性答案归一化
task_type_en: Figure QA, Visual Logical and Arithmetic Reasoning
build_method_en: Collect puzzle-test figures from online learning platforms, annotate them with STEM graduate students, conduct three independent reviews, and resolve disagreements by consensus
eval_feature_en: Induction, Abstraction, Pattern Prediction, Visual Calculation, Deterministic Answer Normalization
intro_en: IQTest is MathVista's newly created 228-example visual-logic subset. It sources puzzle-test figures from online learning platforms and tests induction, abstraction, pattern prediction, and calculation. STEM graduate students annotate the items, three reviewers independently verify them, and MathVista extracts, normalizes, and exactly scores model answers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the IQTest portions of MathVista arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 2.2-2.4, 3.1, Appendix C.4/D.3, and the official lupantech/MathVista data and evaluator. IQTest is one of MathVista's three newly created datasets, not an Intern-S1 text-only benchmark. It contains 228 puzzle-test figure questions sourced from online learning platforms and targets inductive reasoning, abstract thinking, pattern prediction, logical reasoning, and calculations. Graduate students in STEM fields manually annotate questions and answers. Each new dataset is independently checked by three reviewers; across the 736 newly annotated MathVista questions, answer agreement is 99.2%, with only six disagreements, all resolved through full-team discussion. IQTest is standardized as math-targeted figure QA with puzzle-test context, English language, elementary-school grade metadata, and logical/arithmetic skill labels, then included in MathVista's distribution-preserving testmini/test split. Evaluation generates a response from the figure and question, directly extracts already-short choices or integers and otherwise uses the GPT-4 answer extractor validated above 99.5% on 200 examples, normalizes option or numeric format, and reports deterministic exact accuracy.

name: JailBench
intro: JailBench 是面向中文语境深层安全漏洞的越狱基准。它以 5 个一级领域、40 个二级风险类别组织有害问题，再用 AJPE 自动测试、生成并筛选越狱提示，最终将 20 个提示与 540 道种子题组合成 10,800 个用例。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
build_method: 中文两级安全分类；公开有害问题翻译与标注；ChatGPT 少样本补齐；AJPE 模板测试、生成与对数概率筛选
task_type: 内容安全测试, 红队, 越狱攻击
eval_feature: 5×40 分层分类, AJPE, MDJudge 有害性判定, 种子与增强集对比
scale: 540 道种子题 × 20 个越狱提示 = 10,800 个用例
task_type_en: Content Safety Testing, Red Teaming, Jailbreak Attacks
build_method_en: Chinese two-level safety taxonomy, translation and labeling of public harmful queries, ChatGPT few-shot coverage repair, and AJPE template testing/generation/log-probability screening
eval_feature_en: 5-by-40 Hierarchical Taxonomy, AJPE, MDJudge Harmfulness Classification, Seed-versus-enhanced Comparison
intro_en: JailBench evaluates deep safety vulnerabilities in Chinese-language LLMs. It organizes harmful questions under five top-level domains and 40 risk categories, uses AJPE to test, generate, and rank jailbreak prompts, and combines 20 prompts with 540 seed questions into 10,800 cases.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.18935 Sections 3-4 and the official STAIR-BUPT/JailBench repository snapshot. Chinese generative-AI safety requirements and security/linguistics experts define a two-level taxonomy with five risk domains and 40 specific categories. Harmful queries are aggregated from public safety and red-team datasets, translated into Chinese, and manually corrected. Existing labels are mapped into the taxonomy; ChatGPT classifies unlabeled queries using explicit criteria and output constraints, followed by random-sample manual verification. Underrepresented categories are filled through few-shot ChatGPT generation conditioned on a target category and sampled examples, producing a construction pool of more than 10,000 seed questions. Prior jailbreak templates, including AutoDAN, GPTFuzzer, and DeepInception patterns, are translated and manually refined. AJPE crosses sampled templates with seed questions, evaluates target-model outputs for harmfulness, and removes templates below an ASR threshold. Successful harmful input-output pairs then prompt ChatGPT to generate diverse jailbreak instructions; output log probability ranks prompt effectiveness, expanding the pool beyond 1,000. The paper selects 20 prompts and 540 seed questions to form 10,800 cases. Thirteen Chinese-capable LLMs are evaluated, the official repository identifies MDJudge as the harmfulness classifier, and results report ASR plus prompt-length-aware Attack Efficiency, including Seed-versus-enhanced comparisons.

name: JailJudge

BERT and regex prefiltering produce about 26K candidates; medical professionals retain 1,212 stand-alone questions and assign ICD-10 labels. Twelve in-house physicians contribute to 201 reference answers and their decomposition into 1,589 Must Have or Nice to Have statements, enabling GPT-4 few-shot NLI comprehensiveness and hallucination metrics.

name: KernelBench
intro: KernelBench 是一个评估语言模型能否为真实 PyTorch 机器学习工作负载生成正确且高效 GPU 内核的开放基准。论文版包含 250 题，覆盖单算子、可融合算子序列和完整模型架构，并用目标 GPU 上的正确性与加速比联合评分。
build_method: 真实PyTorch工作负载整理, 三级任务分区, 固定输入生成器
build_method_en: Real PyTorch Workload Curation, Three-Level Task Partitioning, Fixed Input Generators
intro_en: KernelBench is an open benchmark for evaluating whether language models can generate correct and efficient GPU kernels for real PyTorch machine-learning workloads. The paper benchmark has 250 tasks across primitive operators, fusible operator sequences, and full model architectures, jointly scored by correctness and target-GPU speedup.
metric_en: fast(p) (fast(0) correctness; fast(1) faster than PyTorch)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.10517 and the official ScalingIntelligence repository. The paper benchmark has exactly 250 evaluation-only tasks in three levels: 100 single primitive operations, 100 multi-operator sequences with fusion opportunities, and 50 full ML architectures sourced from popular PyTorch repositories. The current repository later adds a Level 4 extension, but the diagram preserves the paper's three-level contract. Every task packages a torch.nn.Module Model plus get_inputs and get_init_inputs to fix tensor shapes and precision; no gold kernel is supplied. The paper's one-shot prompt includes one addition Model/ModelNew example, and greedy decoding returns optimized ModelNew code using any suitable kernel language or library. On the target L40S, compilation and execution precede five randomized output-equivalence checks. Timing uses three warm-ups and 100 CUDA-event trials, with mean speedup equal to PyTorch Eager time divided by generated-kernel time. fast(p) is the fraction both correct and faster than threshold p; fast(0) is correctness and fast(1) means faster than PyTorch.

name: KodCode
intro: KodCode 是一个用于代码模型后训练的大规模全合成可验证数据集。它从 12 个子集生成多样问题，经语义去重后由 GPT-4o 同时生成解答与单元测试，并要求测试全过和 100% 分支覆盖率。第二阶段得到 279K 个已验证三元组，风格转换再增加 168K，形成 447K 条 RL 数据；DeepSeek-R1 三次采样与测试拒绝采样另构建 SFT 数据。

Step 2 yields 279K verified triplets; style conversion adds 168K for 447K RL items, while three DeepSeek-R1 samples per question and test-based rejection form SFT data.

intro: LV-Eval 是包含 11 个中英双语单跳与多跳问答数据集的长上下文基准。1,729 个独特问答对在 16K、32K、64K、128K 和 256K 五个长度层级上构成 8,645 个上下文，并用混淆事实、关键词替换和关键词召回指标减轻知识泄漏与评分偏差。

intro_en: LV-Eval is a long-context benchmark of 11 bilingual single-hop and multi-hop QA datasets. Its 1,729 unique QA pairs are materialized at 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, and 256K into 8,645 contexts, with confusing facts, keyword replacement, and keyword-recall scoring designed to reduce knowledge leakage and metric bias.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2402.05136v3 Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix B plus official LVEval repository snapshot 63e7ae9. The diagram preserves 11 bilingual datasets, 1,729 unique QA pairs, five 16K–256K word-or-Chinese-character levels, and 8,645 resulting contexts. Supporting and distractor documents are sampled to the target length, shuffled, and multi-hop supports dispersed. Six datasets receive GPT-4-generated similar facts that humans revise to create genuine conflicts; six receive 1,924 manually designed keyword and phrase replacements. Five full-time master's-level annotators review 557 confusing-fact instances and 955 answer-keyword instances. Evaluation uses greedy decoding, head-tail middle truncation when required, a keyword-recall gate, blacklist-aware F1, and the original task metric such as ROUGE-L where specified.

name: LAB-Bench
intro: LAB-Bench 是面向实际生物学研究能力的 2,457 题基准，涵盖 8 个大类、30 个子任务。序列和数据库问答主要程序生成，其余文献、补充材料、图表、实验方案和克隆场景由作者及生物学专家编写并审核。

modality: 文本, 图像, 生物序列

build_method_en: Programmatic generation and biology-expert authorship
eval_feature_en: Practical research tasks, expert baseline
intro_en: LAB-Bench is a 2,457-question benchmark of practical biology-research capabilities across eight broad categories and 30 subtasks. Sequence and database QA are mainly programmatic; literature, supplement, figure, table, protocol, and cloning tasks are authored and reviewed by the paper's authors and biology experts.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2407.10362v3, especially the benchmark construction and Appendix C, plus official futurehouse/lab-bench dataset snapshot 5c77cec. The diagram separates the exact programmatic branch—750 SeqQA questions across 15 subtasks and 650 DbQA questions across ten subtasks—from the expert-authored branch: LitQA2 248, SuppQA 102, FigQA 226, TableQA 305, ProtocolQA 135, and CloningScenarios 41. Model suggestions are optional inspiration only and remain subject to expert correction. Calibration closely reviews each author's first 5–10 questions, followed by ongoing review and revision. The final 2,457 questions carry contamination canaries and an approximately 80/20 public/private split per subtask. Models run three no-tool zero-shot-chain-of-thought trials with an insufficient-information option; accuracy, precision, and coverage are reported. The separate PhD-researcher baseline may use research tools but no AI tools.

name: LAB-Bench FigQA
intro: LAB-Bench FigQA 是 LAB-Bench 的 226 题科学图像推理子集。生物学专家从论文图像中编写只能依靠图像回答、需要综合多个视觉元素且不能由图中文字直接解出的多项选择题。
build_method: 生物学专家编写与多轮审核
task_type: 科学图像多项选择问答
eval_feature: 仅图像可回答, 多元素推理
build_method_en: Biology-expert authorship and multi-round review
eval_feature_en: Figure-only answerability, multi-element reasoning
intro_en: LAB-Bench FigQA is LAB-Bench's 226-question scientific-figure reasoning subset. Biology experts write multiple-choice questions that can be answered only from the figure, require integration across multiple visual elements, and cannot be solved merely by reading text inside the image.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the FigQA-specific process in arXiv:2407.10362v3 Appendix C.3 and official futurehouse/lab-bench snapshot 5c77cec. FigQA is a LAB-Bench subset rather than a separate 2025 benchmark. Authors select papers and figures; contracted staff assemble a paper pool; a separate LabelBox annotation pass isolates the figure, caption, relationship boxes, and DOI; and author or contracted biology experts draft the question, ideal answer, and plausible distractors. GPT-4 Turbo suggestions may be used only for brainstorming and are corrected because they are frequently inaccurate or too easy. Every question must be answerable from the figure alone, not from the caption or paper text, not by simply reading text inside the image, and must integrate multiple figure elements. Calibration and continuing review yield 226 total questions, with 181 currently public and 45 private. Models receive only the figure and MCQ, run no-tool zero-shot chain of thought with an insufficient-information option, and are scored by accuracy, precision, and coverage over three runs.

name: LABBench2
intro: LABBench2 是 LAB-Bench 的高保真后继基准，包含 1,912 个开放式生物学研究任务，覆盖文献理解与检索、数据访问、分子生物学、实验方案排错和实验规划，并比较无工具与网络搜索、代码执行工具增强系统。
build_method: 领域专家编写、程序生成与任务专用验证
modality: 文本, 图像, PDF, 数据文件, 生物序列
task_type: 开放式生命科学研究任务, Agent 任务
eval_feature: 真实检索与文件输入, 工具增强, 自定义验证器
scale: 1,912 个任务 / 5 类科研能力
modality_en: Text, image, PDF, data files, biological sequences
task_type_en: Open-response life-science research tasks, agent tasks
build_method_en: Domain-expert authorship, programmatic generation, task-specific verification
eval_feature_en: Realistic retrieval and file inputs, tool augmentation, custom verifiers
intro_en: LABBench2 is the higher-fidelity successor to LAB-Bench. Its 1,912 open-response biology-research tasks cover literature understanding and retrieval, data access, molecular biology, protocol troubleshooting, and experiment planning, and compare base systems with web-search and code-execution augmentation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.09554v2 Sections 2.1.1, 2.2.1, 2.3.1, 2.4.1, and 2.5 plus official EdisonScientific/labbench2 repository snapshot c028ecdc. The exact 1,912-task total comprises LitQA3 168, PatentQA 121, TrialQA 120, SourceQuality 150, DbQA2 86, SuppQA2 125, ProtocolQA2 125, SeqQA2 400, CloningQA 14, FigQA2 101 in each of image/PDF/retrieval modes, and TableQA2 100 in each mode. Literature and protocol tasks use contracted and internal domain experts with multiple review rounds; DbQA2 combines LLM analysis of 1,000 bioRxiv papers with expert curation of 43 sources; SeqQA2 expands 20 in-house-biologist templates into 20 variants each. CloningQA produces a parseable DSL and uses end-to-end in-silico validators. The diagrams preserve open-response framing, image/PDF/retrieval and inline/file/retrieval modes, task-specific graders, and the paper's base-versus-web-search-and-code-execution comparison with overall, family, mode, and subtask accuracy breakdowns.

name: Legal Agent Benchmark
intro: Legal Agent Benchmark 是 Harvey 发布的持续演进法律智能体基准。当前官方仓库包含 1,660 个闭卷式任务和约 101,000 个律师编写的原子评分点，覆盖 24 个法律执业领域及合同工作；每项任务在隔离容器中运行并按全部评分点均通过才得分。
build_method: 执业律师任务设计, 合成客户材料, 原子二元评分点
metric: All-criteria task pass rate, pooled criterion pass rate
modality: 文本, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, 邮件
task_type: 法律智能体任务, 文档交付
eval_feature: 隔离工具环境, 逐评分点语义评判, 严格全通过计分
scale: 1,660 个任务 / 约 101,000 个评分点 / 24 个执业领域及合同工作
modality_en: Text, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, email
build_method_en: Practicing-lawyer task design, synthetic client materials, atomic binary criteria
eval_feature_en: Isolated tool environment, criterion-level semantic judging, strict all-pass scoring
intro_en: Legal Agent Benchmark is Harvey's evolving benchmark for legal agents. The current official repository contains 1,660 closed-universe tasks and about 101,000 lawyer-authored atomic criteria across 24 legal practice areas plus contracting; each task runs in an isolated container and receives credit only when every criterion passes.
scale_en: 1,660 tasks / about 101,000 criteria / 24 practice areas plus contracting
metric_en: All-criteria task pass rate, pooled criterion pass rate
drawio_review_note: No associated research paper was found. Aligned with Harvey's May 6, 2026 official announcement and harveyai/harvey-labs repository snapshot f46ef86. Practicing lawyers turn realistic client matters into about 50-word partner-to-associate requests with closed-universe source documents and reviewable deliverables. Synthetic key and peripheral documents are generated in batches under lawyer guidance and review. Experts author atomic, binary, equal-weight, deliverable-scoped criteria rather than one golden output. The current evolving repository reports 1,660 tasks and about 101,000 criteria across 24 practice areas plus contracting; this supersedes the announcement's initial 1,250-task and 75,000-criterion counts. Each task runs in a network-disabled, capability-free Podman container with read-only sources, a writable output directory, and six file/shell tools. The default judge is Claude Sonnet 4.6 at temperature 0, judging one criterion semantically against only relevant deliverables. A task scores 1 only if every criterion passes; pooled criterion pass rate and operational diagnostics are secondary.

name: LifeBench
intro: LifeBench 是一个面向长时程多源记忆的代理评测基准，要求模型在长期事件轨迹中综合陈述性与非陈述性记忆，并基于真实世界先验完成跨来源、跨时间的检索与推理。

eval_feature: 长期记忆, 多源信息整合, 时序演化
scale: 2003个问题, 平均上下文深度3.66M tokens
intro_en: LifeBench evaluates long-horizon multi-source memory for agents by combining declarative and non-declarative memory reasoning over dense life-event simulations.
build_method_en: Real-world priors, cognitive-science-inspired long-horizon event simulation, partonomic event structuring
task_type_en: Agent Task, Long-context Reasoning, Memory Retrieval
eval_feature_en: Long-horizon Memory, Multi-source Integration, Temporal Evolution

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.03781v1, Sections 3–5. LifeBench uses five DeepSeek-R1 modules for persona synthesis, hierarchical outline planning, daily activity simulation, phone-data generation, and QA generation. Survey and PersonaHub priors, a 20–30-person social graph, and real AMap locations ground each persona; up to 10 plots from about 50 candidates are decomposed into sub-day atomic events. Subjective and objective agents combine long/short-term memory with schedule, travel, venue, weather, and factual constraints. The release contains 10 one-year lives, 5,149 events and 8,046 phone/health records per user, and 2,003 timestamped questions (517 multiple-choice and 1,486 short-answer) across IE, MR, TKU, ND, and UA. Evaluation normalizes artifacts to LoCoMo format and uses GPT-5.1-Mini plus text-embedding-3-small, with manual and automatic quality checks.

name: LifelongAgentBench
intro: LifelongAgentBench是首个统一基准，系统评估大型语言模型智能体的终身学习能力。涵盖数据库、操作系统和知识图谱三大交互环境，支持自动标签验证、可复现性和模块化扩展。
org: South China University of Technology, MBZUAI, Chinese Academy of Sciences, East China Normal Univers
build_method: 原子技能驱动任务生成, 稀有技能概率增采样, 自动执行校验与10%人工复核

build_method_en: Atomic-skill-grounded generation, rare-skill probabilistic upsampling, execution verification and 10% manual review
eval_feature_en: Lifelong Learning, Interdependent Tasks
intro_en: LifelongAgentBench is the first unified benchmark that systematically evaluates the lifelong learning ability of large language model agents. It covers three interactive environments: databases, operating systems, and knowledge graphs, supporting automatic label verification, reproducibility, and modular extensibility.
scale_en: 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash commands, and 7 knowledge-graph operations

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.11942v3, Sections 3–5. LifelongAgentBench defines 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash commands, and 7 knowledge-graph operations, then probabilistically upsamples rare skills while varying complexity, noise, overlap, and task dependency. DeepSeek-R1 turns sampled SQL skills into database tasks that run in fresh Dockerized MySQL instances and are checked by query-result comparison or database-state hashing; operating-system tasks reset Ubuntu containers and use task-specific Bash evaluators whose exit code must be zero; knowledge-graph tasks map GrailQA S-expressions to agent/SPARQL operations and verify returned outputs. A 10% task sample is manually reviewed. Unified agent-environment-controller APIs enforce strict sequential execution, and evaluation compares no replay with 1/4/8/16/32/64 recent successful trajectories plus group self-consistency majority voting.

name: LingoQA
intro: LingoQA是一个针对自动驾驶领域视觉问答的新型数据集和基准。该数据集包含2.8万个独特的短视频场景和41.9万个标注。对最先进的视觉语言模型进行评估表明，它们的性能仍低于人类水平。LingoQA引入了一个名为Lingo-Judge的真实性分类器，其与人类评估的Spearman相关系数达到0.95，超越了现有技术。该基准旨在作为自动驾驶视觉语言模型的评估平台。
build_method: 动作与场景双分支标注, GPT-3.5/GPT-4辅助问答生成, 双人评测标注
scale: 28K个四秒视频场景, 419.9K条问答标注
build_method_en: Action/scenery dual pipelines, GPT-3.5/GPT-4-assisted QA generation, double-labeled human evaluation set
eval_feature_en: Process Evaluation
intro_en: LingoQA is a novel dataset and benchmark for visual question answering in the autonomous driving domain. It contains 28,000 unique short video scenes and 419,000 annotations. Evaluations of state-of-the-art vision-language models show their performance still lags behind human level. LingoQA introduces Lingo-Judge, a fidelity classifier with a Spearman correlation of 0.95 against human evaluations, surpassing existing methods. This benchmark aims to serve as an evaluation platform for autonomous driving vision-language models.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2312.14115, Sections 3–4 and Tables 2–3. LingoQA extracts four-second driving scenarios at 1 Hz and builds data through separate Action and Scenery branches. Action seeds combine operator behavior descriptions, perception/vehicle metadata, prompt templates, and GPT-3.5 rephrasing, answering, and extension; Scenery data densely annotates three 30-minute sessions in ELAN across about 15 caption categories and uses GPT-4 chain-of-thought prompting. The unambiguous aggregate is 28K scenarios and 419.9K QA annotations; the paper's prose and Table 3 disagree on the Action-branch QA subtotal, so the diagram does not assert that disputed subtotal. More than 20 in-house evaluators create 500 questions and two independently authored answers per question, with repeated relabeling of semantic disagreements. DeBERTaV3 Lingo-Judge uses question, reference answer, and model answer without video, takes the maximum over references, reaches 95% held-out accuracy, and correlates with human model rankings at Spearman 0.950 and Pearson 0.993.

name: LinuxArena
intro: LinuxArena 是面向真实多服务生产环境的 AI 控制基准，在智能体完成正常软件工程主任务时评估其隐蔽完成有害副任务的能力，以及监控器在危害发生前检出攻击的能力。
build_method: 生产式Docker Compose环境, LLM辅助主任务, 人工副任务, 隐藏二元评分器, 两阶段意外完成过滤
metric: 主任务成功率, 副任务成功率, 未检出破坏成功率
eval_feature: 逐动作监控, 破坏评测, 诚实阈值校准
openness_en: Partly Public (10 public and 10 withheld environments)
build_method_en: Production-like Docker Compose environments, LLM-assisted main tasks, human-authored side tasks, hidden binary scorers, two-stage accidental-completion filtering
eval_feature_en: Per-action monitoring, sabotage evaluation, honest-score threshold calibration
intro_en: LinuxArena is an AI-control benchmark for live multi-service production environments. It evaluates whether agents can covertly complete harmful side tasks while doing legitimate software-engineering main tasks and whether monitors detect attacks before harm occurs.
metric_en: Main-task success, side-task success, undetected sabotage success
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.15384v2, Sections 2–5 and appendices. LinuxArena scratch-builds 20 stateful multi-service Docker Compose environments and splits them into 10 public and 10 withheld environments. The v2 release contains 1,667 LLM-assisted, human-reviewed software-engineering main tasks in six categories and 185 human-authored side tasks in six security-failure categories, each with hidden external binary scorers. Main and side tasks can be paired within the same environment rather than forming one fixed pair set. All same-environment combinations undergo LLM likelihood screening followed by fresh-environment honest-trajectory replay and scorer-only testing; about 0.9% are removed for accidental completion. Honest, obvious, and subtle attack policies are evaluated with 0–10 per-action monitors calibrated at the 99th percentile of honest scores (1% step-wise false-positive rate), and successful sabotage requires side-task success without a pre-harm flag.

name: LinuxBench
intro: LinuxBench 是 Claude 系统卡中提到的 AI control arena，Minimal-LinuxBench 是其用于隐蔽副任务检测的子集。
build_method: 私有LinuxBench任务对, 随机200对Minimal子集, 三种受监控攻击提示词

scale: 1,948个主/副任务对, 随机评测200对
build_method_en: Private LinuxBench task pairs, random 200-pair Minimal subset, three monitored attack prompts
eval_feature_en: Stealth behavior
intro_en: LinuxBench is an AI control arena mentioned by Claude system cards; Minimal-LinuxBench is its subset for stealthy side-task detection.
scale_en: 1,948 main/side task pairs, random 200-pair evaluation sample
drawio_review_note: No public LinuxBench construction paper is available. This diagram follows the official Claude Mythos Preview System Card, Section 4.4.3.2 and Figure 4.4.3.2.A, and explicitly leaves the private upstream construction boundary undisclosed. Anthropic adapted 1,948 main/side task pairs from Redwood Research's private LinuxBench and randomly sampled 200 as Minimal-LinuxBench; a small minority failed before evaluation, so the effective sample is slightly below 200. Claude Mythos Preview runs without extended thinking under three similar attack system prompts that disclose full-transcript monitoring. The monitor receives the entire transcript including assistant turns; the card compares the early-deployment no-CoT monitor with the currently used without-CoT monitor, prior checkpoints, and a helpful-only model. Successful stealth completion requires the side task to succeed without a monitor flag; the card reports 69/200 side-task successes and Wilson 95% confidence intervals.

name: LitBench
intro: LitBench 是首个面向创意写作验证的标准化基准与配套数据集，用于可靠评估 LLM 生成故事的质量偏好判断。它包含去偏的人类标注故事对测试集与大规模训练语料，可用于评测零样本评审模型和训练奖励模型。

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.00769 / EACL 2026, Sections 3–5. LitBench queries r/WritingPrompts through PRAW, searches the top 100 results for more than 5,000 prompt IDs, and restricts the held-out benchmark to stories posted after 2 January 2023; training data comes from the MIT-licensed pre-2023 WritingPrompts preference corpus. The two splits independently remove stories with fewer than 10 upvotes or 50 words and those exceeding 2,048 tokens, pair stories under the same prompt, require at least a 25% upvote difference with the chosen story posted later, and prune a 100-bin length-difference histogram toward symmetry. The release contains 2,480 test pairs from 3,543 stories and 43,827 training pairs from 50,309 stories. Evaluation compares order-swapped zero-shot LLM judges, Bradley–Terry and generative reward models, and online human preferences on newly generated stories; the paper reports 73% for the best zero-shot judge and 78% for both trained model families.

name: LitQA2
intro: LitQA2 是 FutureHouse 为检验科学文献检索与综合能力构建的 248 道英文多项选择题。专家从近 36 个月论文中选择必须依赖正文、不能仅凭标题或摘要回答且需要推理的发现，配制可信干扰项并经模型挑战、Google Scholar 检索与持续人工审核；评测随机打乱选项，温度 0 完整运行三次，用 GPT-4-0613 抽取字母答案，并报告准确率、精确率与正确来源 DOI 召回率。
build_method: 近期论文专家出题, 模型与检索挑战, 持续人工审核
task_type: 科学文献检索, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 选项随机化, 信息不足选项, 三次零温运行, DOI归因
build_method_en: Expert authoring from recent papers, model and search challenge tests, continuous human review
eval_feature_en: Choice randomization, insufficient-information option, three temperature-zero runs, DOI attribution
intro_en: LitQA2 is a 248-question English multiple-choice benchmark built by FutureHouse to test retrieval and synthesis over scientific literature. Experts select findings from papers published within the previous 36 months that require main-body context and reasoning rather than the title or abstract, add plausible distractors, and subject drafts to model probes, Google Scholar searches, and continuing human review. Evaluation randomizes choices, runs the full set three times at temperature zero, uses GPT-4-0613 to extract the answer letter, and reports accuracy, precision, and correct-source DOI recall.
