The diagrams preserve separate PL/FOL and non-monotonic streams, depth-one rules, conclusion-to-premise chaining, 71 monotonic combinations, eight NM patterns and 12/2/2/1 depth-wise combinations, Claude-2 few-shot generation, naturalization, manual logic and language correction, the exact 1,552 total with logic/depth/label distributions, six-model zero-shot-CoT binary entailment, Accuracy by logic and depth, and reasoning-chain analysis.

name: Multi-SWE-bench
intro: Multi-SWE-bench 是一个面向真实代码问题解决的多语言基准，包含 1,632 个高质量实例，覆盖 Java、TypeScript、JavaScript、Go、Rust、C 和 C++ 七种语言。它从 39 个仓库的 2,456 个可执行候选中，经 68 位专家双人标注、交叉复核和内部质检筛选而来，并在容器化环境中评测智能体补丁的问题解决率、成功定位率与平均成本。
build_method: GitHub PR 挖掘、容器化执行过滤、专家双人标注与质检
metric: Resolved Rate, Success Location, Average Cost
eval_feature: 多语言、容器化执行、专家验证
scale: 1,632 个实例，39 个仓库，7 种语言
build_method_en: GitHub PR Mining, Containerized Execution Filtering, Dual Expert Annotation and QA
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, Containerized Execution, Expert-Validated
intro_en: Multi-SWE-bench evaluates real-world issue resolution with 1,632 high-quality instances spanning Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C, and C++. The benchmark was curated from 2,456 executable candidates across 39 repositories through dual annotation, cross-review, and internal quality assurance by 68 experts, and evaluates agent patches in containerized environments using resolved rate, success location, and average cost.
language_en: Multilingual Code (Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C, C++)
metric_en: Resolved Rate, Success Location, Average Cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.02605 Sections 2.1-2.5 and 3. The diagram separates repository and pull-request selection, Docker environment determination, three-run test transition filtering, dual annotation, internal quality assurance, and executable patch evaluation. It uses the paper's final 1,632 instances from 2,456 candidates across 39 repositories and seven languages; Python and the separate 4,723-instance Multi-SWE-RL collection are intentionally excluded from the benchmark count.

name: MultiChallenge
intro: MultiChallenge 是面向真实多轮人机对话的英文基准，覆盖指令保持、推断记忆、可靠版本编辑与自洽性四类挑战。候选对话由 MMSE 多智能体系统生成，再经人工编辑和两层独立复核；最终 273 条数据均附带只依赖最终回答的实例级二元量表。
build_method: 多智能体生成, 人工编辑, 多层复核, 混合
task_type: 多轮对话, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 四类多轮挑战, MMSE, 至少 3/6 前沿模型失败, 实例级二元量表
build_method_en: Multi-agent Generation, Human Editing, Multi-layer Review, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Four Multi-turn Challenges, MMSE, At Least 3/6 Frontier-model Failures, Instance-level Binary Rubrics
intro_en: MultiChallenge is an English benchmark for realistic multi-turn human-LLM dialogue across instruction retention, inference memory, reliable versioned editing, and self-coherence. MMSE generates candidates, humans edit them and apply two independent review layers, and each of the final 273 examples includes an instance-level binary rubric that uses only the final response.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.17399 Sections 3–5 and Appendix A plus the official MultiChallenge repository. The diagrams preserve the four challenge categories, hierarchical topics, PersonaHub personas, five-part configs, Planner/User/Responder MMSE roles, random sampling of six frontier responders, blueprint updates and failure-or-limit stopping, the no-failure discard branch, human category/naturalness/failure review with an at-least-3-of-6 gate, two additional independent review layers, exact 273-item category counts and length statistics, final-response-only binary rubrics, GPT-4o or Claude judging, Accuracy, and 93.95% human-judge alignment.

name: MultiMedQA
intro: MultiMedQA是Google Research与DeepMind提出的综合医疗问答评测套件，汇集六个既有英文数据集，覆盖专业医学考试、生物医学研究和消费者健康问答，并新增含3,375条常见搜索问题的HealthSearchQA；论文分别使用多选准确率和临床医生人工评测考察模型。
build_method: 数据集汇编, 搜索问题整理, 临床医生评测, 混合
metric: 多选准确率, 临床医生人工评测
task_type: 医疗问答, 多项选择, 长回答
eval_feature: 七数据集套件, HealthSearchQA, 多种提示策略, 临床安全人工评测
scale: 7 个数据集, 3,375 条 HealthSearchQA 问题
task_type_en: Medical QA, Multiple Choice, Long-form Answers
build_method_en: Dataset Compilation, Search-query Curation, Clinician Evaluation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Seven-dataset Suite, HealthSearchQA, Multiple Prompting Strategies, Clinician Safety Review
intro_en: MultiMedQA is a comprehensive medical QA suite introduced by Google Research and DeepMind. It combines six existing English datasets spanning professional exams, biomedical research, and consumer health QA, and adds HealthSearchQA with 3,375 commonly searched questions; the paper evaluates multiple-choice tasks by accuracy and long-form answers through clinician review.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2212.13138 Sections 3.1-3.3, 4.1-4.5, Table 1, and Appendix A. The diagram separates compilation of six existing English medical QA datasets from construction of the 3,375-question HealthSearchQA set, then preserves the paper's two evaluation branches: exact-choice accuracy on four multiple-choice groups with few-shot, chain-of-thought, and 11-path self-consistency prompting; and blinded clinician review of 140 long-form questions sampled as 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA items. It also records nine clinicians and the paper's consensus, reasoning, completeness, harm, bias, relevance, and helpfulness dimensions.

name: MultiPL-E
intro: MultiPL-E是一个用于将单元测试驱动的代码生成基准测试翻译成新语言的系统。它通过将两个流行的Python代码生成基准测试扩展到18种额外的编程语言，创建了第一个大规模多语言代码生成基准测试。该基准测试用于评估Codex、CodeGen和InCoder等最先进代码生成模型的多语言性能，并探讨语言频率和语言特性对模型性能的影响。
build_method: HumanEval/MBPP 规范化, 18 个小型编译器, 提示与隐藏单测翻译, 容器化执行
eval_feature: 多语言
build_method_en: HumanEval/MBPP Normalization, 18 Little Compilers, Prompt and Hidden-Test Translation, Containerized Execution
eval_feature_en: Multilingual
intro_en: MultiPL-E is a system that translates unit test-driven code generation benchmarks into new languages. By extending two popular Python code generation benchmarks to 18 additional programming languages, it creates the first large-scale multilingual code generation benchmark. This benchmark evaluates the multilingual performance of state-of-the-art code generation models such as Codex, CodeGen, and InCoder, and explores the impact of language frequency and language features on model performance.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2208.08227v4. MultiPL-E normalizes HumanEval and MBPP before translation: three HumanEval tasks with Python helper functions are excluded, two randomized tasks are converted to unit tests, and MBPP assertions are hidden while signatures are inferred. Eighteen benchmark-specific little compilers translate signatures, descriptions, doctests, unit tests, terminology, typed values, and type annotations into 18 target languages, yielding parallel MultiPL-HumanEval and MultiPL-MBPP suites in 19 languages including Python. Completions are compiled and run with language-specific timeouts in a containerized sandbox, judged only by all hidden tests, classified by failure type, and reported with Pass@1/10/100 from 200 samples per problem and temperature.

name: MultiPriv
intro: MultiPriv是系统评估视觉语言模型个体级别隐私推理能力的基准，通过隐私感知与推理框架和双语多模态数据集，涵盖属性检测、跨图像重识别和链式推理等九项挑战性任务。
build_method: 公开数据筛选, 受控合成, 人工任务设计, 混合验证
metric: F1, IEA, mIoU, Accuracy, Completion Percentage
task_type: 视觉问答, 隐私感知, 个体级隐私推理
eval_feature: PPR, 九项任务, 身份关联, 双语分层风险指标
scale: 1,119 张图像, 7,414 条人工 VQA, 40 个合成个体
task_type_en: Visual QA, Privacy Perception, Individual-level Privacy Reasoning
build_method_en: Public-data Curation, Controlled Synthesis, Manual Task Design, Hybrid Verification
eval_feature_en: PPR Framework, Nine Tasks, Identity Linkage, Bilingual Hierarchical Risk Metrics
intro_en: MultiPriv is a benchmark for systematically evaluating the individual-level privacy inference capabilities of vision-language models. It features a privacy-aware inference framework and a bilingual multimodal dataset, covering nine challenging tasks including attribute detection, cross-image re-identification, and chain reasoning.
scale_en: 1,119 images, 7,414 manually designed VQA pairs, 40 synthetic individuals
metric_en: F1, IEA, mIoU, Accuracy, Completion Percentage
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2511.16940v3 Sections 3.3-3.5 and Appendices B, D, E, and H, plus the official CyberChangAn/MultiPriv-PII repository. The diagram reflects 36 fine-grained attributes in seven categories, 40 fully synthetic profiles, 1,119 images, and 7,414 manually designed bilingual VQA pairs. It separates four perception tasks from five reasoning tasks, records the three-step individual synthesis pipeline and the approximately 18 percent Doubao-generated attribute pool, and preserves the 93 percent deterministic plus 7 percent Qwen2.5-72B-and-human verification split. Refusals are reported as privacy mitigation rather than counted as successful privacy extraction.

name: MuSR
intro: MuSR 是面向自然长叙事中多步软推理的英文基准。论文通过领域模板、黄金与多样性事实、GPT-4 递归推理树、树校验器、分章节故事生成和事实一致性校验，构建 564 篇叙事与 756 道问题，覆盖谋杀谜案、物体放置和团队分配。
build_method: 神经符号生成, 自动生成, 人工验证, 混合
eval_feature: 递归推理树, 章节化叙事, 树与故事校验器, 思维链与神经符号评测
build_method_en: Neurosymbolic Generation, Automated Generation, Human Validation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Recursive Reasoning Trees, Chaptered Narratives, Tree and Story Validators, CoT and Neurosymbolic Evaluation
intro_en: MuSR is an English benchmark for multistep soft reasoning in long natural narratives. Its paper builds 564 narratives and 756 questions across murder mystery, object placement, and team allocation through domain templates, gold and diversity facts, GPT-4 recursive reasoning trees, tree validators, chaptered story generation, and fact-consistency checks.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.16049 Sections 3–5 and the official MuSR repository and dataset files. The diagrams preserve the three domain templates, gold and diversity facts, GPT-4 recursive reasoning-tree completion, tree validators and retry behavior, the S(T)/C(T) leaf split, chaptered story generation and fact-consistency rewrites, 564-narrative/756-question release with exact domain counts, heuristic and human quality checks, CoT variants, domain-specific neurosymbolic methods, and Accuracy-based human-model comparison.

name: MVBench
intro: MVBench是一个全面的多模态视频理解基准，旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在动态视频任务中的时序理解能力。它涵盖了20项具有挑战性的视频任务，这些任务无法通过单帧有效解决。该基准通过新颖的“静态到动态”方法定义时序相关任务，并自动将公共视频标注转换为多项选择题进行评估。
org: OpenGVLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sc
build_method_en: Automated Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, process evaluation
intro_en: MVBench is a comprehensive multimodal video understanding benchmark designed to evaluate the temporal reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on dynamic video tasks. It covers 20 challenging video tasks that cannot be effectively solved using single frames. The benchmark defines temporal reasoning tasks through a novel "static-to-dynamic" approach and automatically converts public video annotations into multiple-choice questions for evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2311.17005 Sections 3.1-3.3 and the task-generation appendix. The diagram preserves the static-to-dynamic conversion from nine spatial references to 20 temporal tasks, collection from 11 public video benchmarks, diversity and mostly 5-35-second temporal filtering, STAR boundary shifts and CLEVRER condition cap, ChatGPT question generation, template/LLM option construction, 200 MCQs per task and 4,000 total, three-to-five shuffled options with LLM length balancing, temporal evaluation prompt, parenthesized-choice Best Option prefix with 100% extraction, and deterministic accuracy against gold annotations.

name: NaturalQuestions
intro: NaturalQuestions 是报告中用于检索增强问答和开放域问答的真实搜索问题数据集。
build_method: 真实搜索查询, Wikipedia配对, 人工长短答案标注
task_type: 知识问答, 检索问答
build_method_en: Real search queries, Wikipedia pairing, human long/short answer annotation
intro_en: NaturalQuestions is a real search-query QA dataset referenced by reports for retrieval-augmented and open-domain question answering.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the primary TACL paper at ACL Anthology Q19-1026. Natural Questions samples anonymized, aggregated Google queries of at least eight words issued by multiple users, applies question-form heuristics, and keeps queries with a Wikipedia page in the top five results. About 50 annotators first judge question validity without seeing the page, then select the earliest smallest long-answer HTML box or NULL, followed by short entity spans, yes/no, or no short answer. The release has 307,373 single-annotated training examples and five-way Dev/Test sets of 7,830/7,842. With beta=2, at least two non-null annotations require an answer matching any reference; otherwise the system must return NULL. Long and short answers report precision, recall, and F1 separately.

name: NeedleBench V2
intro: NeedleBench V2是评估大型语言模型在不同信息密度下进行长上下文检索与推理的合成框架。信息稀疏分支在中英文干草文本中插入虚构单针或多针，信息密集的祖先追溯挑战则用连续亲属关系构造2至512条针；官方配置覆盖4k至1,000k上下文。
build_method: 程序化合成, 长上下文插入, 受控任务生成
metric: 关键词感知精确匹配, 加权准确率, ENL-50
task_type: 长上下文检索, 多步推理, 祖先追溯
eval_feature: 信息稀疏与信息密集, 4k–1,000k, ATC, 双语
task_type_en: Long-context Retrieval, Multi-step Reasoning, Ancestral Trace
build_method_en: Programmatic Synthesis, Long-context Insertion, Controlled Task Generation
eval_feature_en: Information-sparse and Dense Tasks, 4k–1,000k, ATC, Bilingual
intro_en: NeedleBench V2 is a synthetic framework for evaluating long-context retrieval and reasoning at different information densities. Its sparse branch inserts fictional single or multiple needles into English and Chinese haystacks, while the information-dense Ancestral Trace Challenge constructs continuous kinship chains with 2 to 512 needles; official configurations span 4k to 1,000k contexts.
metric_en: Keyword-aware Exact Match, Weighted Accuracy, ENL-50
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2407.11963 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendices E-G, plus the official OpenCompass NeedleBench V2 configuration README. The diagram separates information-sparse S-RT, M-RT, and fictional-kinship M-RS from the information-dense Ancestral Trace Challenge. It records English PaulGrahamEssays and ChineseDomainModelingEval haystacks, 2-5 fact kinship needles, 10 repetitions, 4k through 1,000k context configurations, ATC powers-of-two from 2 to 512 needles, keyword-aware exact match for sparse tasks, and boxed exact match with needle-count weighting and ENL-50 for ATC.

name: NextQA
intro: NExT-QA是面向解释性视频问答的人工标注基准，从6,000个VidOR候选视频中保留5,440个交互丰富片段，并构建52,044条因果、时序和描述性问答。论文同时提供47,692道五选一题和完整开放式问答集，用Accuracy与WUPS评估模型。
build_method: 视频筛选, 三阶段人工标注, 困难干扰项生成
task_type: 视频问答, 因果推理, 时序推理
eval_feature: 因果/时序/描述问题, 多选与开放式问答, 人工标注
task_type_en: Video QA, Causal Reasoning, Temporal Reasoning
build_method_en: Video Selection, Three-stage Human Annotation, Hard Distractor Generation
eval_feature_en: Causal, Temporal, and Descriptive Questions; Multi-choice and Open-ended QA; Human Annotation
intro_en: NExT-QA is a manually annotated benchmark for explanatory video QA. It retains 5,440 interaction-rich clips from 6,000 VidOR candidates and contains 52,044 causal, temporal, and descriptive QA pairs. The paper provides 47,692 five-option questions alongside the full open-ended set, evaluated by accuracy and WUPS.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2105.08276v2 Sections 3.1-4 and Appendix A, plus the official doc-doc/NExT-QA repository. The diagram records selection of 6,000 longer interaction-rich VidOR videos, the 7:1:2 video split, one year of causal-then-temporal-then-descriptive annotation by 100 trained undergraduates, separate question and answer roles, visible-evidence quality control, and post-processing of boring videos, yes/no balance, and counts above 20. It preserves the final 5,440 videos and 52,044 QA pairs, Sentence-BERT hard-negative construction with similarity thresholds 0.9 and 0.2, manual checking of all 47,692 five-option tuples, and separate multiple-choice accuracy versus open-ended WUPS evaluation.

name: NL2Repo-Bench
intro: NL2Repo-Bench是一个旨在评估编码智能体长周期代码仓库生成能力的基准测试。它要求智能体根据自然语言需求文档，自主设计架构、管理依赖、实现多模块逻辑并生成可安装的Python库。实验表明，现有模型在长周期仓库生成方面表现不佳，平均测试通过率低于40%。该基准测试揭示了长周期推理是下一代自主编码智能体的关键瓶颈。
org: Tsinghua University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Peking University, Renmin University of China,
build_method: GitHub 仓库筛选, AST 辅助需求逆向, 专家与静态覆盖审核, Agent 先导验证
metric: Average Test Pass Rate, Fully Passed Pass@1 Count
eval_feature: 空工作区从零构建, 隐藏源码与测试, 上游 pytest 执行评测
build_method_en: GitHub Repository Selection, AST-Assisted Specification Reverse Engineering, Expert and Static-Coverage Review, Pilot-Agent Validation
eval_feature_en: From-Scratch Empty-Workspace Generation, Hidden Source and Tests, Upstream-pytest Execution
intro_en: NL2Repo-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate the long-term code repository generation capabilities of coding agents. It requires agents to autonomously design architecture, manage dependencies, implement multi-module logic, and generate installable Python libraries based on natural language requirement documents. Experiments show that existing models perform poorly in long-term repository generation, with an average test pass rate below 40%. This benchmark reveals that long-term reasoning is a key bottleneck for the next generation of autonomous coding agents.
metric_en: Average Test Pass Rate, Fully Passed Pass@1 Count
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.12730v2. Candidate Python libraries must have 300-120,000 LOC, at least 10 stars, native pytest tests, and recent creation or updates; annotators retain only repositories whose upstream tests pass. An AST scanner inventories classes, functions, and signatures, which annotators reverse-engineer into a four-part requirements document. Expert review, static API coverage, verified Docker environments, pilot coding agents, and senior-engineer failure analysis drive refinement until valid. The release contains 104 tasks across nine categories. Agents receive only one document in an empty workspace, with no scaffold, source, tests, or signatures, then generated installable libraries are scored by the original upstream pytest suite using average test pass rate and fully passed Pass@1 count.

name: NOVA-63
intro: NOVA-63是一个大规模、学科平衡、原生多语言基准测试，包含14种语言和63个学科的89,107个问题。该基准测试通过LLM辅助格式化、专家质量验证和多级别难度筛选，确保了学科平衡、难度标准一致和语言元素的真实性。对现有LLM的广泛实验揭示了跨语言一致性和模型在不同学科能力上的显著差异。这项工作为多语言模型的未来发展提供了宝贵的基准数据。
org: Peking University, Alibaba Group, Zhejiang University
build_method: 母语数据收集, LLM辅助格式化, 人工标注, 多模型难度筛选
metric: Accuracy（问题级、二级学科级、一级学科级平均）
task_type: 多项选择, 多学科知识与推理
eval_feature: 母语内容, 63 个学科, 难度控制, 学科均衡
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Multidisciplinary Knowledge and Reasoning
build_method_en: Native-data Collection, LLM-assisted Formatting, Human Annotation, Multi-model Difficulty Screening
eval_feature_en: Native-language Content, 63 Disciplines, Difficulty Control, Discipline Balance
intro_en: NOVA-63 is a large-scale, discipline-balanced, native multilingual benchmark comprising 89,107 questions across 63 disciplines and 14 languages. The benchmark ensures discipline balance, consistent difficulty standards, and linguistic authenticity through LLM-assisted formatting, expert quality validation, and multi-level difficulty screening. Extensive experiments on existing LLMs reveal cross-lingual consistency and significant variations in model capabilities across different disciplines. This work provides valuable benchmark data for the future development of multilingual models.
metric_en: Accuracy averaged by question, secondary discipline, and primary discipline
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against the authoritative EMNLP 2025 paper PDF, Sections 3.1-4.1 and Appendix A. The four-stage diagram covers native-source collection; LLM-assisted extraction with human verification and quality annotation; small-versus-large model difficulty screening with manual review of suspicious reversals; and supplementation, native-language review, and balancing to 50-150 questions per language-discipline cell. It records 2,425 QA-to-MCQ conversions, 62 evaluated LLMs, and question-, secondary-, and primary-discipline accuracy. The paper PDF consistently reports 89,107 questions; the ACL landing-page abstract currently shows 93,536, so the diagram follows the authoritative PDF.

name: NYU CTF Bench
intro: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在网络安全领域的夺旗（CTF）挑战解决能力尚未得到充分评估。为解决此问题，本研究开发了一种新颖的方法，通过创建一个可扩展的开源基准数据集来评估LLMs在CTF挑战中的表现。该基准数据集包含来自流行竞赛的各种CTF挑战，并支持LLM测试和自适应学习的元数据。通过提供专门的基准，该项目为开发、测试和完善基于LLM的漏洞检测和解决方案提供了理想平台。
build_method: CSAW 挑战收集, 人工可解性验证, Docker/文件环境标准化, JSON 元数据打包
eval_feature: 可扩展, 开源, 动态更新, 过程评估, 工具调用
build_method_en: CSAW Challenge Collection, Manual Solvability Validation, Docker/File Environment Standardization, JSON Metadata Packaging
eval_feature_en: Scalable, open source, Dynamic Update, process evaluation, tool invocation
intro_en: Large language models (LLMs) have not been fully evaluated in their ability to solve cybersecurity capture-the-flag (CTF) challenges. To address this, this study developed a novel approach by creating a scalable open-source benchmark dataset to assess LLM performance on CTF challenges. The benchmark dataset includes various CTF challenges from popular competitions and supports metadata for LLM testing and adaptive learning. By providing a dedicated benchmark, this project offers an ideal platform for developing, testing, and refining LLM-based vulnerability detection and solutions.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.05590v3. The source archive spans 2011-2023 and initially contains 568 CSAW challenges, while the paper's validated 200-challenge table covers 2017-2023 across crypto, forensics, pwn, reverse engineering, web, and miscellaneous categories. Every retained challenge is manually revalidated for setup and solvability. Server tasks require internal and external Docker-network connectivity; file tasks require complete configs and source. Docker Hub images, Compose files, source assets, and challenge JSON are standardized. Models see only listed files, descriptions, and connection details, while flags stay hidden. The solver exposes six function-call tools, checks exact flags, cleans resources, and reports category success and failure reasons across five evaluated LLMs.

name: OCNLI
intro: OCNLI（Original Chinese Natural Language Inference）是首个不依赖翻译、完全从原生中文材料人工构建的大规模中文自然语言推理数据集。论文从政府、新闻、文学、电视谈话和电话对话五种体裁收集前提句，由145名中文母语的语言相关专业学生按四种策略生成56,486个前提—假设对，并通过五标签多数投票构建标准标签。
org: Indiana University, Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence, CLUE Benchmark
build_method: 人工假设生成, 多数投票, 专家设计
eval_feature: 原生中文, 四种生成策略, 五标签复核
scale: 56,486个句对；约50k训练集、3k开发集、3k测试集
build_method_en: Human Hypothesis Elicitation, Majority Vote, Expert Design
eval_feature_en: Original Chinese, Four Elicitation Strategies, Five-label Verification
intro_en: OCNLI (Original Chinese Natural Language Inference) is the first large-scale Chinese NLI dataset constructed entirely from original Chinese material without translation. Premises come from five government, news, literature, TV-talk, and telephone genres; 145 native Chinese students in language-related majors produced 56,486 premise-hypothesis pairs under four elicitation strategies, followed by five-label majority-vote verification.
scale_en: 56,486 pairs; about 50k train, 3k dev, and 3k test
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2010.05444 Sections 3–4 and Appendices E and G plus the official CLUEbenchmark/OCNLI repository. The diagrams preserve the five original Chinese genres, Callhome cleanup and 8–50-character premise gate, 145 native Chinese undergraduate/graduate writers in Chinese or other language majors, the 70% lexical-overlap cap, exact SINGLE 11,986, MULTI 12,328, MULTI ENCOURAGE 16,584, and MULTI CONSTRAINT 15,627 counts, the 56,486-pair total, roughly 15% per-subset relabeling by four independent labelers plus the original label, 98.3–98.8% three-vote agreement, majority gold with no-majority “-”, the balanced 3k dev and 3k test split, about 50k training release and 30k train.small variant, Chinese NLI accuracy baselines, and the independent 300-item human study.

name: OCRBench
intro: OCRBench是一个综合性评估基准，旨在评估大型多模态模型的光学字符识别（OCR）能力。它包含29个数据集，涵盖文本识别、场景文本视觉问答、文档视觉问答、关键信息提取和手写数学表达式识别等任务。该基准包含1000个经过人工验证和校正的问题-答案对，以确保评估的准确性。研究揭示了模型在处理多语言文本、手写文本、非语义文本和数学表达式识别方面的优势和劣势。
org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Microsoft Research, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Chinese Academy of Sciences, South China University of Technology
build_method: 数据集整合, 人工筛选与校正, 任务专属提示
task_type: 视觉问答, 文本识别, 关键信息提取
eval_feature: 多任务, 多语言
scale: 1,000个问答对；29个来源数据集；5类任务
task_type_en: Visual QA, text recognition, key information extraction
build_method_en: Dataset Integration, Manual Filtering and Correction, Task-specific Prompting
eval_feature_en: Multi-task, Multilingual
intro_en: OCRBench is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark designed to assess the optical character recognition (OCR) capabilities of large multimodal models. It includes 29 datasets covering tasks such as text recognition, scene text visual question answering, document visual question answering, key information extraction, and handwritten mathematical expression recognition. The benchmark contains 1,000 manually verified and corrected question-answer pairs to ensure evaluation accuracy. Studies reveal the models' strengths and weaknesses in handling multilingual text, handwritten text, non-semantic text, and mathematical expression recognition.
scale_en: 1,000 QA pairs; 29 source datasets; five task families
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.07895 Sections 3.1 and 3.3 and Appendix A plus the official Yuliang-Liu/MultimodalOCR repository. The diagrams distinguish the broad 29-dataset study from the compact 1,000-item OCRBench release, retain the IIIT5K-based 3,000-image semantic/non-semantic controls and broad-pool filtering of answers shorter than four symbols, preserve task-specific English, Chinese, digit, KIE, and LaTeX prompts, and encode the exact final composition: 300 recognition items across six 50-item types, 200 scene-text VQA items across four 50-item sources, 200 document VQA items across four 50-item sources, 200 KIE items split 67/66/67 across SROIE/FUNSD/POIE, and 100 HME100K HMER items. All 1,000 answers are manually verified and corrected with alternatives, and scoring checks gold-answer containment before summing five component counts to a maximum of 1,000.

name: OCRBench v2
intro: OCRBench v2 是面向大多模态模型的高难度双语视觉文本基准，聚焦单图场景，覆盖31个场景、八类OCR能力和23项任务。公开集包含10,000个经人工核验的问答对，另有1,500张人工收集并标注、用于抗污染排行榜评测的私有图像。
org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, South China University of Technology, University of Adelaide, ByteDance
build_method: 数据集整合, 人工核验, 私有测试集
task_type: OCR, 文本定位, 结构解析, 视觉文本推理
eval_feature: 双语, 23项任务, 31个场景, 多指标
scale: 10,000个公开问答对 + 1,500张私有图像；23项任务；31个场景
task_type_en: OCR, text localization, structured parsing, visual text reasoning
build_method_en: Dataset Integration, Human Verification, Private Test Set
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, 23 Tasks, 31 Scenarios, Task-routed Metrics
intro_en: OCRBench v2 is a high-difficulty bilingual visual-text benchmark for large multimodal models. It focuses on single-image settings and spans 31 scenarios, eight OCR capabilities, and 23 tasks. The public set contains 10,000 human-verified QA pairs, accompanied by 1,500 manually collected and annotated private images for contamination-resistant leaderboard evaluation.
scale_en: 10,000 public QA pairs + 1,500 private images; 23 tasks; 31 scenarios
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.00321 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A.2–A.6 plus the official MultimodalOCR repository and OCRBench v2 project. The diagrams preserve the single-image scope, 81 screened academic datasets plus private data, 31 scenarios, 23 tasks grouped into eight capabilities, bilingual instructions, structured Markdown/JSON/LaTeX outputs, coordinate normalization to 0–1,000, manual annotation of added images, review of every public instruction and correction of about 1% annotation errors, the 10,000 human-verified public QA pairs with 7,400 English and 2,600 Chinese images, and the separate withheld 1,500-image human-annotated private test set. Evaluation routes parsing to TEDS, localization to IoU, relation extraction to F1, long reading to the mean of BLEU/METEOR/F1/normalized edit distance, counting to exact match or normalized L1, and basic VQA to exact match, containment, or ANLS before averaging eight capability scores on a 0–100 scale.

name: OctoBench
intro: OctoBench 是面向代码智能体指令遵循的可执行基准：它把代码库策略、技能文档、系统与用户提示、记忆、工具模式及提醒打包进 34 个自包含环境，以 217 个任务和 7,098 项二元检查同时衡量任务成功与跨来源约束遵循。
build_method: 人工种子编写, 模型辅助扩展, 人机联合检查表审计
modality: 文本, 代码, 工具轨迹
task_type: 代码智能体任务, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 可执行环境, 细粒度二元检查, 多评审轨迹判定
scale: 34个环境；217个任务；7,098项二元检查；另含32个冲突实例
build_method_en: Human Seed Authoring, Model-assisted Expansion, Joint Human-LLM Checklist Audit
eval_feature_en: Executable Environments, Fine-grained Binary Checks, Multi-judge Trajectory Grading
intro_en: OctoBench is an executable benchmark for instruction-following coding agents. It packages repository policies, skill documents, system and user prompts, memory, tool schemas, and reminders into 34 self-contained environments, using 217 tasks and 7,098 binary checks to measure both task success and compliance with constraints from every source.
scale_en: 34 environments; 217 tasks; 7,098 binary checks; plus 32 conflict instances
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.10343 Sections 3–5 and the official MiniMaxAI/OctoBench dataset. The diagrams preserve the seven instruction-source families, self-contained Docker environments, three scaffolds, 72 manually authored seed instances, model-assisted expansion to 217 tasks, 16 independent GPT-5.1 reference rollouts per task, atomic evidence-backed binary checks, checklist deduplication and harmonization, joint human-LLM review, 20% manual spot check and stratified double-annotator audit, the 34-environment/7,098-check main release, and the paper's separate 32-instance conflict set. Evaluation uses full proxy-logged trajectories normalized into messages and tools, three independent judges, and both all-applicable-check ISR and check-level CSR.

name: ODVBench
l2: 在线自动驾驶视频理解
intro: ODV-Bench 是 StreamForest 论文提出的在线自动驾驶视频理解基准，使用1,190段第一视角驾驶视频构建6,322个多选问答，覆盖静态目标、动态目标和多智能体交互事件三类场景下的12项实时感知、历史记忆、未来预测与风险推理任务。
org: Nanjing University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Zhejiang University, Noah’s Ark Lab at Huawei, Yinwang Intelligent Technology
build_method: 半自动标注, 人工核验, 模板生成
task_type: 在线自动驾驶视频理解, 时空感知, 未来预测
eval_feature: 流式因果约束, 12项任务, 分层准确率
task_type_en: Online autonomous-driving video understanding, spatiotemporal perception, future prediction
build_method_en: Semi-automatic Annotation, Human Verification, Template Generation
eval_feature_en: Causal Streaming Constraint, 12 Tasks, Hierarchical Accuracy
intro_en: ODV-Bench is the online autonomous-driving video-understanding benchmark introduced with StreamForest. It builds 6,322 multiple-choice QA pairs from 1,190 first-person driving clips and covers 12 real-time perception, past-memory, future-prediction, and risk-reasoning tasks across static targets, dynamic targets, and multi-agent interaction events.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.24871 Section 4, Section 5.1, Appendix C, and the official MCG-NJU/StreamForest repository. The diagrams preserve collection from six autonomous-driving datasets, semi-automatic annotation/YOLO filtering plus manual video selection, direct conversion of strong labels versus VLLM+YOLO coarse meta-annotations followed by structured human verification, and the exact three-category statistics: static 247 clips/1,639 questions, dynamic 162/2,973, and event 781/1,710. They retain all 12 tasks, template-based QA generation from fine-grained meta-annotations, option-pool distractors with two to four choices, multiple manual review rounds, video-length-proportional balancing, the final 1,190 unique 5–90-second clips and 6,322 QA pairs with an 18.9-second mean query time, and causal 1-FPS online evaluation using only content available before each query timestamp, with task/category/overall accuracy.

name: OfficeQA
intro: OfficeQA（OfficeQA Full）以 1939–2025 年美国财政部公报为语料，覆盖约 89,000 页和超过 2,600 万个数值。246 道文档落地问题经独立复现、第三方裁决、两轮智能体问答复核与参数知识过滤后，分为 113 道 Easy 和 133 道 Pro。
build_method: 人工命题, 独立答案复现, 智能体辅助双轮质检
metric: 确定性正确率（精确匹配或绝对相对误差）
modality: 文本, PDF文档, 表格, 图表
task_type: 文档问答, 检索增强Agent任务
eval_feature: 真实文档检索, 多页推理, 确定性评分
scale: 246道问题（113 Easy + 133 Pro）；约89,000页；超过2,600万数值
build_method_en: Human Question Authoring, Independent Answer Reproduction, Two-round Agent-assisted QA
eval_feature_en: Real-document Retrieval, Multi-page Reasoning, Deterministic Grading
intro_en: OfficeQA (OfficeQA Full) is grounded in U.S. Treasury Bulletins from 1939–2025, spanning about 89,000 pages and more than 26 million numeric values. Its 246 document-grounded questions undergo independent answer reproduction, third-party adjudication, two rounds of agent-assisted QA, and parametric-knowledge filtering before being split into 113 Easy and 133 Pro questions.
scale_en: 246 questions (113 Easy + 133 Pro); about 89,000 pages; more than 26M numeric values
metric_en: Deterministic Accuracy (Exact Match or Absolute Relative Error)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.08655 and the official databricks/officeqa repository. The diagrams preserve the 1939–2025 Treasury Bulletin corpus (about 89,000 pages and over 26M numeric values), removal of embedded text layers, realistic multi-step question criteria, expert seed authoring and scaled annotation, USAFacts topical review, independent answer reproduction with third-annotator adjudication, two end-to-end agent-QA rounds with human conflict review, Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 parametric-knowledge filtering, and the final 246-question OfficeQA Full split into 113 Easy and 133 Pro questions based on two frontier agents. Evaluation retrieves original or OCR/parsed PDFs and uses deterministic normalization plus exact or absolute-relative-error grading with a default 0.0% threshold.

name: OfficeQA Pro
intro: OfficeQA Pro 是 OfficeQA Full 的 133 道困难子集，来源于同一套 1939–2025 年美国财政部公报；当两个前沿智能体都无法借助解析文档正确回答时，问题才进入 Pro。它强调跨公报、联网、视觉和超越基础算术的复杂分析。
build_method: 人工命题, 独立答案复现, 双智能体难度筛选
metric: 确定性正确率（精确匹配或绝对相对误差）
modality: 文本, PDF文档, 表格, 图表
task_type: 高难文档问答, 检索增强Agent任务
eval_feature: 多文档推理, 外部检索, 视觉与高级分析
scale: 133道困难问题；同源语料约89,000页、超过2,600万数值
task_type_en: Hard Document QA, Retrieval-augmented Agent Tasks
build_method_en: Human Question Authoring, Independent Answer Reproduction, Two-agent Difficulty Filtering
eval_feature_en: Multi-document Reasoning, External Retrieval, Visual and Advanced Analysis
intro_en: OfficeQA Pro is the 133-question hard subset of OfficeQA Full, grounded in the same U.S. Treasury Bulletin corpus from 1939–2025. A question enters Pro only when both frontier agents fail to answer it correctly using the parsed documents; the subset emphasizes cross-bulletin, web, visual, and beyond-basic-arithmetic analysis.
scale_en: 133 hard questions; source corpus of about 89,000 pages and more than 26M numeric values
metric_en: Deterministic Accuracy (Exact Match or Absolute Relative Error)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.08655 and the official databricks/officeqa repository. OfficeQA Pro shares OfficeQA Full's 1939–2025 Treasury Bulletin corpus, text-layer removal, question-authoring criteria, scaled annotation, USAFacts review, independent reproduction and adjudication, two end-to-end agent-QA passes, and parametric-knowledge filter. The diagrams then preserve the distinct Pro gate: remove the 113 questions both frontier agents answer correctly from the parsed corpus and retain 133 hard questions. The released subset includes questions spanning one to more than 20 pages; the paper reports 11% using at least three bulletins, 22% requiring the web, 3% visual, and 62% beyond basic arithmetic. Grading uses the same deterministic normalization and exact or absolute-relative-error rules as OfficeQA Full.

name: OIBench
intro: OIBench 是面向强推理模型的高难度信息学奥赛基准，包含250道由资深竞赛教练原创且发布前未公开的中英文题目。每题配有难度标签、大规模测试与经执行验证的C++标准解，并以四种编程语言的全测试通过率及时间/空间完成曲线评估正确性和效率。
org: AGI-Eval, Beijing Normal University, Meituan, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
build_method: 专家原创命题, 人工复审, 可执行测试
metric: AC 通过率, 时间/空间完成曲线
task_type: 信息学奥赛, 竞赛编程, 代码效率
eval_feature: 原创抗污染, 四种编程语言, 全测试通过
scale: 250道原创双语题；含测试、难度标签与C++标准解
task_type_en: Olympiad in Informatics, competitive programming, code efficiency
build_method_en: Expert Original Problem Authoring, Human Review, Executable Tests
eval_feature_en: Original Anti-contamination Data, Four Programming Languages, All-tests-correct
intro_en: OIBench is a high-difficulty Olympiad-in-Informatics benchmark for strong reasoning models, containing 250 original Chinese and English problems authored by experienced contest coaches and kept private before release. Each problem includes difficulty tags, large official tests, and an execution-verified canonical C++ solution; evaluation measures all-tests-correct acceptance in four programming languages plus time/space completion curves.
scale_en: 250 original bilingual problems with tests, difficulty tags, and canonical C++ solutions
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.10481 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A.4 and A.9–A.10 plus the official AGI-Eval/OIBench release. The diagrams preserve problem sourcing from experienced ACM-ICPC/OI coaches’ private repositories or new authoring, strict unpublished-originality rules, Codeforces-style difficulty and competition-level tags, large and edge-focused official tests, canonical C++ solutions executed against all tests, six medal-level OI participants reviewing solvability/clarity/samples/TeX/Markdown, professional English translation using a coach-and-contestant terminology glossary, and search-engine verification that no problem was directly retrievable as of May 2025. The 250 bilingual problems are evaluated zero-shot in C++/Java/Python/JavaScript with the paper’s decoding exceptions, fixed Docker runtimes, all-tests-correct AC rate rather than pass@k, and separate time/space completion curves.

name: OJBench
intro: OJBench是一个新颖且具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在竞争级代码推理方面的能力。它包含232个来自NOI和ICPC的编程竞赛问题，为模型提供了更严格的推理技能测试。研究表明，即使是最先进的推理导向模型，也难以应对这些高挑战性的问题。这突显了模型在竞争级代码推理方面面临的重大挑战。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University
build_method: 赛事题目采集, 完整测试验证, 特殊评测过滤, 英译人工校验, 分来源难度标注
eval_feature: 无
build_method_en: Contest Problem Collection, Full-Test Validation, Special-Judge Filtering, Verified English Translation, Source-Specific Difficulty Labeling
eval_feature_en: None
intro_en: OJBench is a novel and challenging benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' abilities in competitive-level code reasoning. It includes 232 programming contest problems from NOI and ICPC, providing a more rigorous test of models' reasoning skills. Studies show that even state-of-the-art reasoning-oriented models struggle with these highly challenging problems, highlighting significant challenges in competitive-level code reasoning.
scale_en: 232 problems (159 NOI + 73 ICPC; 36 easy / 79 medium / 117 hard)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.16395v2. OJBench contains 232 problems: 159 NOI tasks sourced from Luogu and 73 ICPC tasks from the official ICPC website, each with organizer test cases. Correct contestant submissions validate the tests; incomplete or erroneous test sets and tasks with unavailable special judges are removed. GPT-4o translates NOI statements to English with manual semantic and formatting checks. NOI solver votes and ICPC acceptance-attempt statistics use separate difficulty rules, producing 36 easy, 79 medium, and 117 hard problems. Evaluation samples eight candidates in Python and C++, runs the entire official test suite, requires every case to pass, and reports Pass@1 and Pass@8 by language and difficulty.

name: OK-VQA
intro: OK-VQA 是需要图像之外知识的开放式视觉问答基准。研究者从 COCO 图像出发，经两轮众包、人工外部知识筛选、答案频率与零一致性过滤，构建 14,055 个问题；每题保留五个答案并标注知识类别。
org: Carnegie Mellon University, Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: 两轮众包, 人工知识需求筛选, 多标注员类别标注
eval_feature: 外部知识, 开放式答案, 知识类别分解
build_method_en: Two-round Crowdsourcing, Manual Knowledge-need Filtering, Multi-annotator Category Labeling
eval_feature_en: External Knowledge, Open-ended Answers, Knowledge-category Breakdown
intro_en: OK-VQA is an open-ended visual question answering benchmark that requires knowledge beyond the image. Starting from COCO images, the authors use two crowdsourcing rounds, manual external-knowledge screening, answer-frequency filtering, and zero-agreement removal to construct 14,055 questions, retaining five answers and a knowledge-category label for each question.
scale_en: 14,055 questions; 14,031 images; five answers per question
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.00067 Sections 3–4 and the official OK-VQA project. The diagrams preserve random sampling from COCO train/validation images, first-round MTurk question authoring under explicit external-knowledge rules, five independent answers per pair in round two, manual filtering from 86,700 candidates to 34,921 knowledge-dependent questions, removal of counting/detection and nonsensical items, answer-frequency bias control, removal of zero-agreement questions, the 9,009-train/5,046-test split totaling 14,055 questions over 14,031 images, and plurality knowledge-category labels from five workers. Evaluation follows the official open-ended VQA metric, counts each of five answers twice to match the ten-answer convention, applies Porter stemming, and reports both overall and category scores.

name: OlmoBaseEval
intro: OlmoBaseEval 是 OLMo 3 为基础模型预训练与中训练决策构建的 43 任务评测套件。它以 2.3 万条外部模型结果、层次聚类、缩放相关性与信噪比实验筛选任务，形成 Base Easy 和 Base Main，并保留四项发布前未使用的独立留出基准。
build_method: 任务池构建, 排名层次聚类, 缩放与信噪比筛选
metric: 能力簇宏平均（BPB, Accuracy, F1, pass@k）
task_type: 基础模型综合评测, 问答, 数学, 代码
eval_feature: 预训练决策, 计算缩放, 能力簇聚合, 独立留出集
scale: 43项任务；Base Easy与Base Main；四项独立留出基准
build_method_en: Candidate Pool Construction, Ranking-based Hierarchical Clustering, Scaling and SNR Selection
eval_feature_en: Pretraining Decisions, Compute Scaling, Capability-cluster Aggregation, Independent Held-out Set
intro_en: OlmoBaseEval is the 43-task suite built by OLMo 3 for base-model pretraining and midtraining decisions. It selects tasks using 23K external-model results, hierarchical clustering, scaling correlation, and signal-to-noise experiments, yielding Base Easy and Base Main while reserving four independent benchmarks that were not used before release.
scale_en: 43 tasks; Base Easy and Base Main; four independent held-out benchmarks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.13961's OlmoBaseEval methodology and the official allenai/olmes toolkit. The diagrams preserve the goal of low-noise, compute-efficient pretraining and midtraining decisions; broad candidate coverage; a 23K-result pool from 70 external open-weight models; Ward hierarchical clustering over model-ranking similarity; manual format alignment and the MC STEM/non-STEM split; scaling analysis with 25 OLMo 2 scaling models; Base Easy BPB proxies and Base Main headroom; signal-to-noise experiments with the final 50 OLMo 2 13B checkpoints, ten comparable external checkpoints, and repeated preliminary runs; full-set refinements; BasicSkills, Gen2MC, 17-language MBPP, and masked-perplexity additions; and the final 43-task Base Easy/Base Main suite. MMLU Pro, DeepMind Math, LBPP, and BigBench Hard remain an independent held-out set unused before release. Evaluation pins OLMES/vLLM task configurations and reports BPB, accuracy, F1, pass@k, and capability-cluster macro-averages.

name: olmOCR-bench
intro: olmOCR-Bench 是用于评估 PDF 文档提取系统的单元测试基准。发布版包含 1,403 份高难 PDF 和 7,010 项二元测试，覆盖文本存在/缺失、自然阅读顺序、表格关系、数学公式以及基础输出健全性，并按七类文档来源宏平均。
build_method: 七类来源筛选, 人机协同单元测试编写, 人工复核, URL去污染
metric: Binary unit-test pass rate, Document-source macro average
eval_feature: 7类文档来源, 5类内容测试, 基线健全性测试, 二元评分, 来源宏平均
build_method_en: Seven-source curation, human-and-model unit-test authoring, manual review, URL decontamination
eval_feature_en: Seven document sources, five content-test categories, baseline sanity tests, binary scoring, source macro average
intro_en: olmOCR-Bench is a unit-test benchmark for PDF document extraction systems. The released benchmark contains 1,403 challenging PDFs and 7,010 binary tests spanning text presence and absence, natural reading order, table relationships, mathematical formulas, and baseline output sanity, with macro-averaging across seven document sources.
