    C1 --> D1[olmOCR识别TeX页面] --> E1[匹配原始TeX源] --> F1[ValidationKaTeX渲染兼容性] --> G1[手动Validation测试用例]
    C2 --> D2[olmOCR查找公式页面] --> E2[手动标注公式作为测试用例]
    C3 --> D3[Gemini-Flash-2.0提示表格关系] --> E3[手动审查准确性]
    C4 --> D4[脚本生成自然阅读顺序用例] --> E4[手动添加页眉页脚排除用例] --> F4[人工二次审查准确性]
    C5 --> D5[DocLayout-YOLO识别页眉页脚区域] --> E5[视觉遮罩后Gemini-Flash-2.0提取内容] --> F5[手动审查和设置条件]
    C6 --> D6[Claude-Sonnet-3.7渲染为HTML] --> E6[从HTML提取文本段] --> F6[手动审查准确性]
    C7 --> D7[Gemini-Flash-2.0生成测试用例] --> E7[手动Validation]

    G1 & E2 & E3 & F4 & F5 & F6 & E7 --> H[合并测试用例]
    H --> I{Quality Control: 移除PII/非公开文档}
    I --> J{去污: URL级别去重}
    J --> K[定义5种单元测试类别]
    K --> L1[文本存在: Validation文本段识别]
    K --> L2[文本缺失: Validation外围内容排除]
    K --> L3[自然阅读顺序: Validation文本段顺序]
    K --> L4[表格准确性: 检查表格内容和单元格属性]
    K --> L5[数学公式准确性: 检查数学方程存在]
    K --> L6[基线: 默认文本Output检查]
    L1 & L2 & L3 & L4 & L5 & L6 --> M[应用字符串归一化]
    M --> N(Final Dataset: 1,403个PDF, 7,010项单元测试)
    N --> O[Evaluation: 运行工具生成文本]
    O --> P[评分: Pass/Fail测试, 按文档类型宏平均]
    P --> Q(最终分数: 各测试源百分比平均值)
metric_en: Binary unit-test pass rate, Document-source macro average
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Curate 1,403 PDFs from seven challenging document sources"] --> B["Write and manually verify 7,010 binary unit tests"]
    B --> C["Run an OCR system and normalize its Markdown or plain-text output"]
    C --> D["Apply sanity, presence, absence, reading-order, table, and formula tests"]
    D --> E["Compute binary pass rates for each document source"]
    E --> F["Macro-average source scores and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从七类高难文档来源筛选1,403份PDF"] --> B["编写并人工核验7,010项二元单元测试"]
    B --> C["运行OCR系统并规范化Markdown或纯文本输出"]
    C --> D["执行健全性、存在、缺失、阅读顺序、表格和公式测试"]
    D --> E["按文档来源计算二元通过率"]
    E --> F["对来源分数宏平均并Bootstrap 95%置信区间"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.18443v3 Section 3 and Appendix F.1 plus the released olmOCR-Bench dataset. Seven sources cover arXiv math, old-scan math, tables, old scans, headers and footers, multi-column pages, and long tiny text. Source-specific human, LLM-assisted, and scripted tests are manually verified; documents containing PII or lacking public-distribution permission are removed; URLs are deduplicated against olmOCR-mix-0225. The release contains 1,403 PDFs and 7,010 tests: 721 text-presence, 823 text-absence, 1,061 reading-order, 1,020 table, and 3,385 formula tests, plus baseline sanity checks. OCR output is normalized before binary scoring, source pass rates are macro-averaged, and results use bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. One paper prose location says 1,402 distinct PDFs, while the v3 release table and current release use 1,403; the diagram follows the release total.

name: OlympiadBench
intro: OlympiadBench是一个奥林匹克级别的双语多模态科学基准，包含8476道数学和物理竞赛题目，其中包括中国高考题。该基准配备专家级逐步推理注释，旨在评估大型语言模型和多模态模型的高级能力，以应对传统基准日益严峻的挑战。
build_method: 官方竞赛PDF整理, Mathpix OCR与人工校核, 专家解答和标签标注
metric: Accuracy（数值与符号等价自动评分）
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答, 定理证明
eval_feature: 双语, 多模态, 专家级逐步解答, 数值与符号等价判分
task_type_en: Math Problems, Open-ended QA, Theorem Proving
build_method_en: Official Competition PDFs, Mathpix OCR and Manual Verification, Expert Solutions and Labels
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, multimodal, expert step-by-step solutions, numeric and symbolic equivalence scoring
intro_en: OlympiadBench is an Olympiad-level bilingual multimodal science benchmark containing 8,476 math and physics competition problems, including Chinese Gaokao questions. It features expert-level step-by-step reasoning annotations and aims to evaluate the advanced capabilities of large language models and multimodal models in addressing the increasing challenges of traditional benchmarks.
metric_en: Accuracy with automatic numeric and symbolic equivalence scoring
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.14008 and the official OpenBMB/OlympiadBench repository. The diagrams preserve collection from global math and physics Olympiads, Chinese regional/national competitions, and Gaokao/mock exams; official PDF acquisition; Mathpix OCR to Markdown with embedded images; manual source comparison and scientific-notation repair; Problem-Solution-Answer structuring with expert reasoning; math-language-model embeddings and cosine-similarity deduplication; manual topic, subfield, and open/theorem-proof labels; progressive physics context preservation; definitive answer types; bilingual multimodal prompt construction; the 8,476-problem release with 100% solutions, 6,728 open-ended and 1,748 theorem-proving problems, and 4,869 image-bearing problems; numeric tolerance at 1e-8, equation normalization, element checks, and SymPy equivalence. Theorem-proof results are kept separate because the official automatic scorer does not cover them.

name: OlympicArena
intro: OlympicArena 是覆盖七个科学领域的双语多模态奥林匹克推理基准，收录62项竞赛的11,163道题，并以答案级和过程级协议评估模型的认知推理与视觉推理能力。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Soochow University, GAIR
build_method: 公开竞赛材料整理, Mathpix与人工标注, 多轮验证和模型辅助能力标签
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 数学问题, 多学科推理
eval_feature: 双语, 多学科, 答案级与过程级评测, 认知与视觉推理标签
build_method_en: Public Competition Materials, Mathpix and Human Annotation, Multi-round Validation and Model-assisted Skill Labels
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, multidisciplinary, answer- and process-level evaluation, cognitive and visual reasoning labels
intro_en: OlympicArena is a bilingual multimodal Olympiad reasoning benchmark spanning seven scientific fields. It contains 11,163 problems from 62 competitions and evaluates cognitive and visual reasoning with answer-level and process-level protocols.
scale_en: 11,163 problems, 62 competitions, 7 fields, 7,571 images, 13 answer types
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.12753 and the official GAIR-NLP/OlympicArena repository. The diagrams preserve public PDF sourcing from 62 Olympiad competitions across seven fields; licensed problem and solution collection and CS test cases; Mathpix Markdown conversion; extraction by about 30 STEM students through the released annotation interface; multi-step validation; within-competition and same-year embedding deduplication; GPT-4V cognitive-difficulty labels with manual verification; eight logical and five visual reasoning categories; the 11,163-problem release with 7,571 images, 13 answer types, and 7,904 solved problems; splits of 548 OlympicArena-ot problems, 638 validation problems with steps, and the remaining official test set; image, caption, and text-only zero-shot settings; rule matching, CS pass@k, and GPT-4V answer judging with manual sampling; plus the 96-problem process evaluation with GPT-4/GPT-4V step scoring and 83% inter-annotator agreement.

name: OmniBench
intro: OmniBench 是要求同时结合图像与音频信息作答的三模态理解基准，包含1,142道四选一问答，覆盖语音、声音事件和音乐三类场景及八类任务。
org: M-A-P, University of Manchester, Queen Mary University of London, 01.AI, HKUST, Nanjing University, Dartmouth College
build_method: 人工三模态问答标注, 交叉质检, 模型辅助单模态可解性过滤
modality: 图像, 音频, 文本
task_type: 三模态理解, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 图像与音频联合必要性, 单模态消融, 人类音乐家基线
build_method_en: Human Tri-modal QA Annotation, Cross-inspection, Model-assisted Unimodal-solvability Filtering
eval_feature_en: Joint image-audio necessity, single-modality ablations, human musician baseline
intro_en: OmniBench is a tri-modal understanding benchmark whose questions require jointly using image and audio evidence. It contains 1,142 four-option QA pairs across speech, sound events, and music, organized into eight task types.
scale_en: 1,142 QA pairs, 3 primary categories, 8 task types
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2409.15272 and the official multimodal-art-projection/OmniBench repository. The diagrams preserve the image-audio-text input and textual-answer contract; three primary categories and eight task types; 16 annotators and five quality inspectors; four-option questions with one correct answer and at least one confusing distractor; the requirement that both image and audio are necessary; minimum 480p images, audio clips of at most 30 seconds, and source/speaker/question repetition limits; transcripts or music captions plus modality-specific rationales; human cross-inspection with revision reasons; three repeated LLaVA-1.6-34B limited-information checks over image-plus-text, transcript-plus-text, and text-only inputs; revision, recycling, or discard of solvable items; the 1,142-question release across speech, sound events, and music; full tri-modal answer-letter accuracy; image/audio ablations and textual approximations; and the human-musician baseline. Video is excluded because it is not a benchmark input modality.

name: OmniDocBench
intro: OmniDocBench 是面向多样 PDF 文档解析的细粒度基准。它从 20 多万份 PDF 中经视觉聚类和属性平衡筛出 981 页，覆盖九类文档、19 类版面元素、15 个属性标签和超过 10 万条标注，并支持端到端、逐任务和逐属性评测。
build_method: 视觉聚类抽样, 半自动预标注, 人工逐字符修订, 专家质检
modality: 文本, 图像, 文档
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
task_type: 文档解析, OCR, 版面分析
eval_feature: 端到端评测, 逐任务评测, 逐属性评测
scale: 981个PDF页面, 9种文档类型, 19类版面元素, 15个属性标签, 10万+标注
build_method_en: Visual Clustering and Sampling, Semi-automatic Pre-annotation, Character-level Human Revision, Expert Quality Control
eval_feature_en: End-to-end Evaluation, Task-level Evaluation, Attribute-level Evaluation
intro_en: OmniDocBench is a fine-grained benchmark for diverse PDF document parsing. It selects 981 pages from more than 200,000 PDFs through visual clustering and attribute balancing, covers nine document types, 19 layout-element classes, 15 attribute labels, and over 100,000 annotations, and supports end-to-end, task-level, and attribute-level evaluation.
scale_en: 981 PDF pages, 9 document types, 19 layout classes, 15 attribute labels, 100K+ annotations
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.07626 and the official OpenDataLab/OmniDocBench project. The diagrams preserve the collection of more than 200,000 PDFs from Common Crawl, Google, Baidu, and internal sources; ResNet-50 visual features and ten-center Faiss clustering; 6,000 annotation candidates; page-attribute balancing to 981 pages across nine document types; LayoutLMv3, PaddleOCR, UniMERNet, and GPT-4o pre-annotations; 19 layout classes, reading order and element relationships, Unicode text, LaTeX formulae, and HTML/LaTeX tables; character-level human correction; CDM rendering checks and three-researcher review; the release of more than 100,000 annotations and 15 attribute labels; Markdown preprocessing, adjacency and fuzzy matching, ignore rules, and text, table, formula, and reading-order metrics.

name: OmniMedVQA
intro: OmniMedVQA 是大规模综合医学视觉问答基准，由 73 个真实医学图像分类数据集构建，含 118,010 张图像和 127,995 条问答，覆盖 12 种成像模态、20 多个解剖区域和五类问题。
org: University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Southeast University
build_method: 医学分类数据模板化, 反比例平衡采样, GPT-3.5改写与干扰项生成, 人工双重检查
eval_feature: 问答生成分数与前缀似然分数双轨评测, 五类医学能力与模态分析
scale: 118,010张图像, 127,995条问答, 73个源数据集, 12种模态, 20+解剖区域
build_method_en: Medical Classification Template Conversion, Inverse-proportional Sampling, GPT-3.5 Rewriting and Distractor Generation, Human Double Check
eval_feature_en: Dual Question-answering and Prefix-likelihood Scores, Five Medical Capabilities and Modality Analysis
intro_en: OmniMedVQA is a large-scale comprehensive medical visual-question-answering benchmark built from 73 real medical image-classification datasets. It contains 118,010 images and 127,995 QA items across 12 imaging modalities, more than 20 anatomical regions, and five question types.
scale_en: 118,010 images, 127,995 QA items, 73 source datasets, 12 modalities, 20+ anatomical regions
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.09181 and the official OmniMedVQA release. The diagrams preserve 73 real medical classification datasets, 12 imaging modalities, more than 20 anatomical regions, dataset-specific QA templates, inverse-proportional template sampling, five question types, GPT-3.5 semantic-preserving question reformulation, two-to-four-option distractor generation, human double checking, the 118,010-image and 127,995-item release, image-question-option prompts, free-form response-to-option similarity for Question-answering Score, per-option visual-prefix likelihood for Prefix-based Score, ground-truth comparison, and separate zero-shot reporting across question types and overall.

name: OneIG-Bench
intro: OneIG-Bench 是面向文生图模型的双语细粒度基准，包含动漫与风格、人像、通用物体、文本渲染、知识推理和多语种六个提示集合，并自动评测语义对齐、文本渲染、推理、风格和多样性。
build_method: 真实提示整理, 聚类平衡与语义去重, GPT-4o长度改写, 人工审核与中文翻译核验
metric: Semantic Alignment, Text Score, Reasoning Score, Style Score, Diversity Score
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
eval_feature: 五维自动评测, 中英文对比, 提示类型与长度细分分析
scale: 2,440条提示记录：1,120条英文及其中文版本，另含200条多语种提示
build_method_en: Real-world Prompt Curation, Clustering and Semantic Deduplication, GPT-4o Length Rewriting, Manual Review and Verified Chinese Translation
eval_feature_en: Five-dimensional Automated Evaluation, English-Chinese Comparison, Prompt-type and Length Analysis
intro_en: OneIG-Bench is a bilingual fine-grained benchmark for text-to-image models. It contains six prompt sets for anime and stylization, portrait, general objects, text rendering, knowledge and reasoning, and multilingualism, and automatically evaluates semantic alignment, text rendering, reasoning, style, and diversity.
scale_en: 2,440 prompt records: 1,120 English prompts and their Chinese counterparts, plus 200 multilingual prompts
metric_en: Semantic Alignment, Text Score, Reasoning Score, Style Score, Diversity Score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.07977, the official OneIG-Bench project page, dataset, and evaluation code. The diagrams preserve five core evaluation dimensions; prompt curation from public internet data, user inputs, and established datasets; scene and semantic clustering, cosine-similarity deduplication, and subset balancing; GPT-4o rewriting into short, medium, and long prompts at about a 1:2:1 ratio; manual sensitive-content and semantic-conflict review; verified Chinese translation and 200 additional multilingual prompts; six prompt sets totaling 1,120 English and 1,320 Chinese records; category-based image generation; DSG question graphs with GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-VL-7B conditional leaf scoring; text edit distance, completion rate, and word accuracy; GPT-4o/LLM2CLIP reasoning, dual-encoder style similarity, DreamSim diversity, and bilingual fine-grained reporting.

name: OneMillion-Bench
intro: OneMillion-Bench 是覆盖金融、法律、医疗、自然科学和工业五大领域的高经济价值专业智能体基准。400 个中英文任务由领域专家通过三阶段流程构建，并经多模型对抗筛选、同行评审、第三专家仲裁和难度双向截断。
build_method: 三阶段多专家标注, 前沿智能体对抗筛选, 难度双向截断, 专家量规与负向惩罚
metric: Expert Score, Pass Rate, Economic Value
eval_feature: 逐标准专家量规, -20至10非对称权重, 能力标签与领域聚合
scale: 400个任务, 5个领域, 37个子域, 92个三级类别；英文全球集与中文本地集各200题
intro_en: OneMillion-Bench is a high-economic-value professional-agent benchmark spanning finance, law, healthcare, natural science, and industry. Its 400 English and Chinese tasks are built through a three-stage domain-expert pipeline with multi-agent adversarial filtering, peer review, third-expert resolution, and bidirectional difficulty truncation.
build_method_en: Three-stage Multi-expert Annotation, Frontier-agent Adversarial Filtering, Bidirectional Difficulty Truncation, Expert Rubrics with Negative Penalties
metric_en: Expert Score, Pass Rate, Economic Value
eval_feature_en: Criterion-level Expert Rubrics, Asymmetric -20-to-10 Weights, Capability Tags and Domain Aggregation
scale_en: 400 tasks, 5 domains, 37 subdomains, 92 tertiary categories; 200 English Global and 200 Chinese local-context tasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.07980 and the official OneMillion-Bench dataset. The diagrams preserve five professional domains, 37 subdomains, and 92 tertiary categories; expert task, reference-answer, and rubric creation; semi-open, multi-solution, time-invariant design; concurrent adversarial validation across frontier-agent families; independent same-subdomain peer review and consensus revision; third-expert resolution of risky or disputed cases; lower-bound elimination and upper-bound review; rubric criteria, asymmetric -20-to-10 weights, capability tags, and verified sources; the 400-task bilingual release with 200 English Global and 200 China-specific tasks; vanilla, search-enabled, and deep-research systems; Web Search, Reasoning, Verbalization, and Instruction Following rubric tags; weighted clipped Expert Score, Pass Rate, balanced domain aggregation, and estimated economic value.

name: Oolong
intro: Oolong 是专门评测长上下文信息聚合而非简单检索的基准，包含受控合成的 Oolong-synth 和基于 Critical Role 转写及 CritRoleStats 真值的 Oolong-real。合成上下文覆盖 1K 至 4M token，真实上下文覆盖 55K 至 1.3M token。
build_method: 分类数据原子难度过滤, 合成长上下文与元信息, 真实节目转写和人工统计真值整合
metric: Exact Match, Numeric Partial Credit, Set Overlap
task_type: 分类, 计数, 关系推理, 时间推理
eval_feature: 长上下文聚合, 计数, 用户交叉引用, 时序推理, 按长度分析
scale: Oolong-synth：10个源分类数据集、1K至4M token；Oolong-real：1至24集、55K至1.3M token
task_type_en: Classification, Counting, Relational Reasoning, Temporal Reasoning
build_method_en: Atomic-difficulty Filtering over Classification Data, Synthetic Long-context and Metadata Construction, Real Transcript and Human-statistic Integration
eval_feature_en: Long-context Aggregation, Counting, User Cross-reference, Temporal Reasoning, Length-wise Analysis
intro_en: Oolong targets long-context information aggregation rather than simple retrieval. It combines controlled Oolong-synth tasks with Oolong-real tasks grounded in Critical Role transcripts and CritRoleStats human gold records. Synthetic contexts span 1K to 4M tokens and real contexts span 55K to 1.3M tokens.
scale_en: Oolong-synth: 10 source classification datasets and 1K–4M tokens; Oolong-real: 1–24 episodes and 55K–1.3M tokens
metric_en: Exact Match, Numeric Partial Credit, Set Overlap
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.02817, the official abertsch72/oolong repository, and the released Oolong dataset cards. The diagrams preserve the aggregation-focused task definition; ten two-to-ten-label classification sources; dual-model atomic-difficulty filtering with GPT-4.1 nano and Llama 4 Maverick; 80/20-skewed user IDs and dates uniformly distributed across forty months; 1K-to-4M-token synthetic contexts filled to about 95% and reused for 25 questions; counting, user cross-reference, and temporal questions; CRD3 Critical Role transcripts and CritRoleStats dice/spell gold records; one-to-twenty-four-episode real contexts spanning 55K to 1.3M tokens; prompt ordering; boxed and fallback parsing including GPT-5-nano for real answers; exact, 0.75-to-absolute-error numeric, and set-overlap scoring; random baselines; and length- and task-wise reporting through the paper main study at 128K.

name: OpenAI-Proof Q&A
intro: OpenAI-Proof Q&A 是 OpenAI 的闭源内部评测，包含20个真实研究与工程瓶颈。每个问题都曾使重大项目至少延误一天，并需要 OpenAI 团队超过一天才能解决；被测模型在提供历史代码、日志、实验数据和运行工件的容器中诊断并解释根因。
build_method: 内部高影响瓶颈筛选, 历史代码日志实验数据和运行工件打包, 容器化闭源评测
modality: 文本, 代码, 日志, 指标, 运行工件
task_type: Agent诊断, 研究工程调试, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 真实内部瓶颈, 历史证据容器, 根因诊断, 评分器细节未公开
modality_en: Text, Code, Logs, Metrics, Run Artifacts
task_type_en: Agent Diagnosis, Research and Engineering Debugging, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Internal High-impact Bottleneck Curation, Historical Code Log Experiment-data and Run-artifact Packaging, Closed Container Evaluation
eval_feature_en: Real Internal Bottlenecks, Historical-evidence Container, Root-cause Diagnosis, Undisclosed Grader Details
intro_en: OpenAI-Proof Q&A is a closed internal OpenAI evaluation of 20 real research and engineering bottlenecks. Each problem caused at least a one-day delay to a major project and required an OpenAI team more than a day to solve; evaluated models diagnose and explain the root cause in a container with historical code, logs, experiment data, and run artifacts.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Section 5.1.3.4 and Table 8 of the official GPT-5.2-Codex system-card addendum. The diagrams preserve the twenty internal research and engineering bottlenecks; the requirement that each took an OpenAI team more than one day to solve and caused at least a one-day delay to a major project; examples spanning performance regressions, anomalous training metrics, and subtle implementation bugs; the evaluation container with historical code, logs, experiment data, and run artifacts; diagnosis and explanation as the target behavior; and pass@1 as the reported metric. The official source does not disclose task-authoring details, generation settings, rubric, or grader implementation, so the diagrams label these boundaries instead of inventing them. The previous GPQA-derived fallback flow was removed as unrelated.

name: OpenAudioBench
intro: OpenAudioBench 是 Baichuan-Audio 论文发布的音频理解基准，包含自建 Reasoning QA 202题、Spoken Llama Questions 300题、随机抽样的 Web Questions 1,000题与 TriviaQA 1,000题，以及经过子集筛选并移除数学和代码问题的 AlpacaEval 199题，共2,701题。评测分别覆盖语音转文本与非级联语音转语音设置。
build_method: 自建音频推理题, 公开问答子集抽样与筛选, 作者TTS语音合成
task_type: 开放式问答, 逻辑推理, 常识问答
eval_feature: 五个音频子集, 语音转文本与语音转语音, GPT-4o参考答案或开放式评分
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Logical Reasoning, Commonsense QA
build_method_en: Self-constructed Audio Reasoning, Public QA Subset Sampling and Filtering, Author TTS Speech Synthesis
eval_feature_en: Five Audio Components, Speech-to-text and Speech-to-speech, GPT-4o Reference-based or Open-ended Judging
intro_en: OpenAudioBench is the audio-understanding benchmark released with Baichuan-Audio. It contains 202 self-constructed Reasoning QA items, 300 Spoken Llama Questions, random samples of 1,000 Web Questions and 1,000 TriviaQA items, and 199 filtered AlpacaEval items after removing math and code questions, for 2,701 items total. Evaluation covers speech-to-text and non-cascaded speech-to-speech settings.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Section 4.3 of arXiv:2502.17239 and the official baichuan-inc/OpenAudioBench dataset card. The diagrams preserve Reasoning QA (202), Spoken Llama Questions (300), Web Questions (1,000), TriviaQA (1,000), and AlpacaEval (199); random sampling for Web Questions and TriviaQA; selection of helpful-base and vicuna AlpacaEval subsets with math and code removed; TTS synthesis reported for Web Questions, TriviaQA, and AlpacaEval prompts; the 2,701-item total; speech-to-text and non-cascaded speech-to-speech settings; merging interleaved output text for speech-to-speech evaluation; reference-based GPT-4o correctness judging for Reasoning, Llama, Web, and Trivia; and GPT-4o-based scoring for AlpacaEval.

name: OpenBookQA
intro: OpenBookQA是一个模拟开卷考试的问答数据集，旨在评估对一个学科的理解能力。该数据集提供一本包含1326个基础科学事实的“开卷”，并提出约6000个问题，这些问题需要结合开卷中的事实和广泛的常识来回答。
build_method: 众包, 专家构建
eval_feature: 思维链
build_method_en: Crowdsourcing, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: OpenBookQA is an open-book exam-style QA dataset designed to assess understanding of a subject. It provides an "open book" containing 1,326 basic science facts and poses about 6,000 questions that require combining these facts with broad commonsense knowledge to answer.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1809.02789. The authors filter 2,287 WorldTree facts marked central to 1,326 general elementary-science facts. A qualified crowd worker receives a core fact f, supplies a second common fact k, derives an assertion, converts it into a question-answer pair, and adds three incorrect choices. Automatic checks require exactly four choices, no listed negation words, and uniform answer length. IR and word-association solvers must fail and their top three retrieved sentences must be insufficient; easy items are edited and retried. Five new workers answer each question and at least four must be correct. Choices are shuffled, Dev/Test receive in-house expert review, and 5,957 questions are split 4,957/500/500. Evaluation awards one point for a correct choice or 1/k for a correct answer inside a k-way tie.

name: OpenMathReasoning
intro: OpenMathReasoning 是 NVIDIA 为数学推理模型训练发布的大规模数据集，而不是独立的固定评测基准。它从 AoPS 论坛抽取并清洗问题，生成3.2M条长思维链解答、1.7M条工具集成推理解答和566K条GenSelect样例；官方数据卡已将有公开解答的问题数更正为306K，并另提供193K个仅问题样例。
build_method: AoPS问题抽取分类和去污染, 长思维链蒸馏, 迭代工具集成推理生成, GenSelect构建
metric: 数据集规模；论文下游数学准确率
task_type: 数学推理训练数据, 思维链, 工具集成推理, 解答选择
eval_feature: 训练数据集构建, 论文540K初始数量与官方306K有解问题更正并列, 下游模型评测
scale: 5,678,317行；306K个有解问题；193K个仅问题样例；3.2M CoT；1.7M TIR；566K GenSelect
task_type_en: Mathematical-reasoning Training Data, Chain of Thought, Tool-integrated Reasoning, Solution Selection
build_method_en: AoPS Problem Extraction Classification and Decontamination, Long-CoT Distillation, Iterative Tool-integrated Reasoning Generation, GenSelect Construction
eval_feature_en: Training-dataset Construction, Paper 540K Initial Count Reconciled with Official 306K Solved-problem Correction, Downstream Model Evaluation
intro_en: OpenMathReasoning is NVIDIA's large-scale training dataset for mathematical-reasoning models, not a standalone fixed evaluation benchmark. It extracts and cleans AoPS forum problems and provides 3.2M long-CoT solutions, 1.7M tool-integrated reasoning solutions, and 566K GenSelect examples. The official dataset card corrected the number of problems with released solutions to 306K and separately provides 193K problem-only examples.
scale_en: 5,678,317 rows; 306K solution-bearing problems; 193K problem-only examples; 3.2M CoT; 1.7M TIR; 566K GenSelect
metric_en: Dataset Scale; Downstream Mathematical Accuracy in the Paper
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.16891 Sections 2-4, the official nvidia/OpenMathReasoning dataset card, and NVIDIA NeMo-Skills. The diagrams preserve AoPS collection excluding Middle School Math; Qwen2.5-32B problem extraction and classification; removal of multiple-choice, binary, and invalid problems; proof conversion and answer extraction; LLM benchmark decontamination; long-CoT generation with DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B plus answer-equivalence filtering; 3.2M CoT, iterative 1.7M TIR, and 566K GenSelect records; and the open release. They explicitly reconcile the paper pipeline's initial 540K problem count with the official card correction: the card attributes the discrepancy to filtering and a pipeline bug that lost 137K proof-based questions; only the 306K solution-bearing set enters CoT/TIR, while 193K additional examples remain problem-only. OpenMathReasoning is identified as training data rather than a standalone fixed benchmark.

name: OpenRCA
intro: OpenRCA 从 AIOps Challenge 的三个真实企业系统中筛选1,753条故障记录，经规模平衡得到412条，再由三名工程师统一格式、校准标签并过滤为335个故障案例，配套68.5GB指标、日志和追踪。每题要求从遥测中识别故障时间、根因组件和根因原因的一个子集，并以全部目标要素精确匹配计算准确率。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Microsoft, Tsinghua University
build_method: 系统筛选, 数据平衡, 三名工程师数据校准, LLM查询合成与人工核验
metric: 严格根因准确率（时间、组件、原因全部匹配）
modality: 文本, 时间序列指标, 日志, 追踪图
task_type: 根因分析, Agent诊断, 开放式结构化预测
eval_feature: 七种根因目标, 68.5GB异构遥测, RCA-agent程序合成执行, 全要素精确匹配
modality_en: Text, Time-series Metrics, Logs, Trace Graphs
task_type_en: Root-cause Analysis, Agent Diagnosis, Open-ended Structured Prediction
build_method_en: System Selection, Dataset Balancing, Three-engineer Data Calibration, LLM Query Synthesis and Human Verification
eval_feature_en: Seven Root-cause Goals, 68.5 GB Heterogeneous Telemetry, RCA-agent Program Synthesis and Execution, All-element Exact Match
intro_en: OpenRCA selects 1,753 failure records from three real enterprise systems in the AIOps Challenge series, balances them to 412, and uses three engineers to standardize, calibrate, and filter them into 335 failure cases with 68.5 GB of metrics, logs, and traces. Each task asks for a subset of failure time, root-cause component, and root-cause reason, and accuracy requires all requested elements to match.
scale_en: 335 failure cases; 68.5 GB and 523M telemetry lines
metric_en: Strict Root-cause Accuracy (all requested time, component, and reason elements match)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ICLR 2025 Sections 2.2-2.4, 3, and 4 plus the official microsoft/OpenRCA repository. The diagrams preserve the four-stage construction from AIOps Challenge data: selecting Telecom, Bank, and Market systems with 1,753 records; balancing to 412; standardizing names and formats; three-engineer telemetry-grounded calibration and filtering to 335; 68.5 GB and 523M lines of de-identified metrics, logs, and traces; seven goals formed from subsets of time, component, and reason; specification-based LLM query synthesis with a thirty-minute window and human verification; structured JSON answers; sampling or RCA-agent execution; and one-or-zero strict accuracy requiring every requested element to match.

name: OpenSkillEval
intro: OpenSkillEval 是自动审计开放 skill 生态的 Agent 评测框架。它从五类真实应用的工件或源材料反向构造任务，经生成器与 verifier 形成677个动态案例；同时从多个社区仓库按采用度筛选30个 skill，并在统一隔离环境中比较无 skill 与强制使用 skill 的 Agent，从 ATIF 轨迹和最终工件两条通道评测。
org: Singapore Management University, Fudan University, Joy Future Academy, JD
build_method: 动态任务构建, 社区技能收集, 统一Agent runner
metric: 任务专用工件质量, Skill增益, 轨迹遵循, Token与时间成本
modality: 文本, 图像, 文档, 代码
task_type: Agent任务, 技能评估, 真实工作流
eval_feature: 技能生态审计, 动态任务, 成本质量分析
task_type_en: Agent task, Skill evaluation, Real-world workflow
build_method_en: Dynamic task construction, community skill collection, unified agent runner
eval_feature_en: Skill ecosystem audit, dynamic tasks, cost-quality analysis
intro_en: OpenSkillEval automatically audits the open skill ecosystem for LLM agents. It reverse-constructs tasks from artifacts or source materials in five real application families and uses generators plus a verifier to produce 677 dynamic cases. It also selects 30 skills from multiple community repositories using adoption signals and compares no-skill with force-use agents in a unified isolated environment through both ATIF trajectory and final-artifact evaluation.
metric_en: Task-specific Artifact Quality, Skill Gain, Trajectory Adherence, Token and Time Cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.23657 Sections 2.1-2.3 and its appendices plus the official project page. The diagrams preserve the five task families; category-specific artifact and source collection; snapshot source packages; reverse construction with Claude-4.6-Opus and GPT-5.2 into task_input.json and instruction.md; verifier-LLM grounding and completeness checks; 677 dynamic cases; time-sensitive collection from multiple community skill repositories and adoption-based filtering to 30 skills; unified isolated agent execution under no-skill and force-use conditions; ATIF trajectory normalization and agent-as-judge workflow adherence; task-specific VLM, screenshot, interaction, code, and rubric artifact checks; and quality, skill-gain, token, time, and cost-performance reporting.

name: OPQA
intro: OPQA（OpenAI-Proof Q&A）是 OpenAI 的内部研究与工程诊断评测，由 20 个真实项目瓶颈构成；每个问题都曾让团队耗时超过一天并延误重大项目。模型可访问包含历史代码和运行产物的容器，需要定位并解释性能回退、训练指标异常或隐蔽实现缺陷，按 pass@1 评分。
build_method: 真实内部案例筛选, 历史证据封装
task_type: Agent任务, 代码调试, 研究工程诊断
eval_feature: 内部评测, 代码执行环境
task_type_en: Agent task, code debugging, research engineering diagnosis
build_method_en: Real Internal Case Selection, Historical Evidence Packaging
eval_feature_en: Internal Evaluation, Containerized Code and Run Artifacts
intro_en: OPQA (OpenAI-Proof Q&A) is OpenAI's internal research and engineering diagnosis evaluation built from 20 real project bottlenecks. Each problem took a team more than a day to solve and delayed a major project. Models receive a container with historical code and run artifacts, diagnose issues such as performance regressions, anomalous training metrics, or subtle implementation bugs, and are graded with pass@1.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official GPT-5 system card's OPQA section. The diagrams preserve the 20 real internal research and engineering bottlenecks, the more-than-one-day team-delay inclusion criterion, impact on major projects and sometimes training runs or launches, representative failure types, container access to historical code and run artifacts, diagnosis-and-explanation objective, and pass@1 scoring. Because OPQA is in-house, the diagrams explicitly mark task-authoring, reference-answer, and grader implementation details as undisclosed rather than inventing them.

name: OR-Bench
intro: OR-Bench 是大规模过度拒答基准：研究者先在 10 个类别中生成有害种子，再将其改写为无害但容易触发拒答的边界提示，并通过三模型多数审核与安全回答恢复。最终发布 80,000 条无害提示、约 1,000 条困难提示和约 600 条有毒对照，用拒答率同时衡量有用性与安全性。
build_method: LLM生成与改写, 三模型多数审核, 安全回答恢复
eval_feature: 过度拒答与有毒对照, 关键词与GPT-4评判
scale: 80,000条安全提示, 约1,000条困难提示, 约600条有毒提示
build_method_en: LLM Seed Generation and Rewriting, Three-model Majority Moderation, Safe-response Recovery
eval_feature_en: Over-refusal and Toxic Controls, Keyword and GPT-4 Judging
intro_en: OR-Bench is a large-scale over-refusal benchmark. Harmful seeds from ten categories are rewritten into benign borderline prompts, then filtered through three-model majority moderation and safe-response recovery. The release contains 80,000 benign prompts, about 1,000 hard prompts, and about 600 toxic controls, using rejection rates to measure both helpfulness and safety.
scale_en: 80,000 safe prompts, about 1,000 hard prompts, about 600 toxic prompts
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.20947 Sections 3–4 and the official justincui03/or-bench repository. The diagrams preserve ten refusal categories, 2,000 Mixtral 8x7B toxic seeds per category, deduplication, five constrained few-shot rewrites per seed, moderation by GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09, Llama-3-70B, and Gemini-1.5-Pro with majority voting, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 response-based recovery for oversensitive flags, the OR-Bench-80K and roughly 600-item Toxic releases, Hard-1K selection from safe prompts rejected by at least three largest/newest models in each family, and evaluation of 32 models across eight families at temperature 0 without system prompts. Full 80K responses use keyword matching; Hard and Toxic use GPT-4 judging.

name: OSWorld
intro: OSWorld是一个为多模态智能体设计的可扩展、真实的计算机环境，支持在Ubuntu、Windows和macOS等操作系统上进行任务设置、基于执行的评估和交互式学习。它提供了一个统一的平台，用于评估涉及任意应用程序的开放式计算机任务。该基准包含369个计算机任务，涵盖真实网络和桌面应用、操作系统文件I/O以及跨多个应用程序的工作流。对现有LLM/VLM智能体的评估显示，它们在作为计算机助手方面存在显著不足，人类完成率为72.36%，而最佳模型仅为12.24%。
build_method: 真实场景人工编写, 初始态配置, 逐例执行式评测器
eval_feature: 真实虚拟机交互, 初始态复位, 逐例执行式评估
scale: 369个Ubuntu任务, 另有43个Windows分析任务
build_method_en: Real-use-case Authoring, Initial-state Configuration, Example-wise Execution Evaluators
eval_feature_en: Real VM Interaction, Reproducible Setup, Example-wise Execution Evaluation
intro_en: OSWorld is a scalable, realistic computer environment designed for multimodal agents, supporting task setup, execution-based evaluation, and interactive learning on operating systems such as Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS. It provides a unified platform for evaluating open-ended computer tasks involving arbitrary applications. The benchmark includes 369 computer tasks covering real web and desktop applications, OS file I/O, and workflows across multiple applications. Evaluations of existing LLM/VLM agents reveal significant shortcomings as computer assistants, with a human success rate of 72.36% compared to only 12.24% for the best model.
scale_en: 369 Ubuntu tasks, plus 43 Windows analysis tasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.07972 and the official xlang-ai/OSWorld project. The diagrams preserve real-world open-domain use cases; web, desktop, file-I/O, single-app, and cross-app coverage; per-example natural-language instructions; detailed initial-state configurations with files and setup actions; custom example-wise execution evaluators built from 134 evaluation functions; joint revisions for false positives and negatives; more than 400 person-hours across four checks; the original 369 Ubuntu tasks (268 single-app and 101 multi-app) plus 43 Windows analysis tasks; VM restoration and multimodal screenshot/a11y observations; interactive actions; result-state retrieval; and success-rate reporting with the paper's 72.36% human and 12.24% initial best-agent figures. The later OSWorld-Verified maintenance process is kept separate.

name: OSWorld-G
intro: OSWorld-G 是独立的桌面 GUI grounding 基准。它从先进模型在 OSWorld 中的定位失败轨迹抽取 720p/1080p 截图，由软件专家编写无歧义操作指令并在 CVAT 标注精确边界框，再经真实软件验证和多轮复核，形成覆盖文本匹配、元素识别、布局理解、精细操作与拒绝的 564 个样例。
org: The University of Hong Kong, Salesforce AI Research
build_method: 失败轨迹挖掘, 专家边界框标注, 真实软件与多轮复核
eval_feature: 点或边界框空间包含评分, 不可执行指令拒绝
build_method_en: Failure-trajectory Mining, Expert Bounding-box Annotation, Real-software and Multi-round Verification
eval_feature_en: Point or Box Spatial-containment Scoring, Infeasible-instruction Refusal
intro_en: OSWorld-G is a standalone desktop GUI-grounding benchmark. It samples 720p and 1080p screenshots from state-of-the-art model grounding failures in OSWorld, uses software experts to write unambiguous action instructions and annotate precise CVAT boxes, then validates them in real software through multiple review rounds. Its 564 examples cover text matching, element recognition, layout understanding, fine-grained manipulation, and refusal.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.13227 Section 2.1 and Appendix A.1 plus the official xlang-ai/OSWorld-G repository. The diagrams distinguish OSWorld-G from the 369-task OSWorld agent benchmark and preserve collection of state-of-the-art grounding failures from real OSWorld trajectories, 720p/1080p screenshots, five capability categories, expert low-level instructions, precise CVAT bounding boxes including character-level actions, actual-software edge-case validation, multiple verification rounds guided by strong-model predictions, knowledge-decomposed paraphrases, 32 UI-type tags, the 564-example release including 54 refusal cases, and point-in-box accuracy with explicit infeasibility refusal.

name: OSWorld-Verified
intro: OSWorld-Verified 是原 369 题 OSWorld 的持续维护修订版。约十人团队用近两个月核验并修复 300+ 条社区反馈，优先修改评测器以保持任务与分数连续性，同时修复网页变化、指令歧义、环境依赖和严格评分问题，并迁移到最多 50 环境并行的 AWS 公开评测基础设施。
org: XLANG Lab, The University of Hong Kong
build_method: 社区问题核验, 最小侵入式评测器修复, AWS并行复跑
eval_feature: 真实计算机环境, 基于执行的评估, 系统复核
intro_en: OSWorld-Verified is the maintained revision of the original 369-task OSWorld benchmark. A roughly ten-person team spent nearly two months validating and fixing 300-plus community reports, preferentially repairing evaluators to preserve task and score continuity while addressing web drift, ambiguity, environment dependencies, and brittle grading, then moved verified reruns to an AWS public-evaluation platform supporting up to 50 parallel environments.
build_method_en: Community Issue Validation, Minimally Invasive Evaluator Repair, AWS Parallel Reruns
eval_feature_en: Real Computer Environment, Execution-based Evaluation, Systematic Verification
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official XLANG OSWorld-Verified report and the original arXiv:2404.07972 foundation. The diagrams preserve the original 369 tasks, 15 months of field use, roughly 300 community-reported issues, validation and repair by about ten people over nearly two months, triage of web/access drift, ambiguity, evaluator robustness and system stability, the explicit minimally invasive policy of fixing evaluators before task text, URL and fuzzy web validation, proxy or equivalent-site handling, task clarification only when necessary, tolerant document/image/spreadsheet checks, synchronous operations and VM/font/file-hosting stabilization, migration to AWS with up to 50 parallel environments and minutes-scale runs, unified public evaluation, calibrated reruns, and the 300-plus-fix OSWorld-Verified release.

name: OVBench
intro: OVBench是一个综合性的问答基准测试，旨在评估模型在在线视频上下文中感知、记忆和推理的能力。它包含六种核心任务类型，涵盖过去、当前和未来的三种时间上下文，形成来自不同数据集的16个子任务。
org: Nanjing University, China Mobile Research Institute, OpenGVLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: 源数据集整理, 人工时空问答标注, 干扰项生成与人工质检
task_type: 在线视频理解, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 过去、当前与未来时间上下文, 滑动窗口与流式评测
scale: 1,463个视频, 约7,000条标注, 6类任务/16个子任务
build_method_en: Source-dataset Curation, Human Spatiotemporal QA Annotation, Distractor Generation and Human Review
eval_feature_en: Past, current, and future temporal contexts; sliding-window and streaming evaluation
intro_en: OVBench is a comprehensive question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate models' abilities in perception, memory, and reasoning within online video contexts. It includes six core task types covering past, present, and future temporal contexts, comprising 16 subtasks from various datasets.
scale_en: 1,463 videos, approximately 7,000 annotations, 6 task types and 16 subtasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.00584 and the official VideoChat-Online project. The diagrams preserve the past/current/future temporal-context definition; six task types and 16 subtasks; leakage-aware curation from six real-world domains; validation/test-only source splits; precise timestamp, bounding-box, trajectory, action, and object annotations; human-written task-specific QA; same-video cross-timestamp distractors; manual checks for question clarity, option ambiguity, and annotation accuracy; trimming at the earliest relevant frame; duration-proportional sampling and task balance; the paper release of 1,463 videos and about 7,000 annotations; 32-second sliding-window and full-stream modes at 2 FPS; and accuracy aggregation across capabilities. It is explicitly kept separate from the independently published OVO-Bench.

name: OVOBench
intro: OVO-Bench 是面向在线长视频理解的综合基准，统一评测后向追溯、实时视觉感知和前向主动响应三种在线模式。论文版包含644个独立视频、12类任务和2,814条问答/元标注。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Tsinghua University, Beihang University, Communication University of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, SenseTime Research, Shanghai Innovation Institute
build_method: 源视频整理, 人机协同时间戳与问答标注, 干扰项设计与人工复核
task_type: 在线视频理解, 多项选择问答, 时机感知响应
eval_feature: 后向追溯, 实时视觉感知, 前向主动响应
scale: 论文版644个独立视频, 2,814条问答/元标注, 12类任务
task_type_en: Online Video Understanding, Multiple-choice QA, Timing-aware Response
build_method_en: Source-video Curation, Human-AI Timestamp and QA Annotation, Distractor Design and Human Review
eval_feature_en: Backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding
intro_en: OVO-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for online long-video understanding that jointly evaluates backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding. The paper release contains 644 unique videos, 12 tasks, and 2,814 QA/meta-annotations.
scale_en: Paper release: 644 unique videos, 2,814 QA/meta-annotations, 12 tasks
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.05510 and the official JoeLeelyf/OVO-Bench repository. The diagrams preserve the three online modes and 12 tasks; curated public datasets and self-crawled YouTube videos across seven domains; validation/test-only leakage control; precise existing labels, Gemini-1.5 coarse timestamps, and volunteer meta-annotation; human timestamp refinement; GPT-4o-assisted candidate generation from short clips; human-proposed hard cases; visually grounded and rule-based distractors; manual review and option shuffling; start-to-query multiple-choice evaluation for backward and real-time tasks; dense timeline queries for forward response timing; task-specific scoring with GPT-4o judging for SSR and CRR; and the paper release of 644 unique videos and 2,814 QA/meta-annotations. Later repository query-count revisions are not substituted for the paper release.

name: P-MMEval
l2: 并行多语言多任务评测
intro: P-MMEval 是通义实验室构建的平行多语言多任务基准。它以三组不同规模模型对和配对样本 t 检验筛选基础数据集，再加入五个专项数据集，通过 GPT-4o 补齐缺失翻译并由专业翻译团队复核，最终以八个基准组成部分、七类任务和十种语言评估多语言能力与跨语言迁移一致性。
build_method: 模型规模显著性筛选, GPT-4o补译, 专业翻译复核与本地化
language: 英文, 中文, 阿拉伯文, 西班牙文, 日文, 韩文, 泰文, 法文, 葡萄牙文, 越南文
task_type: 多语言理解与生成, 数学与逻辑推理, 代码生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 十语言平行样本, 英文/母语/英文少样本提示, 跨语言迁移一致性
scale: 8个基准组成部分, 7类任务, 10种语言, 共21,580条分语言实例
task_type_en: Multilingual understanding and generation, Math and logical reasoning, Code generation, Instruction following
build_method_en: Model-scale Significance Screening, GPT-4o Translation Completion, Professional Translation Review and Localization
eval_feature_en: Parallel Samples in Ten Languages, English/Native/English Few-shot Prompts, Cross-lingual Transfer Consistency
intro_en: P-MMEval is a parallel multilingual multitask benchmark from Tongyi Lab. It screens fundamental datasets using three model-size pairs and paired-sample t-tests, adds five specialized datasets, fills missing translations with GPT-4o, and has professional translators review them. The final suite evaluates multilingual capability and transfer consistency across eight benchmark components, seven task types, and ten languages.
language_en: English, Chinese, Arabic, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Thai, French, Portuguese, Vietnamese
scale_en: 8 benchmark components, 7 task types, 10 languages, 21,580 language-specific instances
default_l2: 并行多语言多任务评测
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.09116 Sections 3-4, Tables 1-3, and the official Qwen/P-MMEval dataset card. The diagrams follow the paper's ten languages from seven families; eleven-dataset candidate pool; three model-size pairs; English-plus-four-language, at-most-250-instance paired-sample t-tests with p below 0.01 for every pair; retained XNLI, MHellaSwag, and Flores-200; five specialized additions; GPT-4o translation completion followed by professional review, correction, localization, and removal; exact per-language component counts; eight benchmark components spanning seven tasks; English, native, and English few-shot prompts; MGSM chain-of-thought versus direct answering elsewhere; Accuracy, BLEU, Pass@1, and CACR reporting.

name: PACE-Bench
intro: PACE-Bench 是 PACE 框架针对四个昂贵 Agent 目标自动选择出的具体代理基准。它在严格留一模型验证中，利用 14 个模型在 19 个低成本非 Agent 基准上的实例级得分，结合目标相关性与全局杠杆度，构建每个目标约 100 个带权来源实例的代理，用于预测绝对得分和模型排序。
org: Carnegie Mellon University; Salesforce AI Research
build_method: 模型留一验证, SVD杠杆度与目标相关性筛选, Local/Global代理回归集成
metric: MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy
modality: 文本, 代码, 图像
eval_feature: 四个目标专用代理, 约100实例预算, 绝对得分与成对排序预测
scale: 4个目标代理文件（每个约100个带权来源实例）, 19个来源候选基准, 14个模型
build_method_en: Leave-one-model-out Validation, SVD Leverage and Target-relevance Selection, Local/Global Proxy Regression Ensemble
eval_feature_en: Four Target-specific Proxies, Approximately 100-instance Budget, Absolute-score and Pairwise-ranking Prediction
intro_en: PACE-Bench is the concrete proxy benchmark automatically produced by PACE for four expensive agentic targets. Under strict leave-one-model-out validation, it combines instance-level scores from 14 models on 19 low-cost non-agentic benchmarks with target relevance and global leverage, yielding an approximately 100-instance weighted proxy for each target to predict absolute scores and model rankings.
scale_en: 4 target proxy files (about 100 weighted source instances each), 19 candidate source benchmarks, 14 models
metric_en: MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2607.02032 and the official neulab/pace code and pace-bench dataset card. The diagrams distinguish the PACE selection framework from its concrete four-target PACE-Bench output; preserve 14 models, 4 agentic targets, 19 candidate source benchmarks, 11 capabilities, OpenHands Index target evaluation, strict leave-one-model-out calibration, target-instance bootstrap, thin SVD, leverage and absolute Spearman signals, separate C_L Local and C_G Global paths with fixed-ratio replenishment after overlap until C=100 unique instances, separate projections, linear absolute-score and logistic pairwise regressions, lambda ensembling, serialized weighted target files, and MAE, Spearman, pairwise accuracy, and cost results.

name: PaperBench
intro: PaperBench是一个旨在评测AI代理复现顶尖人工智能研究能力的基准。它要求代理从零开始，完整复现20篇ICML 2024的重点论文，涵盖了从理解论文贡献、开发代码到执行实验的全过程。该基准采用一个包含8316个可评分子任务的分层评分体系进行客观评估，并配备了一个基于大型语言模型的自动评分机制以实现规模化评测。
build_method: 论文筛选, 双工程师分层rubric, 原作者多轮核验, JudgeEval验证
eval_feature: 全新Ubuntu 24.04环境, A10 GPU, 12小时复现实验, SimpleJudge逐叶节点判定, 加权树聚合
scale: 20篇论文, 12个ICML主题, 8,316个叶节点评分结果
build_method_en: Paper filtering, two-engineer hierarchical rubrics, multi-round author verification, JudgeEval validation
eval_feature_en: Fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VM, A10 GPU, 12-hour reproduction, per-leaf SimpleJudge decisions, weighted tree aggregation
intro_en: PaperBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' ability to replicate cutting-edge AI research. It requires agents to fully reproduce 20 key ICML 2024 papers from scratch, covering the entire process from understanding the paper's contributions, developing code, to executing experiments. The benchmark uses a hierarchical scoring system with 8,316 scorable subtasks for objective evaluation and features an LLM-based automatic scoring mechanism for scalable assessment.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.01848 and OpenAI's official PaperBench implementation. Automated eligibility filters and author outreach yield 20 ICML 2024 Spotlight/Oral papers across 12 topics. Two engineers draft weighted hierarchical rubrics, followed by internal review, multi-round original-author verification, and addenda. Candidates receive only the paper and addendum, run reproduce.sh for at most 12 hours in a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 A10 VM, and are judged leaf-by-leaf by SimpleJudge; weighted roll-up produces Replication Score. JudgeEval uses expert gold labels on partial replications and reports 0.83 F1 for o3-mini.

name: PaperQA
intro: PaperQA 是 MathVista 的论文图表问答子集，包含 107 个来自 2023 年 8 月 Hugging Face Papers 论文图表的科学视觉推理样例，由 STEM 研究生标注并经三位审阅者独立核验。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: STEM研究生人工标注, 三位审阅者独立核验, 团队共识消歧
task_type: 论文图表问答, 科学视觉推理
eval_feature: 学术表格/图形/图表, 三审阅者核验, 细粒度元数据, GPT-4答案抽取与确定性准确率
task_type_en: Paper figure QA, scientific visual reasoning
build_method_en: Manual annotation by STEM graduate students, independent review by three annotators, team-consensus adjudication
eval_feature_en: Academic tables/figures/charts, three-reviewer validation, fine-grained metadata, GPT-4 answer extraction and deterministic accuracy
intro_en: PaperQA is MathVista's paper-figure QA subset. It contains 107 scientific visual-reasoning examples sourced from figures and tables in August 2023 Hugging Face Papers, annotated by STEM graduate students and independently checked by three reviewers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MathVista paper arXiv:2310.02255 and official project. PaperQA contributes 107 examples from informative academic tables, figures, and charts in papers released on Hugging Face Papers in August 2023. STEM graduate students manually author the questions; three reviewers independently check each newly collected example, reaching 99.2% consistency across 736 new questions, with six disagreements resolved by team consensus. Records include question/answer type, language, source, category, task, grade, context, and reasoning skills. Evaluation uses response generation, GPT-4 answer extraction, normalization, and deterministic accuracy.

name: Pare-Bench
intro: Pare-Bench 是 PARE 主动助手研究环境中的评测基准，包含 143 个跨通信、生产力、日程和生活应用的多样任务。PARE 将移动应用建模为有限状态机，并通过主动用户仿真构造情境，使 proactive assistant 必须观察用户行为、推断目标、判断干预时机并跨应用执行任务。
org: University of California, Santa Barbara; Apple; University of Washington; Independent Researcher
build_method: 有限状态机应用建模, 四阶段Agent场景生成, Oracle重试, 人工语义核验
metric: Success@4, Success^4, Success Rate, Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate
task_type: 主动助手任务, Agent任务, 多应用编排
eval_feature: 主动性, 状态依赖用户仿真, 扁平助手API, Oracle校验, 工具失败与噪声通知
task_type_en: Proactive assistant task, Agent task, Multi-app orchestration
build_method_en: Finite-state app modeling, four-stage agent scenario generation, oracle retries, human semantic review
eval_feature_en: Proactivity, state-dependent user simulation, flat assistant APIs, oracle validation, tool failures and noise notifications
intro_en: Pare-Bench is the benchmark built on the PARE proactive assistant research environment. It contains 143 diverse tasks across communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps. PARE models mobile applications as finite state machines and uses active user simulation, forcing proactive assistants to observe user behavior, infer goals, decide when to intervene, and execute tasks across apps.
metric_en: Success@4, Success^4, Success Rate, Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.00842 and the official PARE repository. The environment contains nine FSM applications plus the System, Agent UI, and FileSystem core apps; users receive state-dependent actions while assistants use flat APIs. A Claude Agent SDK generation agent performs four stages: unique story description, app initialization/population, event-flow construction with user/agent oracle actions, and validation criteria. Stages two through four run in oracle mode with failure feedback and retries, followed by human checks for semantic coherence, event realism, and validation correctness. The final 143 scenarios support optional tool failures and Poisson noise notifications and report Success@4, Success^4, Success Rate, Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate, and read-only actions.

name: PathVQA
intro: PathVQA 是病理图像视觉问答基准，包含 4,998 张图像和 32,799 个问答，其中 16,465 个为开放式、16,334 个为是非题；数据由病理学教材和 PEIR 资源经半自动生成与逐题人工校验构建。
org: University of California, San Diego; Beijing University of Technology; Carnegie Mellon University
build_method: 教材与PEIR图文抽取, CoreNLP与Tregex问答生成, 全量人工校验
metric: Accuracy, Exact Match, Macro F1, BLEU-1/2/3
eval_feature: 7类问题, 开放式与是非题平衡, 图像级划分, 多指标评测
build_method_en: Textbook and PEIR image-caption extraction, CoreNLP and Tregex QA generation, full manual verification
eval_feature_en: Seven question types, balanced open-ended and yes/no questions, image-level splits, multiple evaluation metrics
intro_en: PathVQA is a pathology visual question-answering benchmark with 4,998 images and 32,799 QA pairs: 16,465 open-ended and 16,334 yes/no. It is built from pathology textbooks and PEIR through semi-automatic generation followed by manual verification of every question.
scale_en: 32,799 QA pairs, 4,998 images, seven question types
metric_en: Accuracy, Exact Match, Macro F1, BLEU-1/2/3
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2003.10286 and the official UCSD-AI4H repository. The pipeline extracts 1,670 textbook images with PyPDF2/PDFMiner and 3,328 PEIR images with Requests/BeautifulSoup, then removes non-pathology images and repairs mismatches. Stanford CoreNLP and Tregex generate seven open question types; yes/no questions are created by inversion and same-POS negative substitution. Every QA pair is manually proofread for spelling, syntax, semantics, ambiguity, and artifacts. The final image-level split is 2,499/17,325 train, 1,499/9,462 validation, and 1,000/6,012 test images/QAs; yes/no uses accuracy and open-ended answers use exact match, macro F1, and BLEU-1/2/3.

name: PawBench
intro: PawBench 是面向 Agentic AI 的 Model × Harness 联合评测基准，强调同一个模型放入不同 Agent runtime 后表现可能显著不同。v1.0 覆盖 9 个模型、3 个 harness 和 150 个任务，提供公开 prompts、graders、任务标签、提交结果、leaderboard 切片和诊断 trace。
build_method: Reuse & Tag, 统一任务合同, Model × Harness联合运行
metric: Overall score, Slice scores, Harness gap
modality: 文本, 多模态, 工具
task_type: Agent任务, Harness评估, 工具调用
eval_feature: 6类任务来源, 5维正交标签, 3种评分模式, Model × Harness共评估, 诊断trace
scale: 150个任务, 9个模型, 3个Harness, 6类任务来源
task_type_en: Agent task, Harness evaluation, Tool use
build_method_en: Reuse and Tag, unified task contracts, Model × Harness execution
eval_feature_en: Six task sources, five orthogonal tags, three grading modes, Model × Harness co-evaluation, diagnostic traces
intro_en: PawBench is a Model × Harness co-evaluation benchmark for agentic AI, built around the observation that the same model can behave very differently inside different agent runtimes. v1.0 covers 9 models, 3 harnesses, and 150 tasks, with public prompts, graders, task labels, submissions, leaderboard slices, and diagnostic traces.
metric_en: Overall score, Slice scores, Harness gap
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official PawBench repository and project page. PawBench v1.0 uses Reuse & Tag to combine 21 self-built tasks with 52 ClawEval, 29 QwenClawBench, 23 PinchBench, 15 SkillsBench, and 10 WildClawBench tasks, normalizes all 150 tasks to one prompt/workspace/result contract, and tags scenario, capability, complexity, modality, and environment. The same tasks are run across 9 models and QwenPaw, OpenClaw, and Hermes harnesses. Outcomes use automated, LLM-judge, or hybrid grading; the published baseline uses Claude Opus 4.6 for LLM judging. Results are sliced by task and execution attributes, while transcripts and harness gaps support diagnosis. No standalone paper is published, so the official repository is the primary methodology source.

name: PersonQA
intro: PersonQA 是 OpenAI 系统卡披露的内部人物事实问答评测，包含 18 类人物事实，用公开可得的人物事实衡量模型对已尝试答案的准确率与幻觉率。OpenAI 未公开样本量、类别名称、来源选择、标注协议、评分器、数据或代码。
build_method: 公开人物事实问答, 18类事实, 构建与标注细节未公开
eval_feature: 已尝试答案准确率, 幻觉率, 18类人物事实, 参考事实时效性审计
scale: 18类人物事实, 样本总量未公开
build_method_en: Public person-fact QA, 18 fact categories, construction and annotation details not disclosed
eval_feature_en: Attempted-answer accuracy, hallucination rate, 18 person-fact categories, reference-freshness audit
intro_en: PersonQA is an internal person-fact QA evaluation disclosed in OpenAI system cards. It covers 18 categories of publicly available facts about people and measures accuracy on attempted answers plus hallucination rate. OpenAI has not released its item count, category names, source-selection procedure, annotation protocol, grader, data, or code.
scale_en: 18 person-fact categories; total item count not disclosed
drawio_review_note: Aligned only with official OpenAI system-card disclosures, without inventing a standalone paper or dataset pipeline. OpenAI states that PersonQA contains questions and publicly available facts about people, spans 18 categories of person facts, and measures accuracy on attempted answers and hallucination rate. The system cards do not disclose item counts, category names, source selection, collection dates, refresh cadence, annotation or adjudication procedures, prompts, parsers, graders, splits, data, or code. The diagram marks each of those components as not disclosed. It also preserves the official warning that stale reference facts can overstate hallucination because a model may provide a current correct answer that differs from an outdated test set.

name: PHYBench
intro: PHYBench 是由 178 名北京大学物理专业学生参与构建的原创符号物理推理基准。流程从 757 道人工编写题出发，经多轮专家审查，并由 81 名学生独立验证后保留 500 题；其中 o1 和 DeepSeek-R1 的输出仅用于帮助审查者发现歧义或误读，不用于生成题目或标准答案。评测同时报告符号等价准确率与表达式编辑距离分数。
org: School of Physics and Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University; Beijing Computational Science Research Center
build_method: 学生人工出题, 多轮专家审查, 独立学生验证
eval_feature: 原创防污染题目, 符号等价检查, 表达式编辑距离, 人类基线
build_method_en: Student-authored Problems, Multi-round Expert Review, Independent Student Validation
eval_feature_en: Original Contamination-resistant Problems, Symbolic Equivalence, Expression Edit Distance, Human Baseline
intro_en: PHYBench is an original symbolic physics reasoning benchmark built with contributions from 178 Peking University physics students. It starts from 757 human-authored problems, applies multi-round expert review, and retains 500 after independent validation by 81 students. Outputs from o1 and DeepSeek-R1 are shown only to help reviewers expose ambiguity or misinterpretation, never to generate questions or ground truth. Evaluation reports both symbolic-equivalence accuracy and Expression Edit Distance.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.16074's dataset construction, human validation, prompting, and metric sections plus the official PHYBench page. The diagrams preserve 178 participating Peking University physics students; the 757-to-500 filtering path; original or substantially adapted symbolic-expression problems; broad physics and high-school-to-Olympiad scope; self-contained, unambiguous, uniquely checkable requirements; the internal Question Bank and multi-round review; o1 and DeepSeek-R1 outputs used only to expose ambiguity or misreading, never for question or ground-truth generation; independent validation by 81 students including 50 Chinese Physics Olympiad gold medalists; boxed symbolic zero-shot answers; SymPy/latex2sympy equivalence; Zhang-Shasha tree edit distance; and the paper's exact EED rule: 100 at r=0, 60-100r for 0<r<0.6, and zero for r at least 0.6.

name: π-Bench
intro: π-Bench 是一个评估主动式个人助手在长程、多会话工作流中表现的基准。它包含 5 类 persona 下的 100 个多轮任务，任务运行在持久工作区中，用户需求通常不完整且会逐步显现，用于同时衡量 Agent 的任务完成度和主动发现隐藏意图的能力。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Fudan University, University of Science and Technology of China, Peking University, Nanjing University, Zhejiang University, Tongji University, Soochow University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 领域专家Persona, 真实工作流与跨会话依赖, 隐藏意图和Checklist双层标注, 持久工作区仿真
task_type: 主动助手任务, 长程规划, 多会话工作流
eval_feature: 524个隐藏意图, 510个Rubric项, 168个规则项, 三次独立轨迹, PROC与COMP
scale: 100个任务, 5个Persona, 每个20会话, 187个工具, 21个技能
task_type_en: Proactive assistant task, Long-horizon planning, Multi-session workflow
build_method_en: Domain-expert personas, authentic workflows and cross-session dependencies, dual hidden-intent and checklist annotation, persistent-workspace simulation
eval_feature_en: 524 hidden intents, 510 rubric items, 168 rule items, three independent trajectories, PROC and COMP
intro_en: π-Bench evaluates proactive personal assistant agents in long-horizon, multi-session workflows. It contains 100 multi-turn tasks across 5 personas in persistent workspaces where user requirements are often underspecified and emerge over time, jointly measuring task completion and whether agents discover or infer hidden intents early.
scale_en: 100 tasks, 5 personas, 20 sessions each, 187 tools, 21 skills
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define five domain personas with stable roles, routines, preferences, and long-term goals"] --> B["Create one persistent 20-session episode for each persona in a shared project workspace"]
    B --> C["Derive workflow-grounded tasks from authentic routines, supporting materials, files, tools, and skills"]
    C --> D["Write natural underspecified initial requests or environment-triggered starts for each session"]
    D --> E["Annotate recoverable hidden intents separately from visible user requests"]
    D --> F["Create checklist criteria and rule- or rubric-based graders for final task completion"]
    E --> G["Run turn-based simulated user-agent sessions while tracking intent terminal status"]
    F --> G
    G --> H["Iteratively inspect leakage, recoverability, tool setup, workspace paths, and grader stability"]
    H --> I["Report Proactivity from agent-resolved intents and Completeness from checklist satisfaction"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["定义五类领域persona，包含稳定角色、习惯、偏好和长期目标"] --> B["为每个persona创建共享项目工作区中的20会话持久episode"]
    B --> C["从真实工作例程、支撑材料、文件、工具和skill派生工作流任务"]
    C --> D["为每个会话编写自然但欠规格的初始请求或环境触发任务"]
    D --> E["将可恢复隐藏意图与可见用户请求分开标注"]
    D --> F["为最终任务完成创建checklist和规则/模型rubric评分器"]
    E --> G["运行轮流式模拟用户-代理会话并跟踪意图终态"]
    F --> G
    G --> H["迭代检查泄漏、可恢复性、工具配置、工作区路径和评分器稳定性"]
    H --> I["用代理解决的隐藏意图计算Proactivity，用checklist满足度计算Completeness"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.14678 and the official Pi-Bench repository. Domain experts construct five stable professional personas and derive authentic, feasible workflows in persistent project workspaces. Each persona has one 20-session episode with six strong dependency groups of two or three tasks plus five largely independent tasks, totaling 100 tasks. The environment exposes 187 unique tools and 21 skills. Underspecified starts hide 524 recoverable intents; experts execute reference solutions and author 510 rubric checklist items plus 168 deterministic rule items. A GPT-5.4 simulated user at temperature zero tracks completed, inferred, and provided terminal statuses through a Nanobot-derived scaffold. Every task runs three independent trajectories. PROC credits completed and inferred intents, while COMP averages binary rubric and rule checklist outcomes; reported results include means and standard deviations.

name: PhyX
intro: PhyX 是面向真实视觉场景物理推理的大规模基准，包含 3,000 个独立问题、6 个物理领域、25 个子领域和 6 种推理类型。每题同时提供开放题与选择题以及 Full-Text、Text-DeRedundancy、Text-Minimal 三种视图，形成 18,000 个核心评测实例。
org: The University of Hong Kong, University of Michigan, Independent Researchers, University of Toronto, University of Waterloo, The Ohio State University
build_method: STEM研究生专家采集, OE/MC双题型转换, 三文本视图, 物理博士生三级质控
task_type: 多模态问答, 物理推理
eval_feature: 3,300到3,000筛选, 18,000核心实例, 1,000题testmini, 规则抽取与DeepSeek-V3 Judge
scale: 3,000个独立问题, 6,000个OE/MC问题, 18,000个核心实例, 1,000题testmini
build_method_en: Expert collection by STEM graduate students, paired OE/MC conversion, three text views, three-stage quality control by physics PhD students
eval_feature_en: 3,300-to-3,000 curation, 18,000 core instances, 1,000-problem testmini, rule extraction and DeepSeek-V3 judging
intro_en: PhyX is a large-scale benchmark for physics-grounded reasoning in realistic visual scenarios. It contains 3,000 unique problems across 6 physics domains, 25 subdomains, and 6 reasoning types. Every problem has open-ended and multiple-choice formats plus Full-Text, Text-DeRedundancy, and Text-Minimal views, yielding 18,000 core evaluation instances.
scale_en: 3,000 unique problems, 6,000 OE/MC questions, 18,000 core instances, 1,000-problem testmini

    C["Convert each question into open-ended and multiple-choice versions with three parallel text variants"] --> D["Generate descriptive image captions using GPT-4o for LLM evaluation support"]
    D["Generate descriptive image captions using GPT-4o for LLM evaluation support"] --> E["Physics Ph.D. students detect duplicates via lexical overlap and filter shortest 10% questions"]
    E["Physics Ph.D. students detect duplicates via lexical overlap and filter shortest 10% questions"] --> F["Ph.D. students validate each scenario for scientific accuracy and eliminate dataset bias"]

    G["Proportionally sample 1,000 problems across domains to create testmini subset for evaluation"] --> H["Evaluate models using VLMEvalKit with three-step protocols on testmini subset"]

    B["招募STEM研究生从教材收集3300道避免直接答案的问题"] --> C["将每道题转换为开放式和选择题并创建三种文本变体"]
    C["将每道题转换为开放式和选择题并创建三种文本变体"] --> D["使用GPT-4o生成图像描述文本以支持LLM评估"]
    D["使用GPT-4o生成图像描述文本以支持LLM评估"] --> E["物理博士生通过词汇重叠检测重复并过滤最短10%问题"]
    E["物理博士生通过词汇重叠检测重复并过滤最短10%问题"] --> F["博士生验证每个场景的科学准确性并消除数据集偏差"]
    F["博士生验证每个场景的科学准确性并消除数据集偏差"] --> G["按领域比例抽样1000道题创建testmini子集用于评估"]
    G["按领域比例抽样1000道题创建testmini子集用于评估"] --> H["使用VLMEvalKit三步协议在testmini子集上评估模型"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.15929, the official PhyX project page, and the official repository. The paper defines a four-stage collection pipeline: survey six physics domains, 25 subdomains, and six reasoning types; recruit STEM graduate annotators under copyright and contamination guidance; convert every item between OE and MC and build Full-Text, Text-DeRedundancy, and Text-Minimal variants; and use GPT-4o to caption images for text-only LLMs. The initial 3,300 candidates undergo lexical-overlap duplicate detection, physics-PhD manual review and scientific validation, and shortest-10-percent filtering to reach 3,000 unique problems and 18,000 core format-view instances. testmini proportionally samples 1,000 problems. Evaluation uses zero-shot CoT generation, rule-based answer extraction, DeepSeek-V3 judging for OE, letter matching with judge fallback for MC, and Accuracy slices by format, view, domain, and reasoning type.

name: PIQA
intro: PIQA是一个物理常识推理基准，包含多项选择题，测试模型对日常物品使用的理解。旨在评估模型的物理知识水平，推动具备物理世界推理能力的语言理解系统发展。
org: Carnegie Mellon University, Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
eval_feature: Commonsense
build_method_en: Crowdsourcing, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Commonsense
intro_en: PIQA is a physical commonsense reasoning benchmark consisting of multiple-choice questions that test a model's understanding of everyday object usage. It aims to evaluate models' physical knowledge and promote the development of language understanding systems with physical world reasoning abilities.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1911.11641. Qualified annotators use Instructables from six categories as creativity scaffolds, write two physical goals and valid solutions per seed, and create a syntactically and topically similar but physically invalid trick. Qualification requires over 80% on well-formed versus underspecified pairs. Independent batch validation removes low-agreement examples and workers. AFLite fine-tunes BERT-Large on 5,000 original examples, embeds the remainder, and uses a linear-classifier ensemble to discard label-predictive artifacts. The released 21,035 English examples contain one goal and two solutions with exactly one correct answer; evaluation reports accuracy and a majority-vote human baseline.

name: PIRA-Bench
intro: PIRA-Bench 面向无显式指令的主动式 GUI 意图推荐。它整理 100 条真实移动端和桌面端连续轨迹，为每条轨迹注入应用切换、空闲屏幕和随机浏览噪声并配对三种用户画像，再由三名独立标注者确定可行动意图，形成直接推荐、画像依赖和纯噪声负样本三类场景。
org: MMLab @ CUHK, Nankai University, Huawei Research
build_method: 真实连续GUI轨迹, 噪声注入, 三用户画像配对, 三人独立意图标注
metric: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature: 画像条件意图, 纯噪声负样本, 语义集合匹配, 误报惩罚
scale: 100条轨迹, 平均32张截图, 每条轨迹3个用户画像
intro_en: PIRA-Bench evaluates proactive GUI intent recommendation without explicit user instructions. It curates 100 real mobile and desktop trajectories, injects application switching, idle screens, and random browsing noise, pairs each trajectory with three user profiles, and uses three independent annotators to establish actionable intents across direct, profile-dependent, and pure-noise negative scenarios.
build_method_en: Real Sequential GUI Trajectories, Noise Injection, Three-profile Pairing, Three-person Independent Intent Annotation
metric_en: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature_en: Profile-conditioned Intents, Pure-noise Negatives, Semantic Set Matching, False-positive Penalty
scale_en: 100 trajectories, 32 screenshots on average, 3 user profiles per trajectory
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.08013's benchmark construction and evaluation sections plus the official PIRA-Bench leaderboard. The diagrams preserve 100 real mobile and desktop trajectories, an average of 32 sequential screenshots, injected application-switching, idle-screen, and random-browsing noise, three socioeconomic/preference/characteristic profiles per trajectory, direct, profile-dependent, and pure-noise scenarios, three independent human intent annotations, two-of-three agreement, empty intent sets for negative cases, no-explicit-instruction prediction, Gemini-3-flash semantic matching, macro Average Intent F1, normalized false-positive score 1/(1+ln(1+FPS)), and multiplicative Final Score.

name: PixMo-Count
intro: PixMo-Count 是 Ai2 在 Molmo 与 PixMo 工作中发布的开放视觉计数数据集。它使用 Detic 在网页图像上检测对象，经严格置信度和多样性过滤后生成对象中心点与计数问答，并对 2 至 10 个对象的验证集和测试集进行人工核验。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
build_method: Detic非VLM检测, 严格置信度与多样性过滤, 对象中心点计数问答, 人工核验评测集
task_type: 视觉计数问答, 对象中心点指点
eval_feature: Detic自动构建, 0至10计数训练, 2至10人工核验评测, Point-then-Count
build_method_en: Non-VLM Detic detection, strict confidence and diversity filtering, object-center counting QA, human-verified evaluation sets
eval_feature_en: Detector-built data, 0-to-10 training counts, human-verified 2-to-10 evaluation, point-then-count
intro_en: PixMo-Count is an open visual counting dataset released by Ai2 with Molmo and PixMo. It runs Detic on web images, applies strict confidence and diversity filtering, derives object-center points and counting QA pairs, and manually verifies validation and test examples with counts from 2 to 10.
drawio_review_note: Corrected and aligned with arXiv:2409.17146, the CVPR 2025 Molmo and PixMo paper, the official allenai/molmo repository, and the official allenai/pixmo-count dataset card. PixMo-Count is an Ai2 dataset rather than a Gemini Robotics benchmark. A standard non-VLM Detic detector runs on web images; after strict confidence thresholding, the class with the most detections is selected and object centers become point supervision. The pipeline filters for accuracy and diversity and forms image counting-QA pairs. For counts 2 through 10, 120 samples per count are manually verified to create 540-record validation and test splits; those evaluation records omit points. The released training split has 36,916 records with counts 0 through 10, labels, and center points. The ODC-BY dataset publishes URLs and SHA-256 hashes. Evaluation reports counting Accuracy and the paper shows point-then-count outperforming direct count generation.

name: PlanBench-XL
intro: PlanBench-XL 是面向大规模工具生态的交互式长程规划 benchmark，包含 327 个零售任务和 1,665 个工具。它评估 Agent 在工具可见性受限时能否检索可用工具、分解隐式子目标、处理缺失/失败/干扰工具，并沿长路径逐步恢复到最终目标。
build_method: LLM生成与过滤, 类型化工具合成, 状态图路径枚举, 可执行后端
metric: Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, Avg Turns, Mean EDT, Search/Call Ratio, ITCR, UIRR
task_type: Agent任务, 工具调用, 长程规划
eval_feature: 56种数据类型, 工具检索上限30, 最短路径5至9, 100轮上限, 三类保路径阻断
scale: 327个零售任务, 1,665个工具, 56种数据类型
task_type_en: Agent task, Tool use, Long-horizon planning
build_method_en: LLM generation and filtering, typed-tool synthesis, state-graph path enumeration, executable backend
eval_feature_en: 56 datatypes, retrieval capped at 30 tools, shortest paths of 5-9 calls, 100-turn cap, three path-preserving blocker types
intro_en: PlanBench-XL is an interactive long-horizon planning benchmark for large-scale tool ecosystems, with 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools. It evaluates whether agents can retrieve usable tools under limited visibility, infer implicit sub-goals, handle missing, failing, or distracting tools, and recover over long alternative tool-use paths.
metric_en: Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, Avg Turns, Mean EDT, Search/Call Ratio, ITCR, UIRR
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2606.22388 benchmark-construction, interaction, blocker, and metrics sections plus the official JiayuJeff/PlanBench-XL repository. An LLM proposes retail datatypes and tools before filtering vague, redundant, or unrealistic candidates. The released executable ecosystem has 56 datatypes and 1,665 tools with one-to-five typed inputs and one output, canonical names plus aliases, five noisy sibling variants, concrete backend records, and fixed unhelpful noisy outputs. Tasks define initial datatypes and a goal, enumerate state-graph solution paths, retain solvable instances whose shortest valid paths require 5-9 calls, verbalize 327 natural-language queries, and execute a valid path for the gold answer. Agents can retrieve by input, output, or bridge conditions, receive at most 30 tools, and act through retrieve, tool-call, or answer for up to 100 turns. Optional explicit, implicit, and semantically misleading blockers replace path-critical tools while preserving at least one valid path. Evaluation reports Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, average turns, mean EDT, search/call ratio, invalid tool-call rate, and untrusted-input rejection rate.

name: PMC-VQA
intro: PMC-VQA 是从 PubMed Central 开放论文图像构建的大规模医疗视觉问答数据集与评测基准。作者从 381K 对图像与图注出发，用 ChatGPT 生成四选一问答，再通过纯文本 LLaMA-7B 过滤和图像可回答性分类器清洗为 226,946 组问答、149,075 张图像，并从图像隔离的 50,000 题初始测试集中人工核验出 2,000 题测试集。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: ChatGPT图注问答生成, 两级视觉依赖自动过滤, 人工测试集核验
task_type: 医疗视觉选择题与开放式问答
eval_feature: 纯语言可答过滤, 图像可回答性分类, 图像隔离划分, 2,000题人工核验测试集
scale: 226,946组问答, 149,075张图像, 50,000题初始测试集, 2,000题人工核验测试集
task_type_en: Medical Visual Multiple-choice and Open-ended QA
build_method_en: ChatGPT Caption-to-QA Generation, Two-stage Visual-dependence Filtering, Manual Test-set Verification
eval_feature_en: Language-only Answerability Filter, Image-answerability Classifier, Image-disjoint Split, 2,000-item Manually Verified Test Set
intro_en: PMC-VQA is a large-scale medical visual question-answering dataset and benchmark built from PubMed Central open-access figures. Starting with 381K image-caption pairs, the authors use ChatGPT to generate four-choice QAs, then apply a text-only LLaMA-7B filter and an image-answerability classifier to obtain 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images. A 2,000-item test set is manually verified from an image-disjoint 50,000-item initial test split.
scale_en: 226,946 QAs, 149,075 images, 50,000-item initial test split, 2,000-item manually verified test set
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.10415 Sections 4.1 and 4.3.2, Figure 4, Table 3, and the official xiaoman-zhang/PMC-VQA repository. The diagrams preserve the 1.6M-pair PMC-OA source, the 381K first-stage figure-caption subset without automatic subfigure separation, five ChatGPT-generated four-choice QAs per caption with randomized answer position, 1,497,808 cleaned generations, cross-half text-only LLaMA-7B filtering with five option shuffles and a three-of-five removal threshold, 848,433 retained pairs, 2,192 manually labeled image-answerability examples split 1,752/440, the 81.77%-accurate classifier, final 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images, a 50,000-pair image-disjoint initial test split, 2,000 manually verified test items, Choice and Blanking tasks, and Accuracy plus BLEU-1 metrics.

name: Point-Bench
intro: Point-Bench 是 PointArena 的静态语言引导指向基准，包含五类共 982 组图文任务。数据通过三个匿名多模态模型与人工评审筛选高难查询，再由 SAM 辅助生成并经两轮人工标注核验目标掩码；模型以坐标点覆盖掩码并按二元 Success Rate 评分。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Anderson Collegiate Vocational Institute
build_method: 众包查询, 模型难度过滤, SAM辅助掩码, 双阶段人工复核
task_type: 点位预测, 空间推理
eval_feature: 5类任务, 3模型高难筛选, 掩码覆盖判定, 16个MLLM, 3次独立运行
build_method_en: Crowdsourced queries, model-based hardness filtering, SAM-assisted masks, two-stage human review
eval_feature_en: Five categories, three-model hardness filter, mask-coverage criterion, 16 MLLMs, three independent runs
intro_en: Point-Bench is the static language-guided pointing benchmark in PointArena, with 982 text-image tasks across five categories. Three anonymized MLLMs and human judges filter for difficult queries, while SAM-assisted target masks receive two stages of human annotation and verification; coordinate predictions are scored with binary Success Rate by mask coverage.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.09990 Point-Bench construction and evaluation sections and the official PointArena project. Point-Bench is not a Gemini Robotics benchmark: it is the 982-pair static-image component of PointArena. Public-source images posted after April 20, 2025 are divided across spatial, affordance, counting, steerable, and reasoning categories. Crowdworkers write category-aligned queries; three anonymized MLLMs answer them; human judges retain items for which at most one model is correct. Annotators place target points, SAM proposes masks, the same annotators refine masks, and a separate annotator group verifies them. At evaluation, a model predicts K coordinates for K-star target masks. Success requires K equals K-star and every target mask contains at least one predicted point; non-counting tasks request one point and evaluate only the first if extra points are emitted. Sixteen MLLMs are run over all 982 pairs in three independent trials, reporting mean and standard deviation of Success Rate across five categories.

name: PolyMATH
intro: PolyMath是一个多语言数学推理基准，涵盖18种语言和4个难度级别。该基准旨在评估大型语言模型在多语言环境下的数学推理能力，并揭示了LLM在多语言推理中的关键挑战。它通过确保难度全面性、语言多样性和高质量翻译，成为一个具有高度区分度的多语言数学基准。研究发现，即使是先进的LLM也仅能达到约50%的准确率。
build_method: 专家难度标注, GPT-4o预翻译, 数学术语提取, 语言专家校准
eval_feature: 18种平行语言, 四档难度各125题, 专家翻译校准, 规则答案匹配, 难度权重1/2/4/8
build_method_en: Expert difficulty labeling, GPT-4o pretranslation, math-term extraction, language-expert calibration
eval_feature_en: 18 parallel languages, 125 problems per difficulty level, expert translation calibration, rule-based answer matching, 1/2/4/8 difficulty weights
intro_en: PolyMath is a multilingual mathematical reasoning benchmark covering 18 languages and 4 difficulty levels.
