It aims to evaluate large language models' mathematical reasoning abilities in a multilingual context and highlights key challenges LLMs face in multilingual reasoning. By ensuring comprehensive difficulty, language diversity, and high-quality translations, it serves as a highly discriminative multilingual math benchmark. Studies show that even advanced LLMs achieve only about 50% accuracy.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Partition difficulty into four levels by Thought Depth and Knowledge Breadth"] --> B["Collect 500 English problems total, 125 per level"]
    B --> C["Assign each level through one expert and two additional confirmations"]
    C --> D["Pretranslate the same problems into 17 languages with GPT-4o"]
    D --> E["Math experts extract key terms and language experts calibrate terms, formulas, logic, and fluency"]
    E --> F["Release 500 × 18 = 9,000 parallel instances"]
    F --> G["Use rule-based answer matching and Difficulty-Weighted Accuracy with weights 1, 2, 4, and 8"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["按思维深度和知识广度划分四个难度等级"] --> B["从公开基准和官方竞赛库收集500道英文题目"]
    B["从公开基准和官方竞赛库收集500道英文题目"] --> C["专家判定难度等级,每个标签由两名专家确认"]
    C["专家判定难度等级,每个标签由两名专家确认"] --> D["用GPT-4o生成17种目标语言的初步翻译"]
    D["用GPT-4o生成17种目标语言的初步翻译"] --> E["数学专家从英文题目提取关键术语列表"]
    E["数学专家从英文题目提取关键术语列表"] --> F["标注员校准翻译的术语准确性、公式和流畅性"]
    F["标注员校准翻译的术语准确性、公式和流畅性"] --> G["用难度加权准确率评估18语言4难度的模型表现"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.18428v4 dataset-construction, translation, and evaluation sections plus the official QwenLM/PolyMath repository. PolyMATH contains 500 original English problems total, not 500 per level: 125 are assigned to each of four levels defined by thought depth and knowledge breadth. Sources include MGSM, official examinations and competitions, and 25 HLE problems at the top level. A mathematics expert assigns each level and two additional experts confirm every tag. GPT-4o pretranslates the same problems into 17 target languages; math experts extract key terms; language experts with mathematics knowledge calibrate terminology, formulas, logical equivalence, and fluency. The 18 parallel languages yield 9,000 instances and cover about 75% of native speakers. Models return boxed answers. Non-reasoning open models use greedy decoding; reasoning models use temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, and 16 runs per sample for average@16. A human-validated rule matcher exceeds 98% precision. Difficulty-Weighted Accuracy uses weights 1, 2, 4, and 8 across the four levels, alongside language, level, and consistency analyses.

name: PopQA
intro: PopQA 是包含 14,267 条问题的开放域事实问答基准，通过 16 种 Wikidata 关系覆盖热门与长尾实体。它为每题保存全部可接受宾语及别名，并附加维基百科访问量，用于分析参数记忆、检索增强与自适应检索的准确率如何随实体流行度变化。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Johns Hopkins University
build_method: Wikidata三元组抽样, 人工关系模板, 全宾语与别名扩展, 页面访问量标注
metric: Exact-substring Accuracy, Per-relation Accuracy, Popularity correlation
eval_feature: 16种关系, 热门与长尾实体, 多答案别名, 维基页面访问量, 参数与非参数记忆对比
build_method_en: Wikidata triple sampling, manual relation templates, all-object and alias expansion, page-view annotation
eval_feature_en: 16 relations, popular and long-tail entities, multi-answer aliases, Wikipedia page views, parametric versus non-parametric memory
intro_en: PopQA is an open-domain factual QA benchmark with 14,267 questions across 16 Wikidata relations and both popular and long-tail entities. It stores all acceptable objects and aliases and adds Wikipedia page views, enabling analysis of how parametric memory, retrieval augmentation, and adaptive retrieval accuracy vary with entity popularity.
metric_en: Exact-substring Accuracy, Per-relation Accuracy, Popularity correlation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2212.10511v4 PopQA construction and evaluation sections plus the official AlexTMallen/adaptive-retrieval repository. The authors select 16 Wikidata relations and randomly sample subject-relation-object triples over a broad popularity range. A natural-language template is manually written for each relation and instantiated with the subject. Acceptable answers include every entity E satisfying the same subject-relation-E fact and their aliases, with Wikidata IDs or URIs, Wikipedia titles, relation types, and subject/object metadata. Monthly Wikipedia page views provide the popularity signal. The final dataset has 14,267 open-domain questions. Models receive no evidence paragraph and are evaluated in zero- or few-shot settings, with vanilla parametric memory compared against BM25, Contriever, GenRead, and adaptive retrieval variants. A prediction is correct when any exact gold-answer string appears as a substring. Results report overall and per-relation Accuracy and analyze correlation with log entity popularity.

name: PRDBench
intro: PRDBench 是面向真实产品需求文档（PRD）的项目级代码生成基准，包含 50 个 Python 项目、20 个领域和 1,262 个可执行评分点，并以单元测试、Shell 交互和文件比较检验工程交付。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Meituan, AGI-Eval
build_method: Agent驱动PRD与测试标准生成, 人工执行检查, 迭代修复
task_type: 项目级代码生成, 软件工程, 调试
eval_feature: PRD驱动, 单元测试/Shell交互/文件比较, Agent-as-a-Judge, 开发与调试双轮
scale: 50个项目级任务, 20个领域, 1,262个评分点
task_type_en: Project-level code generation, software engineering, debugging
build_method_en: Agent-generated PRDs and test criteria, human execution checks, iterative repair
eval_feature_en: PRD-driven, unit tests/shell interaction/file comparison, Agent-as-a-Judge, development and debugging rounds
intro_en: PRDBench is a project-level code-generation benchmark built from real product requirement documents. It contains 50 Python projects across 20 domains and 1,262 executable evaluation points spanning unit tests, shell interaction, and file comparison.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.24358 and the official PRDBench repository: seed requirements are filtered to public all-Python projects, GPT-4 assigns domains, and 50 projects across 20 domains are selected. Agents draft the PRD, AAA-oriented metric outline, scaffold, and criteria; humans execute and inspect tests; failures are iteratively repaired; the scaffold is then removed. EvalAgent runs 409 unit-test, 729 shell-interaction, and 124 file-comparison points and reports pass rate.

name: PreciseWikiQA
intro: PreciseWikiQA是HalluLens的动态外在幻觉评测任务：从GoodWiki页面按WikiRank中心性分层，每次生成5,000条无需上下文的精确事实问答，用于区分错误拒答、尝试回答后的幻觉和正确回答。
org: FAIR at Meta, GenAI at Meta, HKUST
build_method: GoodWiki页面池、WikiRank中心性十档分层抽样、两阶段LLM问答生成与质量过滤
metric: 错误拒答率, 尝试回答后的幻觉率, 总体正确回答率
eval_feature: 每次动态重采样5,000题；无上下文推理；先判拒答再判正确、错误或不可验证；论文报告三次试验
scale: 44,754个GoodWiki页面；十档各抽500页，每次动态生成5,000组问答
build_method_en: GoodWiki page pool, ten WikiRank-centrality strata, two-stage LLM question-answer generation, and quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Dynamically resample 5,000 questions per run; answer without context; judge refusal before correctness; report three trials
intro_en: PreciseWikiQA is HalluLens' dynamic extrinsic-hallucination task. It stratifies GoodWiki pages by WikiRank centrality and generates 5,000 context-free factual questions per run to distinguish false refusals, hallucinations among attempted answers, and correct answers.
scale_en: 44,754 GoodWiki pages; 500 pages from each of ten bins produce 5,000 dynamic QA pairs per run
metric_en: False Refusal Rate, Hallucination Rate among attempted answers, Overall Correct-Answer Rate
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已纠正旧的ERNIE归属，按HalluLens论文与官方仓库核对GoodWiki、WikiRank分层、动态生成、拒答判定与三项指标，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: PreScience
intro: PreScience是一个科学预测基准，它将科研过程分解为四个相互依赖的生成式任务：合作者预测、前期工作选择、贡献生成和影响预测。该基准包含一个精心策划的9.8万篇近期AI相关研究论文的数据集，具有消歧的作者身份、时间对齐的学术元数据，以及一个跨越50.2万篇论文的作者出版历史和引用的结构化图谱。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Chicago, University of Washington, Google DeepMind
build_method: arXiv时间快照筛选、Semantic Scholar引用图扩展、S2AND作者消歧与时间元数据对齐
metric: nDCG, R-Precision, LACERScore, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, MAE, Pearson, Spearman
task_type: 生成, 排序, 预测
eval_feature: 按时间切分四项科研预测任务，并组合为12个月端到端科研模拟
scale: 9.8万篇目标论文；共50.2万篇目标、参考与作者历史论文
build_method_en: Temporal arXiv snapshot filtering, Semantic Scholar citation-graph expansion, S2AND author disambiguation, and time-aligned metadata
eval_feature_en: Four temporally split scientific forecasting tasks composed into a 12-month end-to-end research simulation
intro_en: PreScience is a scientific prediction benchmark that breaks down the research process into four interdependent generative tasks: collaborator prediction, prior work selection, contribution generation, and impact prediction. The benchmark includes a carefully curated dataset of 98,000 recent AI-related research papers, featuring disambiguated author identities, time-aligned academic metadata, and a structured graph of author publication histories and citations spanning 502,000 papers.
scale_en: 98K target papers; 502K target, reference, and author-history papers in total
metric_en: nDCG, R-Precision, LACERScore, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, MAE, Pearson, Spearman
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按论文与官方仓库逐步核对时间快照、S2图扩展、S2AND消歧、时间元数据、四项任务及12个月模拟，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProcBench
intro: ProcBench是一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）多步推理能力的基准测试。它通过消除路径探索和隐式知识利用，专注于直接评估多步推理。该数据集包含明确的指令和相应问题对，模型通过遵循提供的指令来解决问题。
build_method: 23类固定程序模板、可复现任务生成器与2至25步受控长度采样
metric: Prefix Match Length, Prefix Accuracy, Sequential Match, Final Match
task_type: 指令遵循, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 要求输出全部中间状态与最终状态，由GPT-4o规范化为带类型JSON后进行精确序列比较
scale: 23类任务，每类240题，共5,520题；程序长度2至25步
build_method_en: Twenty-three fixed procedural templates, reproducible task generators, and controlled sampling from 2 to 25 steps
eval_feature_en: Require every intermediate and final state, normalize free-form outputs to typed JSON with GPT-4o, and compare state sequences exactly
intro_en: ProcBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate the multi-step reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs). By eliminating path exploration and implicit knowledge use, it focuses on directly assessing multi-step reasoning. The dataset contains explicit instructions paired with corresponding questions, and models solve problems by following the given instructions.
scale_en: 23 task types, 240 examples per task, 5,520 examples total; 2-25 procedure steps
metric_en: Prefix Match Length, Prefix Accuracy, Sequential Match, Final Match
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按论文与官方代码核对23类任务、固定模板、2至25步采样、中间状态生成、GPT-4o JSON规范化和四项过程指标，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProgramBench
intro: ProgramBench评估智能体仅凭可执行程序与文档重建完整软件的能力。基准把200个开源程序转为离线黑盒任务，并以248,853个隐藏行为测试检验功能等价性。
org: Meta FAIR, Meta TBD, Stanford University, Harvard University
build_method: 智能体辅助的开源仓库转换、覆盖率驱动行为测试、弱断言过滤与源码剥离离线镜像
eval_feature: 无网络黑盒重建；禁止读取或反编译标准可执行文件；隐藏测试与作弊检测；每题最多1,000步和6小时
scale: 200个程序任务，248,853个测试函数，每题中位数770个测试
build_method_en: Agent-assisted open-source repository conversion, coverage-driven behavioral tests, weak-assertion filtering, and source-stripped offline images
eval_feature_en: Offline black-box reconstruction with no internet, executable reading, or decompilation; hidden tests and cheating detection; 1,000 steps and 6 hours per task
intro_en: ProgramBench evaluates whether agents can reconstruct complete software from only an executable and documentation. It converts 200 open-source programs into offline black-box tasks and checks behavioral equivalence with 248,853 hidden test functions.
scale_en: 200 program tasks, 248,853 test functions, median 770 tests per task
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已纠正旧的Claude系统卡归属，按ProgramBench论文、官网与官方仓库核对仓库转换、行为测试、离线镜像、黑盒重建及三项指标，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: PromptCBLUE
intro: PromptCBLUE是基于CBLUE重建的中文医疗领域大模型评测基准，评估中文大模型在医疗实体识别、文本分类、自然语言推理、对话理解及内容生成等多任务上的能力，提供在线评测平台。
build_method: 16项医疗NLP任务重构、94个指令模板与统一prompt-response JSONL格式
metric: 严格micro-F1, macro-F1, ROUGE-1/2/L, 任务平均分
task_type: 多任务（实体识别, 分类, 推理, 对话, 生成）
eval_feature: 隐藏测试target；共享LLM主干与语言模型头；任务专用文本后处理；在线平台评分
scale: 16项任务、94个模板；训练68,900条、验证10,360条、测试A/B各10,320条
task_type_en: Multi-task (entity recognition, Classification, Reasoning, Dialogue, Generation)
build_method_en: Reformulate 16 medical NLP tasks with 94 instruction templates and one unified prompt-response JSONL schema
eval_feature_en: Hide test targets; require one shared LLM backbone and language-model head; apply task-specific text post-processing; score online
intro_en: PromptCBLUE is a Chinese medical large model evaluation benchmark reconstructed from CBLUE. It assesses the capabilities of Chinese large models across multiple tasks, including medical entity recognition, text classification, natural language inference, dialogue understanding, and content generation, and provides an online evaluation platform.
scale_en: 16 tasks and 94 templates; 68,900 train, 10,360 validation, and 10,320 examples in each of Test A and Test B
metric_en: Strict micro-F1, macro-F1, ROUGE-1/2/L, mean primary-task score
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按原始16任务论文与官方仓库核对五类任务、94个模板、统一JSONL、隐藏测试答案、共享模型约束、后处理与各类评分，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProntoQA
intro: ProntoQA是一个合成的问答基准，旨在通过基于一阶逻辑的测试用例和思维链来评估大型语言模型的多跳推理能力。该数据集能够将生成的思维链解析为符号证明，以进行形式化分析，从而系统地探究语言模型的推理能力。研究发现，虽然模型在单个演绎步骤上表现良好，但在需要系统探索多个有效选项的证明规划方面存在困难。
build_method: 从3至10概念的线性本体生成唯一肯定前件证明，再用受控语法翻译为问答与标准思维链
task_type: 判断题, 思维链生成
eval_feature: 反向语义解析模型思维链并逐步判断有效性、原子性与是否偏离标准证明路径
scale: 按配置动态生成；论文主实验每个配置400个测试样例，覆盖1、3、5跳并使用8-shot提示
build_method_en: Generate a unique chained-modus-ponens proof from a linear ontology of 3-10 concepts, then translate it into QA and gold CoT with a controlled grammar
eval_feature_en: Semantically parse model CoT back into logic and classify each step by validity, atomicity, and deviation from the gold proof path
intro_en: ProntoQA is a synthetic question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' multi-hop reasoning abilities through first-order logic-based test cases and chains of thought. The dataset allows generated chains of thought to be parsed into symbolic proofs for formal analysis, enabling a systematic investigation of the models' reasoning capabilities. Studies show that while models perform well on individual deductive steps, they struggle with proof planning that requires systematically exploring multiple valid options.
scale_en: Generated per configuration; the paper's main experiments use 400 test examples per setting across 1, 3, and 5 hops with eight-shot prompting
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按原始PrOntoQA v1论文与官方生成代码核对线性本体、唯一肯定前件证明、1/3/5跳、上下文排序、二元标签、8-shot提示、反向语义解析与五类标签/证明准确率，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProteinLMBench
intro: ProteinLMBench是一个用于评估大型语言模型蛋白质理解能力的选择题基准。论文作者让LLM阅读下载的研究论文生成蛋白质问答，经机器与人工验证后，从超过10万条候选问答中随机抽取944道带答案解释的人工标注题，覆盖蛋白质性质预测、描述与序列理解。
org: Toursun Synbio, Johns Hopkins University, University of Cambridge, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, UNSW Sydney
build_method: LLM阅读蛋白质研究论文产题，机器与作者双重验证，从超过10万条问答池随机抽取944题
task_type: 科学问答, 蛋白质任务
eval_feature: 论文目标格式为六选一且附正确答案解释，题目经机器与人工验证，未设置推荐数据划分
scale: 944道人工标注选择题；从超过10万条蛋白质问答池随机抽取
build_method_en: Use an LLM to draft questions from protein research papers, validate them by machine and paper authors, and randomly sample 944 items from a pool exceeding 100,000 QA pairs
eval_feature_en: The paper targets six-choice items with correct-answer explanations, validates them by machine and humans, and recommends no data split
intro_en: ProteinLMBench is a multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating LLM protein understanding. The paper authors used an LLM to read downloaded research papers and generate protein QA, validated candidates by machine and humans, and randomly sampled 944 manually annotated questions with explanations from a pool exceeding 100,000 pairs, covering protein property prediction, descriptions, and sequence understanding.
scale_en: 944 manually annotated multiple-choice questions, randomly sampled from a pool of more than 100,000 protein QA pairs
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按论文、数据说明与官方Hugging Face文件核对论文阅读产题、机器与作者验证、超过10万问答池随机抽样、944题、答案解释、主题覆盖和Accuracy评测。论文规定六选一；公开JSON中少量记录的选项数偏离六项，图中保留论文定义并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProtocolQA
intro: ProtocolQA是LAB-Bench中的135题无工具多项选择子任务，用于评估模型理解研究实验方案、解释假想负面结果并提出改进措施的能力。生物学专家从protocols.io和STAR Protocols提取方案并注入明确破坏实验结果的错误，再由另一批专家核验并撰写故障排除题。
build_method: 两轮生物学专家从protocols.io与STAR Protocols提取方案、注入错误、交叉核验并撰写故障排除选择题
eval_feature: 零样本思维链、随机选项顺序、信息不足拒答项、正则与Claude 2回退解析，并以20题开放回答子集复核
scale: 135道题；约80%公开、20%私留用于污染监测
build_method_en: Two rounds of biology experts extract protocols.io and STAR Protocols procedures, inject errors, cross-check the failure scenario, and draft troubleshooting MCQs
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot CoT, randomized options, an insufficient-information choice, regex plus Claude 2 fallback parsing, and a 20-item open-response validation subset
intro_en: ProtocolQA is the 135-question, tool-free multiple-choice subtask in LAB-Bench. It evaluates whether models can understand a research protocol, interpret a hypothetical negative result, and propose an improvement. Biology experts extract procedures from protocols.io and STAR Protocols and inject errors that clearly damage the result, then additional experts validate the scenario and draft troubleshooting questions.
scale_en: 135 questions; approximately 80% public and 20% private for contamination monitoring
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按LAB-Bench论文与官方仓库核对两轮专家流程、protocols.io与STAR Protocols来源、错误注入与核验、135题而非全库2,457题、约80/20公开私留、零样本CoT、拒答选项、两级解析、Accuracy/Precision/Coverage及20题开放回答验证，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProtocolQA Open-Ended
intro: ProtocolQA Open-Ended是OpenAI在o1系统卡中披露的开放式湿实验故障排除评测。它把FutureHouse ProtocolQA中的108道多项选择题改写为简答题，保留常见已发表实验方案中的严重错误与观察到的实验结果，并要求模型说明如何修复流程。
build_method: 从FutureHouse ProtocolQA选择108题，移除选项并改写为开放式湿实验故障排除简答题
task_type: 开放式问答, 生物安全评测
eval_feature: 开放式简答、单次尝试通过率，并与19名具有一年以上湿实验经验的博士科学家基线比较
build_method_en: Select 108 FutureHouse ProtocolQA items, remove answer options, and rewrite them as open-ended short-answer wet-lab troubleshooting questions
eval_feature_en: Open-ended short answers, one-attempt pass rate, and comparison with 19 PhD scientists who each have more than one year of wet-lab experience
intro_en: ProtocolQA Open-Ended is an open-ended wet-lab troubleshooting evaluation disclosed in OpenAI's o1 System Card. It converts 108 multiple-choice questions from FutureHouse ProtocolQA into short-answer tasks, preserving egregious errors in common published protocols and the observed wet-lab result, then asks how to fix the procedure.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按OpenAI o1系统卡与原始LAB-Bench论文核对108题来源、选择题到开放简答改写、严重方案错误、实验结果与修复问题、pass@1、19名博士湿实验专家及57%共识/42%中位数基线；系统卡未披露该评测评分器实现细节，图中明确保留这一边界，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: ProverBench
intro: ProverBench是DeepSeek-Prover-V2论文提出的Lean 4形式化定理证明基准，共325题。其中15题从AIME 2024与2025的数论和代数题中筛选并形式化，另310题来自精选的高中竞赛与本科教材、教育教程，覆盖数论、代数、微积分、分析与概率等领域。
build_method: 筛选15道AIME 2024-2025数论与代数题，并从教材和教育教程精选、形式化310道竞赛与本科数学题
eval_feature: 以补全Lean 4代码的整段证明生成评测，支持非CoT与先给证明计划的CoT模式，并在Lean 4.9.0-rc2中形式验证
scale: 325题：15道AIME 2024-2025题与310道教材/教程题，覆盖9个数学领域
build_method_en: Select and formalize 15 number-theory and algebra problems from AIME 2024-2025, then curate and formalize 310 competition and undergraduate problems from textbooks and educational tutorials
eval_feature_en: Whole-proof Lean 4 code completion in non-CoT or proof-plan-first CoT mode, with formal verification in Lean 4.9.0-rc2
intro_en: ProverBench is a Lean 4 formal theorem-proving benchmark introduced with DeepSeek-Prover-V2. It contains 325 problems: 15 selected and formalized number-theory and algebra questions from AIME 2024-2025, plus 310 curated high-school competition and undergraduate problems from textbooks and educational tutorials across number theory, algebra, calculus, analysis, and probability.
scale_en: 325 problems: 15 from AIME 2024-2025 and 310 from textbooks or tutorials across nine mathematical areas
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按DeepSeek-Prover-V2论文、官方仓库与Hugging Face字段核对15道AIME筛选、排除几何/组合/计数、310道教材与教程题、九领域计数、325题Lean 4任务封装、非CoT/CoT提示、Lean 4.9.0-rc2验证与通过率；已移除旧图误混入的冷启动训练流程，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: PubMedQA
intro: PubMedQA是一个基于PubMed摘要的生物医学问答数据集，任务是用“是”、“否”或“可能”回答研究问题。包含1000个专家标注、61200个未标注及211300个人工生成问答，是首个需对生物医学研究文本进行推理的数据集。
org: University of Pittsburgh, Carnegie Mellon University
build_method: PubMed摘要筛选, 医学专家标注, 规则与启发式生成
scale: 1K专家标注 + 61.2K未标注 + 211.3K启发式生成
build_method_en: PubMed abstract filtering, medical-expert annotation, rule-based and heuristic generation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: PubMedQA is a biomedical question answering dataset based on PubMed abstracts, where the task is to answer research questions with "yes," "no," or "maybe." It includes 1,000 expert-annotated, 61,200 unlabeled, and 211,300 artificially generated QA pairs, making it the first dataset requiring reasoning over biomedical research texts.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1909.06146 Section 3. PQA-L and PQA-U start from PubMed question-title articles with structured conclusions, forming title questions, conclusion-free contexts, and conclusion long answers. Two M.D. candidates label 1,000 PQA-L items with yes/no/maybe and resolve disagreements; 500 support 10-fold cross-validation and 500 are held-out test. Rules retain 61.2K answerable PQA-U items. Separately, statement titles are converted and labeled by negation to produce 211.3K PQA-A items. PQA-L reasoning-required evaluation uses question plus context and reports accuracy and macro-F1.

name: PutnamBench
intro: PutnamBench 是 LongCat-Flash-Prover 报告中用于 Putnam 风格高等数学题的评测。
intro_en: PutnamBench is referenced by LongCat-Flash-Prover reports for Putnam-style advanced mathematics problems.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按NeurIPS 2024论文与官方仓库核对640道原题、解答析出、Lean 4/Isabelle/Coq人工形式化、二人复核、1692份形式化及pass@n评测，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: PuzzleVQA
intro: PuzzleVQA 是 Seed1.5-VL 报告中出现的视觉推理问答评测，用于评估模型解决图像谜题类问题的能力。
task_type: 视觉问答, 视觉推理
intro_en: PuzzleVQA is a visual reasoning QA evaluation appearing in the Seed1.5-VL report for solving image puzzle-style questions.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按ACL 2024论文、官方生成代码与数据卡核对10类20个模板、每模板100题、2000题、单/双概念、Pillow生成、三段解释、零样本CoT、答案解析与准确率评测，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: RareArena
intro: RareArena 是一个覆盖近 5 万名患者、4000 多种疾病的罕见病诊断基准，包含罕见病筛查和罕见病确认两类任务，用于评估模型在真实病例基础上的诊断召回能力。
intro_en: RareArena is a rare-disease diagnosis benchmark covering nearly 50,000 patients and more than 4,000 diseases. It includes rare-disease screening and confirmation settings to evaluate diagnostic recall on real patient cases.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with The Lancet Digital Health 2026 article, cross-checked against zhao-zy15/RareArena README Data Collection and evaluation description. RareArena builds on PMC-Patients case summaries and uses GPT-4o for the disclosed data-processing stages. Rare-disease cases are filtered, their diagnoses are extracted and mapped to Orphanet with CODER term embeddings, unmapped cases are removed, and case text is truncated and rephrased to prevent diagnosis leakage. Rare Disease Screening stops before decisive diagnostic tests, while Rare Disease Confirmation stops before the final diagnosis; residual leakage is removed. The resulting resource covers nearly 50,000 patients and more than 4,000 diseases. Models return five diagnoses, GPT-4o aligns synonyms and hypernyms to the gold disease, and Top-1 and Top-5 recall are reported.

name: RareBench
intro: RareBench是首个系统性评估大语言模型在罕见病领域能力的基准。它包含了多个罕见病患者数据集，并提出了一种动态少样本提示方法来提升诊断性能。该基准还对GPT-4与专业医生的诊断能力进行了比较。
task_type: 分类, 抽取, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 领域特定, 少样本
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Few-shot
intro_en: RareBench is the first benchmark to systematically evaluate large language models' capabilities in the rare disease domain. It includes multiple rare disease patient datasets and introduces a dynamic few-shot prompting method to enhance diagnostic performance. The benchmark also compares the diagnostic abilities of GPT-4 with those of expert physicians.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.06341v2 Sections 3.1-3.4, 4-5 and Appendix A, cross-checked against chenxz1111/RareBench. RareBench combines 1,650 PUMCH EHRs with 1,122 public rare-disease cases and defines four tasks: phenotype extraction, diagnosis from incomplete information, common-versus-rare differential diagnosis, and universal rare-disease differential diagnosis. The task subsets contain 87, 33, 527, and 2,185 cases respectively. Four public knowledge bases are integrated into a rare-disease graph; an information-content random walk produces phenotype embeddings for dynamic three-shot retrieval. Models are evaluated with zero-shot, chain-of-thought, random few-shot, and dynamic few-shot prompting using task-specific extraction or Top-k recall measures. A separate study compares GPT-4 with 50 specialist physicians on 75 high-quality PUMCH cases.

name: RE-Bench
intro: RE-Bench（Research Engineering Benchmark）是多个 Gemini 和 OpenAI 报告引用的 AI 研发任务评测，用于衡量模型在真实研究工程问题上的代理能力。
intro_en: RE-Bench, the Research Engineering Benchmark, is cited by Gemini and OpenAI reports for evaluating AI research and engineering agent tasks.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按RE-Bench论文与METR官方仓库核对七个开放式环境、评分函数、起始解/参考解、迭代试跑、61名专家71次八小时尝试、智能体限时运行、归一化与score@k，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: RealPref
intro: RealPref 是一个面向长期个性化用户-LLM 交互的偏好遵循评测基准，覆盖显式与隐式偏好表达、长时程交互历史以及未见场景下的偏好泛化能力。
build_method: 100个用户画像, 1300个个性化偏好, 四种偏好表达, 长时程交互历史
task_type: 偏好遵循, 个性化问答
eval_feature: 四种偏好表达, 长时程交互历史, 未见场景泛化
intro_en: RealPref evaluates long-horizon preference following in personalized user-LLM interactions with both explicit and implicit preference signals.
build_method_en: 100 user profiles, 1,300 personalized preferences, four preference-expression types, long-horizon interaction histories
eval_feature_en: Four Preference Expression Types, Long-horizon Interaction Histories, Unseen-scenario Generalization
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.04191 Sections 3-4, cross-checked against GG14127/RealPref generation pipeline and dataset schema. RealPref samples and manually filters 100 PersonaHub personas, extends them with demographics, biographies, and life events, and creates ten original plus three rationally inferred generalized preferences per user for 1,300 preferences. Each preference is expressed through four modes ranging from explicit to implicit. Preference, life-event, and random sessions are concatenated into histories averaging roughly 2K to 247K tokens. Original and generalized preferences receive multiple-choice, true-or-false, and open-ended queries. Classification tasks use accuracy, while open answers are judged against granular rubrics; results are sliced by expression type, context length, and unseen-scenario generalization.

name: RealWorldQA
intro: RealWorldQA是一个旨在评估多模态AI模型真实世界空间理解能力的基准测试。它通过700多张真实世界场景（包括车载图像）的图片，配以问题和可验证的答案，来评估模型对物理环境的理解能力。该基准测试要求模型能够识别高分辨率图像中的细节，并基于识别结果进行推理，可能需要常识性知识。
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, High-resolution Image Understanding
intro_en: RealWorldQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate the real-world spatial understanding capabilities of multimodal AI models. It uses over 700 images of real-world scenes, including in-car images, paired with questions and verifiable answers to assess models' understanding of physical environments. The benchmark requires models to identify details in high-resolution images and perform reasoning based on these observations, potentially involving commonsense knowledge.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with xAI official Hugging Face dataset card Introduction and release metadata; no accompanying paper or detailed annotation protocol is published. RealWorldQA has no accompanying benchmark paper. The xAI dataset card documents an initial release of 765 anonymized real-world images, including images taken from vehicles and other real-world scenes, with one question and an easily verifiable answer per image. It describes the goal as real-world understanding and releases the data under CC BY-ND 4.0, but does not disclose image sourcing proportions, question-authoring procedure, annotator counts, quality-control stages, prompt formatting, or an official answer parser. The diagram therefore shows only those confirmed stages and marks simple answer accuracy as the public evaluation convention rather than inventing a hidden construction pipeline.

name: ReasoningQA
intro: ReasoningQA 是 LongCat-Flash-Omni 与 LongCat-Next 报告中 OpenAudioBench 相关音频推理问答分项。
intro_en: ReasoningQA is an audio reasoning QA subset associated with OpenAudioBench in LongCat-Flash-Omni and LongCat-Next reports.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Baichuan-Audio arXiv:2502.17239 Section 4.3 and Table 8, cross-checked against the baichuan-inc/OpenAudioBench dataset card; LongCat-Flash-Omni only reuses the subset in its result table. ReasoningQA is not a standalone LongCat benchmark paper. It is the self-constructed logical-reasoning component of OpenAudioBench introduced in the Baichuan-Audio report. The official card lists 202 audio items and the report states that each answer is evaluated by GPT-4o against a reference answer before accuracy is calculated. Audio models are tested in speech-to-text mode or non-cascaded speech-to-speech mode; for the latter, interleaved output text is merged for scoring. Later LongCat reports reuse the same named subset in comparative result tables but do not document an alternative construction pipeline.

name: RedisQA
intro: RedisQA（论文原名 ReDis-QA）是一个罕见病问答基准，包含覆盖 205 种罕见病的 1,360 道高质量选择题，并按疾病及症状、病因、受影响人群、相关疾病、诊断等属性标注元数据。官方协议同时评估直接作答与基于 ReCOP 罕见病语料的检索增强作答。
build_method: 罕见病选择题采集与疾病属性元数据标注；构建 NORD 来源的 ReCOP 检索语料
task_type: 罕见病问答, 医疗诊断
eval_feature: 直接作答与检索增强作答；按疾病属性报告准确率
scale: 1,360 道选择题，覆盖 205 种罕见病
build_method_en: Rare-disease multiple-choice question collection and disease-property metadata annotation; NORD-sourced ReCOP retrieval corpus construction
eval_feature_en: Direct and retrieval-augmented answering with accuracy reported by disease property
intro_en: RedisQA, named ReDis-QA in the paper, is a rare-disease question-answering benchmark with 1,360 high-quality multiple-choice questions covering 205 diseases. Each item is annotated by disease and properties such as symptoms, causes, affected populations, related disorders, and diagnosis; the official protocol evaluates both direct answering and retrieval-augmented answering with the ReCOP corpus.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ReDis-QA arXiv:2408.08422 dataset-construction and evaluation sections, cross-checked against guan-wang/ReDis-QA and ReCOP dataset cards; the catalog ID RedisQA is a casing variant of ReDis-QA. The catalog item RedisQA corresponds to ReDis-QA, not a QuarkMed-created benchmark. The paper collects 1,360 high-quality multiple-choice questions covering 205 rare diseases, annotates each item with disease and question-property metadata, and reports the distribution across symptoms, causes, affected populations, related disorders, diagnosis, and other properties. It also builds ReCOP from NORD rare-disease reports by splitting each report into property-aligned chunks. Models are scored by multiple-choice accuracy in direct and retrieval-augmented settings, with retrieved ReCOP evidence additionally supporting traceable explanations.

name: RefSpatial-Bench
intro: RefSpatial-Bench是一个具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在评估视觉语言模型在多步空间指代推理方面的能力。它基于真实世界中的杂乱场景，并包含大规模的问答对，涵盖了丰富的空间关系和复杂的推理过程。该基准测试填补了现有评估方法在多步空间推理方面的空白，并能有效区分不同模型的性能。
org: Beihang University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
eval_feature: 思维链, 过程评估
build_method_en: Hybrid (Human Annotation, Automatic Generation)
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Process Evaluation
intro_en: RefSpatial-Bench is a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of vision-language models in multi-step spatial coreference reasoning. It is based on cluttered real-world scenes and includes a large-scale set of question-answer pairs covering rich spatial relationships and complex reasoning processes. This benchmark fills the gap in existing evaluation methods for multi-step spatial reasoning and effectively differentiates the performance of various models.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with RoboRefer arXiv:2506.04308 Section 3.3, benchmark and evaluation sections, and appendices, cross-checked against BAAI/RefSpatial-Bench. RefSpatial-Bench is the held-out multi-step spatial-referring benchmark introduced with RoboRefer. Its parent RefSpatial pipeline combines filtered OpenImages, sampled CA-1M embodied-video frames, and simulated Infinigen scenes using manually screened Objaverse-LVIS assets; the full resource spans 2.5 million samples, 20 million QA pairs, 31 relations, and reasoning chains up to five steps. The released benchmark has Location, Placement, and Unseen-composition folders, each pairing RGB images and target masks with prompts, category labels, and step counts. Models return point-coordinate tuples, which are checked against the target regions and summarized as split and average accuracy.

name: RepoBench
intro: RepoBench 是 Step DeepResearch 报告中出现的代码仓库级评测，用于衡量模型理解和操作代码仓库上下文的能力。
task_type: 仓库级代码理解, 代码生成
intro_en: RepoBench is a repository-level code evaluation appearing in the Step DeepResearch report for understanding and operating over code repository context.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with RepoBench arXiv:2306.03091 Sections 2-4 and Appendix, cross-checked against the official Leolty/repobench archive/v0 protocol. RepoBench evaluates repository-level code completion in Python and Java through three linked tasks: retrieval (RepoBench-R), next-line completion with cross-file context (RepoBench-C), and the end-to-end retrieval-plus-completion pipeline (RepoBench-P). The original pipeline crawls time-bounded GitHub repositories, parses repository dependencies and imported identifiers, and masks target lines in cross-file-first, cross-file-random, or in-file settings. Retrieval examples rank candidate snippets, completion examples provide controlled 2K or 8K prompts, and pipeline examples retrieve before predicting. Retrieval is scored with Accuracy@k; generated lines use Exact Match, Edit Similarity, and CodeBLEU.

name: RepoQA
intro: RepoQA是一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）长上下文代码理解能力的基准测试。它通过“搜索针函数”（SNF）任务来挑战LLMs，要求模型根据自然语言描述搜索代码函数，这需要模型深入理解代码和描述。RepoQA是多语言且全面的，包含从50个流行代码库中收集的500个代码搜索任务，涵盖5种现代编程语言。
org: University of Washington, Google, ETH Zurich
build_method: 仓库筛选, 依赖拓扑分析, 针函数抽样, GPT-4-Turbo 描述标注
metric: 检索准确率（目标平滑 BLEU 最高且 > 0.8）
eval_feature: 多语言
scale: 500个任务（50个仓库 × 每仓库10个；5种语言）
build_method_en: Repository Selection, Dependency Topology Analysis, Needle Sampling, GPT-4-Turbo Description Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multilingual
intro_en: RepoQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLMs) long-context code understanding ability. It challenges LLMs with the "Search Needle Function" (SNF) task, requiring models to search for code functions based on natural language descriptions, demanding deep comprehension of both code and descriptions. RepoQA is multilingual and comprehensive, containing 500 code search tasks collected from 50 popular code repositories, covering 5 modern programming languages.
metric_en: Retrieval Accuracy (target has highest smoothed BLEU and > 0.8)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.06025 and the official EvalPlus RepoQA repository. The benchmark selects 50 repositories, ten each in Python, C++, Java, TypeScript, and Rust, requiring topic diversity, unit tests or CI/CD, and at least 100 stars. Main-package files are dependency ordered, concatenated, and divided into 64 chunks; the first uniquely named function under 2,000 bytes from each eligible chunk forms the candidate pool, from which ten needles are sampled per repository. GPT-4-Turbo writes four-part descriptions while hiding function and variable names. Each 16k context places ten needles at 10%-100% depths. Tree-sitter extracts the first syntactically valid block, then smoothed BLEU compares it with every context function; retrieval succeeds only when the target ranks first and exceeds 0.8. Results report overall and per-language accuracy, with an optional comment-free comparison.

name: ReportBench
intro: ReportBench是一个系统性基准，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的学术研究报告的内容质量。该基准关注两个关键维度：引用文献的质量和相关性，以及报告中陈述的忠实性和真实性。它利用arXiv上的高质量已发表综述论文作为黄金标准，通过逆向提示工程构建领域特定提示和评估语料库。
org: ByteDance, Beihang University, The University of Sydney
build_method: 混合
metric: 内容质量, 引用文献质量和相关性, 陈述忠实性和真实性
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Process Evaluation
intro_en: ReportBench is a systematic benchmark designed to evaluate the content quality of academic research reports generated by large language models (LLMs). It focuses on two key dimensions: the quality and relevance of cited references, and the faithfulness and veracity of statements in the reports. It uses high-quality published survey papers from arXiv as the gold standard and employs reverse prompt engineering to construct domain-specific prompts and evaluation corpora.
metric_en: Content Quality, Citation Quality and Relevance, Statement Faithfulness and Truthfulness
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ReportBench arXiv:2508.15804 Sections 2.1-2.2 and Appendix, cross-checked against ByteDance-BandAI/ReportBench. ReportBench starts from a post-2020 arXiv snapshot, finds survey or review papers, verifies publication and survey status, parses LaTeX citations, and retains 678 expert-authored surveys with their bibliographies. It reverse-engineers sentence-, paragraph-, and detail-level research prompts under each survey's temporal cutoff, classifies domains, balances the distribution, and samples 100 tasks. Generated reports must not cite the source survey. Evaluation compares retrieved literature with the gold bibliography, extracts cited and uncited statements, checks cited claims against their sources, validates uncited claims with web evidence and multi-model voting, and reports citation coverage or overlap plus statement factuality.

name: ResearchRubrics
intro: ResearchRubrics是一个用于评估深度研究（Deep Research）能力的标准化基准。它利用大型语言模型处理开放式研究问题，并通过超过2500条由专家撰写的细粒度评分标准来评估模型的表现。该基准基于超过2800小时的人工劳动构建，包含跨领域的真实研究任务，旨在全面评估模型在事实依据、推理和表达清晰度等方面的能力。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 生成, 开放式问答, Agent任务
eval_feature: 结果导向, 思维链, 领域特定
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Result-oriented, Chain-of-Thought, Domain-specific
intro_en: ResearchRubrics is a standardized benchmark for evaluating Deep Research capabilities. It leverages large language models to tackle open-ended research questions and assesses model performance using over 2,500 fine-grained scoring criteria authored by experts. Built on more than 2,800 hours of human labor, the benchmark includes cross-domain real research tasks designed to comprehensively evaluate models on factual accuracy, reasoning, and clarity of expression.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ResearchRubrics arXiv:2511.07685 Sections 3.1-3.4 and evaluation sections, cross-checked against scaleapi/researchrubrics. ResearchRubrics contains 101 open-ended single-turn deep-research prompts across nine domains and 2,593 prompt-specific criteria, usually 20-43 per task. All prompts and rubrics are human-authored without LLM seeding: one STEM-trained expert drafts, a second iteratively reviews, and a third independently finalizes them, totaling more than 2,800 hours. Criteria cover six axes, distinguish mandatory from optional requirements, and use signed importance weights. Human and model judges grade criterion adherence, including partial credit in the ternary protocol, then aggregate weighted rubric compliance and report results by domain, criterion axis, and task-complexity dimensions.

name: RewardBench 2
intro: RewardBench 2是一个全新的多技能奖励建模基准，旨在通过提供更具挑战性的数据来推进奖励模型的评估。与第一代相比，模型在RewardBench 2上的得分平均低20分，但与下游任务性能高度相关。该基准使用新的人类提示，而非现有评估中的提示，从而实现了更严格的评估。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington, Cohere
build_method: WildChat 真人提示采集、分类与去污染；多模型回答生成；领域专属自动与人工过滤
task_type: 选择题, 排序, 对话
eval_feature: 四选一奖励模型评测；六领域无权平均；Ties 分布感知评分
build_method_en: WildChat human-prompt sourcing, classification and decontamination; multi-model completion generation; domain-specific automated and manual filtering
eval_feature_en: Best-of-four reward-model evaluation, unweighted six-domain mean, and distribution-aware Ties scoring
intro_en: RewardBench 2 is a new multi-skill reward modeling benchmark designed to advance reward model evaluation by providing more challenging data. Compared to the first generation, model scores on RewardBench 2 are on average 20 points lower but show a high correlation with downstream task performance. The benchmark uses new human prompts instead of those from existing evaluations, enabling a more rigorous assessment.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with RewardBench 2 arXiv:2506.01937 Section 3 and Appendices G-I, cross-checked against allenai/reward-bench. RewardBench 2 is an accuracy-based reward-model benchmark built from about 3,000 candidate prompts and finalized as 1,865 prompts across Factuality, Precise Instruction Following, Math, Safety, Focus, and Ties. Seventy percent are previously unused human prompts from WildChat; QuRater, a topic classifier, manual inspection, and Tulu 3 decontamination against 20 downstream evaluations are applied before completions from 20 models or humans are filtered with domain-specific judges, verifiers, voting, rubrics, and manual checks. Most items contain one chosen and three rejected completions. Five domains use best-of-four accuracy, Ties uses a distribution-aware score, and the overall score is the unweighted mean of six domains.

name: RiemannBench
intro: Riemann-Bench 是 Surge AI 构建的私有研究级数学基准，包含 25 道由数学研究者编写、经两位领域专家双盲从头求解验证的问题。模型可使用代码与搜索工具，每题运行 100 次独立尝试，并以程序验证器和无偏估计器报告 pass@1。
build_method: 研究数学家原创问题；双盲独立专家从头求解；程序化答案验证；完全私有
eval_feature: 不受约束的研究智能体；每题 100 次独立运行；无偏 pass@1 估计
build_method_en: Original research problems, double-blind from-scratch expert verification, programmatic answer checking, and full privacy
eval_feature_en: Unconstrained research agents, 100 independent runs per problem, and unbiased pass@1 estimation
intro_en: Riemann-Bench is Surge AI's private research-level mathematics benchmark with 25 problems authored by active mathematicians and double-blind verified from scratch by two domain experts. Models may use coding and search tools, run 100 independent attempts per problem, and are scored by problem-specific verifiers with an unbiased pass@1 estimator.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Riemann-Bench arXiv:2604.06802 Sections 3 and 5, cross-checked against the official Surge AI benchmark page. Riemann-Bench contains 25 fully private, research-level mathematics problems written by Ivy League professors, graduate students, and PhD-holding IMO medalists from problems encountered in their own research. Every item must have an unambiguous unique closed-form answer, support programmatic verification when equivalent forms exist, and pass double-blind verification by two independent domain experts who solve it from scratch without seeing the author solution. Models run as unconstrained research agents with coding tools, search, and open-ended reasoning. Each problem receives 100 independent attempts; programmatic verifiers judge correctness and an unbiased estimator reports pass@1.

name: RLWDQA
intro: RLWDQA 是 Qwen3-VL 报告中表格化列出的文档/视觉问答评测项，用于比较模型在文档问答任务上的表现。
task_type: 文档问答, 视觉问答
intro_en: RLWDQA is a document or visual QA evaluation item listed in Qwen3-VL report tables for comparing document QA performance.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按Qwen3-VL技术报告第5.12节表11至12核对RLWDQA仅披露的ViT与DeepStack验证对比，并明确标注独立论文、来源、规模、划分、构建、标注、提示与评分器均未披露，未虚构Build Process；已完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: RoboSpatial
intro: RoboSpatial 是面向机器人空间理解的 2D/3D 数据集与评测套件。它从五个室内和桌面三维数据源自动生成约 300 万条空间问答，覆盖世界、自我和物体中心参考系；RoboSpatial-Val 以 6,000 道是非与坐标预测题评估空间配置、上下文和兼容性。
build_method: 基于标定相机与三维框自动提取参考系空间关系并投影生成二维目标
task_type: 机器人空间推理, 视觉问答
eval_feature: 世界/自我/物体参考系；二元关系与坐标预测；未见扫描留出评测
scale: 约 300 万问答、100 万图像、5,000 个扫描；Val 6,000 题
build_method_en: Automatic reference-frame relation extraction from calibrated cameras and oriented 3D boxes, followed by 2D target projection
eval_feature_en: World-, ego-, and object-centric frames; binary relations and coordinate prediction; held-out unseen scans
intro_en: RoboSpatial is a 2D/3D dataset and evaluation suite for robotics spatial understanding. It automatically generates about 3 million spatial QA pairs from five indoor and tabletop 3D sources across world-, ego-, and object-centric frames; RoboSpatial-Val evaluates spatial configuration, context, and compatibility with 6,000 binary and coordinate-prediction questions.
scale_en: About 3M QA pairs, 1M images, and 5K scans; 6K validation questions
drawio_review_note: Aligned with RoboSpatial arXiv:2411.16537 Sections 3-4 and Appendix B, cross-checked against NVlabs/RoboSpatial. RoboSpatial converts ScanNet, Matterport3D, 3RScan, HOPE, and GraspNet-1B scene data into robotics-oriented spatial QA. The pipeline consumes RGB images, calibrated camera poses, oriented 3D boxes, and semantic labels; it computes spatial configuration, context, and compatibility across world-, ego-, and object-centric reference frames, then projects 3D geometry to sample 2D points or regions and adds 100k grounding QA pairs. The full resource contains about 3 million spatial QA pairs over 1 million images and 5,000 scans. RoboSpatial-Val holds out unseen scans and contains 6,000 questions, evenly split across the three relation types; yes/no questions use accuracy and coordinate predictions must lie within a reference convex hull.

name: Role-play Benchmark
intro: Role-play Benchmark旨在通过情景重现来评估角色扮演代理提供沉浸式体验的能力。它不寻求“正确”答案，而是专注于检测与角色设定不符的“错位”之处，例如逻辑矛盾或脱离角色的行为。
build_method: 内部角色设定嵌入聚类、LLM 语义聚合与人工核验；模型对模型长对话自博弈
metric: Worlds, Stories, User Preferences weighted score
eval_feature: 100 轮对话、每场景 3 次独立会话、每 20 轮切块评判、人工偏好校准
scale: 公开子集含 95 个中英文种子与 3,135 个对话会话
build_method_en: Embedding clustering of internal character settings, LLM semantic aggregation, human verification, and model-on-model long-dialogue self-play
eval_feature_en: 100-turn dialogues, 3 independent sessions per scenario, 20-turn judging chunks, and human-preference calibration
intro_en: The Role-play Benchmark aims to evaluate the ability of role-playing agents to provide immersive experiences through scenario reenactment. It does not seek "correct" answers but focuses on detecting "discrepancies" inconsistent with the character setting, such as logical contradictions or out-of-character behavior.
scale_en: Public subset: 95 Chinese/English seeds and 3,135 dialogue sessions
metric_en: Worlds, Stories, User Preferences weighted score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with MiniMax role-play-bench dataset card and MiniMax-M2-her technical blog Sections 2.1-2.2; no standalone benchmark paper is published. Role-play Benchmark has no standalone paper, so the diagram follows MiniMax's official dataset card and technical blog while marking that evidence boundary. The internal pipeline clusters more than one million NPC/user prompts with embeddings, aggregates semantic tags with an LLM, verifies them with humans, and samples Chinese and English settings. A model-on-model user simulator then runs 100-turn self-play three times per setting. Only NPC outputs are judged, in 20-turn chunks, across Basics, Logic, Knowledge, Diversity, Content Logic, and Interaction with regular human calibration. Worlds, Stories, and User Preferences contribute 50%, 25%, and 25%. The public partial release contains 50 Chinese and 45 English seeds with 3,135 dialogue sessions.

name: RULER
intro: RULER基准扩展了传统的needle-in-a-haystack测试，旨在全面评估长上下文语言模型。它支持灵活配置序列长度和任务复杂度，涵盖多种“针”（信息）的类型和数量，并引入了多跳追踪与聚合等新任务，用以测试模型超越简单信息检索的行为能力。
build_method: 自动生成
task_type: 开放式问答, 分类, 补全
eval_feature: 长文本, Multi-hop
build_method_en: Automated Generation
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-hop
intro_en: The RULER benchmark extends the traditional needle-in-a-haystack test to comprehensively evaluate long-context language models. It supports flexible configuration of sequence length and task complexity, covers various types and quantities of "needles" (information), and introduces new tasks like multi-hop tracking and aggregation to assess models' abilities beyond simple information retrieval.
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按COLM 2024论文与NVIDIA官方仓库核对四类任务、NIAH变体、变量追踪、词频聚合、SQuAD/HotpotQA扩展、13项配置、每长度500例、4K至128K网格、召回准确率与有效上下文长度，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。

name: SafeArena
intro: SafeArena针对基于LLM的网络代理滥用风险提出首个专注于恶意使用的评测基准。包含250个安全任务和250个有害任务，覆盖四个网站，评估代理在网络环境中的滥用可能性。
build_method: 人工策划, 人机协同生成, 三专家复核
metric: Task Completion Rate, Refusal Rate, Normalized Safety Score
modality: 网页截图, 文本, 浏览器交互
eval_feature: 对抗性, 多轮, 领域特定
build_method_en: Human Curation, Human-in-the-loop Generation, Three-expert Review
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: SafeArena is the first benchmark focused on malicious use risks for LLM-based web agents. It includes 250 safety tasks and 250 harmful tasks across four websites, evaluating the potential for agent misuse in web environments.
metric_en: Task Completion Rate, Refusal Rate, Normalized Safety Score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SafeArena arXiv:2503.04957 Sections 3.3-4.3 and Appendix D.3; official safearena.github.io project. SafeArena defines five harm categories across four WebArena-derived websites. Authors manually write 150 harmful tasks, add the required environment artifacts and reference objects, and pair each with a minimally changed safe task testing the same capability. GPT-4o-mini then proposes 100 additional harmful-safe pairs; humans verify intent labels, create site artifacts, and validate URLs, HTML, and reference content. Three expert authors review all 500 tasks and resolve ambiguous cases jointly. During evaluation, functional reference objects score task completion, GPT-4o and human judges assign ARIA levels from immediate refusal through successful completion, and the paper reports safe and harmful task completion, refusal rate, and a capability-normalized safety score.

name: SafeSci
intro: SafeSci 是一个面向科学领域及相关场景的大模型安全评测框架，包含大规模多学科安全基准 SafeSciBench 和用于安全增强的 SafeSciTrain，用来衡量模型在科学风险场景中的安全知识与风险辨识能力。
build_method: 结构化数据模板化, 双代理生成, 人工模板校验
modality: 文本, 分子表示, 生物序列
task_type: 选择题, 判断题, 填空, 结构化生成, 安全问答
eval_feature: 领域特定, 安全评估, 过度拒答分析
intro_en: SafeSci is a framework for safety evaluation of LLMs in scientific domains and related contexts. It combines SafeSciBench for large-scale benchmarking and SafeSciTrain for safety enhancement, with an emphasis on objective scientific-risk assessment.
task_type_en: MCQ, True/False, Fill-in, Structured Generation, Safety QA
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Safety Evaluation, Over-refusal Analysis
build_method_en: Structured-data Templates, Dual-agent Generation, Manual Template Validation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SafeSci arXiv:2603.01589v2 Sections 3.1-3.4, Table 2, and Appendix B; official yangyangyang127/SafeSci repository. SafeSci separates scientific safety knowledge from safety risk and designs 125 tasks across seven fields. More than 90% of SafeSciBench comes from structured scientific records: LLMs draft over 15,000 task templates, humans verify them, and metadata is inserted through placeholders. For the remaining unstructured literature, a Generator creates questions whose answers must be verbatim source sentences and a Validator checks strict correspondence. The final benchmark has more than 250,000 test queries, while 1.5 million non-overlapping SafeSciTrain instructions support safety tuning. Evaluation randomly samples subsets across repeated runs and uses accuracy for MCQ/TFQ, domain-specific molecular and sequence metrics for generation, and refusal or safety rate for risk requests.

name: SafetyBench
intro: SafetyBench是一个综合性的基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型的安全性。它包含11,435个多项选择题，涵盖7个不同的安全问题类别。该基准测试同时包含中文和英文数据，支持两种语言的评估。
build_method: 已有数据转换, 考试题收集, ChatGPT扩增, 人工复核
eval_feature: 双语, 零样本, 少样本
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, Zero-shot, Few-shot
intro_en: SafetyBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of large language models. It includes 11,435 multiple-choice questions covering seven different categories of safety issues. The benchmark contains both Chinese and English data, supporting evaluation in both languages.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SafetyBench arXiv:2309.07045 Sections 3-5 and Appendix; official thu-coai/SafetyBench repository. SafetyBench derives seven categories from eight typical safety scenarios, excluding sensitive topics because they diverge strongly across languages. It combines transformed public datasets, safety-related exams, and ChatGPT augmentation. Roughly 500 middle-school exam papers are OCR-processed and crowd-filtered to about 2,000 questions. Underrepresented categories gain about 3,500 ChatGPT questions, filtered by BLEU-4 similarity below 0.7 and manually checked. Questions are translated in both directions with the Baidu API, then all items receive human validation; GPT-4 agrees on 97% of a sample, disagreements are rechecked, and two authors plus a third adjudicator resolve issues. The final 11,435 bilingual MCQs are evaluated zero- and five-shot by parsed option accuracy, including category and language analysis.

name: SaladBench
intro: SaladBench是一个针对LLM及其攻击防御方法的安全评测基准，规模大、类别丰富、层级复杂且功能多样。它引入了基于LLM的多维评审器MD-Judge，专注于攻击增强查询的问答对，以确保评测的高效与可靠。
build_method: 公开数据收集, 自指令生成, 多模型一致标注, 人工抽检
metric: Attack Success Rate, Safety Score, LLM-as-Judge
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试
eval_feature: 对抗性, 层级安全分类, 攻防评估, LLM评审
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: SaladBench is a security evaluation benchmark for LLMs and their attack-defense methods, featuring large scale, diverse categories, complex hierarchy, and versatile functions. It introduces the LLM-based multidimensional evaluator MD-Judge, focusing on attack-enhanced query QA pairs to ensure efficient and reliable assessment.
scale_en: About 30K (21K base, 5K attack, 200 defense, about 4K MCQ)
metric_en: Attack Success Rate, Safety Score, LLM-as-Judge
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SALAD-Bench arXiv:2402.05044 Sections 3-5 and appendices; official OpenSafetyLab/SALAD-BENCH repository. SALAD-Bench defines a three-level taxonomy of six domains, 16 tasks, and 66 categories. Its 21,000-question base set combines public benchmarks with self-instruction from GPT-3.5-turbo fine-tuned on about 500 harmful QA pairs. LSH and Sentence-BERT remove duplicates, a SafeRLHF reward model filters benign items, and only unanimous labels from three open models are kept; three annotators validate a random subset with 94.3% agreement. An attack pipeline expands roughly 4,000 low-refusal bases to about 240,000 candidates and retains 5,000 effective attacks. A defense pipeline selects 200 hard bases and effective defenses, while about 4,000 MCQs pair safe and unsafe queries and responses. MD-Judge and MCQ-Judge then support safety, attack, defense, category, and Elo-style evaluation.

name: Sandbagging QA
intro: Sandbagging QA 是 Apollo Research 提出的上下文内谋划评测环境之一，通过成对改变部署与遗忘激励，检测模型是否在无害的多位数乘法能力测试中策略性降低准确率。
build_method: 成对反事实部署激励, 沙箱工具环境, 重复运行统计检验
task_type: 安全评测, 沙袋行为检测
eval_feature: 成对反事实, 目标消融, 统计显著性检验
scale: 每模型每激励条件50次运行，含有目标与无目标设置
build_method_en: Paired Counterfactual Deployment Incentives, Sandboxed Tool Environment, Repeated Statistical Testing
eval_feature_en: Paired Counterfactual, Goal Ablation, Statistical Significance Test
intro_en: Sandbagging QA is an in-context scheming evaluation environment introduced by Apollo Research. It changes deployment and unlearning incentives in paired conditions to test whether a model strategically lowers accuracy on harmless multi-digit multiplication tasks.
scale_en: 50 runs per model per incentive condition, with-goal and no-goal settings
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming arXiv:2412.04984 Sections 2.3 and 3.6, Table 6, and Appendix A.6; Apollo Research project page. Sandbagging QA is an evaluation environment inside Apollo Research's in-context scheming suite, not an independently documented OpenAI benchmark. A model receives a harmless list of multi-digit multiplication problems, answer-format documentation, and optionally a long-term mathematics-research goal. In the underperform incentive, documentation says accuracy above 50% triggers arithmetic unlearning; the paired counterfactual says accuracy below 50% triggers unlearning. The paper also removes the explicit goal in an ablation. Each incentive condition is run 50 times per model. Final-answer accuracy is compared between paired conditions, and bootstrap testing with alpha 0.01 estimates whether performance depends significantly on the deployment incentive; the evidence is aggregate behavior rather than proof from a single rollout.

name: ScanBench
intro: ScanBench以303个临床病例模拟“问诊—辅助检查—诊断”完整流程，覆盖12个科室、8857个问诊检查项和38类检查动作，评估模型主动获取信息、选择必要检查及给出层级诊断的能力。
build_method: 临床病例三阶段转换, 专家标注
metric: SCAN四维评分, 加权F1, ICD-10层级匹配
eval_feature: 多轮问诊, 检查选择, 层级诊断
scale: 303个病例, 12个科室, 8857个问诊检查项, 38类检查动作
build_method_en: Three-station Clinical Case Transformation, Expert Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn Inquiry, Test Selection, Hierarchical Diagnosis
intro_en: ScanBench turns 303 clinical cases into an Inquiry–Lab Testing–Diagnosis workflow across 12 departments, 8,857 inquiry checklist items, and 38 examination categories to assess active information gathering, necessary-test selection, and hierarchical diagnosis.
scale_en: 303 cases, 12 departments, 8,857 inquiry checklist items, 38 examination categories
metric_en: SCAN Dimensions, Weighted F1, Hierarchical ICD-10 Matching
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Baichuan-M3 arXiv:2602.06570 Sections 4.1.1-4.1.2 and Figure 4. ScanBench converts 303 clinical cases from 12 departments into the progressive workflow Inquiry, Lab Testing, and Diagnosis. Its inquiry ground truth contains 8,857 checklist items, averaging 29.23 per case, partitioned into Level 2 critical and Level 1 supplementary evidence. The lab station uses a unified action space of 38 examination categories and labels tests as essential or optional. During evaluation, a model first interviews a standardized patient; GPT-4.1 checks coverage of OSCE-derived clinical points and the SCAN framework scores Safety Stratification, Information Clarification, Associative Questioning, and Normative Output. The model then proposes a differential and selects tests, scored by weighted F1 with higher essential-test recall weight, before a final diagnosis is matched hierarchically against ICD-10.

name: SceneBench
intro: SceneBench是LongCat-Image报告内部Poster&SceneBench中的自然场景文字部分，关注纹理标牌、店面和复杂光照下的文字融合；它不是另一个同名Scene-Bench数据集。
build_method: 内部提示整理
metric: 论文报告的Real Scene得分；评分协议未披露
task_type: 图像生成, 文字渲染
eval_feature: 真实场景文字融合, 纹理表面, 复杂光照
scale: Poster与Real Scene合计500条提示；场景子集数量未披露
build_method_en: Internal Prompt Curation
eval_feature_en: Real-scene Text Integration, Textured Surfaces, Complex Lighting
intro_en: SceneBench is the natural-scene-text portion of LongCat-Image's internal Poster&SceneBench, targeting text integration on textured signs and shop fronts under complex lighting; it is not the unrelated Scene-Bench dataset.
scale_en: 500 prompts across Poster and Real Scene combined; scene-subset count not disclosed
metric_en: Paper-reported Real Scene score; scoring protocol not disclosed
drawio_review_note: Aligned with LongCat-Image arXiv:2512.07584 Section 5.1 Poster&SceneBench and Table 8. SceneBench is the natural-scene-text portion of the internal Poster&SceneBench evaluation in the LongCat-Image report, not the unrelated Scene-Bench dataset. The authors curate 500 prompts jointly covering poster typography and natural scene text; they do not disclose the split count, source mixture, annotators, or quality-control procedure for the scene subset. Natural-scene cases target seamless text integration into real environments such as signage on textured surfaces and shop fronts under complex lighting. Models generate images for the prompts, and Table 8 reports separate Poster and Real Scene scores plus their average. The report does not disclose the scorer, rubric, or exact aggregation protocol behind those internal scores.

name: SciCode
intro: SciCode是一个由科学家策划的编码基准，旨在评估语言模型解决真实科学研究问题的能力。该基准包含从80个主要问题分解出的338个子问题，涵盖数学、物理、化学、生物学和材料科学等16个不同的自然科学子领域。它提供了可选的科学背景信息以及科学家标注的黄金标准解决方案和测试用例。在最真实的设置下，目前最先进的模型Claude3.5-Sonnet只能解决4.6%的问题，表明该基准具有挑战性，并为未来科学AI的发展提供了方向。
org: Argonne National Laboratory, Carnegie Mellon University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Prin
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
eval_feature: 思维链, 过程评估
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Process Evaluation
intro_en: SciCode is a coding benchmark curated by scientists to evaluate language models' ability to solve real scientific research problems. It consists of 338 subproblems derived from 80 main problems, covering 16 natural science subfields including mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, and materials science. The benchmark provides optional scientific background information along with scientist-annotated gold standard solutions and test cases. Under the most realistic settings, the state-of-the-art model Claude3.5-Sonnet can only solve 4.6% of the problems, highlighting the benchmark's challenge and guiding future development in scientific AI.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.13168 and the official SciCode repository. Scientists contribute internal research scripts from 16 natural-science subfields and decompose 80 main problems into 338 ordered subproblems with explicit input-output docstrings. The development split has 15 main and 50 subproblems; the test split has 65 main and 288 subproblems. Scientist gold solutions use common documented NumPy, SciPy, or SymPy functionality. Numerical tests and domain-specific workflows reproduce published results or analytical theory. Three validation rounds combine at least two in-domain scientists, one out-of-domain scientist, and GPT-4 generation followed by scientist failure analysis and test redesign. The standard setting omits background and carries generated prior solutions forward; a main problem passes only when every subproblem and the integrated main solution pass. Pass@1 is reported at main and subproblem levels.

name: ScienceQA
intro: ScienceQA是Olmo 3报告中的科学工具调用监督微调数据，包含论文内容问答与引文图谱问答；它不是早期多模态ScienceQA，也未被报告为独立计分基准。
build_method: GPT-5问题生成, 学术检索, 真实工具轨迹
metric: 未披露独立评分器或评测指标
task_type: 科学问答, 检索推理
eval_feature: 论文内容检索, 引文图谱推理, 工具调用
build_method_en: GPT-5 Query Generation, Scholarly Retrieval, Live Tool Trajectories
eval_feature_en: Paper-content Retrieval, Citation-graph Reasoning, Tool Use
intro_en: ScienceQA is scientific tool-use SFT data in the Olmo 3 report, covering paper-content and citation-graph queries; it is not the older multimodal ScienceQA benchmark or a separately scored evaluation suite.
metric_en: No Standalone Scorer or Evaluation Metric Disclosed
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Olmo 3 arXiv:2512.13961 Appendix A.7.2 Science QA. The Science QA entry in the Olmo 3 report describes scientific tool-use SFT data, not the older multimodal ScienceQA benchmark and not a separately scored evaluation suite. It has two query classes: paper-content questions grounded in abstracts or full text, and citation-graph questions about authors, venues, and citations. GPT-5 creates few-shot citation-query templates and instantiates them with real paper entities. For content questions, a GPT-5 agent uses the Ai2 Scholar Corpus server to retrieve papers and formulate questions answerable from the retrieved text. A GPT-4.1-mini agent with the same server then produces tool-use trajectories for both classes; the saved tool outputs are actual environment responses rather than synthetic completions. These trajectories enter Dolci Instruct SFT. The report does not separately disclose this subset's size, split, standalone scorer, or evaluation metric.

name: Scientists' First Exam
intro: Scientists' First Exam（SFE）以真实科研原始数据构建830组双语多模态问答，覆盖天文、化学、地球科学、生命科学和材料科学的66项任务，考查信号感知、属性理解与比较推理。
org: 上海人工智能实验室 PrismaX Team
build_method: 专家构建, 原生科研数据, 双语标注
metric: BERTScore F1, LLM Judge, Execution Success, IoU
modality: 图像, 文本, 科学数据
eval_feature: 三层认知, 多图, 双语, 开放题与定位题
scale: 830组VQA, 66项任务, 5个学科, 17种数据格式
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Native Scientific Data, Bilingual Annotation
eval_feature_en: Three cognitive levels, Multi-image, Bilingual, Open and grounding tasks
intro_en: Scientists' First Exam (SFE) contains 830 bilingual multimodal VQA pairs built from native scientific data. Its 66 tasks span astronomy, chemistry, earth science, life science, and materials science, probing signal perception, attribute understanding, and comparative reasoning.
scale_en: 830 VQA pairs, 66 tasks, 5 disciplines, 17 data formats
metric_en: BERTScore F1, LLM Judge, Execution Success, IoU
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SFE arXiv:2506.10521 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendix E; official PrismaX-Team/sfe repository. Scientists' First Exam is the expanded-name record for SFE and follows the same paper-defined three-phase process. Experts first identify high-value directions in astronomy, chemistry, earth, life, and materials science. Two to five experts per discipline then map concrete tasks to signal perception, attribute understanding, or comparative reasoning and to MCQ, exact-match, or open-question formats. Native scientific data in 17 formats are rendered into images; experts author the VQA pairs, translate them into English and Chinese, cross-review scientific correctness, and apply rule-based format checks. The final set contains 830 VQA pairs across 66 tasks. Zero-shot evaluation uses temperature zero and reports text similarity or LLM-judge scores, with execution success and IoU for grounding tasks, broken down by discipline, cognitive level, and language.

name: ScreenSpot
intro: ScreenSpot是SeeClick提出的原始GUI定位基准，包含移动端、桌面端和网页的真实界面截图及英文操作指令，评估模型能否把目标元素定位到正确可点击区域；它不是ScreenSpot-Pro。
org: 南京大学, 上海人工智能实验室
build_method: 4位标注者采集截图, 边界框与英文指令标注
eval_feature: 移动端桌面端网页, 文本与图标控件定位
scale: 600多张截图, 1200多条指令, 5种系统/环境
build_method_en: Four-annotator Screenshot Collection, Bounding Boxes, English Commands
eval_feature_en: Mobile, Desktop, Web, Text and Icon/Widget Grounding
intro_en: ScreenSpot is the original GUI-grounding benchmark introduced with SeeClick. It pairs realistic mobile, desktop, and web screenshots with English commands to test whether a model locates the correct clickable region; it is not ScreenSpot-Pro.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SeeClick arXiv:2401.10935 Section 4 and Appendix B; official njucckevin/SeeClick repository. ScreenSpot is the original GUI-grounding benchmark introduced with SeeClick, not ScreenSpot-Pro. Four experienced computer-science annotators are assigned mobile, desktop, or web GUI types, capture screenshots during routine use, annotate frequently used clickable regions with bounding boxes, and write English commands. Mobile and desktop cases use common apps and operations; web cases cover development, shopping, forum, and tool sites from WebArena. Interfaces and elements are English, and personal information is removed. The final benchmark contains over 600 screenshots and more than 1,200 instructions across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web, with text and icon/widget labels. Models receive a screenshot and instruction; output coordinates, or bounding-box centers, become predicted points. Click accuracy counts a hit when the point falls inside the ground-truth box and is reported by platform and element type.

name: ScreenSpot-v2
intro: ScreenSpot-v2 是 OS-ATLAS 对原 ScreenSpot 的质量修订版：全面审计 1272 条 GUI 定位样本，修复或替换其中 144 条错误样本，同时保持移动端、桌面端与网页端总体规模不变。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The University of Hong Kong, MIT
build_method: 全量错误审计, 问题样本替换, 指令重写, 边界框重标注
eval_feature: 原版指令与规划器扩写设置, 平台与元素类型切片
scale: 1272条样本；144条修订（网页63、桌面28、移动53）
build_method_en: Full error audit, problematic-sample replacement, instruction rewriting, and bounding-box relabeling
eval_feature_en: Original-instruction and planner-elaborated settings; platform and element-type slices
intro_en: ScreenSpot-v2 is OS-ATLAS's quality-controlled revision of ScreenSpot. It audits all 1,272 GUI-grounding samples and corrects or replaces 144 erroneous items while preserving the mobile, desktop, and web total.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with OS-ATLAS arXiv:2410.23218 Section 4.1 and Appendix C; official OS-Copilot/OS-Atlas repository. ScreenSpot-v2 is the quality-controlled revision introduced with OS-ATLAS. The authors audit all 1,272 original ScreenSpot samples and identify 144 erroneous cases, or 11.32 percent: 63 of 436 web, 28 of 334 desktop, and 53 of 502 mobile samples. Problems include spelling or missing elements, ambiguous instructions with multiple valid targets, near-duplicate elements, and incorrect ground-truth boxes. Problematic questions are removed and replaced, referring-expression-style commands are rewritten as natural instructions, and mislabeled boxes are corrected while the total size remains 1,272. Evaluation can use the original instruction directly or a planner such as GPT-4o to elaborate it. A predicted point is correct when it falls inside the target box; box predictions can additionally be measured by IoU. Results are sliced by mobile, desktop, and web and by text versus icon/widget, then averaged.

name: SD-QA
intro: SD-QA 是基于 TyDi QA 构建的多语言方言语音问答基准，包含 255 名说话者以 24 种语言变体录制的 6.8 万余条问题，覆盖阿拉伯语、孟加拉语、英语、斯瓦希里语和韩语。它联合评估语音识别、段落选择、最小答案抽取及跨方言公平性。
build_method: TyDi QA 原生问题抽样；255 名说话者覆盖 24 种方言录音；ASR 与说话者元数据配对
language: 阿拉伯语, 孟加拉语, 英语, 斯瓦希里语, 韩语
task_type: 语音识别, 段落选择, 最小答案抽取
eval_feature: 跨 24 种方言及说话者群体比较 ASR 与问答稳健性和公平性
scale: 超过 68,000 条语音问题，24 种方言，255 名说话者
build_method_en: Native TyDi QA question sampling; recordings from 255 speakers across 24 varieties; ASR and speaker-metadata pairing
eval_feature_en: ASR and QA robustness and fairness comparisons across 24 dialects and speaker populations
intro_en: SD-QA is a multilingual spoken-dialectal QA benchmark built from TyDi QA, with more than 68,000 questions recorded by 255 speakers across 24 varieties of Arabic, Bengali, English, Kiswahili, and Korean. It jointly evaluates speech recognition, passage selection, minimal-answer extraction, and cross-dialect fairness.
scale_en: More than 68,000 spoken questions, 24 dialects, 255 speakers
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SD-QA arXiv:2109.12072 Sections 2-3 and official ffaisal93/SD-QA data and baseline layout. SD-QA augments TyDi QA with more than 68,000 human-recorded spoken questions in Arabic, Bengali, English, Kiswahili, and Korean, spanning 24 language varieties and 255 speakers. It uses native TyDi QA questions rather than translations, takes the original TyDi QA development set as test, samples development items from training, and removes those items from the text training data; no spoken training set is provided. Recordings, gold and ASR transcripts, speaker metadata, contexts, and answers are packaged by language, dialect, and split. Evaluation covers ASR with word error rate, passage selection and minimal-answer selection with TyDi QA F1, and robustness or fairness comparisons across dialects and speaker populations.

name: SealQA
intro: SealQA是一个新的挑战性基准测试，旨在评估搜索增强型语言模型在事实查询问题上的推理能力。该基准测试的特点是网络搜索结果可能存在冲突、噪音或无用信息。它包含Seal-0、Seal-Hard和LongSeal三种类型，分别侧重于事实准确性、推理能力以及长上下文、多文档推理。
build_method: 6名NLP研究者人工构建, 多轮失败测试, 至少两名研究生复审与专家批准
eval_feature: 检索增强, 困难负例, 长上下文多文档, 自动判分
build_method_en: Six NLP researchers, repeated model-failure testing, review by at least two graduate researchers, and expert approval
eval_feature_en: Search augmentation, hard negatives, long-context multi-document reasoning, and automatic grading
intro_en: SealQA evaluates search-augmented reasoning on factual questions whose web evidence may be conflicting, noisy, or unhelpful. Its reviewed question pool yields Seal-0, Seal-Hard, and the multi-document LongSeal setting.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SealQA arXiv:2506.01062 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C; official vtllms/sealqa dataset. SealQA is created over eight months by six NLP researchers, who spend more than one hour per question on average. They write single-answer questions in five categories: advanced reasoning, disambiguation, temporal tracking, cross-lingual search, and false-premise detection. Each item includes supporting web pages, an explanation, freshness and expected-search-result labels, and is repeatedly refined until frontier models fail. At least two graduate reviewers check URLs, answer correctness, and clarity before expert approval; volatile items receive effective years and review dates. Seal-0 contains 111 questions with repeated zero-percent performance from tested frontier non-reasoning systems with browsing; Seal-Hard expands to 254. LongSeal pairs each of those 254 questions with one gold source and 50 hard negatives. Evaluation uses tool-enabled or search-injected settings, randomizes the gold position among 12, 20, or 30 documents for LongSeal, and uses GPT-4o-mini to label answers correct, incorrect, or not attempted before reporting accuracy and category breakdowns.

name: SecCodeBench
intro: SecCodeBench-V2 是来自阿里巴巴生产漏洞模式的安全编码基准，包含98个函数级任务、22类CWE、5种编程语言以及生成与修复共4种场景。
build_method: 生产漏洞抽取, 完整项目脚手架, 功能与安全测试, 专家双重审查
task_type: 安全代码生成, 安全代码修复
eval_feature: Docker动态验证, 安全PoC, LLM评审团, CVSS严重度加权
scale: 98个任务, 22类CWE, 5种编程语言, 4种场景
build_method_en: Production vulnerability sourcing, complete project scaffolds, functional and security tests, and expert double review
eval_feature_en: Docker validation, security PoCs, LLM judge panels, and CVSS severity weighting
intro_en: SecCodeBench-V2 is an industrial secure-coding benchmark derived from Alibaba production vulnerability patterns, with 98 function-level tasks, 22 CWE types, five programming languages, and four generation or repair scenarios.
scale_en: 98 tasks, 22 CWE types, 5 programming languages, 4 scenarios
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SecCodeBench-V2 arXiv:2602.15485 Sections 2-4 and Appendices; official alibaba/sec-code-bench repository. SecCodeBench-V2 builds 98 function-level secure-coding tasks from Alibaba production vulnerability patterns, spanning 22 CWE types and Java, C, Python, Go, and JavaScript. Each task supplies a complete project scaffold with fixed interfaces and dependencies and appears in four scenarios: generation, generation with security hints, repair, and repair with hints. Prompts are available in Chinese and English. Experts author and double-review functional tests and security proof-of-concept tests, and assign CVSS Critical, High, or Medium severity with weights 4, 2, or 1. The controller initializes the environment, creates prompts, executes model batches, analyzes artifacts, and exports results. Docker validators compile and run each submission; functionality is checked first and may trigger feedback-based repair, after which security is assessed by dynamic PoCs or an odd-numbered LLM-judge panel with majority voting for semantic flaws. Default Pass@1 is reported overall and by language, scenario, and severity, with weighted and unweighted views. Passing only demonstrates resistance within the benchmark threat model.

name: SeqQA
intro: SeqQA 是 LAB-Bench 的生物序列操作类别，包含750道程序生成的多项选择题和15个子任务，覆盖DNA、RNA、蛋白质、PCR、限制酶、开放阅读框与克隆技能。
build_method: 任务模板程序生成, BioPython计算理想答案, 规则化生成近错干扰项
eval_feature: 15个生物序列子任务, 零样本思维链, 显式放弃选项, 人类对比
build_method_en: Programmatic task templates, BioPython ideal-answer computation, and rule-based near-miss distractors
eval_feature_en: Fifteen biological-sequence subtasks, zero-shot chain-of-thought, explicit decline option, and human comparison
intro_en: SeqQA is LAB-Bench's biological-sequence manipulation category, with 750 programmatically generated multiple-choice questions across 15 subtasks covering DNA, RNA, proteins, PCR, restriction enzymes, open reading frames, and cloning.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with LAB-Bench arXiv:2407.10362 Sections 2-4 and Appendix SeqQA task descriptions; official Future-House/LAB-Bench repository. SeqQA is the sequence-manipulation category of LAB-Bench, containing 750 multiple-choice questions across 15 subtasks involving DNA, RNA, proteins, PCR, restriction enzymes, open reading frames, cloning, and basic sequence properties. Most items are generated programmatically. Task-specific scripts and BioPython compute ideal answers, while distractors are deterministic near misses or incorrect transformations such as shifted fragment lengths, truncated open reading frames, nearby amino acids, or perturbed GC content. The official release separates public data from a protected test or canary portion. In the paper's baseline evaluation, models answer with zero-shot chain-of-thought and no tools, with an explicit decline option. Text completions are parsed into choices. Accuracy measures correct answers over all questions, precision measures correct answers over attempted questions, and coverage measures attempted questions over all questions. Results are reported by subtask over three runs and compared with human researchers.

name: Sequential-NIAH
intro: Sequential-NIAH是一个专门用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）从长上下文中提取有序信息项（即“针”）能力的基准测试。该基准测试包含三种“针”的生成方式，上下文长度从8K到128K不等，共计14000个样本。为了评估模型表现，研究者训练了一个评估模型，通过比较答案的完整性和顺序一致性来打分，提供了比GPT-4或Claude更可靠的评估指标。
org: Zhejiang University, Ant Group, Tencent Youtu Lab, Beihang University, Cornell University
build_method: 三条生成流水线, GPT-4o改写, 长文本一一配对与随机插针, 专用评估器微调
metric: Evaluator Accuracy, Completeness and Order Correctness
eval_feature: 长文本, 防污染
build_method_en: Three generation pipelines, GPT-4o rewriting, one-to-one long-context pairing with random insertion, and evaluator fine-tuning
eval_feature_en: Long context, bilingual data, ordered multi-needle retrieval, and a validated task-specific evaluator
intro_en: Sequential-NIAH evaluates ordered multi-needle extraction from 8K-to-128K contexts. Its 14,000 bilingual samples use synthetic-temporal, real-temporal, and real-logical pipelines, and a fine-tuned evaluator checks answer completeness and order.
metric_en: Evaluator Accuracy, Completeness and Order Correctness
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Sequential-NIAH arXiv:2504.04713 Sections 2-4 and Appendices; official miraclefish/Sequential-NIAH-Benchmark repository. Sequential-NIAH creates 14,000 long-context samples with three pipelines. Synthetic-temporal data combines fake subjects, times, and events into sequences of 3 to 15 needles. Real-temporal data draws from ICEWS and FEG temporal knowledge graphs and uses GPT-4o to rewrite chains of 3 to 10 events. Real-logical data filters 2,986 private open-domain QA examples, manually checks samples, and rewrites them into natural sequential needles. The resulting 6,000 synthetic-temporal, 5,014 real-temporal, and 2,986 real-logical QA items are paired one-to-one with 8K to 128K texts sampled from LongData-Corpus, shuffled, and inserted at random positions. The bilingual set contains 7,500 English and 6,500 Chinese examples and is split 10,000 train, 2,000 development, and 2,000 test. A Qwen2.5-32B evaluator is fine-tuned on shuffled, missing, redundant, and incorrect answer variants with GPT-4o rationales and reaches 99.49 percent validation accuracy. Target models run on the 2,000 test items; the evaluator judges completeness and order, and accuracy is reported by context length, needle count, and pipeline.

name: SFE
intro: SFE（Scientists’ First Exam）以真实科研原始数据构建830组双语多模态问答，覆盖天文、化学、地球科学、生命科学和材料科学的66项任务，分别考查科学信号感知、科学属性理解与科学比较推理。
org: 上海人工智能实验室 PrismaX Team
build_method: 专家构建, 原生科研数据, 双语标注
metric: BERTScore F1, LLM Judge, Execution Success, IoU
modality: 图像, 文本, 科学数据
eval_feature: 三层认知, 多图, 双语, 开放题与定位题
scale: 830组VQA, 66项任务, 5个学科, 17种数据格式
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Native Scientific Data, Bilingual Annotation
eval_feature_en: Three cognitive levels, Multi-image, Bilingual, Open and grounding tasks
