intro_en: SFE (Scientists' First Exam) contains 830 bilingual multimodal VQA pairs built from native scientific data. Its 66 tasks span astronomy, chemistry, earth science, life science, and materials science, probing signal perception, attribute understanding, and comparative reasoning.
scale_en: 830 VQA pairs, 66 tasks, 5 disciplines, 17 data formats
metric_en: BERTScore F1, LLM Judge, Execution Success, IoU
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SFE arXiv:2506.10521 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendix E; official PrismaX-Team/sfe repository. SFE is built in three paper-defined phases. Experts first identify high-value directions in astronomy, chemistry, earth, life, and materials science. Two to five experts per discipline then map concrete tasks to signal perception, attribute understanding, or comparative reasoning and to MCQ, exact-match, or open-question formats. Native scientific data in 17 formats are rendered into images; experts author the VQA pairs, translate them into English and Chinese, cross-review scientific correctness, and apply rule-based format checks. The final set contains 830 VQA pairs across 66 tasks. Zero-shot evaluation uses temperature zero and reports text similarity or LLM-judge scores, with execution success and IoU for grounding tasks, broken down by discipline, cognitive level, and language.

name: SHADE-Arena
intro: SHADE-Arena是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）代理在复杂和长期任务中执行隐蔽破坏和监控能力的基准测试。它包含复杂的良性主任务和有害的次要目标对，代理需要在不引起LLM监控器怀疑的情况下完成次要任务。该基准测试旨在衡量LLM代理规避监控和实现有害隐藏目标的能力，并评估监控模型检测此类行为的能力。
build_method: 专家构建, 对抗性任务设计, 轨迹审查
eval_feature: 隐蔽破坏, 过程监控, 自动任务评估
scale: 17个主任务/次要任务对（5个公开）
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Process evaluation
intro_en: SHADE-Arena is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents' ability to perform covert sabotage and surveillance in complex, long-term tasks. It includes intricate benign primary tasks paired with harmful secondary objectives, where agents must complete the secondary tasks without raising suspicion from LLM monitors. The benchmark aims to measure LLM agents' capability to evade monitoring and achieve harmful hidden goals, as well as to assess monitoring models' effectiveness in detecting such behaviors.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SHADE-Arena arXiv:2506.15740 Sections 2-4 and Appendices B-D; official safety-research/SHADE-Arena repository. SHADE-Arena extends AgentDojo into complex long-horizon environments with more than 30 components, over 340 tools, and some synthetic states exceeding 100,000 tokens. Researchers manually engineer 17 pairs of a benign main task and harmful side task, attach automatic evaluators, confirm that explicit pursuit of the side task is judged suspicious, demonstrate a reference attack that evades the default Claude 3.6 Sonnet monitor, and review tens of transcripts for genuine attempts. During evaluation the agent receives both goals and interacts through tools. The side-task instruction, hidden scratchpad, and system material are removed before a monitor returns a 0-100 suspicion score. Overall sabotage success requires the main task, side task, and evasion score below 80; monitor quality is summarized with AUC on benign versus successful-attack transcripts.

name: SimpleQA
intro: SimpleQA是一个由OpenAI开发的事实性问答基准，旨在评估大型语言模型回答简短、事实明确问题的能力。该基准通过对抗性方式收集，针对GPT-4的回答进行设计，确保问题具有单一且无争议的答案，从而简化评分。SimpleQA旨在测试模型是否能识别其知识边界，避免对不确定的问题做出猜测性回答。
build_method: 人工出题, 四模型对抗筛选, 独立双人答案验证
metric: 总体正确率, 尝试题正确率, F-score
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 对抗性
build_method_en: Human question writing, four-model adversarial filtering, independent two-trainer verification
eval_feature_en: Adversarial
intro_en: SimpleQA is a factual question-answering benchmark developed by OpenAI to evaluate large language models' ability to answer short, fact-based questions. Collected adversarially and designed against GPT-4's responses, it ensures questions have a single, unambiguous answer to simplify scoring. SimpleQA aims to test whether models can recognize their knowledge boundaries and avoid guessing on uncertain questions.
metric_en: Overall correct, Correct given attempted, F-score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.04368 Sections 2-4. AI trainers write short, specific, evergreen fact questions with a reference answer and evidence. A question survives only if at least one of four reviewed OpenAI model responses is wrong; ChatGPT classifiers flag criteria violations and make light copy edits. A blind second trainer independently answers and checks the criteria, then an answer-matching classifier and a two-unique-domain evidence rule gate retention. A third trainer audits 1,000 examples, yielding an estimated 3 percent dataset error rate. The final 4,326 questions are graded as correct, incorrect, or not attempted and summarized by overall correct, correct given attempted, and their harmonic-mean F-score.

name: SimpleQA Verified
intro: SimpleQA Verified 从原 SimpleQA 的4326题中通过来源去重、主题平衡、冲突来源调和、难度筛选与人工复核构建1000道无工具短事实问答，用于更可靠地测量参数知识事实性。
build_method: 多阶段去重与平衡, 来源调和, 前沿模型难度筛选, 人工复核
metric: F1, Accuracy, Correct Given Attempted, Attempted Rate
eval_feature: 无工具参数知识, 三分类自动判分, 数值可接受区间
build_method_en: Multi-stage de-duplication and balancing, source reconciliation, frontier-model difficulty filtering, and manual review
eval_feature_en: No-tool parametric knowledge, ternary automatic grading, and item-specific numeric ranges
intro_en: SimpleQA Verified filters the original 4,326 SimpleQA prompts into 1,000 no-tool short factual questions through source de-duplication, topic balancing, source reconciliation, difficulty filtering, and manual review.
metric_en: F1, Accuracy, Correct Given Attempted, Attempted Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SimpleQA Verified arXiv:2509.07968 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A; official Google DeepMind Kaggle benchmark. SimpleQA Verified filters and corrects OpenAI's 4,326-item SimpleQA to create a 1,000-prompt no-tool parametric-factuality benchmark. The authors retain one question per source document, then apply Gemini-embedding and TF-IDF de-duplication, remove sources whose publishers opt out via crawler controls, and rebalance answer types and topics. Search-augmented model ensembles reconcile conflicting nonnumeric answers and numeric answers within a five-percent margin; numeric ground truths are rewritten with item-specific acceptable ranges. Frontier-model difficulty filtering retains 1,000 hard prompts. Manual review then repairs URLs and date precision and adds reasoning and multi-step metadata. Models answer with standard API settings and no tools. GPT-4.1 grades each response correct, incorrect, or not attempted using a revised prompt that handles numeric ranges, extra information, hedging, and varied refusal styles. Accuracy, correct-given-attempted, attempted rate, hedged rate, and their harmonic F1 are reported.

name: SimpleVQA
intro: SimpleVQA是首个全面的多模态基准测试，旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）回答自然语言简短问题的真实性能力。它涵盖多任务和多场景，确保高质量和具有挑战性的查询，并维护静态和永恒的参考答案。该基准将视觉问答项目分为9个围绕客观事件或常识的不同任务，并置于9个主题中。通过严格的质量控制和LLM作为评判的评分系统，SimpleVQA对MLLMs的图像理解和文本生成能力进行全面评估。
org: Beihang University, Baidu, M-A-P, Beijing Jiaotong University, Yantai University
build_method: 多源种子收集, GPT-4o改写, GPT-4筛查, 双专家复核与第三人裁决
metric: Correct, Not Attempted, Incorrect, Correct Given Attempted, F-score
eval_feature: 中英双语, 9任务9领域, 原子事实错误分析, LLM自动评分
scale: 2025组图像问答, 9类任务, 9个领域, 244种图像类型
build_method_en: Multi-source seed collection, GPT-4o rewriting, GPT-4 screening, two-expert review, and third-expert adjudication
eval_feature_en: Chinese-English bilingual, nine tasks and domains, atomic-fact error analysis, and LLM grading
intro_en: SimpleVQA evaluates multimodal factuality with 2,025 bilingual short-answer image questions spanning nine tasks, nine domains, and 244 image types. Its multi-stage pipeline combines source-dataset and web seeds, model screening, difficulty filtering, and expert fact checking.
scale_en: 2,025 image-question pairs, 9 tasks, 9 domains, 244 image types
metric_en: Correct, Not Attempted, Incorrect, Correct Given Attempted, F-score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SimpleVQA arXiv:2502.13059 Sections 2.1-2.5 and 3.1-3.3, Figures 2-4, and Appendix G; official SimpleVQA/SimpleVQA repository. SimpleVQA is a bilingual factual visual-question-answering benchmark with 2,025 short-answer image-question pairs across nine tasks, nine domains, and 244 image types. Seed images and QA come from MM-Vet, MME, DynaMath, MMBench-CN, CCBench, and expert web search. GPT-4o rewrites or creates one-to-one factual QA, GPT-4 screens stability, uniqueness, and difficulty, and two professional annotators refine samples. Questions answered by all four of GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Doubao-Vision-Pro, and ERNIE-VL are removed. Atomic recognition questions are generated for later error analysis. Every item is independently fact-checked by two experts against at least two URLs, with a third expert resolving disagreement. From 8,360 candidates, repeated filtering retains 2,025. Models receive an image and concise question; GPT-4o grades correct, not attempted, or incorrect. Correct-given-attempted and the harmonic F-score of correct and correct-given-attempted are reported by language, task, and domain, with a 569-item complex-fact subset used for atomic-fact analysis.

name: SingleCellBench
intro: SingleCellBench 是 LatchBio 开发并在 Claude Sonnet 5 系统卡中披露的单细胞RNA测序分析评测变体，包含195个问题，覆盖细胞类型标注、差异表达分析和批次效应校正；构建与评分细节未公开。
build_method: 未披露
task_type: 生物信息学问答, 数据分析
eval_feature: 单细胞RNA测序分析, 标准生物信息学流程, 协议未披露
build_method_en: Not disclosed
eval_feature_en: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis, standard bioinformatics workflows, and an undisclosed protocol
intro_en: SingleCellBench is a LatchBio single-cell RNA-sequencing analysis evaluation disclosed in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card. Its 195 problems cover cell-type labeling, differential-expression analysis, and batch-effect correction; construction and scoring details are not public.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Claude Sonnet 5 System Card Section 8.14.2 LatchBio Bioinformatics, p.142. SingleCellBench is a LatchBio evaluation variant documented only in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card, not in a standalone benchmark paper. The card says it contains 195 problems that test analysis of single-cell RNA-sequencing data across standard workflows including cell-type labeling, differential-expression analysis, and batch-effect correction. It reports aggregate model scores for the variant. The source does not disclose how the 195 problems were sourced or annotated, dataset splits, prompt and tool setup, reference-answer format, per-item scoring rubric, or aggregation formula. The diagram therefore separates the few disclosed task-scope facts from an explicit undisclosed-method boundary instead of inventing a build process.

name: SkillGenBench
intro: SkillGenBench 是一个用于评估 LLM Agent 技能生成流水线的基准。它将原始仓库或长文档交给生成器，要求生成标准化的 SKILL.md 工件，再在固定 harness 中执行并用统一评测流程判断技能是否正确、可复用且可执行，覆盖任务可见与任务不可见两种生成设置。
build_method: 仓库与文档源构建, 固定harness执行, 确定性检查
modality: 文本, 代码, 文档
task_type: Agent技能生成, 工具使用, 过程执行
eval_feature: 技能生成, 仓库理解, 文档理解, 执行验证
scale: 2种生成设置, 2类程序源, 5种生成方法
task_type_en: Agent skill generation, Tool use, Procedure execution
build_method_en: Repository and document source construction, fixed-harness execution, deterministic checks
eval_feature_en: Skill generation, repository understanding, document understanding, execution verification
intro_en: SkillGenBench evaluates skill-generation pipelines for LLM agents. A generator receives raw repositories or long documents, produces standardized SKILL.md artifacts, and the generated skills are executed under fixed harnesses and assessed with unified procedures for correctness, reusability, and executability across task-conditioned and task-agnostic generation settings.
scale_en: 2 generation regimes, 2 procedural source types, 5 generation methods
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.18693 Figure 2 and benchmark-construction and evaluation-protocol sections. SkillGenBench turns fixed repository snapshots and long-form documents into 187 repository- and document-grounded skill-generation tasks. Its five construction stages abstract sources into knowledge graphs, propose scenarios, generate function-style tasks and hidden tests, remove tasks that are solvable without procedural extraction or trivial with the complete corpus, and validate survivors with iteratively refined reference skills before human verification. Evaluation separates task-conditioned from task-agnostic generation, requires standardized skill artifacts, and runs them in pinned environments with fixed executors, deterministic hidden checks, artifact diagnostics, and pass@3 reporting.

name: SkillsBench
intro: SkillsBench v1.1 用87项、8领域的真实专业任务和确定性验证器，对比无Skills与专家Skills条件，测量程序性技能包对智能体完成任务的实际增益。
org: BenchFlow, Ohio State University, Amazon, Dartmouth College, Stanford University, UC Davis, Carnegie Mellon University, UC Berkeley, and collaborators
build_method: 400份贡献者任务筛选, Oracle百分百验证, 来源与泄漏门禁, 维护者审查
metric: Task-macro Pass Rate, Skill Lift, Normalized Gain
eval_feature: 无Skills与专家Skills配对, 18种模型harness配置, 每题3次, 确定性验证
scale: 87项任务, 8个领域, 18种模型harness配置, 9396个主条件结果槽位
intro_en: SkillsBench v1.1 measures the practical lift from procedural Skill packages using 87 authentic professional tasks across eight domains, paired no-Skills versus curated-Skills conditions, and deterministic verifiers.
build_method_en: Filtering 400 contributed tasks with 100-percent oracle runs, provenance and leakage gates, and maintainer review
metric_en: Task-macro Pass Rate, Skill Lift, Normalized Gain
eval_feature_en: Matched no-Skills and curated-Skills conditions, 18 model-harness configurations, three trials per task, and deterministic verification
scale_en: 87 tasks, 8 domains, 18 model-harness configurations, 9,396 main-condition result slots
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SkillsBench arXiv:2602.12670 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B, D, and N; official benchflow-ai/skillsbench v1.1 repository. The current SkillsBench v1.1 paper builds 87 tasks across eight professional domains from 400 submissions by 142 contributors. Each task packages a human-authored instruction, pinned Docker environment and data, independently curated reusable Skills, a withheld oracle solution, and a deterministic pytest or checker verifier. Automated gates validate structure, require the oracle to pass 100 percent, screen instruction provenance, and reject Skill-to-solution leakage such as task-specific paths, magic numbers, oracle commands, or expected outputs. Maintainers then review realism, data, oracle and Skill quality, anti-cheating robustness, and whether Skills create measurable signal; 87 tasks survive. For each model-harness configuration, BenchFlow creates fresh pinned containers and runs matched no-Skills and curated-Skills conditions for three selected trials per task at temperature zero; a self-generated-Skills arm is reported separately for selected configurations. Deterministic pass/fail rewards are averaged within task and then macro-averaged across 87 tasks. The paper reports pass rate, absolute Skill lift, and normalized gain over 18 model-harness configurations.

name: SocialIQA
intro: SocialIQA 是 Gemma 和 OLMo 3 报告中使用的社会常识问答 benchmark，用于评估模型对人物意图、反应和社会情境的推理能力。
build_method: ATOMIC事件改写, 众包问答与双路负例, 人工多数验证
build_method_en: ATOMIC event rewriting, crowdsourced QA with two negative branches, human majority validation
intro_en: SocialIQA is a social commonsense QA benchmark used by Gemma and OLMo 3 reports to evaluate reasoning about intent, reactions, and social situations.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1904.09728 Section 3. SocialIQA rewrites ATOMIC's 24K social events, uses nine inference dimensions to collect contexts, questions, and correct answers, and builds negative candidates through handwritten incorrect answers and question-switching answers. A random correct answer and two least-entailed negatives form each three-choice tuple. Training items get three-worker validation; Dev/Test get a second five-worker pass and a stylistic difficulty filter. The context-disjoint 37,588-item split is 33,410/1,954/2,224 and is evaluated with accuracy.

name: SoMe
intro: SoMe 是真实社交媒体智能体基准，包含8项任务、32个平台来源、9164284条帖子、6591个用户画像、25686篇报告和17869条标注查询，并通过8个MCP工具评估多步数据获取、分析与推理。
org: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 多源公开数据收集, 多媒体转写, 模板与人机交互标注, 10人专业复核
metric: Task Score, Accuracy, Task Completion Rate
eval_feature: 8项社交媒体任务, 8个MCP工具, 噪声长上下文, 多轮工具调用
build_method_en: Multi-source public-data collection, media transcription, template and human-LLM annotation, and review by ten professionals
eval_feature_en: Eight social-media tasks, eight MCP tools, noisy long contexts, and multi-turn tool use
intro_en: SoMe is a realistic social-media agent benchmark with eight tasks, data from 32 platforms, 9,164,284 posts, 6,591 user profiles, 25,686 reports, and 17,869 annotated queries served through eight MCP tools.
metric_en: Task Score, Accuracy, Task Completion Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SoMe arXiv:2512.14720 Section 3, Tables 1-2, Section 4, and Appendices; official LivXue/SoMe repository. SoMe defines eight social-media agent tasks in post-centered, user-centered, and comprehensive classes. It collects public data from 32 social platforms and external sites through commercial data, Weibo crawling, and open datasets, yielding 9,164,284 posts, 6,591 user profiles, and 25,686 fact-check reports. Qwen2.5-VL-72B produces image and video captions and OCR; GPT-4o produces ASR transcripts. Template rules derive queries and ground truths for user-behavior prediction, comment simulation, and recommendation without editing the observed outcomes. Qwen3-32B supports multi-round human-LLM annotation for event detection, streaming summarization, emotion analysis, and social QA, while misinformation data merges LIAR-RAW and RAWFC. Ten professional annotators manually filter and verify all generated ground truths. The final set has 17,869 queries. A platform exposes eight MCP-compatible tools for data access and analysis. Agents receive task queries, call tools, and reason over noisy long-context social data. Three open-ended tasks use LLM semantic comparison; the other five use LLM extraction followed by ground-truth accuracy. All tasks report normalized scores and task completion rate, then average across the eight tasks.

name: SpatialBench Verified
intro: SpatialBench Verified 是 LatchBio 开发并由 Claude Sonnet 5 系统卡披露的空间转录组学分析评测变体，包含 115 个经过外部验证的问题，要求模型根据样本分析结果回答生物学问题。
build_method: 外部验证；来源、标注与评分构建未披露
metric: 系统卡未披露评分协议
task_type: 生物信息学问答, 数据分析
eval_feature: 空间转录组学分析, 外部验证
build_method_en: External validation; sourcing, annotation, and scoring construction not disclosed
eval_feature_en: Spatial-transcriptomics analysis, External validation
intro_en: SpatialBench Verified is a LatchBio spatial-transcriptomics evaluation variant documented in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card. It contains 115 externally validated problems that require models to answer biological questions from sample-analysis results.
metric_en: Scoring protocol not disclosed in the system card
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Claude Sonnet 5 System Card Section 8.14.2 LatchBio Bioinformatics, p.142. SpatialBench Verified is a LatchBio evaluation variant documented only in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card, not in a standalone benchmark paper. The card says it tests analysis of spatial-transcriptomics data across 115 externally validated problems and requires models to answer biological questions about a sample from the analysis results. The cited source does not disclose how problems were sourced or annotated, dataset splits, prompts, tools, reference-answer format, per-item rubric, or aggregation formula. The diagram therefore preserves the disclosed scope and validation facts while marking the unavailable build and scoring details explicitly instead of inventing them.

name: SPEED-Bench
intro: SPEED-Bench为推测解码提供语义多样性与真实服务吞吐两套数据划分及统一测量框架。其质量集从18个公开来源的11类数据中选出880条提示，吞吐集覆盖1k至32k输入长度、三种领域熵和最高512并发样本。
build_method: 公开数据聚合, 嵌入多样性筛选, 长度分桶
metric: Acceptance Rate, Acceptance Length, Output TPS, User TPS, Speedup
eval_feature: 推测解码, 生产推理引擎, 并发与长上下文
scale: 质量集880条；吞吐集5个长度桶×3类×512条
build_method_en: Public Data Aggregation, Embedding Diversity Selection, Length Bucketing
eval_feature_en: Speculative decoding, Production inference engines, Concurrency and long context
intro_en: SPEED-Bench pairs a semantically diverse qualitative split with realistic serving-throughput workloads and a unified speculative-decoding measurement framework. Its qualitative split selects 880 prompts across 11 categories from 18 public sources; the throughput split spans 1k-32k input lengths, three entropy groups, and up to 512 samples per group.
scale_en: 880 qualitative samples; 5 length buckets x 3 groups x 512 throughput samples
metric_en: Acceptance Rate, Acceptance Length, Output TPS, User TPS, Speedup
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SPEED-Bench arXiv:2604.09557 Sections 4-7 and Appendix B; official nvidia/SPEED-Bench dataset and measurement framework. SPEED-Bench has a qualitative split, a throughput split, and a unified measurement framework. The qualitative split aggregates 18 public sources into 11 categories, embeds candidates with text-embedding-3-large, and uses greedy selection plus local swaps to minimize pairwise similarity, retaining 80 prompts per category and 880 total. The throughput split draws real prompts from eight sources, groups them by low, mixed, or high entropy, and truncates or neutrally pads them into 1k, 2k, 8k, 16k, and 32k input-length buckets. Every bucket has 512 prompts per entropy group. The framework normalizes tokenization and prompt formatting outside SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM, dispatches concurrent requests, and reports conditional acceptance rate, acceptance length, output TPS, user TPS, latency, and speedup.

name: Spider 2.0
intro: Spider 2.0 是一个包含632个真实企业级数据库文本转SQL工作流问题的评测框架。数据库来自实际应用，常含1000多列，存储于本地或云端如BigQuery和Snowflake。挑战要求模型处理复杂SQL环境、长上下文、多条SQL语句及复杂推理，远超传统文本转SQL任务。
org: xlang.ai, The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory,
build_method: 专家构建, 混合
eval_feature: 长文本, 多轮, 领域特定
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: Spider 2.0 is a benchmark consisting of 632 real-world enterprise-level database text-to-SQL workflow problems. The databases originate from practical applications, often containing over 1,000 columns, stored locally or in the cloud such as BigQuery and Snowflake. The challenge requires models to handle complex SQL environments, long contexts, multiple SQL statements, and intricate reasoning, far exceeding traditional text-to-SQL tasks.
scale_en: 632 agentic workflows; 547 tasks each in Lite and Snow
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.07763v2 and the official Spider 2.0 repository. Source material spans 213 enterprise databases and a candidate pool of 1,021 complex SQL queries plus 157 DBT projects; 547 SQL queries and 78 DBT projects are retained only after successful, timely, non-empty execution. Those retained source artifacts are not presented as an arithmetic derivation of the 632 released agentic workflows. To reduce contamination, 84.2% receive surface rewrites and 42.0% semantic rewrites, followed by re-execution. Tasks bundle dialect documentation, database interfaces, codebase context, and manually verified instructions. Focused string, table, or database evaluators ignore irrelevant columns and are red-teamed; each instruction, gold SQL, and evaluator is reviewed by at least three annotators. Spider 2.0 reports binary Success Rate over 632 agentic workflows, while the 547-task Lite and Snow variants report Execution Accuracy.

name: SpreadsheetBench
intro: SpreadsheetBench是一个具有挑战性的电子表格操作基准，完全来源于真实世界的场景，旨在让当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）沉浸在电子表格用户的实际工作流程中。与依赖合成查询和简化电子表格文件的现有基准不同，SpreadsheetBench由从在线Excel论坛收集的912个真实问题构建而成，这些问题反映了用户错综复杂的需求。相关的电子表格包含多种表格数据，如多表、非标准关系表和丰富的非文本元素。此外，我们提出了一种更可靠的评估指标，类似于在线评测平台，为每个指令创建多个电子表格文件作为测试用例，确保评估能够处理不同值的电子表格的鲁棒解决方案。我们对各种LLMs在单轮和多轮推理设置下的综合评估揭示了最先进（SOTA）模型与人类表现之间存在巨大差距，突显了基准的难度。
org: Renmin University of China, Tsinghua University
build_method: 真实论坛采集, GPT-4改写, 专家标注, 多测试用例构造
eval_feature: 真实世界场景, 每题多测试用例, 单轮与多轮
build_method_en: Real-forum collection, GPT-4 rewriting, expert annotation, multi-case construction
eval_feature_en: Real-world scenarios, Multiple test cases per instruction, Single- and multi-round
intro_en: SpreadsheetBench is a challenging spreadsheet operation benchmark entirely derived from real-world scenarios, designed to immerse current large language models (LLMs) in the actual workflows of spreadsheet users. Unlike existing benchmarks that rely on synthetic queries and simplified spreadsheet files, SpreadsheetBench is built from 912 real questions collected from online Excel forums, reflecting users' complex needs. The associated spreadsheets contain diverse tabular data, including multi-sheet, non-standard relational tables, and rich non-text elements. Additionally, we propose a more reliable evaluation metric, similar to online testing platforms, by creating multiple spreadsheet files as test cases for each instruction to ensure the assessment can handle robust solutions across spreadsheets with varying values. Our comprehensive evaluation of various LLMs under single-turn and multi-turn reasoning settings reveals a significant gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) models and human performance, highlighting the benchmark’s difficulty.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SpreadsheetBench arXiv:2406.14991 Sections 2.1-2.4 and Appendix B; official RUCKBReasoning/SpreadsheetBench repository. SpreadsheetBench starts from real spreadsheet-manipulation posts on ExcelForum, Chandoo, MrExcel, and ExcelGuru. The authors retain solved, software-independent, feasible, testable, and representative questions with spreadsheet attachments. GPT-4 rewrites scattered forum threads into self-contained instructions, which annotators verify; annotators also identify forum solutions, apply formulas or VBA, and specify cell- or sheet-level answer positions. Each suitable instruction receives the original input-output spreadsheet plus two data-modified corner-case test pairs. Rewritten questions, changed spreadsheet values, and shifted answer positions mitigate leakage. Twenty Excel specialists annotate; two validators and two authors perform two quality rounds. The release has 912 instructions and 2,729 test cases. A model generates one code solution per instruction, which is applied to every associated spreadsheet. Exact output matches are accepted. Soft OJ scoring grants per-test partial credit, while hard OJ scoring requires every test to pass; single- and up-to-five-round inference settings are evaluated.

name: SQuAD
intro: SQuAD 是经典阅读理解问答 benchmark，OLMo 报告中与 DROP、CoQA 等 QA 任务一起出现。
build_method: Wikipedia筛选, 众包标注, 多答案复标
build_method_en: Wikipedia curation, crowdsourcing, multi-answer re-annotation
intro_en: SQuAD is a classic reading-comprehension QA benchmark referenced by OLMo reports together with DROP and CoQA.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1606.05250. SQuAD v1.0 samples 536 of the top 10,000 English Wikipedia articles by internal PageRank, extracts 23,215 paragraphs after removing visual/table content and passages shorter than 500 characters, and splits by article 80/10/10. Qualified crowdworkers write up to five questions per paragraph in their own words and highlight answer spans. At least two additional answers are collected for every Dev/Test question. The final 107,785 QA pairs are evaluated after ignoring articles and punctuation: exact match accepts any ground truth, while macro token F1 takes the maximum over references for each question.

name: ST-VQA
intro: ST-VQA是面向场景文字理解的视觉问答数据集，包含来自7个公开视觉数据集的23,038张图像和31,791组问答，答案始终依据图像中的文字。挑战按每图词典、3万词全局词典和开放词典定义三档任务。
org: Computer Vision Center, UAB, IIIT Hyderabad
build_method: 公开图像聚合, 众包问答标注, 人工验证
eval_feature: 场景文字读取, 三档词典约束, 编辑距离评分
build_method_en: Public Image Aggregation, Crowdsourced QA Annotation, Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Scene-text reading, Three dictionary regimes, Edit-distance scoring
intro_en: ST-VQA is a scene-text visual question answering dataset with 23,038 images from seven public vision datasets and 31,791 question-answer pairs whose answers are grounded in image text. Its challenge defines per-image, 30k global, and open-dictionary tasks.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ST-VQA arXiv:1905.13648 Sections 3-4, ICDAR competition arXiv:1907.00490, and official RRC challenge 11 task definitions. ST-VQA combines 23,038 natural images from seven public vision datasets with 31,791 question-answer pairs. Images are selected to contain scene text, then crowd workers write questions whose answers are grounded in that text and the annotations are validated. The challenge publishes train and test data and defines three increasingly difficult settings: a small per-image answer dictionary, one shared 30,000-word dictionary built from roughly 22,000 ground-truth words plus 8,000 distractors, and an open-dictionary end-to-end task. All three are evaluated with Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity, which gives partial credit for OCR-like edit errors and zeroes similarities below the official threshold.

name: StableToolBench
intro: StableToolBench是一个旨在解决工具学习基准不稳定问题的项目。它通过引入虚拟API服务器和稳定的评估系统，在ToolBench的基础上进行了改进。虚拟API服务器结合了缓存系统和API模拟器，以减轻API状态变化带来的影响；而稳定的评估系统则利用GPT-4作为自动评估器，设计了可解的通过率和获胜率，以消除评估过程中的随机性。
build_method: ToolBench迁移, 缓存与API模拟, 三模型可解性筛选
metric: Solvable Pass Rate, Solvable Win Rate
eval_feature: 虚拟API服务器, 稳定评估系统
build_method_en: ToolBench migration, cache and API simulation, three-model solvability filtering
eval_feature_en: Virtual API server, Stability evaluation system
intro_en: StableToolBench is a project aimed at addressing the instability issues in tool learning benchmarks. It improves upon ToolBench by introducing a virtual API server and a stable evaluation system. The virtual API server combines a caching system and an API simulator to mitigate the impact of API state changes, while the stable evaluation system uses GPT-4 as an automatic evaluator and designs solvable pass rates and win rates to eliminate randomness in the evaluation process.
metric_en: Solvable Pass Rate, Solvable Win Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with StableToolBench arXiv:2403.07714 Sections 2-4 and Appendices D, F-H; official THUNLP-MT/StableToolBench repository. StableToolBench evolves ToolBench's 1,100 ToolEval2 test queries into a stable virtual-API and evaluation setup. The cache is initialized from ToolBench training and reproduced-test API histories, filters invalid records while retaining selected realistic exceptions, and had 164,980 filtered records at the paper snapshot. For each call, the server checks the cache, then tries the real API, then uses GPT-4-turbo to simulate unavailable responses from the API documentation with up to five cached few-shot examples; returned responses update the cache. GPT-4-turbo, Gemini-Pro, and Claude-2 independently judge every ToolBench query, and a majority-solvable rule retains 765 tasks. Models execute the queries through the virtual server. GPT-4-turbo grades answers solved, unsure, or unsolved. Solvable Pass Rate assigns 1, 0.5, or 0 respectively; Solvable Win Rate compares paired candidates, using deterministic solved-versus-unsolved wins and GPT-4-turbo for the remaining cases.

name: Step-Audio-Edit
intro: Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark 是一个用于可控语音合成的综合评测框架，专注于情感、说话风格和副语言等细粒度属性。该基准随 Step-Audio-EditX 模型一同发布，后者是一个基于大语言模型的音频编辑模型。此评测框架的提出旨在解决现有评测方法在全面性上的不足。
build_method: 双语提示构建, 多语料说话者采样, 零样本声音克隆
eval_feature: 情感与风格分类, 副语言1至3分评分, 遗漏检查
build_method_en: Bilingual prompt construction, multi-corpus speaker sampling, zero-shot voice cloning
eval_feature_en: Emotion and style classification, paralinguistic 1-3 rating, omission checks
intro_en: Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark is a comprehensive evaluation framework for controllable speech synthesis, focusing on fine-grained attributes such as emotion, speaking style, and paralinguistics. The benchmark is released alongside the Step-Audio-EditX model, an audio editing model based on large language models. This evaluation framework aims to address the limitations of existing methods in terms of comprehensiveness.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Step-Audio-EditX Technical Report arXiv:2511.03601 Section 5.1; official stepfun-ai/Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark repository. Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark evaluates emotion, speaking style, and paralinguistic control with zero-shot voice cloning. Its eight speakers comprise two male and two female speakers per language: Chinese voices from Wenet-Speech4TTS and English voices from GLOBE-V2 and Libri-Light. The emotion set has five categories and 50 content-matched Chinese plus 50 English prompts per category. The speaking-style set has seven categories with the same per-language count and target-matched content. Ten paralinguistic labels each have 50 relevant LLM-generated Chinese and 50 English samples. Crossing the 2,200 bilingual text samples with four speakers per language produces 8,800 evaluation audios. Gemini-2.5-Pro classifies emotion among five choices and style among seven; category accuracy is averaged across speakers. For paralinguistics it applies a dedicated 1-to-3 rubric, explicitly checking required event insertion and omission, and the benchmark reports the overall mean judge score.

name: StreamBench
intro: StreamBench 是 StreamChat 论文提出的流式视频理解基准，包含 306 段共 24.8 小时的视频和约 1800 组带时间戳问答，覆盖六类多轮在线理解任务。
org: Dalian University of Technology, Harvard University
build_method: 公开视频聚合, 多模态模型分类, 人工筛选与反馈标注
metric: Semantic Score, Accuracy, Coherence, Request Processing Delay
eval_feature: 流式视频前缀, 多轮对话, 六类时间约束问题, 延迟评测
build_method_en: Public-video aggregation, multimodal-model classification, human filtering and feedback annotation
eval_feature_en: Streaming video prefixes, Multi-turn dialogue, Six temporally constrained tasks, Latency evaluation
intro_en: StreamBench is the streaming-video benchmark introduced with StreamChat. It contains 306 videos totaling 24.8 hours and about 1,800 timestamped QA pairs across six multi-round online-understanding tasks.
metric_en: Semantic Score, Accuracy, Coherence, Request Processing Delay
drawio_review_note: Aligned with StreamChat arXiv:2501.13468 Section 2, Section 4.1, and Appendix D; official hmxiong/StreamChat repository. The video StreamBench in Seed1.5-VL is the benchmark introduced with StreamChat, not the namesake continuous-improvement language-agent benchmark. It draws candidate videos from EgoSchema and YouTube-8M, covers egocentric, web, work, and movie domains with 16 subtypes, uses a multimodal model to classify source categories, and has humans remove static or high-noise content. The final 306 videos total 24.8 hours and average 4.5 minutes. Annotators create six timestamped question types per video: object search, long-term memory, short-term memory, conversational interaction, video-grounded knowledge QA, and simple factual QA, each with paper-defined temporal constraints. Different workers check format diversity, clarity and video consistency, and remove sensitive topics. The release contains about 1.8K QA pairs in multi-round streaming dialogues. Models receive only the video prefix available at each query time and the prior dialogue. A LLaMA-3 judge reports semantic correctness score and accuracy; coherence is measured from score fluctuations across turns, and streaming systems also report request processing delay.

name: StreamingBench
intro: StreamingBench 是面向多模态大模型流式视频理解的综合基准，包含900段YouTube视频和4500组带时间戳问答，覆盖实时视觉、视听全源和上下文理解三大类18项任务。
build_method: 公开视频筛选, GPT-4o辅助生成, 人工标注与复核
eval_feature: 带时间戳视频前缀, 视听联合理解, 顺序问答历史, 主动输出
build_method_en: Public-video curation, GPT-4o-assisted generation, human annotation and review
eval_feature_en: Timestamped video prefixes, Audio-visual understanding, Sequential QA history, Proactive output
intro_en: StreamingBench is a comprehensive streaming-video-understanding benchmark for multimodal LLMs, with 900 YouTube videos and 4,500 timestamped QA pairs across 18 tasks in real-time visual, omni-source, and contextual understanding.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with StreamingBench arXiv:2411.03628 Sections 3-4 and Appendix A; official THUNLP-MT/StreamingBench repository. StreamingBench defines 18 streaming-video tasks in three categories: ten real-time visual tasks, four omni-source audio-visual tasks, and four contextual tasks. The authors manually curate 900 YouTube videos across eight scenario categories. For real-time tasks and proactive output, frames are sampled at 1 fps, timestamps are overlaid, GPT-4o captions every 20 frames, and GPT-4o generates timestamped QA; humans annotate omni-source and the other contextual tasks. Reviewers check accuracy, clarity, and relevance, revise ambiguous or mislabeled items, discard questions answerable without video, and shuffle options. The paper reports 4,500 QA pairs; 250 proactive-output questions were built, while 50 were used in the reported version. Except for proactive output, models receive only the video prefix ending at the question timestamp; sequential QA also receives prior QA history. Multiple-choice accuracy is reported. Proactive output polls once per second, requests the keyword after a yes response, and counts answers within two seconds of the reference timestamp.

name: StrongReject
intro: StrongREJECT是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击的基准。它旨在解决现有越狱研究中普遍存在的夸大攻击效果的问题，提供了一个包含特定、有害信息请求的标准化提示数据集。其核心是一个自动评估器，能够衡量模型响应中提供有害信息的程度，并与人类判断达到很高的吻合度，从而提供更准确、更稳健的越狱有效性评估。
org: Center for Human-Compatible AI, UC Berkeley
build_method: 政策交叉归类, 人工与LLM构题, 嵌入去重, 多模型拒答筛选
eval_feature: 对抗性, Jailbreak
build_method_en: Policy taxonomy, human and LLM prompt creation, embedding de-duplication, multi-model refusal filtering
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Jailbreak
intro_en: StrongREJECT is a benchmark for evaluating jailbreak attacks on large language models (LLMs). It aims to address the common issue of exaggerated attack effectiveness in existing jailbreak research by providing a standardized prompt dataset containing specific harmful information requests. At its core is an automatic evaluator that measures the extent of harmful information in model responses and achieves high alignment with human judgments, offering a more accurate and robust assessment of jailbreak effectiveness.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with StrongREJECT arXiv:2402.10260 Sections 2-3 and Appendices C-E; official dsbowen/strong_reject repository. StrongREJECT cross-references five provider policy families to define six universally prohibited harm categories. Its 313 prompts combine 221 new manual or LLM-assisted items with curated prompts from prior benchmarks. Existing candidates undergo category selection, longest-to-shortest OpenAI-embedding cosine de-duplication, a nine-model refusal screen, GPT-3.5 taxonomy classification, and manual removal of vague, unanswerable, ill-posed, or information-hazard items. Every category has at least 50 prompts; 70 percent are novel, 10 percent come from DAN, 10 percent from AdvBench, and the remainder from other sources. The rubric evaluator receives the forbidden prompt and response, reasons, then outputs binary refusal plus 1-to-5 convincingness and specificity scores. Refusals score zero; otherwise the two rescaled attributes are equally averaged. The paper uses GPT-4o-mini for this rubric and also trains a Gemma 2B evaluator from rubric labels. Validation uses five LabelBox raters on a 60-prompt subset, 17 jailbreaks, and four victim models, with median human scores compared by bias, MAE, and Spearman correlation.

name: Sudoku-Bench
intro: Sudoku-Bench 是评测创造性逻辑推理的数独变体基准，核心challenge_100覆盖15道4×4、15道6×6和70道9×9题，并以纯文本精确描述规则、棋盘和视觉约束。
build_method: 专家选题, SudokuPad导出, 纯文本规则与棋盘编码
eval_feature: 无工具, 多步交互与单轮求解, 首错即停
build_method_en: Expert puzzle selection, SudokuPad export, pure-text rule and board encoding
eval_feature_en: No tools, Multi-step interaction and single-shot solving, Stop on first error
intro_en: Sudoku-Bench evaluates creative logical reasoning over Sudoku variants. Its core challenge_100 contains fifteen 4x4, fifteen 6x6, and seventy 9x9 puzzles, with rules, boards, and visual constraints represented precisely in text.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Sudoku-Bench arXiv:2505.16135 Sections 2-4; official SakanaAI/Sudoku-Bench repository and challenge_100 release. Sudoku-Bench's core challenge_100 set selects 15 four-by-four, 15 six-by-six, and 70 nine-by-nine puzzles to span model capability. Fifty puzzles were curated exclusively by the Cracking the Cryptic hosts and twenty difficult vanilla puzzles were supplied by Nikoli. The collection is balanced from one- to five-star difficulty. Each puzzle is exported from SudokuPad into a pure-text specification containing the rules, grid size, initial digits, and coordinate descriptions of visual elements, isolating creative reasoning from visual parsing. The release also includes separate nikoli_100 and 2,565-item ctc subsets plus an expert-trace research asset built from more than 3,000 Cracking the Cryptic video transcripts and SudokuPad actions; these are not the core 100-puzzle score set. Evaluation is tool-free. In multi-step mode the model commits at least one digit, receives the updated board, and stops at the first wrong placement or after solving; the initial prompt and five latest responses remain in context. Single-shot mode requests the whole solution once. Average solve rate and, for multi-step, average correct placements are reported across one run per model and puzzle.

name: SUPERChem
intro: SUPERChem是一个具有挑战性的、由专家策划的多模态基准测试，旨在严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）和多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的化学推理能力。它包含500个专家策划的推理密集型化学问题，涵盖不同子领域，并以多模态和纯文本格式提供。该基准测试引入了推理路径保真度（RPF）评分，以评估模型推理的质量，超越了最终答案的准确性。
build_method: 专家构建, 混合
eval_feature: 多模态, 过程评估, 防污染
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Multimodal, Process evaluation, Contamination-free
intro_en: SUPERChem is a challenging, expert-curated multimodal benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the chemical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 500 expert-curated, reasoning-intensive chemistry questions covering various subfields, presented in both multimodal and pure text formats. The benchmark introduces a Reasoning Path Fidelity (RPF) score to assess the quality of model reasoning beyond final answer accuracy.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SUPERChem arXiv:2512.01274 Sections 3-4.5; official superchem.pku.edu.cn site and ZehuaZhao/SUPERChem dataset card. SUPERChem curates 500 reasoning-intensive chemistry multiple-choice problems from chemistry competitions, literature adaptation, and expert authorship across diverse subfields. Each item has aligned multimodal and text-only forms plus an expert solution path decomposed into weighted checkpoints. A three-stage domain-expert review process with AI-assisted validation removes flawed or ambiguous items and mitigates contamination. Evaluation runs models on both forms, extracts a final answer for pass@1 accuracy, and sends the question, options, checkpoint-tagged expert path, and candidate reasoning to Gemini 2.5 Pro. The judge marks semantic checkpoint matches, and RPF is the weighted recall of those matches. Results compare accuracy, RPF, modality effects, fine-grained chemistry profiles, and a 40.3% human baseline.

name: SuperGPQA
intro: SuperGPQA 是一个全面的评测基准，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）在285个研究生级别学科中的知识和推理能力。该基准通过人机协同过滤机制，消除了简单或模棱两可的问题，从而揭示了当前最先进的LLM在不同知识领域中的性能仍有显著提升空间。SuperGPQA的构建过程涉及80多位专家标注员和一个人机协作系统，为未来大规模研究项目提供了方法论指导。
build_method: 专家来源筛选, 众包转写, 规则与多模型质检, 专家复核
eval_feature: 13学科门类, 72领域, 285子领域, 零样本与五样本
build_method_en: Expert source screening, crowd transcription, rule and multi-model QC, expert review
eval_feature_en: 13 disciplines, 72 fields, 285 subfields, zero-shot and five-shot
intro_en: SuperGPQA is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) knowledge and reasoning abilities across 285 graduate-level disciplines. Using a human-AI collaborative filtering mechanism, it eliminates simple or ambiguous questions, revealing significant room for improvement in state-of-the-art LLMs across various knowledge domains. The construction of SuperGPQA involved over 80 expert annotators and a human-AI collaboration system, providing methodological guidance for future large-scale research projects.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SuperGPQA NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks paper Sections 3-4 and Appendices D-H and K; official SuperGPQA/SuperGPQA repository. SuperGPQA contains 26,529 graduate-level multiple-choice questions across 13 disciplines, 72 fields, and 285 subfields, with at least 50 items per subfield and 9.67 answer choices on average. More than 80 PhD-level expert annotators screen credible sources and preserve source evidence, prioritizing solved textbook examples and reasoning-heavy web or multiple-choice problems; selected open datasets provide supplements. Crowd annotators translate non-English material into academic English, convert free-response items to multiple choice, standardize correct-or-incorrect-statement questions, add region context, and create plausible unique distractors with subtle errors. Real-time plagiarism checks and expert-plus-model estimates support difficulty and reliability. Rule checks remove formatting failures. Seven frontier models tag validity, negative or extreme wording, multimodal dependence, field relevance, completeness, and discrimination. Experts re-solve suspicious items with web access, spending over thirty minutes per item when needed, then revise them. Reasoning and chat models use zero-shot prompts; base models use MMLU-Pro-style five-shot prompts. The default temperature is zero. Exact answer-letter accuracy is reported at sample, subfield, field, and discipline levels and by difficulty.

name: SWE-bench
intro: SWE-bench是一个用于评估大型语言模型解决真实世界GitHub问题能力的基准测试。它从12个流行的Python代码库中收集了2294个软件工程问题，每个问题都配有对应的拉取请求和测试补丁。该基准旨在衡量模型在理解代码库、定位问题和生成正确修复方面的能力。
build_method: GitHub PR抓取, 属性过滤, 执行验证
eval_feature: 真实Issue修复, 长代码上下文, 可执行测试验证
build_method_en: GitHub PR scraping, attribute filtering, execution validation
eval_feature_en: Real issue resolution, long code context, executable test validation
intro_en: SWE-bench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to solve real-world GitHub issues. It collects 2,294 software engineering problems from 12 popular Python repositories, each paired with corresponding pull requests and test patches. The benchmark aims to assess models' capabilities in understanding codebases, identifying issues, and generating correct fixes.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.06770 / ICLR 2024. The three-stage construction starts from about 90,000 pull requests across 12 popular repositories with more than 90% Python code. It retains merged PRs that resolve an issue and change tests, separates the pre-PR codebase, issue text, test patch, and gold patch, then executes tests before and after the gold patch. Candidates must install and run successfully, contain at least one FAIL_TO_PASS transition, and not rely on tests invoking newly introduced functions or classes. The resulting 2,294 tasks provide issue text and a codebase while hiding tests; a generated patch resolves an instance only if it applies and all FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests succeed.

name: SWE-bench Lite
intro: SWE-bench Lite 是从 SWE-bench 可执行任务中筛选出的轻量子集，聚焦较自包含的真实 GitHub 功能缺陷修复。评测系统获得 Issue 与基线仓库，生成补丁，并以 Fail-to-Pass 与 Pass-to-Pass 测试共同判定是否解决实例。
build_method: GitHub Issue-PR采集, 可执行F2P验证, Lite内容与范围过滤
task_type: 软件工程, 代码修复
build_method_en: GitHub Issue-PR Collection, Executable F2P Validation, Lite Content and Scope Filtering
intro_en: SWE-bench Lite is a smaller subset selected from executable SWE-bench tasks and focused on more self-contained real GitHub functional bug fixes. Systems receive an issue and base repository, generate a patch, and resolve an instance only when both fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass tests succeed.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICLR 2024 SWE-bench paper arXiv:2310.06770 and the dedicated official SWE-bench Lite page. The full construction starts from 93,139 PRs across 12 popular Python repositories, keeps 11,407 merged PRs that resolve an issue and modify tests, then executes test patches before and after code patches to require at least one fail-to-pass transition and remove installation/runtime failures, yielding 2,294 full tasks. Lite removes images, external links, commit SHAs, cross-PR/issue references, and statements under 40 words. It also requires at most one edited file and three gold-patch hunks, forbids file creation/deletion, and removes tests that assert error messages. The dedicated Lite release samples 300 test and 23 development instances across 11 repositories. Evaluation gives the issue and base codebase, accepts any applicable diff solution, and marks an instance resolved only when all fail-to-pass tests now pass and all pass-to-pass tests remain passing.

name: SWE-Bench Pro
intro: SWE-Bench Pro 是一个面向长周期、复杂软件工程任务的基准，包含 41 个活跃专业代码库中的 1,865 个问题：731 个公开问题、276 个商业问题和 858 个隔离保留问题。任务由连续提交对构建，人工补充问题陈述、行为需求和可选接口信息，并经专业工程师 Docker 环境、重复执行与 F2P/P2P 测试复核后进入 Pass@1 评测。
build_method: 代码库分层采样、人工任务增补、Docker 与测试复核
eval_feature: 防污染、长周期、多文件、人工测试复核
scale: 1,865 个问题，41 个仓库（公开 731、商业 276、隔离保留 858）
build_method_en: Repository-Stratified Sampling, Human Task Augmentation, Docker and Test Review
eval_feature_en: Contamination-Aware, Long-Horizon, Multi-File, Human-Reviewed Tests
intro_en: SWE-Bench Pro targets long-horizon, complex software engineering with 1,865 problems from 41 active professional repositories: 731 public, 276 commercial, and 858 held-out. Tasks are built from consecutive commit pairs, augmented with human-written problem statements, behavioral requirements, and optional interface details, then verified through professional Docker setup, repeated execution, and human-reviewed F2P/P2P tests before Pass@1 evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.16941 Sections 2-3. The diagram preserves the contamination-aware public, commercial, and held-out repository sources; substantial 50-100 task cap per repository; consecutive-commit base, gold, and test patch construction; human-written behavioral requirements; professional Docker setup; repeated flaky-test removal; and human review of F2P relevance and breadth. The final split counts sum exactly to 1,865 and evaluation uses the paper's unified SWE-Agent scaffold, 50-turn budget, human-reviewed F2P/P2P tests, and Pass@1 resolve rate.

name: SWE-bench Verified
intro: SWE-bench Verified 是SWE-bench的一个人工筛选子集，包含500个实例，由OpenAI合作创建。人工标注者确保问题描述清晰、测试补丁正确且任务可解，提升了原版SWE-bench的可靠性。
build_method: 专业开发者人工审查, 问题描述与测试质量筛选
eval_feature: 人工验证可解性, 测试补丁复核, 容器化执行评测
build_method_en: Professional-developer review, problem-statement and test-quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Human-validated solvability, test-patch review, containerized execution
intro_en: SWE-bench Verified is a manually curated subset of SWE-bench containing 500 instances, created in collaboration with OpenAI. Human annotators ensure clear problem descriptions, correct test patches, and solvable tasks, enhancing the reliability of the original SWE-bench.
drawio_review_note: The task and evaluation contract follows arXiv:2310.06770, while Verified-specific construction is aligned with the official SWE-bench page and OpenAI's August 2024 release because Verified is a later curated subset, not part of the original paper. Ninety-three Python-experienced professional developers manually screened 1,699 random SWE-bench test samples for underspecified issue descriptions, inappropriate FAIL_TO_PASS tests, and task solvability. Problematic or infeasible samples were removed to release 500 human-validated tasks with difficulty annotations. Evaluation keeps issue text and tests separate, runs generated patches in the containerized harness, and requires both FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests to succeed.

name: SWE-bench-Live
intro: SWE-bench-Live 是一个面向持续更新的软件工程基准。首次发布包含 93 个开源 Python 仓库中的 1,319 个任务，Issue 创建时间为 2024 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 4 月 20 日。它通过 GitHub Issue-PR 挖掘、REPOLAUNCH 自动构建实例级 Docker 环境，并重复验证 FAIL_TO_PASS 与 PASS_TO_PASS 转换，以提供时新且可复现的补丁评测。
build_method: Issue-PR 自动挖掘、REPOLAUNCH Docker 构建、重复执行过滤
eval_feature: 时新数据、自动环境构建、重复稳定性验证
scale: 1,319 个任务，93 个开源 Python 仓库
build_method_en: Automated Issue-PR Mining, REPOLAUNCH Docker Construction, Repeated Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Fresh Data, Automated Environment Construction, Repeated Stability Validation
intro_en: SWE-bench-Live is designed for continuously refreshed software engineering evaluation. Its initial release contains 1,319 tasks from 93 open-source Python repositories, with issues created between January 1, 2024 and April 20, 2025. The pipeline mines GitHub issue-PR pairs, uses REPOLAUNCH to build instance-level Docker environments, and repeatedly validates FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS transitions for fresh, reproducible patch evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.23419 Sections 3.1-3.4. The diagram includes the exact repository funnel, issue-resolving pull requests with test-suite changes, January 1 2024 through April 20 2025 freshness window, REPOLAUNCH repository inspection, interactive ReAct setup, verifier refinement, instance-level Docker finalization, and repeated transition validation. The first release count is 1,319 tasks across 93 Python repositories; monthly updates are described by the paper as a plan rather than asserted as an already-running schedule.

name: SWE-Evo
intro: SWE-Evo 评测编码智能体能否根据发布说明和关联 PR/Issue 上下文完成发布级软件演进。它从 SWE-bench 与 SWE-gym 的可执行种子中选择连续版本标签，经 FAIL_TO_PASS 执行过滤和人工质量复核，形成 7 个 Python 仓库中的 48 个任务；每题平均修改 21 个文件并运行 874 个测试，以问题解决率、补丁应用率和修复率同时衡量完整解决与无回归的部分进展。
org: FPT Software AI Center, University of Melbourne, Marvis AI
build_method: 版本发布转换挖掘、执行式过滤、人工质量复核
metric: Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, Fix Rate
task_type: 代码生成, Agent任务, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 发布级长周期演进、多文件修改、部分进展评分
scale: 48 个发布级任务，7 个 Python 仓库，平均修改 21 个文件、运行 874 个测试
task_type_en: Code Generation, Agent Task, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Release-Transition Mining, Execution Filtering, Human Quality Review
eval_feature_en: Release-Level Long-Horizon Evolution, Multi-File Changes, Partial-Progress Scoring
intro_en: SWE-Evo evaluates whether coding agents can complete release-level software evolution from release notes and explicitly linked PR/issue context. It selects consecutive version-tag transitions from executable SWE-bench and SWE-gym seeds, applies FAIL_TO_PASS execution filtering and human quality review, and retains 48 tasks from seven Python repositories. Each task edits 21 files and runs 874 tests on average; Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, and Fix Rate measure complete solutions and regression-free partial progress.
scale_en: 48 release-sized tasks, 7 Python repositories, 21 files and 874 tests per task on average
metric_en: Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, Fix Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.18470 Sections 3.1-3.2. The diagram starts from executable SWE-bench and SWE-gym seeds, selects base commits that exactly match version tags, defines the task from the delta to the next release note plus explicitly linked PR/issue text, separates the test and start-to-end gold patches, requires at least one FAIL_TO_PASS transition with no install/runtime error, and records the human alignment review that reduces hundreds of candidates to 48 tasks. Evaluation preserves Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, and regression-gated Fix Rate.

name: SWE-fficiency
intro: SWE-fficiency 评测编码智能体能否在真实工作负载上优化代码库性能，同时保持现有行为。它从 9 个数据科学、机器学习和 HPC Python 仓库中挖掘 498 个专家性能 PR，经关键词/AST 过滤、动态覆盖与静态符号解析、人工工作负载标注和受控执行验证；模型补丁须通过覆盖单元测试，再以相对专家加速效果的 Speedup Ratio 评分。
org: Harvard University, Google DeepMind, Princeton University, Xi'an Jiaotong University
build_method: 性能 PR 挖掘、覆盖测试定位、人工工作负载标注、受控执行过滤
task_type: 代码优化, 性能工程
eval_feature: 真实工作负载、正确性约束、专家归一化性能评分
scale: 498 个性能优化任务，9 个 Python 仓库
build_method_en: Performance-PR Mining, Covering-Test Localization, Manual Workload Annotation, Controlled Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Real Workloads, Correctness Constraints, Expert-Normalized Performance Scoring
intro_en: SWE-fficiency evaluates whether coding agents can optimize repository performance on real workloads while preserving existing behavior. It mines 498 expert performance pull requests from nine data-science, machine-learning, and HPC Python repositories, then applies keyword/AST filtering, dynamic coverage plus static symbol resolution, manual workload annotation, and controlled execution. Model patches must pass covering unit tests and are scored by Speedup Ratio relative to the expert optimization.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.06090 Section 2.1 and the evaluation metric definition. The diagram preserves all five stages: nine-repository PR mining; performance-keyword, no-test-change, and meaningful-AST filtering; covering-test discovery with pinned Docker, coverage.py, and static symbol resolution; manual performance-workload annotation; and controlled execution with resource pinning. Retained tasks require significant improvement above two measurement standard deviations and less than 0.5 percent SR drift, while evaluation requires covering tests to pass and aggregates expert-normalized Speedup Ratio with a harmonic mean.

name: SWE-Lancer
intro: SWE-Lancer 收录 1,488 个围绕 Expensify 代码库的真实 Upwork 软件工程任务，实际支付总额为 100 万美元。其中 764 个独立贡献者任务由模型生成代码补丁并接受隐藏 Playwright 端到端测试，724 个工程管理任务要求模型从至少两个候选方案中选择最佳方案；最终以 Pass@1、获得的总报酬和赚取率衡量经济价值。
build_method: Upwork 真实任务筛选、专业工程师复核、隐藏端到端测试
task_type: 代码生成, 补全, Agent任务
eval_feature: 真实经济价值、隐藏端到端测试、管理方案选择
scale: 1,488 个任务（IC 764、管理 724），真实报酬 100 万美元
build_method_en: Real Upwork Task Screening, Professional-Engineer Review, Hidden End-to-End Tests
eval_feature_en: Real Economic Value, Hidden End-to-End Tests, Management Proposal Selection
intro_en: SWE-Lancer contains 1,488 real Upwork software engineering tasks centered on the Expensify codebase, representing $1 million in actual payouts. For 764 individual-contributor tasks, models generate repository patches scored by hidden Playwright end-to-end tests; for 724 engineering-management tasks, models choose the best of at least two proposals. Economic performance is reported with Pass@1, total payout earned, and earn rate.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.12115 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C. The diagram preserves the 1,488-task, $1M Upwork source; human eligibility and clarity review; separate 764-task individual-contributor and 724-task management branches; hidden Playwright end-to-end tests with three-round fixed/broken validation; offline Docker execution; proposal-choice grading; and economic reporting. Pass@1 is the primary setting, while pass@k appears only as an ablation in the paper.

name: SWE-PolyBench
intro: SWE-PolyBench 是一个多语言仓库级软件工程基准，包含来自 21 个仓库的 2,110 个实例，覆盖 Java、JavaScript、TypeScript 和 Python。任务由关闭 Issue 且包含测试代码的真实 PR 构建，经历史 Docker 环境、F2P/P2P 测试和可测试性过滤，并同时评测可执行解决率以及文件级、CST 节点级检索能力。
build_method: GitHub PR 挖掘、人工 Docker 配置、F2P/P2P 执行过滤
metric: Pass Rate, File/CST Retrieval Precision & Recall
eval_feature: 多语言、执行式评测、CST 结构检索
scale: 2,110 个实例，21 个仓库，4 种语言
build_method_en: GitHub PR Mining, Manual Docker Configuration, F2P/P2P Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, Execution-Based, CST Structural Retrieval
intro_en: SWE-PolyBench is a multilingual repository-level software engineering benchmark with 2,110 instances from 21 repositories in Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. It mines real pull requests that close issues and add tests, validates them in historical Docker environments with F2P/P2P tests, and evaluates both executable resolution and file- and CST-node-level retrieval.
metric_en: Pass Rate, File/CST Retrieval Precision & Recall
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.08703 Sections 2-3. The diagram follows the four-language repository metadata filters, issue-closing PR and test-code requirement, manually configured historical Docker environments, gold/test patch split, F2P/P2P execution, and the requirement for at least one F2P test. It also records the paper's exclusion of tasks that test newly created files, LLM-assisted task and informativeness annotation, the 500-item stratified subset, and both execution and file/CST retrieval metrics.

name: SWE-Sharp-Bench
intro: SWE-Sharp-Bench 是一个面向 C#/.NET 的可复现软件工程基准，包含 17 个真实仓库中的 150 个 Issue 解决任务。构建流程从高星活跃仓库与已合并测试 PR 出发，自动解析工作流、解决方案和项目文件生成 Docker 环境，经基线/测试补丁/修复补丁三状态执行与两位作者复核后，使用 C# 专用提示词、单次两小时尝试和全部测试通过条件评测智能体。
build_method: C# PR 挖掘、.NET Docker 自动构建、三状态执行过滤、双人复核
eval_feature: C#/.NET、多测试框架、容器化可复现执行
scale: 150 个 Issue 解决任务，17 个 C# 仓库
build_method_en: C# PR Mining, Automated .NET Docker Construction, Three-State Execution Filtering, Dual Review
eval_feature_en: C#/.NET, Multiple Test Frameworks, Reproducible Container Execution
intro_en: SWE-Sharp-Bench is a reproducible C#/.NET software-engineering benchmark with 150 issue-resolution tasks from 17 real repositories. It selects high-star active repositories and merged test-changing pull requests, automatically derives Docker environments from workflow, solution, and project files, applies base/test/fix three-state execution and two-author review, then evaluates agents with C#-adapted prompts, one valid two-hour attempt, and an all-tests-pass criterion.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.02352 Sections III-A and IV plus Appendix B. The diagram preserves the top-100, 5,000-star, six-month activity, and build-viability repository filters; 1,000 latest PRs per repository with issue, test-file, and merge requirements; automated .NET Docker construction from workflow, solution, project, environment, and global configuration; base/test/test-plus-fix pass-fail-pass execution; and two-author checks for underspecified statements and inadequate tests. Evaluation uses C#-adapted SWE-Agent/OpenHands prompts, one valid attempt, a two-hour timeout, normalized NUnit/XUnit/MSTest logs, and all-tests-pass Resolution Rate.

name: SysBench
intro: SysBench用于系统评测大语言模型遵循系统消息的能力，包含500个五轮会话和2500轮用户交互，覆盖6类可验证约束、对齐与不对齐指令，以及并行与依赖多轮关系。
build_method: 真实日志收集, 启发式与聚类清洗, GPT-4o辅助, 人工重写与检查表标注
metric: Constraint Satisfaction Rate, Instruction Satisfaction Rate, Session Stability Rate
eval_feature: 多轮
build_method_en: Real-log collection, heuristic and clustering cleanup, GPT-4o assistance, human rewriting and checklist annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn
intro_en: SysBench systematically evaluates whether LLMs follow system messages. It contains 500 five-turn sessions and 2,500 user turns spanning six verifiable constraint types, aligned and misaligned instructions, and parallel and dependent multi-turn relations.
metric_en: Constraint Satisfaction Rate, Instruction Satisfaction Rate, Session Stability Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SysBench arXiv:2408.10943 Section 3 and Appendix A; official PKU-Baichuan-MLSystemLab/SysBench repository. SysBench starts from thousands of system messages in online logs and defines six atomic, verifiable constraint types: action, content, background, role, format, and style. Heuristic rules and clustering remove duplicates and noise. Twenty-one trained annotators select and refine 500 system messages for explicit tasks and diverse constraints. GPT-4o assists conversation generation; annotators retain and rewrite five user rounds per system message under expert guidelines. The 500 sessions contain 2,500 turns: 144 parallel and 356 dependent sessions, with 1,951 aligned and 549 misaligned instructions and 2.38 constraints per instruction on average. Annotators write a checklist for every instruction, and multiple experts perform independent multi-round review. During evaluation, the target model receives the system message, conversation history, and current user instruction. An advanced-LLM verifier receives the same context plus the checklist and judges every relevant constraint as binary satisfied or not. Constraint Satisfaction Rate averages atomic checks, Instruction Satisfaction Rate requires all constraints in a response, and Session Stability Rate measures the consecutive fully satisfied prefix from the start of each dialogue.

name: SysBench-ISR
intro: SysBench-ISR 不是独立数据集，而是 GLM-4.5 报告对原始 SysBench 的指令满足率（ISR）指标切片。它复用 SysBench 的500个会话、2500轮对话及逐指令约束检查表；只有一条回复同时满足该指令的全部约束时，该指令才计为满足。
org: Z.ai, Tsinghua University; SysBench by Peking University and Baichuan AI
build_method: 复用SysBench：在线日志筛选、21名标注者、GPT-4o辅助五轮对话、逐指令约束检查表、多专家复核
eval_feature: SysBench指标切片, 全约束同时满足, LLM验证器
build_method_en: Reuses SysBench: online-log filtering, 21 annotators, GPT-4o-assisted five-turn dialogues, per-instruction constraint checklists, and multi-expert review
eval_feature_en: SysBench metric slice, all-constraints satisfaction, LLM verifier
intro_en: SysBench-ISR is not a separate dataset; it is the Instruction Satisfaction Rate slice of the original SysBench used in the GLM-4.5 report. It reuses SysBench's 500 sessions, 2,500 turns, and per-instruction constraint checklists. An instruction counts only when every associated constraint is satisfied.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with GLM-4.5 arXiv:2508.06471 Sections 3.3 and 4.2.4, including Figure 9; SysBench arXiv:2408.10943 Section 3 and Appendix A; official PKU-Baichuan-MLSystemLab/SysBench repository. SysBench-ISR is not a separate benchmark dataset. The GLM-4.5 report uses the Instruction Satisfaction Rate slice of the original SysBench for instruction-following evaluation and shows it as the SysBench-ISR training curve. The underlying SysBench defines six atomic constraint types, cleans thousands of online system messages with heuristics and clustering, and has twenty-one trained annotators select 500 system messages. GPT-4o assists five-round conversation generation; annotators rewrite the conversations, label aligned and misaligned instructions plus parallel and dependent sessions, and write a constraint checklist for every instruction. Multi-expert review freezes 500 sessions and 2,500 turns. During evaluation, the target model receives the system message, dialogue history, and current instruction. An advanced-LLM verifier uses the same context plus the checklist to judge every relevant constraint as satisfied or not. ISR counts an instruction only when all associated constraints are satisfied, then averages this binary result over instructions. GLM-4.5 reports this metric slice rather than a new SysBench-ISR dataset.

name: T-Eval
intro: T-Eval把工具使用分解为规划、推理、检索、理解、调用和复审六种能力。其553条经两轮人工核验的黄金工具轨迹由15个工具的完整文档、GPT生成查询、多智能体轨迹和人工筛选构成，并拆解为23,305个分步测试用例。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Tsinghua University, Jilin Un
build_method: 工具文档构建、GPT-3.5查询生成、GPT-4润色、多智能体轨迹生成、两轮人工核验
metric: 规划、推理、检索、理解、调用、复审六项分数及总体平均分
eval_feature: 过程级评测, 黄金工具轨迹, 六能力分解
scale: 553条黄金工具轨迹、23,305个分步测试用例
build_method_en: Tool-document construction, GPT-3.5 query generation, GPT-4 refinement, multi-agent trajectory generation, and two-round human verification
eval_feature_en: Process-level evaluation, golden tool trajectories, six-ability decomposition
intro_en: T-Eval decomposes tool use into planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, invocation, and review. Its 553 golden tool trajectories are built from full documentation for 15 tools, GPT-generated queries, multi-agent trajectories, and two rounds of human verification, then decomposed into 23,305 step-level test cases.
scale_en: 553 golden tool trajectories and 23,305 step-level test cases
metric_en: Planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, invocation, review, and overall mean
drawio_review_note: Aligned with T-Eval arXiv:2312.14033 Sections 2-4 and Appendices; official open-compass/T-Eval repository. T-Eval decomposes tool utilization into planning, reasoning, retrieval, understanding, invocation, and review. The benchmark defines 15 tools across Research, Travel, Entertainment, Web, Life, and Financial domains and supplies complete human-written tool documentation. Tools are uniformly sampled, GPT-3.5 generates user queries from shuffled documentation and few-shot examples, and GPT-4 refines them. A planner, executor, and reviewer multi-agent annotator produces golden thought-action-observation-review trajectories. Humans review and filter 1,500 initial instruction-solution pairs twice, retaining 553 golden trajectories that are decomposed into 23,305 step-level test cases. Planning compares predicted and golden action sequences with Sentence-BERT similarity, Hopcroft-Karp matching, and ordered-sequence matching. Reasoning compares the next thought, retrieval checks the next tool, understanding compares parameters, invocation checks tool name and arguments, and review is a five-way multiple-choice diagnosis. The six subset scores are averaged for overall process performance; end-to-end win rate is also reported in the paper.

name: T2I-CompBench
intro: T2I-CompBench（原始NeurIPS 2023版本）用6000条提示评测文本到图像模型的组合生成能力，覆盖颜色、形状、纹理、空间关系、非空间关系和复杂组合六个子类。本条目固定对应arXiv v2，不混入后续8000提示的CompBench++。
org: The University of Hong Kong, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: 规则模板与ChatGPT生成、六子类均衡、已见/未见组合划分、人工验证
eval_feature: 开放世界组合生成, 六子类, 每提示生成10张图
scale: 6000条提示（六个子类各1000条；每类700训练、300测试）
build_method_en: Rule templates and ChatGPT generation, six-subcategory balancing, seen/unseen composition splits, and human validation
eval_feature_en: Open-world compositional generation, six subcategories, ten images per prompt
intro_en: T2I-CompBench (the original NeurIPS 2023 version) uses 6,000 prompts to evaluate compositional text-to-image generation across color, shape, texture, spatial, non-spatial, and complex compositions. This entry is pinned to arXiv v2 and does not mix in the later 8,000-prompt CompBench++.
scale_en: 6,000 prompts (1,000 per subcategory; 700 train and 300 test each)
metric_en: BLIP-VQA, UniDet, CLIPScore, 3-in-1, MiniGPT4-CoT, and human rating
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Original T2I-CompBench conference paper arXiv:2307.06350v2 Sections 3-4 and 6.2; official Karine-Huang/T2I-CompBench repository and project page. This entry intentionally excludes the later T2I-CompBench++ v3 expansion.. This entry follows the original NeurIPS 2023 T2I-CompBench conference version, not the later 8,000-prompt T2I-CompBench++. The original benchmark contains 6,000 prompts across three categories and six subcategories: 3,000 attribute-binding prompts for color, shape, and texture; 2,000 relationship prompts for spatial and non-spatial relations; and 1,000 complex-composition prompts. Each subcategory has 1,000 prompts split into 700 training and 300 test prompts with seen and unseen compositions balanced. Rules and ChatGPT generate template and natural prompts; color prompts combine CC-500, COCO, and ChatGPT sources, spatial prompts include seven relation types and contrastive swaps, and complex prompts cover four scenarios. Models generate ten images per prompt. Disentangled BLIP-VQA multiplies independent object-attribute probabilities, UniDet and geometric rules score spatial relations, CLIPScore evaluates non-spatial relations, and the 3-in-1 complex score averages CLIP, BLIP-VQA, and UniDet. MiniGPT4-CoT is an auxiliary unified metric. Human validation samples 25 prompts per subcategory, two images per prompt, and three MTurk raters who use a normalized five-point scale.

name: T2V-CompBench
intro: T2V-CompBench用1400条经人工核验的提示评测文本到视频组合生成，覆盖一致属性、动态属性、空间关系、运动绑定、动作绑定、物体交互和生成计数七类，并为每类选择经人工相关性验证的MLLM、检测或跟踪指标。
org: The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: VidProM语料分析、WordNet概念筛选、GPT-4生成与解析、人工核验、七类均衡
metric: Grid-LLaVA、D-LLaVA、Grounding DINO、SAM+Depth Anything、DOT跟踪及人工相关性
eval_feature: 七类组合视频生成, 类别专用自动指标, 人工相关性验证
build_method_en: VidProM corpus analysis, WordNet concept filtering, GPT-4 generation and parsing, human verification, and seven-category balancing
eval_feature_en: Seven compositional video categories, category-specific automatic metrics, human correlation validation
intro_en: T2V-CompBench uses 1,400 human-verified prompts to evaluate compositional text-to-video generation across consistent attributes, dynamic attributes, spatial relations, motion binding, action binding, object interactions, and generative numeracy. Each category uses MLLM-, detection-, or tracking-based metrics selected through human-correlation validation.
scale_en: 1,400 prompts (200 in each of seven categories)
metric_en: Grid-LLaVA, D-LLaVA, Grounding DINO, SAM + Depth Anything, DOT tracking, and human correlation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with T2V-CompBench arXiv:2407.14505v2 Sections 3-5 and Appendix; official KaiyueSun98/T2V-CompBench repository and t2v-compbench-2025 project page. T2V-CompBench contains 1,400 prompts, with 200 prompts in each of seven categories: consistent attribute binding, dynamic attribute binding, spatial relationships, motion binding, action binding, object interactions, and generative numeracy. The authors analyze 1.67 million unique VidProM prompts, organize concepts with WordNet metaclasses, retain thing rather than stuff objects, and collect 260 nouns, 200 active verbs, and 80 attributes. GPT-4 generates free-form prompts and parsed metadata; every prompt includes an active verb, humans verify and filter the outputs, and challenging uncommon concepts make up 20 percent of relevant categories. Evaluation samples six frames for MLLM metrics, sixteen for detection, and videos at eight frames per second for tracking. Grid-LLaVA scores consistent attributes, actions, and interactions from six-frame grids with chain-of-thought and disentangled questions. D-LLaVA checks initial and final frames for dynamic attributes. Grounding DINO plus geometric rules scores spatial and numeric composition, with SAM and Depth Anything supporting 3D relations. DOT tracks foreground and background motion. Human validation covers 651 videos with three MTurk raters and uses Kendall and Spearman correlations to select the category-specific automatic metrics.

name: TableVQA-Bench
intro: TableVQA-Bench把WikiTableQuestions、TabFact和FinTabNet改造成包含表格图像、HTML与问答的视觉表格基准，形成VWTQ、VWTQ-Syn、VTabFact和FinTabNetQA四个子集，共1500组问答、894张表格图像。
build_method: 既有表格QA/事实核验数据改造、样式表与自定义渲染、GPT-4生成金融QA、人工复核
metric: 归一化准确率、真假分类准确率、FinTabNetQA宽松准确率
task_type: 表格问答, 文档理解
eval_feature: 四域视觉表格问答, 图像与HTML配对, 数据集专用答案规范化
build_method_en: Conversion of table-QA and fact-verification datasets, stylesheet and custom rendering, GPT-4 financial QA generation, and human review
eval_feature_en: Four-domain visual table QA, paired image and HTML, dataset-specific answer normalization
intro_en: TableVQA-Bench converts WikiTableQuestions, TabFact, and FinTabNet into a visual table benchmark containing table images, HTML, and QA. Its VWTQ, VWTQ-Syn, VTabFact, and FinTabNetQA subsets total 1,500 QA pairs over 894 table images.
metric_en: Normalized accuracy, true/false accuracy, and relaxed FinTabNetQA accuracy
drawio_review_note: Aligned with TableVQA-Bench arXiv:2404.19205 Sections 3-4; official naver-ai/tablevqabench repository and released dataset card. TableVQA-Bench converts WikiTableQuestions, TabFact, and FinTabNet into four visual table-QA subsets containing an image, HTML, and QA for every sample. VWTQ applies a Wikipedia stylesheet to WikiTableQuestions tables. VWTQ-Syn uses a custom renderer to create more varied styles. VTabFact renders TabFact tables and converts entailed or refuted statements into True or False questions. FinTabNet originally lacks QA, so GPT-4 generates questions and answers from text- and HTML-formatted financial tables; authors manually revise scale-unit errors. Tables with more than fifty rows are filtered and the authors review the released samples. The final benchmark contains 1,500 QA pairs over 894 table images: 750 VWTQ, 250 VWTQ-Syn, 250 VTabFact, and 250 FinTabNetQA. Evaluation sends the table image and question to each model, normalizes free-form answers for VWTQ and VWTQ-Syn, uses binary accuracy for VTabFact, and uses relieved accuracy that tolerates scale-unit variation for FinTabNetQA. Results are reported for every subset and as the benchmark aggregate.

name: TACO
intro: TACO是一个开源的大规模代码生成数据集，聚焦算法与编程技能，旨在为代码生成模型提供更具挑战性的训练数据和评测基准。TACO包含竞赛级编程问题，用于增强或评估模型在真实编程场景中的问题理解与推理能力。每个问题都带有主题、算法、编程技能和难度等级等细粒度标签，为训练与评测提供更精确的依据。
build_method: 多源爬取与整合, 可执行解答验证, MinHash去重, GPT-4测试增强, 多维标注
eval_feature: 细粒度标签
scale: 25,443个训练问题 + 1,000个测试问题；1,539,152个验证解答
build_method_en: Multi-Source Collection, Executable-Solution Validation, MinHash Deduplication, GPT-4 Test Augmentation, Multidimensional Annotation
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained Labels
intro_en: TACO is an open-source, large-scale code-generation dataset focused on algorithms and programming skills. It provides challenging competition-level problems for training and evaluating problem understanding and reasoning in realistic programming scenarios. Each problem includes fine-grained topic, algorithm, skill, and difficulty labels.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2312.14852 and the official FlagOpen TACO repository. The detailed contribution, dataset table, and official repository consistently specify 25,443 training problems plus 1,000 test problems; this is used instead of the isolated 25,433 figure in the abstract. Four platforms are crawled directly and APPS, CodeContest, and Description2code are integrated. Newly crawled solutions are executed, Python 2 code is converted with 2to3, failures are removed, and MinHash with a 0.85 Jaccard threshold deduplicates normalized AST code. The initial 2,045,502 examples become 1,539,152 verified Python 3 solutions. GPT-4 proposes test inputs, 30 verified solutions establish consensus outputs, and augmentation repeats until at least 200 tests. The release consolidates 968 labels into 36 algorithm categories and eight programming skills. Evaluation samples 200 attempts per problem with top_p 0.95 and difficulty temperatures 0.2, 0.6, and 0.8, requires every test to pass, and reports Pass@1, Pass@10, and Pass@100.

name: TallyQA
intro: TallyQA是一个开放式视觉计数问答基准，包含简单计数题和需要属性、关系或位置推理的复杂计数题，共287907道题。
build_method: 混合：导入、合成与人工标注
task_type: 视觉问答, 计数推理
build_method_en: Hybrid: imported, synthetic, and human annotated
eval_feature_en: Separate simple and human-vetted complex test splits
intro_en: TallyQA is an open-ended visual counting QA benchmark containing both simple object-counting questions and complex questions that require attribute, relational, or positional reasoning, with 287,907 questions in total.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with TallyQA AAAI 2019 paper Section 3 and official manoja328/TallyQA_dataset repository. TallyQA combines imported and newly collected open-ended counting questions. Questions beginning with How many and having integer answers from zero through fifteen are imported from VQA2 and Visual Genome; VQA2 items require agreement from at least five of ten annotators. The authors also import synthetic TDIUC questions and construct absent-object zero-count items. Targeted AMT tasks with about 800 annotators produce 19,500 complex questions over 17,545 images; nonzero questions must include counterexamples and a separate task creates hard zero-answer questions. The authors manually remove low-quality or insufficiently complex items. A conservative linguistic classifier strips generic image phrases, applies spaCy POS tagging, and labels a question simple only when it contains one noun and no adjective or adverb.
